However, existing approaches lack a principled understanding of how agents should balance these two modalities and how to enable iterative self-improvement across diverse applications. We formulate MCP-GUI interplay as a unified hybrid policy learning problem where the agent learns when each modality provides complementary advantages, and show that distillation and experience augmentation target fundamentally different failure modes - requiring application-aware mechanism selection. Built on this formulation, we propose a self-evolving framework with a fully automatic pipeline that orchestrates automatic environment generation and validation, trajectory collection, gap-driven task synthesis, and quality-filtered training - all without manual intervention. A key innovation is our experience bank, which accumulates LLM-learned rules from trajectory comparison, enabling inference-time improvement without fine-tuning. Systematic \textbf{cross-application analysis} across three desktop applications reveals that the optimal strategy depends on MCP-GUI composition: distillation achieves 77.8\% pass rate on MCP-dominant tasks (+17.8pp), while the experience bank excels on GUI-intensive tasks (+10.0pp).

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个自进化框架，通过自动环境生成、轨迹收集、任务合成和质量筛选训练，让计算机使用代理在MCP和GUI两种交互模式间智能切换，实现无需人工干预的自我改进。
AI.motivation: 现有的计算机使用代理结合了GUI交互和MCP结构化API调用，但缺乏对如何平衡这两种模式以及如何实现跨应用迭代自我改进的原则性理解。
AI.method: 将MCP-GUI交互表述为统一的混合策略学习问题，提出自进化框架，包括自动环境生成与验证、轨迹收集、基于差距的任务合成、质量筛选训练，以及创新的经验库积累LLM学习规则。
AI.result: 跨三个桌面应用的系统分析显示：蒸馏方法在MCP主导任务上达到77.8%通过率（+17.8pp），而经验库在GUI密集型任务上表现更佳（+10.0pp），最优策略取决于MCP-GUI组合。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为MCP-GUI交互提供了原则性框架，展示了蒸馏和经验增强针对不同失败模式，需要应用感知的机制选择，并通过经验库实现无需微调的推理时改进。

title: F3G-Avatar : Face Focused Full-body Gaussian Avatar
summary: Existing full-body Gaussian avatar methods primarily optimize global reconstruction quality and often fail to preserve fine-grained facial geometry and expression details. This challenge arises from limited facial representational capacity that causes difficulties in modeling high-frequency pose-dependent deformations. To address this, we propose F3G-Avatar, a full-body, face-aware avatar synthesis method that reconstructs animatable human representations from multi-view RGB video and regressed pose/shape parameters. Starting from a clothed Momentum Human Rig (MHR) template, front/back positional maps are rendered and decoded into 3D Gaussians through a two-branch architecture: a body branch that captures pose-dependent non-rigid deformations and a face-focused deformation branch that refines head geometry and appearance. The predicted Gaussians are fused, posed with linear blend skinning (LBS), and rendered with differentiable Gaussian splatting. Training combines reconstruction and perceptual objectives with a face-specific adversarial loss to enhance realism in close-up views. Experiments demonstrate strong rendering quality, with face-view performance reaching PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS of 26.243/0.964/0.084 on the AvatarReX dataset. Ablations further highlight contributions of the MHR template and the face-focused deformation. F3G-Avatar provides a practical, high-quality pipeline for realistic, animatable full-body avatar synthesis.

AI.tldr: F3G-Avatar：一种全身体、面部感知的虚拟化身合成方法，通过双分支架构优化面部几何和表情细节，在保持高质量全身重建的同时显著提升面部渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有全身高斯虚拟化身方法主要优化全局重建质量，但难以保留细粒度的面部几何和表情细节。这源于有限的面部表示能力，导致难以建模高频姿势相关变形。
AI.method: 从穿衣的Momentum Human Rig模板开始，渲染前后位置图并通过双分支架构解码为3D高斯：身体分支捕捉姿势相关的非刚性变形，面部专注变形分支细化头部几何和外观。预测的高斯通过线性混合蒙皮进行姿势调整，并使用可微分高斯溅射进行渲染。训练结合重建和感知目标，并添加面部特定的对抗损失以增强特写视图的真实感。
AI.result: 在AvatarReX数据集上，面部视图性能达到PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS为26.243/0.964/0.084。消融实验进一步突出了MHR模板和面部专注变形分支的贡献。
AI.conclusion: F3G-Avatar为真实、可动画的全身虚拟化身合成提供了一个实用、高质量的管道，在保持全身重建质量的同时显著提升了面部细节的保真度。

title: CodaRAG: Connecting the Dots with Associativity Inspired by Complementary Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with knowledge-intensive tasks due to hallucinations and fragmented reasoning over dispersed information. While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds generation in external sources, existing methods often treat evidence as isolated units, failing to reconstruct the logical chains that connect these dots. Inspired by Complementary Learning Systems (CLS), we propose CodaRAG, a framework that evolves retrieval from passive lookup into active associative discovery. CodaRAG operates via a three-stage pipeline: (1) Knowledge Consolidation to unify fragmented extractions into a stable memory substrate; (2) Associative Navigation to traverse the graph via multi-dimensional pathways-semantic, contextualized, and functional-explicitly recovering dispersed evidence chains; and (3) Interference Elimination to prune hyper-associative noise, ensuring a coherent, high-precision reasoning context. On GraphRAG-Bench, CodaRAG achieves absolute gains of 7-10% in retrieval recall and 3-11% in generation accuracy. These results demonstrate CodaRAG's superior ability to systematically robustify associative evidence retrieval for factual, reasoning, and creative tasks.

AI.tldr: CodaRAG是一个基于互补学习系统启发的检索增强生成框架，通过知识整合、关联导航和干扰消除三阶段流程，将检索从被动查找转变为主动关联发现，显著提升了检索召回率和生成准确性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在知识密集型任务中存在幻觉问题，且对分散信息的推理能力有限。现有的检索增强生成方法通常将证据视为孤立单元，无法重建连接这些证据的逻辑链条，因此需要一种能够主动发现关联证据链的框架。
AI.method: CodaRAG采用三阶段流水线：1) 知识整合：将碎片化提取的信息统一为稳定的记忆基质；2) 关联导航：通过语义、情境化和功能等多维路径遍历图结构，显式恢复分散的证据链；3) 干扰消除：修剪过度关联的噪声，确保连贯、高精度的推理上下文。
AI.result: 在GraphRAG-Bench基准测试中，CodaRAG在检索召回率上实现了7-10%的绝对提升，在生成准确性上实现了3-11%的绝对提升，展示了其在事实性、推理性和创造性任务中系统性地增强关联证据检索的能力。
AI.conclusion: CodaRAG通过将检索从被动查找转变为主动关联发现，显著提升了检索增强生成系统的性能，特别是在恢复分散证据链方面表现出色，为知识密集型任务提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: COMPOSITE-Stem
summary: AI agents hold growing promise for accelerating scientific discovery; yet, a lack of frontier evaluations hinders adoption into real workflows. Expert-written benchmarks have proven effective at measuring AI reasoning, but most at this stage have become saturated and only measure performance on constrained outputs. To help address this gap, we introduce COMPOSITE-STEM, a benchmark of 70 expert-written tasks in physics, biology, chemistry, and mathematics, curated by doctoral-level researchers. Our benchmark combines exact-match grading and criterion-based rubrics with an LLM-as-a-jury grading protocol, allowing more flexible assessment of scientifically meaningful outputs. Using an adapted multimodal Terminus-2 agent harness within the Harbor agentic evaluation framework, we evaluate four frontier models. The top-performing model achieves 21%, demonstrating that COMPOSITE-STEM captures capabilities beyond current agent reach. All tasks are open-sourced with contributor permission to support reproducibility and to promote additional research towards AI's acceleration of scientific progress in these domains.

AI.tldr: COMPOSITE-STEM是一个由博士级研究人员编写的70个STEM任务基准测试，结合精确匹配和基于标准的评估，用于评估AI代理在科学发现中的能力，目前最佳模型仅达到21%准确率。
AI.motivation: AI代理在加速科学发现方面具有巨大潜力，但缺乏前沿评估阻碍了其在真实工作流程中的应用。现有的专家编写基准测试大多已经饱和，且仅能评估受限输出，需要更灵活的评估方法来衡量AI在科学领域的推理能力。
AI.method: 开发了包含70个物理、生物、化学和数学任务的COMPOSITE-STEM基准测试，采用精确匹配评分和基于标准的评分标准，结合LLM作为评审团的评分协议。在Harbor代理评估框架中使用改进的多模态Terminus-2代理来评估四个前沿模型。
AI.result: 最佳性能模型仅达到21%的准确率，表明COMPOSITE-STEM基准测试捕捉到了超出当前AI代理能力范围的科学推理能力。所有任务都已开源，以支持可重复性和进一步研究。
AI.conclusion: COMPOSITE-STEM基准测试为评估AI代理在科学发现中的能力提供了更灵活的评估框架，揭示了当前AI在复杂科学任务中的局限性，并开源了所有任务以促进该领域的研究进展。

title: Vector Field Synthesis with Sparse Streamlines Using Diffusion Model
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures; published at IEEE VIS 2025
summary: We present a novel diffusion-based framework for synthesizing 2D vector fields from sparse, coherent inputs (i.e., streamlines) while maintaining physical plausibility. Our method employs a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model with classifier-free guidance, enabling progressive reconstruction that preserves both geometric and physical constraints. Experimental results demonstrate our method's ability to synthesize plausible vector fields that adhere to physical laws while maintaining fidelity to sparse input observations, outperforming traditional optimization-based approaches in terms of flexibility and physical consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于扩散模型的框架，从稀疏、连贯的流线输入合成二维矢量场，同时保持物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 传统优化方法在从稀疏流线输入合成矢量场时，在灵活性和物理一致性方面存在局限，需要一种能同时保持几何约束和物理约束的方法。
AI.method: 采用条件去噪扩散概率模型，结合无分类器引导，实现渐进式重建，同时保持几何和物理约束。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该方法能够合成符合物理定律的合理矢量场，同时保持对稀疏输入观测的保真度，在灵活性和物理一致性方面优于传统优化方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的扩散框架能够有效地从稀疏流线输入合成物理合理的矢量场，为矢量场合成提供了新的解决方案。

title: Instruction Data Selection via Answer Divergence
summary: Instruction tuning relies on large instruction-response corpora whose quality and composition strongly affect downstream performance. We propose Answer Divergence-Guided Selection (ADG), which selects instruction data based on the geometric structure of multi-sample outputs. ADG draws several high-temperature generations per instruction, maps responses into an embedding space, and computes an output divergence score that jointly encodes dispersion magnitude and shape anisotropy. High scores correspond to instructions whose answers are both far apart and multi-modal, rather than clustered paraphrases along a single direction. Across two backbones and three public instruction pools, fine-tuning on only 10K ADG-selected examples consistently outperforms strong selectors on six benchmarks spanning reasoning, knowledge, and coding. Analyses further show that both dispersion magnitude and shape anisotropy are necessary, supporting answer divergence as a practical signal for instruction data selection. Code and appendix are included in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: ADG方法通过分析指令的多样本输出在嵌入空间的几何结构（分散度和形状各向异性）来筛选高质量的指令数据，仅用1万条精选数据就能在多个基准测试中超越现有选择方法。
AI.motivation: 指令调优依赖于大规模指令-响应语料库，其质量和组成严重影响下游性能。现有方法在筛选高质量指令数据方面存在不足，需要更有效的选择策略。
AI.method: 提出答案分歧引导选择（ADG）：为每条指令生成多个高温采样响应，将响应映射到嵌入空间，计算输出分歧分数，该分数同时编码分散幅度和形状各向异性。高分对应那些答案既分散又多模态的指令，而不是沿着单一方向的聚类释义。
AI.result: 在两个骨干模型和三个公共指令池上，仅用1万条ADG选择的示例进行微调，在涵盖推理、知识和编码的六个基准测试中始终优于强基线选择器。分析表明分散幅度和形状各向异性都是必要的。
AI.conclusion: 答案分歧是指导指令数据选择的实用信号，ADG方法能有效筛选出高质量的指令数据，提升指令调优的性能。

title: Steered LLM Activations are Non-Surjective
comment: 10 pages main text. ICLR 2026 Workshops (Sci4DL, Re-Align)
summary: Activation steering is a popular white-box control technique that modifies model activations to elicit an abstract change in output behavior. It has also become a standard tool in interpretability (e.g., probing truthfulness, or translating activations into human-readable explanations and safety research (e.g., studying jailbreakability). However, it is unclear whether steered activation states are realizable by any textual prompt. In this work, we cast this question as a surjectivity problem: for a fixed model, does every steered activation admit a pre-image under the model's natural forward pass? Under practical assumptions, we prove that activation steering pushes the residual stream off the manifold of states reachable from discrete prompts. Almost surely, no prompt can reproduce the same internal behavior induced by steering. We also illustrate this finding empirically across three widely used LLMs. Our results establish a formal separation between white-box steerability and black-box prompting. We therefore caution against interpreting the ease and success of activation steering as evidence of prompt-based interpretability or vulnerability, and argue for evaluation protocols that explicitly decouple white-box and black-box interventions.

AI.tldr: 激活引导技术虽然能有效改变模型输出行为，但研究发现这些被引导的激活状态无法通过任何文本提示实现，表明白盒引导与黑盒提示之间存在形式化分离
AI.motivation: 激活引导已成为解释性和安全研究的常用工具，但尚不清楚被引导的激活状态是否真的能被任何文本提示实现。本研究旨在验证激活引导是否会产生无法通过正常文本输入达到的激活状态。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为满射性问题：对于固定模型，每个被引导的激活是否在模型自然前向传播下存在原像？在实践假设下，证明激活引导会将残差流推离离散提示可达的状态流形。通过三个广泛使用的LLM进行实证验证。
AI.result: 理论上证明激活引导几乎必然产生无法通过任何提示复现的内部行为状态。实证结果在三个LLM上都支持这一发现，确认了白盒可引导性与黑盒提示之间的形式化分离。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导的成功不应被解释为基于提示的解释性或脆弱性证据。需要建立明确区分白盒和黑盒干预的评估协议，避免将激活引导的易用性和效果过度推广到提示场景。

title: NOSE: Neural Olfactory-Semantic Embedding with Tri-Modal Orthogonal Contrastive Learning
comment: Accepted to the ACL 2026 Main Conference
summary: Olfaction lies at the intersection of chemical structure, neural encoding, and linguistic perception, yet existing representation methods fail to fully capture this pathway. Current approaches typically model only isolated segments of the olfactory pathway, overlooking the complete chain from molecule to receptors to linguistic descriptions. Such fragmentation yields learned embeddings that lack both biological grounding and semantic interpretability. We propose NOSE (Neural Olfactory-Semantic Embedding), a representation learning framework that aligns three modalities along the olfactory pathway: molecular structure, receptor sequence, and natural language description. Rather than simply fusing these signals, we decouple their contributions via orthogonal constraints, preserving the unique encoded information of each modality. To address the sparsity of olfactory language, we introduce a weak positive sample strategy to calibrate semantic similarity, preventing erroneous repulsion of similar odors in the feature space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NOSE achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance and excellent zero-shot generalization, confirming the strong alignment between its representation space and human olfactory intuition.

AI.tldr: NOSE是一个跨模态表示学习框架，通过正交约束对齐分子结构、受体序列和自然语言描述，解决现有嗅觉表示方法碎片化的问题，实现了SOTA性能和优秀的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有嗅觉表示方法通常只建模嗅觉通路的孤立片段，忽略了从分子到受体再到语言描述的完整链条，导致学习到的嵌入缺乏生物学基础和语义可解释性。
AI.method: 提出NOSE框架，对齐嗅觉通路上的三个模态：分子结构、受体序列和自然语言描述。通过正交约束解耦各模态的贡献，保留每个模态的独特编码信息。针对嗅觉语言的稀疏性，引入弱正样本策略校准语义相似性。
AI.result: NOSE在广泛实验中实现了最先进的性能，并展现出优秀的零样本泛化能力，证实其表示空间与人类嗅觉直觉之间存在强对齐关系。
AI.conclusion: NOSE框架通过跨模态对齐成功捕捉了嗅觉通路的完整链条，解决了现有方法的碎片化问题，为嗅觉表示学习提供了生物学基础和语义可解释性。

title: MEMENTO: Teaching LLMs to Manage Their Own Context
summary: Reasoning models think in long, unstructured streams with no mechanism for compressing or organizing their own intermediate state. We introduce MEMENTO: a method that teaches models to segment reasoning into blocks, compress each block into a memento, i.e., a dense state summary, and reason forward by attending only to mementos, reducing context, KV cache, and compute. To train MEMENTO models, we release OpenMementos, a public dataset of 228K reasoning traces derived from OpenThoughts-v3, segmented and annotated with intermediate summaries. We show that a two-stage SFT recipe on OpenMementos is effective across different model families (Qwen3, Phi-4, Olmo 3) and scales (8B--32B parameters). Trained models maintain strong accuracy on math, science, and coding benchmarks while achieving ${\sim}2.5\times$ peak KV cache reduction. We extend vLLM to support our inference method, achieving ${\sim}1.75\times$ throughput improvement while also enabling us to perform RL and further improve accuracy. Finally, we identify a dual information stream: information from each reasoning block is carried both by the memento text and by the corresponding KV states, which retain implicit information from the original block. Removing this channel drops accuracy by 15\,pp on AIME24.

AI.tldr: MEMENTO是一种让推理模型将推理过程分段压缩为密集状态摘要（memento）的方法，通过仅关注memento来减少上下文、KV缓存和计算开销，同时保持推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 当前推理模型在长而无结构的推理流中缺乏压缩和组织中间状态的机制，导致计算效率低下。需要一种方法让模型能够分段压缩推理状态，提高计算效率同时保持准确性。
AI.method: 1. 提出MEMENTO方法：教导模型将推理分段，将每段压缩为密集状态摘要（memento），然后仅基于memento进行后续推理；2. 发布OpenMementos数据集：包含22.8万个从OpenThoughts-v3衍生的推理轨迹，已分段并标注中间摘要；3. 采用两阶段SFT训练方法在不同模型家族和规模上进行训练；4. 扩展vLLM以支持该推理方法。
AI.result: 1. 训练后的模型在数学、科学和编码基准测试中保持强准确性；2. 实现约2.5倍的峰值KV缓存减少；3. 通过扩展vLLM实现约1.75倍的吞吐量提升；4. 发现双重信息流现象：推理块信息同时通过memento文本和对应的KV状态传递，移除该通道会导致AIME24准确率下降15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: MEMENTO方法有效解决了推理模型中间状态压缩问题，在保持准确性的同时显著提升了计算效率，为高效推理模型设计提供了新思路。

title: Training-Free Object-Background Compositional T2I via Dynamic Spatial Guidance and Multi-Path Pruning
summary: Existing text-to-image diffusion models, while excelling at subject synthesis, exhibit a persistent foreground bias that treats the background as a passive and under-optimized byproduct. This imbalance compromises global scene coherence and constrains compositional control. To address the limitation, we propose a training-free framework that restructures diffusion sampling to explicitly account for foreground-background interactions. Our approach consists of two key components. First, Dynamic Spatial Guidance introduces a soft, time step dependent gating mechanism that modulates foreground and background attention during the diffusion process, enabling spatially balanced generation. Second, Multi-Path Pruning performs multi-path latent exploration and dynamically filters candidate trajectories using both internal attention statistics and external semantic alignment signals, retaining trajectories that better satisfy object-background constraints. We further develop a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate object-background compositionality. Extensive evaluations across multiple diffusion backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in background coherence and object-background compositional alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的方法解决文本到图像扩散模型的前景偏见问题，通过动态空间引导和多路径剪枝改善前景-背景交互和场景一致性
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型存在持续的前景偏见，将背景视为被动且未充分优化的副产品，这种不平衡损害了全局场景一致性并限制了组合控制能力
AI.method: 提出无需训练的框架，包含两个关键组件：1) 动态空间引导 - 引入软性的时间步依赖门控机制，在扩散过程中调节前景和背景注意力；2) 多路径剪枝 - 执行多路径潜在探索，使用内部注意力统计和外部语义对齐信号动态过滤候选轨迹
AI.result: 在多个扩散骨干网络上进行广泛评估，在背景一致性和对象-背景组合对齐方面展示了一致的改进效果，并开发了专门评估对象-背景组合性的基准
AI.conclusion: 通过重新构建扩散采样过程来显式考虑前景-背景交互，有效解决了扩散模型的前景偏见问题，提高了场景生成的整体质量和组合控制能力

title: Instructing LLMs to Negotiate using Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: The recent advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has established their potential as autonomous interactive agents. However, they often struggle in strategic games of incomplete information, such as bilateral price negotiation. In this paper, we investigate if Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) can effectively teach LLMs to negotiate. Specifically, we explore the strategic behaviors that emerge during the learning process. We introduce a framework that trains a mid-sized buyer agent against a regulated LLM seller across a wide distribution of real-world products. By grounding reward signals directly in the maximization of economic surplus and strict adherence to private budget constraints, we reveal a novel four-phase strategic evolution. The agent progresses from naive bargaining to using aggressive starting prices, moves through a phase of deadlock, and ultimately develops sophisticated persuasive skills. Our results demonstrate that this verifiable training allows a 30B agent to significantly outperform frontier models over ten times its size in extracting surplus. Furthermore, the trained agent generalizes robustly to stronger counterparties unseen during training and remains effective even when facing hostile, adversarial seller personas.

AI.tldr: 研究探索使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练LLM进行价格谈判，发现30B参数的智能体通过四阶段战略演化，在提取经济剩余方面显著优于大10倍的前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在战略性的不完全信息游戏（如双边价格谈判）中表现不佳，需要探索有效的训练方法来提升其谈判能力。
AI.method: 引入一个框架，训练中等规模的买方智能体与受监管的LLM卖方进行谈判，奖励信号基于经济剩余最大化和严格遵守私人预算约束，采用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）方法。
AI.result: 训练出的30B参数智能体在提取经济剩余方面显著优于大10倍的前沿模型，展现出四阶段战略演化：从天真议价到使用激进起始价格，经历僵局阶段，最终发展出复杂的说服技巧。
AI.conclusion: 可验证奖励的强化学习能有效训练LLM进行战略谈判，使较小模型在谈判任务上超越更大模型，并展现出良好的泛化能力和对抗性环境下的鲁棒性。

title: Do vision models perceive illusory motion in static images like humans?
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Workshops (Findings). * Equal contribution
summary: Understanding human motion processing is essential for building reliable, human-centered computer vision systems. Although deep neural networks (DNNs) achieve strong performance in optical flow estimation, they remain less robust than humans and rely on fundamentally different computational strategies. Visual motion illusions provide a powerful probe into these mechanisms, revealing how human and machine vision align or diverge. While recent DNN-based motion models can reproduce dynamic illusions such as reverse-phi, it remains unclear whether they can perceive illusory motion in static images, exemplified by the Rotating Snakes illusion. We evaluate several representative optical flow models on Rotating Snakes and show that most fail to generate flow fields consistent with human perception. Under simulated conditions mimicking saccadic eye movements, only the human-inspired Dual-Channel model exhibits the expected rotational motion, with the closest correspondence emerging during the saccade simulation. Ablation analyses further reveal that both luminance-based and higher-order color--feature--based motion signals contribute to this behavior and that a recurrent attention mechanism is critical for integrating local cues. Our results highlight a substantial gap between current optical-flow models and human visual motion processing, and offer insights for developing future motion-estimation systems with improved correspondence to human perception and human-centric AI.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了多个光流模型在静态旋转蛇错觉中的表现，发现只有受人类视觉启发的双通道模型能产生与人类感知一致的旋转运动，揭示了当前光流模型与人类视觉运动处理之间的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 理解人类运动处理对于构建可靠、以人为本的计算机视觉系统至关重要。虽然深度神经网络在光流估计方面表现出色，但它们仍不如人类稳健，且依赖不同的计算策略。视觉运动错觉为探究这些机制提供了有力工具，能揭示人类与机器视觉的异同。
AI.method: 评估了多个代表性光流模型在旋转蛇错觉上的表现，在模拟眼跳运动的条件下测试模型。通过消融分析探究了亮度信号、高阶颜色特征信号以及循环注意力机制对模型行为的影响。
AI.result: 大多数光流模型无法产生与人类感知一致的光流场。只有在模拟眼跳条件下，受人类视觉启发的双通道模型表现出预期的旋转运动，且最接近人类感知的结果出现在眼跳模拟期间。消融分析显示亮度信号和高阶颜色特征信号都对此行为有贡献，循环注意力机制对整合局部线索至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 当前光流模型与人类视觉运动处理之间存在显著差距，研究结果为开发更符合人类感知和以人为本AI的未来运动估计系统提供了重要见解。

title: Dynamic Adaptive Attention and Supervised Contrastive Learning: A Novel Hybrid Framework for Text Sentiment Classification
summary: The exponential growth of user-generated movie reviews on digital platforms has made accurate text sentiment classification a cornerstone task in natural language processing. Traditional models, including standard BERT and recurrent architectures, frequently struggle to capture long-distance semantic dependencies and resolve ambiguous emotional expressions in lengthy review texts. This paper proposes a novel hybrid framework that seamlessly integrates dynamic adaptive multi-head attention with supervised contrastive learning into a BERT-based Transformer encoder. The dynamic adaptive attention module employs a global context pooling vector to dynamically regulate the contribution of each attention head, thereby focusing on critical sentiment-bearing tokens while suppressing noise. Simultaneously, the supervised contrastive learning branch enforces tighter intra-class compactness and larger inter-class separation in the embedding space. Extensive experiments on the IMDB dataset demonstrate that the proposed model achieves competitive performance with an accuracy of 94.67\%, outperforming strong baselines by 1.5--2.5 percentage points. The framework is lightweight, efficient, and readily extensible to other text classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合动态自适应多头注意力与监督对比学习的BERT混合框架，用于提升电影评论情感分类的准确性，在IMDB数据集上达到94.67%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 随着数字平台上用户生成电影评论的指数级增长，准确的情感分类成为NLP核心任务。传统模型如标准BERT和循环架构难以捕捉长距离语义依赖并解决长文本中的模糊情感表达。
AI.method: 提出新颖的混合框架，将动态自适应多头注意力与监督对比学习集成到基于BERT的Transformer编码器中。动态自适应注意力模块使用全局上下文池化向量动态调节每个注意力头的贡献，聚焦关键情感承载词元并抑制噪声。监督对比学习分支则在嵌入空间中强制实现更紧密的类内紧凑性和更大的类间分离。
AI.result: 在IMDB数据集上的广泛实验表明，所提模型达到94.67%的准确率，比强基线高出1.5-2.5个百分点。该框架轻量高效，易于扩展到其他文本分类任务。
AI.conclusion: 提出的混合框架通过动态自适应注意力机制和监督对比学习的协同作用，有效提升了长文本情感分类的性能，为电影评论情感分析提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Evolutionary Token-Level Prompt Optimization for Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models exhibit strong generative performance but remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation, often requiring extensive manual trial and error to obtain satisfactory results. This motivates the development of automated, model-agnostic prompt optimization methods that can systematically explore the conditioning space beyond conventional text rewriting. This work investigates the use of a Genetic Algorithm (GA) for prompt optimization by directly evolving the token vectors employed by CLIP-based diffusion models. The GA optimizes a fitness function that combines aesthetic quality, measured by the LAION Aesthetic Predictor V2, with prompt-image alignment, assessed via CLIPScore. Experiments on 36 prompts from the Parti Prompts (P2) dataset show that the proposed approach outperforms the baseline methods, including Promptist and random search, achieving up to a 23.93% improvement in fitness. Overall, the method is adaptable to image generation models with tokenized text encoders and provides a modular framework for future extensions, the limitations and prospects of which are discussed.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出使用遗传算法直接优化CLIP扩散模型的token向量，结合美学质量和提示-图像对齐度作为适应度函数，在36个提示上相比基线方法提升23.93%
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型对提示表述高度敏感，需要大量手动试错才能获得满意结果，这促使开发自动化的、模型无关的提示优化方法，以系统探索条件空间
AI.method: 使用遗传算法直接进化CLIP扩散模型使用的token向量，优化结合LAION Aesthetic Predictor V2测量的美学质量和CLIPScore评估的提示-图像对齐度的适应度函数
AI.result: 在Parti Prompts数据集36个提示上的实验表明，该方法优于Promptist和随机搜索等基线方法，实现了高达23.93%的适应度提升
AI.conclusion: 该方法适用于具有token化文本编码器的图像生成模型，提供了模块化框架供未来扩展，并讨论了其局限性和前景

title: From Query to Counsel: Structured Reasoning with a Multi-Agent Framework and Dataset for Legal Consultation
summary: Legal consultation question answering (Legal CQA) presents unique challenges compared to traditional legal QA tasks, including the scarcity of high-quality training data, complex task composition, and strong contextual dependencies. To address these, we construct JurisCQAD, a large-scale dataset of over 43,000 real-world Chinese legal queries annotated with expert-validated positive and negative responses, and design a structured task decomposition that converts each query into a legal element graph integrating entities, events, intents, and legal issues. We further propose JurisMA, a modular multi-agent framework supporting dynamic routing, statutory grounding, and stylistic optimization. Combined with the element graph, the framework enables strong context-aware reasoning, effectively capturing dependencies across legal facts, norms, and procedural logic. Trained on JurisCQAD and evaluated on a refined LawBench, our system significantly outperforms both general-purpose and legal-domain LLMs across multiple lexical and semantic metrics, demonstrating the benefits of interpretable decomposition and modular collaboration in Legal CQA.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对法律咨询问答任务构建了大规模中文数据集JurisCQAD，并提出基于法律元素图分解和模块化多智能体框架JurisMA的系统，显著提升了法律问答性能。
AI.motivation: 法律咨询问答相比传统法律QA面临三大挑战：高质量训练数据稀缺、任务组合复杂、上下文依赖性强。现有方法难以有效处理这些挑战，需要专门的数据集和系统设计。
AI.method: 1) 构建JurisCQAD数据集：包含43,000+真实中文法律查询，标注专家验证的正负回答；2) 设计结构化任务分解：将查询转换为包含实体、事件、意图和法律问题的法律元素图；3) 提出JurisMA框架：模块化多智能体系统，支持动态路由、法规基础和风格优化。
AI.result: 在精炼的LawBench基准上评估，该系统在多个词汇和语义指标上显著优于通用和特定法律领域的LLM，证明了可解释分解和模块化协作在法律CQA中的优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合大规模专家标注数据集、结构化法律元素图分解和模块化多智能体框架，能够有效解决法律咨询问答的独特挑战，实现更强的上下文感知推理能力。

title: What do your logits know? (The answer may surprise you!)
summary: Recent work has shown that probing model internals can reveal a wealth of information not apparent from the model generations. This poses the risk of unintentional or malicious information leakage, where model users are able to learn information that the model owner assumed was inaccessible. Using vision-language models as a testbed, we present the first systematic comparison of information retained at different "representational levels'' as it is compressed from the rich information encoded in the residual stream through two natural bottlenecks: low-dimensional projections of the residual stream obtained using tuned lens, and the final top-k logits most likely to impact model's answer. We show that even easily accessible bottlenecks defined by the model's top logit values can leak task-irrelevant information present in an image-based query, in some cases revealing as much information as direct projections of the full residual stream.

AI.tldr: 研究发现视觉语言模型即使通过top-k logits等自然瓶颈也会泄露任务无关的图像信息，信息泄露风险与完整残差流投影相当
AI.motivation: 最近研究表明探测模型内部可以揭示大量从模型生成中不明显的信息，这带来了无意或恶意信息泄露的风险。模型用户可能学习到模型所有者认为无法访问的信息，需要系统比较不同"表示层次"的信息保留情况。
AI.method: 使用视觉语言模型作为测试平台，系统比较信息从残差流丰富编码通过两个自然瓶颈压缩时的保留情况：1) 使用tuned lens获得的残差流低维投影；2) 最可能影响模型答案的最终top-k logits。
AI.result: 研究表明，即使是模型top logit值定义的易于访问的瓶颈也会泄露图像查询中存在的任务无关信息，在某些情况下揭示的信息量与完整残差流的直接投影相当。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型存在显著的信息泄露风险，即使是看似受限的输出层也可能泄露大量敏感信息，这对模型隐私和安全提出了重要挑战。

title: PAS: Estimating the target accuracy before domain adaptation
comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
summary: The goal of domain adaptation is to make predictions for unlabeled samples from a target domain with the help of labeled samples from a different but related source domain. The performance of domain adaptation methods is highly influenced by the choice of source domain and pre-trained feature extractor. However, the selection of source data and pre-trained model is not trivial due to the absence of a labeled validation set for the target domain and the large number of available pre-trained models. In this work, we propose PAS, a novel score designed to estimate the transferability of a source domain set and a pre-trained feature extractor to a target classification task before actually performing domain adaptation. PAS leverages the generalization power of pre-trained models and assesses source-target compatibility based on the pre-trained feature embeddings. We integrate PAS into a framework that indicates the most relevant pre-trained model and source domain among multiple candidates, thus improving target accuracy while reducing the computational overhead. Extensive experiments on image classification benchmarks demonstrate that PAS correlates strongly with actual target accuracy and consistently guides the selection of the best-performing pre-trained model and source domain for adaptation.

AI.tldr: PAS是一种评估源域和预训练特征提取器到目标分类任务可迁移性的新评分方法，无需实际执行域适应，帮助选择最佳预训练模型和源域。
AI.motivation: 域适应方法的性能高度依赖于源域选择和预训练特征提取器，但由于目标域缺乏标注验证集且可用预训练模型众多，这种选择并不容易。
AI.method: 提出PAS评分方法，利用预训练模型的泛化能力，基于预训练特征嵌入评估源域与目标域的兼容性，将其集成到框架中从多个候选中选择最相关的预训练模型和源域。
AI.result: 在图像分类基准上的大量实验表明，PAS与实际目标准确率强相关，能一致地指导选择性能最佳的预训练模型和源域进行适应。
AI.conclusion: PAS提供了一种有效的方法来预先评估源域和预训练模型的可迁移性，提高了目标准确率同时减少了计算开销。

title: Why Don't You Know? Evaluating the Impact of Uncertainty Sources on Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) becomes critical for safe and effective use. Most existing UQ approaches for language models aim to produce a single confidence score -- for example, estimating the probability that a model's answer is correct. However, uncertainty in natural language tasks arises from multiple distinct sources, including model knowledge gaps, output variability, and input ambiguity, which have different implications for system behavior and user interaction. In this work, we study how the source of uncertainty impacts the behavior and effectiveness of existing UQ methods. To enable controlled analysis, we introduce a new dataset that explicitly categorizes uncertainty sources, allowing systematic evaluation of UQ performance under each condition. Our experiments reveal that while many UQ methods perform well when uncertainty stems solely from model knowledge limitations, their performance degrades or becomes misleading when other sources are introduced. These findings highlight the need for uncertainty-aware methods that explicitly account for the source of uncertainty in large language models.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了LLMs不确定性来源对UQ方法性能的影响，发现现有方法在模型知识不足时表现良好，但在其他不确定性来源下性能下降或误导
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs在现实应用中的部署增加，可靠的不确定性量化变得至关重要。现有UQ方法通常只产生单一置信分数，但自然语言任务中的不确定性来自多个不同来源（模型知识差距、输出可变性、输入模糊性），这些来源对系统行为和用户交互有不同的影响
AI.method: 引入了一个新的数据集，明确分类不确定性来源，允许在每种条件下系统评估UQ性能。通过控制实验分析不同不确定性来源对现有UQ方法行为的影响
AI.result: 实验表明，当不确定性仅来自模型知识限制时，许多UQ方法表现良好；但当引入其他不确定性来源时，它们的性能会下降或变得具有误导性
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了需要开发能够明确考虑LLMs中不确定性来源的不确定性感知方法，而不是依赖单一的置信分数

title: In-situ process monitoring for defect detection in wire-arc additive manufacturing: an agentic AI approach
summary: AI agents are being increasingly deployed across a wide range of real-world applications. In this paper, we propose an agentic AI framework for in-situ process monitoring for defect detection in wire-arc additive manufacturing (WAAM). The autonomous agent leverages a WAAM process monitoring dataset and a trained classification tool to build AI agents and uses a large language model (LLM) for in-situ process monitoring decision-making for defect detection. A processing agent is developed based on welder process signals, such as current and voltage, and a monitoring agent is developed based on acoustic data collected during the process. Both agents are tasked with identifying porosity defects from processing and monitoring signals, respectively. Ground truth X-ray computed tomography (XCT) data are used to develop classification tools for both the processing and monitoring agents. Furthermore, a multi-agent framework is demonstrated in which the processing and monitoring agents are orchestrated together for parallel decision-making on the given task of defect classification. Evaluation metrics are proposed to determine the efficacy of both individual agents, the combined single-agent, and the coordinated multi-agent system. The multi-agent configuration outperforms all individual-agent counterparts, achieving a decision accuracy of 91.6% and an F1 score of 0.821 on decided runs, across 15 independent runs, and a reasoning quality score of 3.74 out of 5. These in-situ process monitoring agents hold significant potential for autonomous real-time process monitoring and control toward building qualified parts for WAAM and other additive manufacturing processes.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于线弧增材制造缺陷检测的智能体AI框架，通过处理智能体和监测智能体协同工作，实现原位过程监控和缺陷分类。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体在现实应用中的广泛部署，需要开发能够进行原位过程监控的智能系统，以检测线弧增材制造中的缺陷，提高产品质量和制造效率。
AI.method: 开发了基于焊工过程信号（电流、电压）的处理智能体和基于过程声学数据的监测智能体，两者协同工作形成多智能体框架。利用X射线计算机断层扫描数据开发分类工具，使用大语言模型进行原位过程监控决策。
AI.result: 多智能体配置在所有个体智能体对比中表现最佳，在15次独立运行中，决策准确率达到91.6%，F1分数为0.821，推理质量得分为3.74/5。
AI.conclusion: 该原位过程监控智能体框架具有显著潜力，可用于线弧增材制造和其他增材制造过程的自主实时过程监控和控制，有助于制造合格零件。

title: DINO_4D: Semantic-Aware 4D Reconstruction
summary: In the intersection of computer vision and robotic perception, 4D reconstruction of dynamic scenes serve as the critical bridge connecting low-level geometric sensing with high-level semantic understanding. We present DINO\_4D, introducing frozen DINOv3 features as structural priors, injecting semantic awareness into the reconstruction process to effectively suppress semantic drift during dynamic tracking. Experiments on the Point Odyssey and TUM-Dynamics benchmarks demonstrate that our method maintains the linear time complexity $O(T)$ of its predecessors while significantly improving Tracking Accuracy (APD) and Reconstruction Completeness. DINO\_4D establishes a new paradigm for constructing 4D World Models that possess both geometric precision and semantic understanding.

AI.tldr: DINO_4D利用冻结的DINOv3特征作为结构先验，将语义感知注入动态场景的4D重建过程，有效抑制语义漂移，在保持线性时间复杂度的同时显著提升跟踪精度和重建完整性。
AI.motivation: 在计算机视觉和机器人感知的交叉领域，动态场景的4D重建是连接低级几何感知与高级语义理解的关键桥梁。现有方法在动态跟踪过程中容易出现语义漂移问题，需要引入语义感知来提升重建质量。
AI.method: 提出DINO_4D方法，引入冻结的DINOv3特征作为结构先验，将语义意识注入重建过程。该方法保持了前驱方法的线性时间复杂度O(T)，同时通过语义特征有效抑制动态跟踪中的语义漂移。
AI.result: 在Point Odyssey和TUM-Dynamics基准测试上的实验表明，该方法在保持线性时间复杂度的同时，显著提高了跟踪精度（APD）和重建完整性。DINO_4D为构建兼具几何精度和语义理解的4D世界模型建立了新范式。
AI.conclusion: DINO_4D通过引入冻结的DINOv3特征作为语义先验，成功将语义理解融入4D动态场景重建，在抑制语义漂移的同时保持计算效率，为构建几何精确且语义丰富的4D世界模型提供了新方法。

title: Structure-Grounded Knowledge Retrieval via Code Dependencies for Multi-Step Data Reasoning
summary: Selecting the right knowledge is critical when using large language models (LLMs) to solve domain-specific data analysis tasks. However, most retrieval-augmented approaches rely primarily on lexical or embedding similarity, which is often a weak proxy for the task-critical knowledge needed for multi-step reasoning. In many such tasks, the relevant knowledge is not merely textually related to the query, but is instead grounded in executable code and the dependency structure through which computations are carried out. To address this mismatch, we propose SGKR (Structure-Grounded Knowledge Retrieval), a retrieval framework that organizes domain knowledge with a graph induced by function-call dependencies. Given a question, SGKR extracts semantic input and output tags, identifies dependency paths connecting them, and constructs a task-relevant subgraph. The associated knowledge and corresponding function implementations are then assembled as a structured context for LLM-based code generation. Experiments on multi-step data analysis benchmarks show that SGKR consistently improves solution correctness over no-retrieval and similarity-based retrieval baselines for both vanilla LLMs and coding agents.

AI.tldr: SGKR是一种基于结构的知识检索框架，通过函数调用依赖图组织领域知识，为LLM代码生成提供结构化上下文，显著提升多步数据分析任务的正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强方法主要依赖词法或嵌入相似性，但这通常是任务关键知识的弱代理。在多步推理任务中，相关知识不仅与查询文本相关，更基于可执行代码和计算依赖结构。
AI.method: SGKR框架：1) 用函数调用依赖图组织领域知识；2) 给定问题时提取语义输入输出标签；3) 识别连接这些标签的依赖路径；4) 构建任务相关子图；5) 将相关知识和函数实现组装为结构化上下文用于LLM代码生成。
AI.result: 在多步数据分析基准测试中，SGKR相比无检索和基于相似性的检索基线，在普通LLM和编码代理上都一致地提高了解决方案的正确性。
AI.conclusion: SGKR通过结构化的知识检索方法，有效解决了传统检索方法在多步推理任务中的局限性，为LLM在领域特定数据分析任务中提供了更准确的知识支持。

title: GLEaN: A Text-to-image Bias Detection Approach for Public Comprehension
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models, and their encoded biases, increasingly shape the visual media the public encounters. While researchers have produced a rich body of work on bias measurement, auditing, and mitigation in T2I systems, those methods largely target technical stakeholders, leaving a gap in public legibility. We introduce GLEaN (Generative Likeness Evaluation at N-Scale), a portrait-based explainability pipeline designed to make T2I model biases visually understandable to a broad audience. GLEaN comprises three stages: automated large-scale image generation from identity prompts, facial landmark-based filtering and spatial alignment, and median-pixel composition that distills a model's central tendency into a single representative portrait. The resulting composites require no statistical background to interpret; a viewer can see, at a glance, who a model 'imagines' when prompted with 'a doctor' versus a 'felon.' We demonstrate GLEaN on Stable Diffusion XL across 40 social and occupational identity prompts, producing composites that reproduce documented biases and surface new associations between skin tone and predicted emotion. We find in a between-subjects user study (N = 291) that GLEaN portraits communicate biases as effectively as conventional data tables, but require significantly less viewing time. Because the method relies solely on generated outputs, it can also be replicated on any black-box and closed-weight systems without access to model internals. GLEaN offers a scalable, model-agnostic approach to bias explainability, purpose-built for public comprehension, and is publicly available at https://github.com/cultureiolab/GLEaN.

AI.tldr: GLEaN是一个基于肖像的文本到图像模型偏见可视化解释管道，通过大规模图像生成、面部对齐和像素合成，将模型偏见转化为直观的视觉肖像，便于公众理解。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到图像模型的偏见研究主要面向技术人员，缺乏公众可理解的可视化解释方法，需要一种能让大众直观理解模型偏见的工具。
AI.method: GLEaN包含三个阶段：1) 从身份提示自动大规模生成图像；2) 基于面部关键点的过滤和空间对齐；3) 中值像素合成，将模型中心趋势提炼为单一代表性肖像。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion XL上对40个社会职业身份提示进行测试，GLEaN复现了已知偏见并揭示了肤色与预测情绪的新关联。用户研究(N=291)显示GLEaN肖像与传统数据表同样有效地传达偏见，但所需观看时间显著减少。
AI.conclusion: GLEaN提供了一种可扩展、模型无关的偏见解释方法，专门为公众理解而设计，且仅依赖生成输出，可在黑盒和闭源系统上复制。

title: ReFEree: Reference-Free and Fine-Grained Method for Evaluating Factual Consistency in Real-World Code Summarization
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) have become capable of generating long and descriptive code summaries, accurate and reliable evaluation of factual consistency has become a critical challenge. However, previous evaluation methods are primarily designed for short summaries of isolated code snippets. Consequently, they struggle to provide fine-grained evaluation of multi-sentence functionalities and fail to accurately assess dependency context commonly found in real-world code summaries. To address this, we propose ReFEree, a reference-free and fine-grained method for evaluating factual consistency in real-world code summaries. We define factual inconsistency criteria specific to code summaries and evaluate them at the segment level using these criteria along with dependency information. These segment-level results are then aggregated into a fine-grained score. We construct a code summarization benchmark with human-annotated factual consistency labels. The evaluation results demonstrate that ReFEree achieves the highest correlation with human judgment among 13 baselines, improving 15-18% over the previous state-of-the-art. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/bsy99615/ReFEree.git.

AI.tldr: ReFEree是一个无参考的细粒度方法，用于评估真实世界代码摘要的事实一致性，通过定义代码摘要特有的不一致标准，在片段级别使用依赖信息进行评估，然后聚合为细粒度分数。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型能够生成长而详细的代码摘要，准确可靠地评估事实一致性成为一个关键挑战。先前的方法主要针对孤立代码片段的简短摘要设计，难以对多句子功能进行细粒度评估，也无法准确评估真实世界代码摘要中常见的依赖上下文。
AI.method: 提出ReFEree方法，定义代码摘要特有的事实不一致标准，在片段级别使用这些标准结合依赖信息进行评估，然后将片段级结果聚合为细粒度分数。
AI.result: 构建了带有人工标注事实一致性标签的代码摘要基准。评估结果显示，ReFEree在13个基线方法中与人类判断的相关性最高，比先前最先进方法提高了15-18%。
AI.conclusion: ReFEree是一种有效的无参考细粒度方法，能够准确评估真实世界代码摘要的事实一致性，解决了现有方法在处理多句子功能和依赖上下文方面的局限性。

title: Not Your Stereo-Typical Estimator: Combining Vision and Language for Volume Perception
summary: Accurate volume estimation of objects from visual data is a long-standing challenge in computer vision with significant applications in robotics, logistics, and smart health. Existing methods often rely on complex 3D reconstruction pipelines or struggle with the ambiguity inherent in single-view images. To address these limitations, we introduce a new method that fuses implicit 3D cues from stereo vision with explicit prior knowledge from natural language text. Our approach extracts deep features from a stereo image pair and a descriptive text prompt that contains the object's class and an approximate volume, then integrates them using a simple yet effective projection layer into a unified, multi-modal representation for regression. We conduct extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrating that our text-guided approach significantly outperforms vision-only baselines. Our findings show that leveraging even simple textual priors can effectively guide the volume estimation task, paving the way for more context-aware visual measurement systems. Code: https://gitlab.com/viper-purdue/stereo-typical-estimator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合立体视觉和文本先验的物体体积估计方法，通过结合立体图像对的深度特征和包含物体类别及近似体积的文本描述，显著提升了单目视觉方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 从视觉数据准确估计物体体积是计算机视觉中长期存在的挑战，在机器人、物流和智能健康等领域有重要应用。现有方法通常依赖复杂的3D重建流程，或者难以处理单视图图像固有的模糊性。
AI.method: 提出了一种新方法，将立体视觉的隐式3D线索与自然语言文本的显式先验知识融合。该方法从立体图像对和包含物体类别及近似体积的描述性文本提示中提取深度特征，然后通过简单有效的投影层将它们集成到统一的多模态表示中进行回归。
AI.result: 在公共数据集上的广泛实验表明，这种文本引导方法显著优于纯视觉基线。研究发现，即使是简单的文本先验也能有效指导体积估计任务。
AI.conclusion: 利用文本先验可以显著提升体积估计性能，为更具上下文感知能力的视觉测量系统铺平了道路。

title: Lost in Diffusion: Uncovering Hallucination Patterns and Failure Modes in Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: While Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising non-autoregressive paradigm comparable to autoregressive (AR) models, their faithfulness, specifically regarding hallucination, remains largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present the first controlled comparative study to evaluate hallucination patterns in dLLMs. Our results demonstrate that current dLLMs exhibit a higher propensity for hallucination than AR counterparts controlled for architecture, scale, and pre-training weights. Furthermore, an analysis of inference-time compute reveals divergent dynamics: while quasi-autoregressive generation suffers from early saturation, non-sequential decoding unlocks potential for continuous refinement. Finally, we identify distinct failure modes unique to the diffusion process, including premature termination, incomplete denoising, and context intrusion. Our findings underscore that although dLLMs have narrowed the performance gap on general tasks, their distinct hallucination mechanisms pose a critical challenge to model reliability. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZeroLoss-Lab/Lost-in-Diffusion

AI.tldr: 本文首次对扩散大语言模型(dLLMs)的幻觉模式进行控制性比较研究，发现dLLMs比自回归模型更容易产生幻觉，并揭示了扩散过程特有的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型作为有前景的非自回归范式，其可靠性特别是幻觉问题尚未得到充分研究，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 采用控制性比较研究方法，在架构、规模和预训练权重相同的条件下，评估dLLMs与自回归模型的幻觉模式，分析推理时间计算动态。
AI.result: 当前dLLMs比自回归模型更容易产生幻觉；准自回归生成存在早期饱和问题，而非顺序解码具有持续优化的潜力；发现了扩散过程特有的失败模式：过早终止、不完全去噪和上下文侵入。
AI.conclusion: 虽然dLLMs在一般任务上缩小了性能差距，但其独特的幻觉机制对模型可靠性构成了关键挑战。

title: New Hybrid Fine-Tuning Paradigm for LLMs: Algorithm Design and Convergence Analysis Framework
summary: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) typically involves either full fine-tuning, which updates all model parameters, or Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), which adjusts a small subset of parameters. However, both approaches have inherent limitations: full fine-tuning is computationally expensive, while PEFT often struggles to learn new knowledge and exhibits suboptimal performance. To overcome these issues, we propose a novel hybrid fine-tuning approach that jointly updates both LLMs and PEFT modules using a combination of zeroth-order and first-order optimization methods. To analyze our new algorithm, we develop a theoretical framework centered on the concept of hybrid smoothness condition, which accounts for the heterogeneous nature of the optimization landscape in joint LLM and PEFT training. We derive a rigorous convergence analysis for the convergence of reshuffling-type SGD algorithm under multiple learning rates and demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive empirical studies across various downstream tasks and model architectures. On the practical side, our results demonstrate consistent performance improvement, making the approach a viable solution for large-scale language model fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合零阶和一阶优化的混合微调方法，联合更新LLM和PEFT模块，解决全微调计算成本高和PEFT学习新知识能力不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 全微调计算成本高昂，而参数高效微调(PEFT)在学习新知识和性能表现上存在不足，需要一种能克服两者局限性的新方法。
AI.method: 提出混合微调方法，联合更新LLM和PEFT模块，结合零阶和一阶优化算法，并建立基于混合平滑条件的理论框架进行分析。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了在多重学习率下重排型SGD算法的收敛性，实证研究显示在各种下游任务和模型架构上性能持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为大规模语言模型微调提供了可行的解决方案，在理论和实践上都表现出优越性。

title: PointSplat: Efficient Geometry-Driven Pruning and Transformer Refinement for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently unlocked real-time, high-fidelity novel view synthesis by representing scenes using explicit 3D primitives. However, traditional methods often require millions of Gaussians to capture complex scenes, leading to significant memory and storage demands. Recent approaches have addressed this issue through pruning and per-scene fine-tuning of Gaussian parameters, thereby reducing the model size while maintaining visual quality. These strategies typically rely on 2D images to compute important scores followed by scene-specific optimization. In this work, we introduce PointSplat, 3D geometry-driven prune-and-refine framework that bridges previously disjoint directions of gaussian pruning and transformer refinement. Our method includes two key components: (1) an efficient geometry-driven strategy that ranks Gaussians based solely on their 3D attributes, removing reliance on 2D images during pruning stage, and (2) a dual-branch encoder that separates, re-weights geometric and appearance to avoid feature imbalance. Extensive experiments on ScanNet++ and Replica across varying sparsity levels demonstrate that PointSplat consistently achieves competitive rendering quality and superior efficiency without additional per-scene optimization.

AI.tldr: PointSplat提出了一种基于3D几何的高斯剪枝与细化框架，通过纯3D属性评估高斯重要性，结合双分支编码器分离几何与外观特征，在保持渲染质量的同时显著减少内存占用。
AI.motivation: 传统3D高斯泼溅方法需要数百万个高斯分布来表示复杂场景，导致巨大的内存和存储需求。现有方法通常依赖2D图像计算重要性分数并进行场景特定优化，存在效率问题。
AI.method: PointSplat包含两个核心组件：1) 基于纯3D属性的几何驱动剪枝策略，在剪枝阶段不依赖2D图像；2) 双分支编码器，分离并重新加权几何和外观特征以避免特征不平衡。
AI.result: 在ScanNet++和Replica数据集上的大量实验表明，PointSplat在不同稀疏度水平下都能保持竞争力的渲染质量，同时实现卓越的效率，无需额外的场景特定优化。
AI.conclusion: PointSplat通过3D几何驱动的剪枝与细化框架，有效减少了3D高斯表示的内存需求，同时保持了渲染质量，为实时高质量新视角合成提供了更高效的解决方案。

title: LLMs Should Incorporate Explicit Mechanisms for Human Empathy
summary: This paper argues that Large Language Models (LLMs) should incorporate explicit mechanisms for human empathy. As LLMs become increasingly deployed in high-stakes human-centered settings, their success depends not only on correctness or fluency but on faithful preservation of human perspectives. Yet, current LLMs systematically fail at this requirement: even when well-aligned and policy-compliant, they often attenuate affect, misrepresent contextual salience, and rigidify relational stance in ways that distort meaning. We formalize empathy as an observable behavioral property: the capacity to model and respond to human perspectives while preserving intention, affect, and context. Under this framing, we identify four recurring mechanisms of empathic failure in contemporary LLMs--sentiment attenuation, empathic granularity mismatch, conflict avoidance, and linguistic distancing--arising as structural consequences of prevailing training and alignment practices. We further organize these failures along three dimensions: cognitive, cultural, and relational empathy, to explain their manifestation across tasks. Empirical analyses show that strong benchmark performance can mask systematic empathic distortions, motivating empathy-aware objectives, benchmarks, and training signals as first-class components of LLM development.

AI.tldr: 论文主张大语言模型应加入显式的人类共情机制，因为当前模型在保留人类视角方面存在系统性失败，即使符合政策要求也会扭曲意义。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地部署在以人为本的高风险场景中，其成功不仅取决于正确性或流畅性，更需要忠实保留人类视角。然而当前模型在这方面存在系统性失败，即使对齐良好且符合政策，也会削弱情感、误判上下文重要性并僵化关系立场，从而扭曲意义。
AI.method: 将共情形式化为可观察的行为属性：建模和回应人类视角同时保留意图、情感和上下文的能力。在此框架下，识别了当代大语言模型中四种共情失败机制：情感衰减、共情粒度不匹配、冲突回避和语言疏离，这些是主流训练和对齐实践的结构性后果。进一步将这些失败沿三个维度组织：认知、文化和关系共情，以解释其在任务中的表现。
AI.result: 实证分析表明，强大的基准性能可能掩盖系统性的共情扭曲，这促使将共情感知的目标、基准和训练信号作为大语言模型开发的一等组件。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型需要显式的共情机制，当前模型在保留人类视角方面存在系统性缺陷，需要将共情感知的目标、基准和训练信号作为模型开发的核心组成部分。

title: FinTrace: Holistic Trajectory-Level Evaluation of LLM Tool Calling for Long-Horizon Financial Tasks
summary: Recent studies demonstrate that tool-calling capability enables large language models (LLMs) to interact with external environments for long-horizon financial tasks. While existing benchmarks have begun evaluating financial tool calling, they focus on limited scenarios and rely on call-level metrics that fail to capture trajectory-level reasoning quality. To address this gap, we introduce FinTrace, a benchmark comprising 800 expert-annotated trajectories spanning 34 real-world financial task categories across multiple difficulty levels. FinTrace employs a rubric-based evaluation protocol with nine metrics organized along four axes -- action correctness, execution efficiency, process quality, and output quality -- enabling fine-grained assessment of LLM tool-calling behavior. Our evaluation of 13 LLMs reveals that while frontier models achieve strong tool selection, all models struggle with information utilization and final answer quality, exposing a critical gap between invoking the right tools and reasoning effectively over their outputs. To move beyond diagnosis, we construct FinTrace-Training, the first trajectory-level preference dataset for financial tool-calling, containing 8,196 curated trajectories with tool-augmented contexts and preference pairs. We fine-tune Qwen-3.5-9B using supervised fine-tuning followed by direct preference optimization (DPO) and show that training on FinTrace-Training consistently improves intermediate reasoning metrics, with DPO more effectively suppressing failure modes. However, end-to-end answer quality remains a bottleneck, indicating that trajectory-level improvements do not yet fully propagate to final output quality.

AI.tldr: FinTrace是一个包含800条专家标注轨迹的金融工具调用基准，涵盖34个真实金融任务类别，采用四维度九指标评估协议。研究发现前沿模型在工具选择上表现良好，但在信息利用和最终答案质量上存在不足。作者还构建了首个金融工具调用轨迹级偏好数据集FinTrace-Training，通过DPO微调改善了中间推理指标，但最终答案质量仍是瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有金融工具调用基准存在局限性：仅关注有限场景，依赖调用级指标而无法捕捉轨迹级推理质量。需要更全面的评估框架来诊断LLM在金融工具调用中的真实能力差距。
AI.method: 1) 构建FinTrace基准：包含800条专家标注轨迹，涵盖34个真实金融任务类别和多个难度级别；2) 设计四维度九指标评估协议（行动正确性、执行效率、过程质量、输出质量）；3) 评估13个LLM；4) 构建FinTrace-Training数据集：包含8,196条带工具增强上下文和偏好对的轨迹；5) 对Qwen-3.5-9B进行监督微调和直接偏好优化(DPO)。
AI.result: 1) 前沿模型在工具选择上表现良好，但所有模型在信息利用和最终答案质量上存在困难；2) 揭示了调用正确工具与有效推理输出之间的关键差距；3) 在FinTrace-Training上微调Qwen-3.5-9B改善了中间推理指标，DPO能更有效抑制失败模式；4) 但端到端答案质量仍是瓶颈，轨迹级改进尚未完全传导到最终输出质量。
AI.conclusion: FinTrace为金融工具调用提供了更全面的评估框架，揭示了当前LLM在金融任务中的关键能力差距。虽然轨迹级训练能改善中间推理过程，但最终答案质量仍是主要挑战，表明需要进一步研究如何将轨迹级改进转化为最终输出质量提升。

title: From UAV Imagery to Agronomic Reasoning: A Multimodal LLM Benchmark for Plant Phenotyping
summary: To improve crop genetics, high-throughput, effective and comprehensive phenotyping is a critical prerequisite. While such tasks were traditionally performed manually, recent advances in multimodal foundation models, especially in vision-language models (VLMs), have enabled more automated and robust phenotypic analysis. However, plant science remains a particularly challenging domain for foundation models because it requires domain-specific knowledge, fine-grained visual interpretation, and complex biological and agronomic reasoning. To address this gap, we develop PlantXpert, an evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning benchmark for soybean and cotton phenotyping. Our benchmark provides a structured and reproducible framework for agronomic adaptation of VLMs, and enables controlled comparison between base models and their domain-adapted counterparts. We constructed a dataset comprising 385 digital images and more than 3,000 benchmark samples spanning key plant science domains including disease, pest control, weed management, and yield. The benchmark can assess diverse capabilities including visual expertise, quantitative reasoning, and multi-step agronomic reasoning. A total of 11 state-of-the-art VLMs were evaluated. The results indicate that task-specific fine-tuning leads to substantial improvement in accuracy, with models such as Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-30B achieving up to 78%. At the same time, gains from model scaling diminish beyond a certain capacity, generalization across soybean and cotton remains uneven, and quantitative as well as biologically grounded reasoning continue to pose substantial challenges. These findings suggest that PlantXpert can serve as a foundation for assessing evidence-grounded agronomic reasoning and for advancing multimodal model development in plant science.

AI.tldr: PlantXpert：一个面向大豆和棉花表型分析的多模态推理基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在植物科学领域的表现，包含385张数字图像和3000多个样本，涵盖病害、虫害、杂草管理和产量等关键领域。
AI.motivation: 植物科学是基础模型面临挑战的领域，需要领域专业知识、细粒度视觉解释和复杂的生物农学推理。传统手动表型分析效率低，而现有多模态基础模型缺乏针对植物科学的专业评估框架。
AI.method: 开发PlantXpert基准，构建包含385张数字图像和3000多个样本的数据集，涵盖病害、虫害控制、杂草管理和产量等植物科学关键领域。评估11个最先进的视觉语言模型，比较基础模型与领域适应模型的表现。
AI.result: 任务特定微调显著提高准确性，Qwen3-VL-4B和Qwen3-VL-30B模型达到78%准确率。但模型规模超过一定容量后收益递减，大豆和棉花之间的泛化能力不均，定量推理和基于生物学的推理仍是重大挑战。
AI.conclusion: PlantXpert可作为评估基于证据的农学推理和推动植物科学多模态模型发展的基础，为农业适应视觉语言模型提供结构化、可复现的评估框架。

title: Early Decisions Matter: Proximity Bias and Initial Trajectory Shaping in Non-Autoregressive Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion-based language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models, offering the potential for parallel token generation and bidirectional context modeling. However, harnessing this flexibility for fully non-autoregressive decoding remains an open question, particularly for reasoning and planning tasks. In this work, we investigate non-autoregressive decoding in dLLMs by systematically analyzing its inference dynamics along the temporal axis. Specifically, we uncover an inherent failure mode in confidence-based non-autoregressive generation stemming from a strong proximity bias-the tendency for the denoising order to concentrate on spatially adjacent tokens. This local dependency leads to spatial error propagation, rendering the entire trajectory critically contingent on the initial unmasking position. Leveraging this insight, we present a minimal-intervention approach that guides early token selection, employing a lightweight planner and end-of-sequence temperature annealing. We thoroughly evaluate our method on various reasoning and planning tasks and observe substantial overall improvement over existing heuristic baselines without significant computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了扩散语言模型中的非自回归解码问题，发现置信度生成存在空间邻近偏差，导致错误传播，提出通过轻量级规划和温度退火来改善早期token选择。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型作为自回归模型的替代方案，具有并行token生成和双向上下文建模的潜力，但在完全非自回归解码方面，特别是在推理和规划任务中，仍存在未解决的问题。
AI.method: 通过系统分析推理动态，发现置信度非自回归生成存在空间邻近偏差问题，提出使用轻量级规划器和序列结束温度退火来指导早期token选择的最小干预方法。
AI.result: 在多种推理和规划任务上进行了全面评估，观察到相比现有启发式基线有显著的整体改进，且没有显著增加计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过理解扩散语言模型的推理动态并采用最小干预方法，可以有效改善非自回归解码在推理和规划任务中的性能，为利用扩散模型的灵活性提供了实用解决方案。

title: LoopGuard: Breaking Self-Reinforcing Attention Loops via Dynamic KV Cache Intervention
summary: Through systematic experiments on long-context generation, we observe a damaging failure mode in which decoding can collapse into persistent repetition loops. We find that this degeneration is driven by collapsed attention patterns, where a subset of heads locks onto a narrow suffix of the history, and is further stabilized by inference-time KV cache reuse. Crucially, since many existing KV cache policies rely on attention-based importance, this collapse can produce spuriously high scores for repetitive tokens, causing cache management to inadvertently amplify repetition. To study this phenomenon in a controlled and reproducible manner, we introduce LoopBench, a benchmark with explicit loop-inducing conditions and loop-oriented metrics that quantify repetition severity and generation instability beyond downstream task scores. Building on these insights, we propose LoopGuard, a lightweight, plug-in KV cache guard that detects loop onset online and disrupts the feedback cycle by pruning repetitive tail spans under a fixed cache budget. Experiments on LoopBench show that LoopGuard reduces loop incidence by over 90 percentage points, while restoring output diversity and reducing token waste.

AI.tldr: 研究发现长文本生成中存在解码崩溃为重复循环的破坏性故障模式，提出了LoopBench基准和LoopGuard缓存保护机制来解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 在长文本生成实验中观察到解码会崩溃为持续重复循环的破坏性故障模式，这种退化由注意力模式崩溃驱动，并且被推理时的KV缓存重用进一步稳定化。
AI.method: 引入LoopBench基准，包含明确的循环诱导条件和循环导向指标；提出LoopGuard，一种轻量级插件式KV缓存保护机制，可在线检测循环开始并通过在固定缓存预算下修剪重复尾部跨度来中断反馈循环。
AI.result: LoopBench实验显示，LoopGuard将循环发生率降低了超过90个百分点，同时恢复了输出多样性并减少了令牌浪费。
AI.conclusion: 解码重复循环是由崩溃的注意力模式和KV缓存重用驱动的系统性故障，通过LoopGuard等针对性干预可以有效缓解这一问题，提高长文本生成的稳定性和多样性。

title: BLPR: Robust License Plate Recognition under Viewpoint and Illumination Variations via Confidence-Driven VLM Fallback
summary: Robust license plate recognition in unconstrained environments remains a significant challenge, particularly in underrepresented regions with limited data availability and unique visual characteristics, such as Bolivia. Recognition accuracy in real-world conditions is often degraded by factors such as illumination changes and viewpoint distortion. To address these challenges, we introduce BLPR, a novel deep learning-based License Plate Detection and Recognition (LPDR) framework specifically designed for Bolivian license plates. The proposed system follows a two-stage pipeline where a YOLO-based detector is pretrained on synthetic data generated in Blender to simulate extreme perspectives and lighting conditions, and subsequently fine-tuned on street-level data collected in La Paz, Bolivia. Detected plates are geometrically rectified and passed to a character recognition model. To improve robustness under ambiguous scenarios, a lightweight vision-language model (Gemma3 4B) is selectively triggered as a confidence-based fallback mechanism. The proposed framework further leverages synthetic-to-real domain adaptation to improve robustness under diverse real-world conditions. We also introduce the first publicly available Bolivian LPDR dataset, enabling evaluation under diverse viewpoint and illumination conditions. The system achieves a character-level recognition accuracy of 89.6% on real-world data, demonstrating its effectiveness for deployment in challenging urban environments. Our project is publicly available at https://github.com/EdwinTSalcedo/BLPR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BLPR框架，专门针对玻利维亚车牌识别，采用两阶段流程：YOLO检测器预训练于合成数据，再微调于真实数据，结合几何校正和字符识别，并引入Gemma3 4B作为置信度后备机制，达到89.6%字符识别准确率。
AI.motivation: 在无约束环境下，特别是在玻利维亚等数据稀缺且视觉特征独特的欠发达地区，车牌识别面临光照变化、视角扭曲等挑战，现有方法在真实条件下的识别准确率往往下降。
AI.method: 提出两阶段BLPR框架：1) YOLO检测器在Blender生成的合成数据上预训练，模拟极端视角和光照条件，然后在玻利维亚拉巴斯收集的街景数据上微调；2) 检测到的车牌进行几何校正后传递给字符识别模型；3) 引入轻量级视觉语言模型(Gemma3 4B)作为基于置信度的后备机制；4) 采用合成到真实的域适应方法提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 系统在真实世界数据上达到89.6%的字符级识别准确率，并发布了首个公开可用的玻利维亚车牌检测与识别数据集，支持在多样化视角和光照条件下的评估。
AI.conclusion: BLPR框架在挑战性城市环境中表现出色，通过合成数据预训练、域适应和视觉语言后备机制的组合，有效解决了玻利维亚车牌识别的特定挑战，为类似数据稀缺地区的车牌识别提供了可行方案。

title: Bridging Linguistic Gaps: Cross-Lingual Mapping in Pre-Training and Dataset for Enhanced Multilingual LLM Performance
summary: Multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with cross-lingual tasks due to data imbalances between high-resource and low-resource languages, as well as monolingual bias in pre-training. Existing methods, such as bilingual fine-tuning and contrastive alignment, can improve cross-lingual performance, but they often require extensive parallel data or suffer from instability. To address these challenges, we introduce a Cross-Lingual Mapping Task during the pre-training phase, which enhances cross-lingual alignment without compromising monolingual fluency. Our approach bi-directionally maps languages within the LLM embedding space, improving both language generation and comprehension. We further propose a Language Alignment Coefficient to robustly quantify cross-lingual consistency, even in limited-data scenarios. Experimental results on machine translation (MT), cross-lingual natural language understanding (CLNLU), and cross-lingual question answering (CLQA) show that our model achieves gains of up to 11.9 BLEU points in MT, 6.72 points in CLQA BERTScore-Precision, and more than 5% in CLNLU accuracy over strong multilingual baselines. These findings highlight the potential of incorporating cross-lingual objectives into pre-training to improve multilingual LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在预训练阶段引入跨语言映射任务的方法，通过双向映射语言嵌入空间来提升多语言大模型的跨语言对齐能力，同时保持单语言流畅性。
AI.motivation: 多语言大语言模型在跨语言任务上表现不佳，主要原因是高资源语言和低资源语言之间的数据不平衡，以及预训练中的单语言偏见。现有方法如双语微调和对比对齐虽然能改善跨语言性能，但需要大量平行数据或存在不稳定性问题。
AI.method: 在预训练阶段引入跨语言映射任务，在LLM嵌入空间中进行双向语言映射，以增强跨语言对齐而不损害单语言流畅性。同时提出语言对齐系数来量化跨语言一致性，即使在数据有限的情况下也能稳健评估。
AI.result: 在机器翻译、跨语言自然语言理解和跨语言问答任务上的实验结果显示，相比强大的多语言基线模型，该方法在机器翻译上获得最高11.9 BLEU分的提升，在跨语言问答上获得6.72分的BERTScore-Precision提升，在跨语言自然语言理解上获得超过5%的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，在预训练阶段融入跨语言目标能够有效改善多语言大语言模型的性能，为提升跨语言对齐提供了有前景的方向。

title: Learning Hierarchical and Geometry-Aware Graph Representations for Text-to-CAD
summary: Text-to-CAD code generation is a long-horizon task that translates textual instructions into long sequences of interdependent operations. Existing methods typically decode text directly into executable code (e.g., bpy) without explicitly modeling assembly hierarchy or geometric constraints, which enlarges the search space, accumulates local errors, and often causes cascading failures in complex assemblies. To address this issue, we propose a hierarchical and geometry-aware graph as an intermediate representation. The graph models multi-level parts and components as nodes and encodes explicit geometric constraints as edges. Instead of mapping text directly to code, our framework first predicts structure and constraints, then conditions action sequencing and code generation, thereby improving geometric fidelity and constraint satisfaction. We further introduce a structure-aware progressive curriculum learning strategy that constructs graded tasks through controlled structural edits, explores the model's capability boundary, and synthesizes boundary examples for iterative training. In addition, we build a 12K dataset with instructions, decomposition graphs, action sequences, and bpy code, together with graph- and constraint-oriented evaluation metrics. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms existing approaches in both geometric fidelity and accurate satisfaction of geometric constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于文本到CAD代码生成的层次化几何感知图表示方法，通过显式建模装配层次和几何约束来提升复杂组件的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到CAD代码生成方法直接将文本解码为可执行代码，没有显式建模装配层次或几何约束，这导致搜索空间扩大、局部错误累积，在复杂装配中经常出现级联失败。
AI.method: 提出层次化几何感知图作为中间表示，将多级部件和组件建模为节点，将显式几何约束编码为边。框架先预测结构和约束，再条件化动作序列和代码生成。引入结构感知渐进课程学习策略，通过受控结构编辑构建分级任务，探索模型能力边界并合成边界示例进行迭代训练。
AI.result: 构建了包含12K个样本的数据集，包含指令、分解图、动作序列和bpy代码，以及图和约束导向的评估指标。实验表明，该方法在几何保真度和几何约束准确满足方面一致优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过层次化几何感知图表示和结构感知渐进课程学习，显著提升了文本到CAD代码生成的几何保真度和约束满足能力，为解决复杂装配生成问题提供了有效方案。

title: I Walk the Line: Examining the Role of Gestalt Continuity in Object Binding for Vision Transformers
summary: Object binding is a foundational process in visual cognition, during which low-level perceptual features are joined into object representations. Binding has been considered a fundamental challenge for neural networks, and a major milestone on the way to artificial models with flexible visual intelligence. Recently, several investigations have demonstrated evidence that binding mechanisms emerge in pretrained vision models, enabling them to associate portions of an image that contain an object. The question remains: how are these models binding objects together? In this work, we investigate whether vision models rely on the principle of Gestalt continuity to perform object binding, over and above other principles like similarity and proximity. Using synthetic datasets, we demonstrate that binding probes are sensitive to continuity across a wide range of pretrained vision transformers. Next, we uncover particular attention heads that track continuity, and show that these heads generalize across datasets. Finally, we ablate these attention heads, and show that they often contribute to producing representations that encode object binding.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了预训练视觉模型是否依赖格式塔连续性原则进行物体绑定，发现视觉Transformer中的特定注意力头对连续性敏感，且这些头对物体绑定表征有贡献。
AI.motivation: 物体绑定是视觉认知的基础过程，将低级感知特征整合为物体表征。虽然已有研究表明预训练视觉模型具备绑定机制，但尚不清楚这些模型如何实现物体绑定，特别是是否依赖格式塔连续性原则。
AI.method: 使用合成数据集测试预训练视觉Transformer对连续性的敏感性；识别追踪连续性的特定注意力头；通过消融实验验证这些注意力头对物体绑定表征的贡献。
AI.result: 绑定探针对连续性敏感；发现了追踪连续性的特定注意力头，这些头在不同数据集间具有泛化能力；消融这些注意力头会削弱模型产生编码物体绑定的表征能力。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视觉模型确实依赖格式塔连续性原则进行物体绑定，特定注意力头在这一过程中发挥关键作用，为理解神经网络中的物体绑定机制提供了新见解。

title: Computational Lesions in Multilingual Language Models Separate Shared and Language-specific Brain Alignment
summary: How the brain supports language across different languages is a basic question in neuroscience and a useful test for multilingual artificial intelligence. Neuroimaging has identified language-responsive brain regions across languages, but it cannot by itself show whether the underlying processing is shared or language-specific. Here we use six multilingual large language models (LLMs) as controllable systems and create targeted ``computational lesions'' by zeroing small parameter sets that are important across languages or especially important for one language. We then compare intact and lesioned models in predicting functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) responses during 100 minutes of naturalistic story listening in native English, Chinese and French (112 participants). Lesioning a compact shared core reduces whole-brain encoding correlation by 60.32% relative to intact models, whereas language-specific lesions preserve cross-language separation in embedding space but selectively weaken brain predictivity for the matched native language. These results support a shared backbone with embedded specializations and provide a causal framework for studying multilingual brain-model alignment.

AI.tldr: 研究通过在多语言大语言模型中创建"计算性损伤"，验证了大脑语言处理存在共享核心结构和语言特异性嵌入的假设
AI.motivation: 探索大脑如何支持不同语言处理，这是一个神经科学基本问题，也是多语言人工智能的重要测试。虽然神经影像学已识别出跨语言的语言响应脑区，但无法确定底层处理是共享的还是语言特异性的。
AI.method: 使用6个多语言大语言模型作为可控系统，通过归零重要参数创建"计算性损伤"：跨语言共享核心损伤和语言特异性损伤。然后比较完整模型和损伤模型在预测英语、中文和法语母语者听故事时的fMRI反应的能力。
AI.result: 损伤共享核心使全脑编码相关性降低60.32%；语言特异性损伤保留了嵌入空间中的跨语言分离，但选择性地削弱了匹配母语的大脑预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持大脑语言处理存在共享主干结构并嵌入语言特异性的假设，为研究多语言大脑-模型对齐提供了因果框架。

title: Ontological Trajectory Forecasting via Finite Semigroup Iteration and Lie Algebra Approximation in Geopolitical Knowledge Graphs
comment: 18 pages. Code and system available at https://github.com/wuqihang-brave/El-druin
summary: We present EL-DRUIN, an ontological reasoning system for geopolitical intelligence analysis that combines formal ontology, finite semigroup algebra, and Lie algebra approximation to forecast long-run relationship trajectories. Current LLM-based political analysis systems operate as summarisation engines, producing outputs bounded by textual pattern matching. EL-DRUIN departs from this paradigm by modelling geopolitical relationships as states in a finite set of named Dynamic Patterns, composing patterns via a semigroup operation whose structure constants are defined by an explicit composition table, and embedding each pattern as a vector in an 8-dimensional semantic Lie algebra space. Forward simulation iterates this semigroup operation, yielding reachable pattern sets at each discrete timestep; convergence to idempotent absorbing states (fixed points of the composition) constitutes the predicted long-run attractor. Bayesian posterior weights combine ontology-derived confidence priors with a Lie similarity term measuring the cosine similarity between the vector sum of composing patterns and the target pattern vector, providing interpretable, calibrated probabilities that are not self-reported by a language model. Bifurcation points -- steps at which two candidate attractors have near-equal posterior mass -- are detected and exposed to downstream analysis. We demonstrate the framework on six geopolitical scenarios including US-China technology decoupling and the Taiwan Strait military coercion trajectory. The architecture is publicly available as an open-source system with a Streamlit frontend exposing full computation traces, Bayesian posterior breakdowns, and 8D ontological state vectors.

AI.tldr: EL-DRUIN是一个结合形式本体论、有限半群代数和李代数近似的本体推理系统，用于预测地缘政治关系的长期演化轨迹，超越了传统LLM的文本模式匹配方法。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的政治分析系统主要作为总结引擎，输出受限于文本模式匹配。需要一种能够建模地缘政治关系动态演化、提供可解释概率预测的系统。
AI.method: 将地缘政治关系建模为有限动态模式集合中的状态，通过半群运算组合模式，结构常数由显式组合表定义。将每个模式嵌入8维语义李代数空间，通过前向模拟迭代半群运算，收敛到幂等吸收状态作为长期吸引子。贝叶斯后验权重结合本体置信度先验和李相似度项。
AI.result: 系统在六个地缘政治场景中进行了演示，包括美中技术脱钩和台湾海峡军事胁迫轨迹。系统作为开源架构提供，具有Streamlit前端，可展示完整计算轨迹、贝叶斯后验分解和8维本体状态向量。
AI.conclusion: EL-DRUIN提供了一种超越传统LLM文本分析的地缘政治关系预测框架，通过形式化建模和代数方法提供可解释、校准的概率预测，能够检测分叉点并支持下游分析。

title: Cross-Cultural Value Awareness in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: The rapid adoption of large vision-language models (LVLMs) in recent years has been accompanied by growing fairness concerns due to their propensity to reinforce harmful societal stereotypes. While significant attention has been paid to such fairness concerns in the context of social biases, relatively little prior work has examined the presence of stereotypes in LVLMs related to cultural contexts such as religion, nationality, and socioeconomic status. In this work, we aim to narrow this gap by investigating how cultural contexts depicted in images influence the judgments LVLMs make about a person's moral, ethical, and political values. We conduct a multi-dimensional analysis of such value judgments in five popular LVLMs using counterfactual image sets, which depict the same person across different cultural contexts. Our evaluation framework diagnoses LVLM awareness of cultural value differences through the use of Moral Foundations Theory, lexical analyses, and the sensitivity of generated values to depicted cultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 研究调查大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）如何根据图像中的文化背景（宗教、国籍、社会经济地位）对人的道德、伦理和政治价值观做出判断，揭示模型存在文化刻板印象问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有研究关注LVLMs中的社会偏见问题，但较少关注与文化背景相关的刻板印象。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探究图像中的文化背景如何影响LVLMs对人的价值观判断。
AI.method: 使用反事实图像集（描绘同一人物在不同文化背景下的图像）对五种流行的LVLMs进行多维度分析。评估框架结合道德基础理论、词汇分析以及生成价值观对文化背景的敏感性。
AI.result: 研究发现LVLMs会根据图像中的文化背景对人的道德、伦理和政治价值观做出不同的判断，表明模型存在文化刻板印象问题，能够检测到模型对文化价值差异的认知。
AI.conclusion: LVLMs在根据文化背景进行价值观判断时存在刻板印象问题，需要进一步研究来理解和缓解这些文化偏见，确保模型在不同文化背景下的公平性。

title: ProUIE: A Macro-to-Micro Progressive Learning Method for LLM-based Universal Information Extraction
summary: LLM-based universal information extraction (UIE) methods often rely on additional information beyond the original training data, which increases training complexity yet often yields limited gains. To address this, we propose ProUIE, a Macro-to-Micro progressive learning approach that improves UIE without introducing any external information. ProUIE consists of three stages: (i) macro-level Complete Modeling (CM), which learns NER, RE, and EE along their intrinsic difficulty order on the full training data to build a unified extraction foundation, (ii) meso-level Streamlined Alignment (SA), which operates on sampled data with simplified target formats, streamlining and regularizing structured outputs to make them more concise and controllable, and (iii) micro-level Deep Exploration (DE), which applies GRPO with stepwise fine-grained rewards (SFR) over structural units to guide exploration and improve performance. Experiments on 36 public datasets show that ProUIE consistently improves unified extraction, outperforming strong instruction-tuned baselines on average for NER and RE while using a smaller backbone, and it further demonstrates clear gains in large-scale production-oriented information extraction.

AI.tldr: ProUIE：一种从宏观到微观的渐进式学习方法，无需外部信息即可提升通用信息抽取性能，通过三阶段学习框架在36个数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的通用信息抽取方法通常依赖额外信息，增加了训练复杂度但收益有限。需要一种不引入外部信息就能提升UIE性能的方法。
AI.method: 提出ProUIE三阶段渐进学习框架：1）宏观级完整建模：按NER、RE、EE的难度顺序在全量数据上学习统一抽取基础；2）中观级简化对齐：在采样数据上简化目标格式，使结构化输出更简洁可控；3）微观级深度探索：应用GRPO结合逐步细粒度奖励引导探索提升性能。
AI.result: 在36个公共数据集上的实验表明，ProUIE持续提升统一抽取性能，使用更小骨干网络时在NER和RE任务上平均优于强指令调优基线，并在大规模生产级信息抽取中显示出明显优势。
AI.conclusion: ProUIE通过从宏观到微观的渐进式学习框架，在不引入外部信息的情况下有效提升了通用信息抽取性能，为UIE提供了一种高效实用的解决方案。

title: Trust Your Memory: Verifiable Control of Smart Homes through Reinforcement Learning with Multi-dimensional Rewards
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become a key foundation for enabling personalized smart home experiences. While existing studies have explored how smart home assistants understand user queries to control devices in real time, their ability to perform memory-driven device control remains challenging from both evaluation and methodological perspectives. In terms of evaluation, existing benchmarks either focus on immediate device control or general open-domain memory retrieval tasks, and therefore cannot effectively evaluate a model's ability to perform memory-driven device control. Methodologically, while memory-driven device control can be approached using Reinforcement Learning, conventional RL methods generally rely on outcome-based supervision (i.e., whether the final task is achieved). This lack of intermediate feedback can lead to sub-optimal performance or local failures in fine-grained memory management tasks (adding, updating, deleting, and utilizing). To address these issues, we first release MemHomeLife, built from anonymized real-world long-term user interaction logs. To enable more fine-grained evaluation of different memory-related subtasks, we further construct MemHome, the first benchmark designed to systematically evaluate memory-driven device control in smart home scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对智能家居中基于记忆的设备控制问题，提出了MemHomeLife数据集和MemHome基准测试，以解决现有评估方法在记忆驱动设备控制方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有智能家居助手虽然能实时控制设备，但在记忆驱动的设备控制方面存在挑战。现有基准测试要么关注即时设备控制，要么关注通用开放域记忆检索，无法有效评估模型在记忆驱动设备控制方面的能力。
AI.method: 1. 发布MemHomeLife数据集，基于匿名化的真实世界长期用户交互日志构建；2. 构建MemHome基准测试，这是首个系统评估智能家居场景中记忆驱动设备控制的基准。
AI.result: 提出了MemHomeLife数据集和MemHome基准测试，能够更细粒度地评估不同记忆相关子任务（添加、更新、删除和利用记忆），解决了传统强化学习方法在中间反馈缺乏导致的问题。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过构建专门的基准测试和数据集，为评估和改进智能家居中记忆驱动设备控制提供了重要工具，有助于提升大语言模型在个性化智能家居体验中的表现。

title: Unmixing-Guided Spatial-Spectral Mamba with Clustering Tokens for Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: Although hyperspectral image (HSI) classification is critical for supporting various environmental applications, it is a challenging task due to the spectral-mixture effect, the spatial-spectral heterogeneity and the difficulty to preserve class boundaries and details. This letter presents a novel unmixing-guided spatial-spectral Mamba with clustering tokens for improved HSI classification, with the following contributions. First, to disentangle the spectral mixture effect in HSI for improved pattern discovery, we design a novel spectral unmixing network that not only automatically learns endmembers and abundance maps from HSI but also accounts for endmember variabilities. Second, to generate Mamba token sequences, based on the clusters defined by abundance maps, we design an efficient Top-\textit{K} token selection strategy to adaptively sequence the tokens for improved representational capability. Third, to improve spatial-spectral feature learning and detail preservation, based on the Top-\textit{K} token sequences, we design a novel unmixing-guided spatial-spectral Mamba module that greatly improves traditional Mamba models in terms of token learning and sequencing. Fourth, to learn simultaneously the endmember-abundance patterns and classification labels, a multi-task scheme is designed for model supervision, leading to a new unmixing-classification framework that outputs not only accurate classification maps but also a comprehensive spectral-library and abundance maps. Comparative experiments on four HSI datasets demonstrate that our model can greatly outperform the other state-of-the-art approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/GSIL-UCalgary/Unmixing_guided_Mamba.git

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于解混引导的空间-光谱Mamba模型，利用聚类token改进高光谱图像分类，通过解混网络学习端元和丰度图，设计Top-K token选择策略，构建多任务学习框架，在四个数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像分类面临光谱混合效应、空间-光谱异质性以及难以保持类别边界和细节的挑战，需要新的方法来改善模式发现和特征学习。
AI.method: 1) 设计光谱解混网络自动学习端元和丰度图并考虑端元变异性；2) 基于丰度图聚类设计Top-K token选择策略自适应序列化token；3) 设计解混引导的空间-光谱Mamba模块改进token学习和序列化；4) 构建多任务监督方案同时学习端元-丰度模式和分类标签。
AI.result: 在四个高光谱数据集上的对比实验表明，该模型显著优于其他最先进方法，不仅能输出准确的分类图，还能生成全面的光谱库和丰度图。
AI.conclusion: 提出的解混引导空间-光谱Mamba模型通过结合解混技术和Mamba架构，有效解决了高光谱图像分类中的光谱混合和细节保持问题，为环境应用提供了更准确的分析工具。

title: Efficient Process Reward Modeling via Contrastive Mutual Information
summary: Recent research has devoted considerable effort to verifying the intermediate reasoning steps of chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories using process reward models (PRMs) and other verifier models. However, training a PRM typically requires human annotators to assign reward scores to each reasoning step, which is both costly and time-consuming. Existing automated approaches, such as Monte Carlo (MC) estimation, also demand substantial computational resources due to repeated LLM rollouts. To overcome these limitations, we propose contrastive pointwise mutual information (CPMI), a novel automatic reward labeling method that leverages the model's internal probability to infer step-level supervision while significantly reducing the computational burden of annotating dataset. CPMI quantifies how much a reasoning step increases the mutual information between the step and the correct target answer relative to hard-negative alternatives. This contrastive signal serves as a proxy for the step's contribution to the final solution and yields a reliable reward. The experimental results show that CPMI-based labeling reduces dataset construction time by 84% and token generation by 98% compared to MC estimation, while achieving higher accuracy on process-level evaluations and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出CPMI方法，利用模型内部概率自动标注推理步骤奖励，相比传统方法大幅减少计算成本和人工标注需求
AI.motivation: 现有过程奖励模型训练需要人工标注推理步骤奖励，成本高耗时长；自动化方法如蒙特卡洛估计也需要大量计算资源。需要一种高效自动的奖励标注方法。
AI.method: 提出对比点互信息方法，通过量化推理步骤相对于硬负例对正确答案互信息的贡献程度，作为步骤奖励的代理信号。
