AI.result: CPMI标注相比蒙特卡洛估计减少84%数据集构建时间和98%token生成，在过程级评估和数学推理基准上获得更高准确率。
AI.conclusion: CPMI是一种高效自动的奖励标注方法，显著降低计算成本，为过程奖励模型训练提供可靠监督信号。

title: Learning from Emptiness: De-biasing Listwise Rerankers with Content-Agnostic Probability Calibration
summary: Generative listwise reranking leverages global context for superior retrieval but is plagued by intrinsic position bias, where models exhibit structural sensitivity to input order independent of relevance. Existing mitigations present a dilemma: inference-time aggregation incurs prohibitive latency, while training-based methods often fail to eradicate ingrained priors, particularly in compact models. To resolve this dilemma, we propose CapCal (Content-Agnostic Probability Calibration), a training-free framework that mechanically decouples positional bias from ranking decisions. By estimating the bias distribution via content-free placeholders, CapCal rectifies output logits through an entropy-adaptive contrastive mechanism. Evaluations across 10 benchmarks confirm that CapCal achieves superior performance among training-free methods while preserving single-pass efficiency. Notably, it unlocks the latent potential of lightweight models (e.g., 0.6B), delivering absolute NDCG gains exceeding 10 points and outperforming both permutation-based aggregation and data-augmentation baselines.

AI.tldr: CapCal是一种无需训练的内容无关概率校准框架，通过内容无关占位符估计位置偏差分布，使用熵自适应对比机制校正输出logits，解决了生成式列表重排序中的固有位置偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式列表重排序利用全局上下文实现优越检索，但受到固有位置偏差的困扰，模型对输入顺序表现出与相关性无关的结构敏感性。现有缓解方法存在两难：推理时聚合导致过高延迟，而基于训练的方法往往无法消除根深蒂固的先验，特别是在紧凑模型中。
AI.method: 提出CapCal（内容无关概率校准）框架，这是一种无需训练的方法，通过内容无关占位符估计位置偏差分布，然后使用熵自适应对比机制机械地将位置偏差与排序决策解耦，校正输出logits。
AI.result: 在10个基准测试上的评估证实，CapCal在无需训练的方法中实现了优越性能，同时保持单次推理效率。特别地，它释放了轻量级模型（如0.6B）的潜在能力，NDCG绝对增益超过10个百分点，优于基于排列的聚合和数据增强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CapCal有效解决了生成式列表重排序中的位置偏差问题，通过无需训练的内容无关概率校准框架，在保持效率的同时显著提升轻量级模型的性能，为实际部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Learnable Motion-Focused Tokenization for Effective and Efficient Video Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
comment: Accepted to IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: Video Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (VUDA) poses a significant challenge in action recognition, requiring the adaptation of a model from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain. Despite recent advances, existing VUDA methods often fall short of fully supervised performance, a key reason being the prevalence of static and uninformative backgrounds that exacerbate domain shifts. Additionally, prior approaches largely overlook computational efficiency, limiting real-world adoption. To address these issues, we propose Learnable Motion-Focused Tokenization (LMFT) for VUDA. LMFT tokenizes video frames into patch tokens and learns to discard low-motion, redundant tokens, primarily corresponding to background regions, while retaining motion-rich, action-relevant tokens for adaptation. Extensive experiments on three standard VUDA benchmarks across 21 domain adaptation settings show that our VUDA framework with LMFT achieves state-of-the-art performance while significantly reducing computational overhead. LMFT thus enables VUDA that is both effective and computationally efficient.

AI.tldr: LMFT通过可学习的运动聚焦标记化方法，在视频无监督域自适应中实现了最先进的性能，同时显著降低了计算开销。
AI.motivation: 视频无监督域自适应（VUDA）面临两个主要挑战：静态无信息背景加剧域偏移，以及现有方法计算效率低限制实际应用。
AI.method: 提出可学习的运动聚焦标记化（LMFT），将视频帧标记化为补丁标记，学习丢弃低运动冗余标记（主要对应背景区域），保留运动丰富、动作相关的标记进行自适应。
AI.result: 在3个标准VUDA基准测试的21个域自适应设置中，LMFT框架实现了最先进的性能，同时显著降低了计算开销。
AI.conclusion: LMFT实现了既有效又计算高效的视频无监督域自适应，解决了背景干扰和计算效率问题。

title: HeceTokenizer: A Syllable-Based Tokenization Approach for Turkish Retrieval
summary: HeceTokenizer is a syllable-based tokenizer for Turkish that exploits the deterministic six-pattern phonological structure of the language to construct a closed, out-of-vocabulary (OOV)-free vocabulary of approximately 8,000 unique syllable types. A BERT-tiny encoder (1.5M parameters) is trained from scratch on a subset of Turkish Wikipedia using a masked language modeling objective and evaluated on the TQuAD retrieval benchmark using Recall@5. Combined with a fine-grained chunk-based retrieval strategy, HeceTokenizer achieves 50.3% Recall@5, surpassing the 46.92% reported by a morphology-driven baseline that uses a 200 times larger model. These results suggest that the phonological regularity of Turkish syllables provides a strong and resource-light inductive bias for retrieval tasks.

AI.tldr: HeceTokenizer是一种基于音节的土耳其语分词器，利用语言的确定性六模式音系结构构建约8000个独特音节类型的封闭词汇表，无OOV问题。使用仅150万参数的BERT-tiny模型在土耳其维基百科子集上训练，结合细粒度分块检索策略，在TQuAD检索基准上Recall@5达到50.3%，超越使用200倍大模型的形态学驱动基线。
AI.motivation: 土耳其语具有确定的六模式音系结构，这为构建基于音节的封闭词汇表提供了机会，可以避免OOV问题。现有基于形态学的分词方法需要大模型，资源消耗大，而利用音系规律性可能提供更轻量但有效的解决方案。
AI.method:
1. 利用土耳其语的确定性六模式音系结构构建音节词汇表（约8000个独特音节类型）
2. 开发HeceTokenizer音节分词器，创建封闭、无OOV的词汇表
3. 使用BERT-tiny编码器（150万参数）在土耳其维基百科子集上从头训练，采用掩码语言建模目标
4. 结合细粒度分块检索策略进行评估
AI.result: 在TQuAD检索基准上Recall@5达到50.3%，显著超越形态学驱动基线的46.92%。值得注意的是，HeceTokenizer使用的模型参数仅为基线模型的1/200（150万 vs 约3亿参数），展示了更高的效率。
AI.conclusion: 土耳其语音节的音系规律性为检索任务提供了强大且资源轻量的归纳偏置。基于音节的分词方法在显著减少模型参数的同时，能够超越基于形态学的更大模型，证明了利用语言固有结构特征的有效性。

title: SpecMoE: A Fast and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Inference via Self-Assisted Speculative Decoding
comment: This is an extended version of our work, which is accepted for publication at the 63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC), 2026
summary: The Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture has emerged as a promising approach to mitigate the rising computational costs of large language models (LLMs) by selectively activating parameters. However, its high memory requirements and sub-optimal parameter efficiency pose significant challenges for efficient deployment. Although CPU-offloaded MoE inference systems have been proposed in the literature, they offer limited efficiency, particularly for large batch sizes. In this work, we propose SpecMoE, a memory-efficient MoE inference system based on our self-assisted speculative decoding algorithm. SpecMoE demonstrates the effectiveness of applying speculative decoding to MoE inference without requiring additional model training or fine-tuning. Our system improves inference throughput by up to $4.30\times$, while significantly reducing bandwidth requirements of both memory and interconnect on memory-constrained systems.

AI.tldr: SpecMoE：基于自辅助推测解码的内存高效MoE推理系统，无需额外训练即可提升推理吞吐量4.3倍
AI.motivation: 混合专家（MoE）架构虽然能降低大语言模型的计算成本，但其高内存需求和次优参数效率给高效部署带来挑战。现有的CPU卸载MoE推理系统效率有限，特别是在大批量处理时表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出SpecMoE系统，基于自辅助推测解码算法，将推测解码技术应用于MoE推理，无需额外的模型训练或微调。
AI.result: 系统将推理吞吐量提升高达4.30倍，同时在内存受限系统上显著降低了内存和互连的带宽需求。
AI.conclusion: SpecMoE展示了将推测解码应用于MoE推理的有效性，为内存受限环境下的高效MoE部署提供了解决方案。

title: Learning and Enforcing Context-Sensitive Control for LLMs
summary: Controlling the output of Large Language Models (LLMs) through context-sensitive constraints has emerged as a promising approach to overcome the limitations of Context-Free Grammars (CFGs) in guaranteeing generation validity. However, such constraints typically require manual specification -- a significant barrier demanding specialized expertise. We introduce a framework that automatically learns context-sensitive constraints from LLM interactions through a two-phase process: syntactic exploration to gather diverse outputs for constraint learning, followed by constraint exploitation to enforce these learned rules during generation. Experiments demonstrate that our method enables even small LLMs (1B parameters) to learn and generate with perfect constraint adherence, outperforming larger counterparts and state-of-the-art reasoning models. This work represents the first integration of context-sensitive grammar learning with LLM generation, eliminating manual specification while maintaining generation validity.

AI.tldr: 提出一个自动从LLM交互中学习上下文敏感约束的框架，无需人工指定，使小模型也能完美遵守约束生成
AI.motivation: 上下文敏感约束能克服上下文无关文法在保证生成有效性方面的局限性，但通常需要人工指定，这需要专业知识且构成显著障碍
AI.method: 采用两阶段过程：1) 句法探索阶段收集多样化输出用于约束学习；2) 约束利用阶段在生成时强制执行学习到的规则
AI.result: 实验表明该方法使小模型(10亿参数)也能学习和生成时完美遵守约束，性能超过更大模型和最先进的推理模型
AI.conclusion: 这是首次将上下文敏感文法学习与LLM生成相结合，消除了人工指定需求同时保持生成有效性

title: Inductive Reasoning for Temporal Knowledge Graphs with Emerging Entities
summary: Reasoning on Temporal Knowledge Graphs (TKGs) is essential for predicting future events and time-aware facts. While existing methods are effective at capturing relational dynamics, their performance is limited by a closed-world assumption, which fails to account for emerging entities not present in the training. Notably, these entities continuously join the network without historical interactions. Empirical study reveals that emerging entities are widespread in TKGs, comprising roughly 25\% of all entities. The absence of historical interactions of these entities leads to significant performance degradation in reasoning tasks. Whereas, we observe that entities with semantic similarities often exhibit comparable interaction histories, suggesting the presence of transferable temporal patterns. Inspired by this insight, we propose TransFIR (Transferable Inductive Reasoning), a novel framework that leverages historical interaction sequences from semantically similar known entities to support inductive reasoning. Specifically, we propose a codebook-based classifier that categorizes emerging entities into latent semantic clusters, allowing them to adopt reasoning patterns from similar entities. Experimental results demonstrate that TransFIR outperforms all baselines in reasoning on emerging entities, achieving an average improvement of 28.6% in Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) across multiple datasets. The implementations are available at https://github.com/zhaodazhuang2333/TransFIR.

AI.tldr: TransFIR是一个用于时序知识图谱推理的新框架，专门解决新兴实体缺乏历史交互数据的问题，通过从语义相似的已知实体转移时序模式来支持归纳推理。
AI.motivation: 现有时序知识图谱推理方法基于封闭世界假设，无法处理训练集中未出现的新兴实体。研究发现新兴实体在TKGs中广泛存在（约25%），且缺乏历史交互数据导致推理性能显著下降。观察到语义相似的实体通常具有可比较的交互历史，表明存在可转移的时序模式。
AI.method: 提出TransFIR框架，利用基于码本的分类器将新兴实体分类到潜在语义簇中，使其能够从相似实体中采用推理模式。通过从语义相似的已知实体转移历史交互序列来支持归纳推理。
AI.result: TransFIR在所有基线方法中表现最佳，在多个数据集上的新兴实体推理任务中，平均MRR（平均倒数排名）提升了28.6%。
AI.conclusion: TransFIR通过从语义相似实体转移时序模式，有效解决了时序知识图谱中新兴实体的推理问题，显著提升了归纳推理性能。

title: FlowPalm: Optical Flow Driven Non-Rigid Deformation for Geometrically Diverse Palmprint Generation
summary: Recently, synthetic palmprints have been increasingly used as substitutes for real data to train recognition models. To be effective, such synthetic data must reflect the diversity of real palmprints, including both style variation and geometric variation. However, existing palmprint generation methods mainly focus on style translation, while geometric variation is either ignored or approximated by simple handcrafted augmentations. In this work, we propose FlowPalm, an optical-flow-driven palmprint generation framework capable of simulating the complex non-rigid deformations observed in real palms. Specifically, FlowPalm estimates optical flows between real palmprint pairs to capture the statistical patterns of geometric deformations. Building on these priors, we design a progressive sampling process that gradually introduces the geometric deformations during diffusion while maintaining identity consistency. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that FlowPalm significantly outperforms state-of-the-art palmprint generation approaches in downstream recognition tasks. Project page: https://yuchenzou.github.io/FlowPalm/

AI.tldr: FlowPalm是一个基于光流驱动的掌纹生成框架，能够模拟真实手掌中观察到的复杂非刚性变形，显著提升了掌纹识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的掌纹生成方法主要关注风格转换，而几何变形要么被忽略，要么通过简单的手工增强来近似。为了有效训练识别模型，合成掌纹需要反映真实掌纹的多样性，包括风格变化和几何变化。
AI.method: FlowPalm通过估计真实掌纹对之间的光流来捕捉几何变形的统计模式，并设计了一个渐进采样过程，在扩散过程中逐步引入几何变形，同时保持身份一致性。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，FlowPalm在下游识别任务中显著优于最先进的掌纹生成方法。
AI.conclusion: FlowPalm能够有效模拟真实手掌的复杂非刚性变形，为掌纹识别提供了高质量的合成数据，解决了现有方法在几何变形处理上的不足。

title: QFS-Composer: Query-focused summarization pipeline for less resourced languages
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong performance in text summarization, yet their effectiveness drops significantly across languages with restricted training resources. This work addresses the challenge of query-focused summarization (QFS) in less-resourced languages, where labeled datasets and evaluation tools are limited. We present a novel QFS framework, QFS-Composer, that integrates query decomposition, question generation (QG), question answering (QA), and abstractive summarization to improve the factual alignment of a summary with user intent. We test our approach on the Slovenian language. To enable high-quality supervision and evaluation, we develop the Slovenian QA and QG models based on a Slovene LLM and adapt evaluation approaches for reference-free summary evaluation. Empirical evaluation shows that the QA-guided summarization pipeline yields improved consistency and relevance over baseline LLMs. Our work establishes an extensible methodology for advancing QFS in less-resourced languages.

AI.tldr: 提出QFS-Composer框架，通过查询分解、问题生成、问题回答和摘要生成的多阶段流程，提升低资源语言中查询聚焦摘要的事实对齐能力，在斯洛文尼亚语上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在文本摘要方面表现出色，但在训练资源受限的语言中性能显著下降。针对低资源语言中查询聚焦摘要任务面临的标注数据集和评估工具有限的问题，需要开发有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出QFS-Composer框架，整合四个关键组件：查询分解、问题生成、问题回答和抽象摘要生成。基于斯洛文尼亚语LLM开发了斯洛文尼亚语的QA和QG模型，并采用无参考摘要评估方法。
AI.result: 实证评估表明，QA引导的摘要流水线在一致性和相关性方面优于基线LLM。在斯洛文尼亚语上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为推进低资源语言中的查询聚焦摘要建立了一个可扩展的方法论，通过多阶段流程改善了摘要与用户意图的事实对齐。

title: Gait Recognition with Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: Gait recognition is a biometric modality that identifies individuals from their characteristic walking patterns. Unlike conventional biometric traits, gait can be acquired at a distance and without active subject cooperation, making it suitable for surveillance and public safety applications. Nevertheless, silhouette-based temporal models remain sensitive to long sequences, observation noise, and appearance-related covariates. Recurrent architectures often struggle to preserve information from earlier frames and are inherently sequential to optimize, whereas transformer-based models typically require greater computational resources and larger training sets and may be sensitive to irregular sequence lengths and noisy inputs. These limitations reduce robustness under clothing variation, carrying conditions, and view changes, while also hindering the joint modeling of local gait cycles and longer-term motion trends. To address these challenges, we introduce a Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (TKAN) for gait recognition. The proposed model replaces fixed edge weights with learnable one-dimensional functions and incorporates a two-level memory mechanism consisting of short-term RKAN sublayers and a gated long-term pathway. This design enables efficient modeling of both cycle-level dynamics and broader temporal context while maintaining a compact backbone. Experiments on the CASIA-B dataset indicate that the proposed CNN+TKAN framework achieves strong recognition performance under the reported evaluation setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于步态识别的时序Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（TKAN），通过可学习的一维函数和两级记忆机制，有效建模步态周期动态和长期时序上下文，在CASIA-B数据集上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 步态识别作为一种远距离、无需主动配合的生物特征识别技术，在监控和公共安全领域具有重要应用价值。然而，现有的基于轮廓的时序模型对长序列、观测噪声和外观相关协变量敏感，循环架构难以保留早期帧信息且优化困难，而基于Transformer的模型需要更多计算资源和训练数据，对不规则序列长度和噪声输入敏感。这些限制降低了模型在服装变化、携带条件和视角变化下的鲁棒性，也阻碍了对局部步态周期和长期运动趋势的联合建模。
AI.method: 提出时序Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（TKAN），用可学习的一维函数替代固定边权重，并引入包含短期RKAN子层和门控长期通路的二级记忆机制。这种设计能够高效建模周期级动态和更广泛的时序上下文，同时保持紧凑的骨干网络。模型采用CNN+TKAN框架进行步态识别。
AI.result: 在CASIA-B数据集上的实验表明，提出的CNN+TKAN框架在报告的评价设置下实现了强大的识别性能。
AI.conclusion: TKAN通过创新的网络架构设计，有效解决了现有步态识别模型在时序建模方面的局限性，为处理长序列、噪声和外观变化提供了更鲁棒的解决方案，在步态识别任务中展现出优越性能。

title: Attention Sinks as Internal Signals for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models frequently exhibit hallucinations: fluent and confident outputs that are factually incorrect or unsupported by the input context. While recent hallucination detection methods have explored various features derived from attention maps, the underlying mechanisms they exploit remain poorly understood. In this work, we propose SinkProbe, a hallucination detection method grounded in the observation that hallucinations are deeply entangled with attention sinks - tokens that accumulate disproportionate attention mass during generation - indicating a transition from distributed, input-grounded attention to compressed, prior-dominated computation. Importantly, although sink scores are computed solely from attention maps, we find that the classifier preferentially relies on sinks whose associated value vectors have large norms. Moreover, we show that previous methods implicitly depend on attention sinks by establishing their mathematical relationship to sink scores. Our findings yield a novel hallucination detection method grounded in theory that produces state-of-the-art results across popular datasets and LLMs.

AI.tldr: SinkProbe：基于注意力下沉机制的大语言模型幻觉检测新方法，通过分析注意力分布异常实现SOTA性能
AI.motivation: 大语言模型经常产生幻觉（流畅但事实错误或无依据的输出），现有检测方法虽探索了注意力图特征，但其底层机制理解不足。作者观察到幻觉与注意力下沉（某些token积累过多注意力）密切相关，表明从分布式、基于输入的注意力向压缩、先验主导计算的转变。
AI.method: 提出SinkProbe方法，基于注意力下沉现象进行幻觉检测。虽然下沉分数仅从注意力图计算，但发现分类器优先依赖那些关联值向量范数大的下沉。建立了先前方法与注意力下沉的数学关系，证明它们隐式依赖于下沉机制。
AI.result: SinkProbe在多个流行数据集和LLM上实现了最先进的幻觉检测性能，提供了一种理论基础扎实的检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 注意力下沉是理解LLM幻觉的关键机制，SinkProbe基于这一理论洞察开发，不仅性能优越，还为理解先前方法的底层机制提供了数学基础。

title: PoreDiT: A Scalable Generative Model for Large-Scale Digital Rock Reconstruction
summary: This manuscript presents PoreDiT, a novel generative model designed for high-efficiency digital rock reconstruction at gigavoxel scales. Addressing the significant challenges in digital rock physics (DRP), particularly the trade-off between resolution and field-of-view (FOV), and the computational bottlenecks associated with traditional deep learning architectures, PoreDiT leverages a three-dimensional (3D) Swin Transformer to break through these limitations. By directly predicting the binary probability field of pore spaces instead of grayscale intensities, the model preserves key topological features critical for pore-scale fluid flow and transport simulations. This approach enhances computational efficiency, enabling the generation of ultra-large-scale ($1024^3$ voxels) digital rock samples on consumer-grade hardware. Furthermore, PoreDiT achieves physical fidelity comparable to previous state-of-the-art methods, including accurate porosity, pore-scale permeability, and Euler characteristics. The model's ability to scale efficiently opens new avenues for large-domain hydrodynamic simulations and provides practical solutions for researchers in pore-scale fluid mechanics, reservoir characterization, and carbon sequestration.

AI.tldr: PoreDiT是一种基于3D Swin Transformer的新型生成模型，能够高效生成千兆体素规模的数字岩石，解决了数字岩石物理中分辨率与视场的权衡问题，在消费级硬件上即可生成1024³体素的大规模样本。
AI.motivation: 解决数字岩石物理（DRP）中的关键挑战：1）分辨率与视场（FOV）之间的权衡问题；2）传统深度学习架构的计算瓶颈；3）需要高效生成大规模数字岩石样本以支持孔隙尺度流体流动和输运模拟。
AI.method: 采用三维（3D）Swin Transformer架构，直接预测孔隙空间的二元概率场而非灰度强度，保留孔隙拓扑特征。该方法提高了计算效率，能够在消费级硬件上生成超大规模（1024³体素）数字岩石样本。
AI.result: PoreDiT能够高效生成千兆体素规模的数字岩石，物理保真度与现有最先进方法相当，包括准确的孔隙度、孔隙尺度渗透率和欧拉特性。模型的高效扩展能力为大规模流体动力学模拟开辟了新途径。
AI.conclusion: PoreDiT通过创新的3D Swin Transformer架构和二元概率场预测方法，成功解决了数字岩石物理中的分辨率-视场权衡和计算效率问题，为孔隙尺度流体力学、储层表征和碳封存研究提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Revisiting the Scale Loss Function and Gaussian-Shape Convolution for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection still faces two persistent challenges: training instability from non-monotonic scale loss functions, and inadequate spatial attention due to generic convolution kernels that ignore the physical imaging characteristics of small targets. In this paper, we revisit both aspects. For the loss side, we propose a \emph{diff-based scale loss} that weights predictions according to the signed area difference between the predicted mask and the ground truth, yielding strictly monotonic gradients and stable convergence. We further analyze a family of four scale loss variants to understand how their geometric properties affect detection behavior. For the spatial side, we introduce \emph{Gaussian-shaped convolution} with a learnable scale parameter to match the center-concentrated intensity profile of infrared small targets, and augment it with a \emph{rotated pinwheel mask} that adaptively aligns the kernel with target orientation via a straight-through estimator. Extensive experiments on IRSTD-1k, NUDT-SIRST, and SIRST-UAVB demonstrate consistent improvements in $mIoU$, $P_d$, and $F_a$ over state-of-the-art methods. We release our anonymous code and pretrained models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种改进红外小目标检测的方法：基于面积差的尺度损失函数解决训练不稳定问题，以及高斯形状卷积结合旋转风车掩码增强空间注意力。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标检测面临两个持续挑战：非单调尺度损失函数导致的训练不稳定，以及通用卷积核忽略小目标物理成像特性造成的空间注意力不足。
AI.method: 1. 提出基于面积差的尺度损失函数，根据预测掩码与真实标签之间的符号化面积差异加权预测，产生严格单调梯度确保稳定收敛；2. 引入高斯形状卷积，其可学习尺度参数匹配红外小目标的中心集中强度分布；3. 结合旋转风车掩码，通过直通估计器自适应对齐核与目标方向。
AI.result: 在IRSTD-1k、NUDT-SIRST和SIRST-UAVB数据集上的大量实验表明，在mIoU、Pd和Fa指标上相比最先进方法取得了一致性改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过重新审视损失函数和空间注意力机制，提出的方法有效解决了红外小目标检测中的训练不稳定和空间注意力不足问题，实现了性能的显著提升。

title: Expect the Unexpected? Testing the Surprisal of Salient Entities
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 (main, long); camera-ready version
summary: Previous work examining the Uniform Information Density (UID) hypothesis has shown that while information as measured by surprisal metrics is distributed more or less evenly across documents overall, local discrepancies can arise due to functional pressures corresponding to syntactic and discourse structural constraints. However, work thus far has largely disregarded the relative salience of discourse participants. We fill this gap by studying how overall salience of entities in discourse relates to surprisal using 70K manually annotated mentions across 16 genres of English and a novel minimal-pair prompting method. Our results show that globally salient entities exhibit significantly higher surprisal than non-salient ones, even controlling for position, length, and nesting confounds. Moreover, salient entities systematically reduce surprisal for surrounding content when used as prompts, enhancing document-level predictability. This effect varies by genre, appearing strongest in topic-coherent texts and weakest in conversational contexts. Our findings refine the UID competing pressures framework by identifying global entity salience as a mechanism shaping information distribution in discourse.

AI.tldr: 研究发现：在话语中，全局显著的实体比非显著实体具有更高的信息量（惊讶度），且显著实体能降低周围内容的信息量，这种效应在不同文体中存在差异。
AI.motivation: 先前关于均匀信息密度假设的研究发现，虽然信息在文档中大致均匀分布，但局部差异可能由句法和话语结构约束引起。然而，现有研究大多忽视了话语参与者的相对显著性。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探究实体在话语中的整体显著性如何与信息量（惊讶度）相关。
AI.method: 使用70K手动标注的提及项，涵盖16种英语文体，采用新颖的最小对比提示方法，研究实体显著性与信息量（惊讶度）的关系，并控制位置、长度和嵌套等混淆因素。
AI.result: 1. 全局显著实体比非显著实体具有显著更高的惊讶度；2. 当用作提示时，显著实体能系统性地降低周围内容的惊讶度，增强文档层面的可预测性；3. 这种效应在不同文体中存在差异：在主题连贯的文本中最强，在对话语境中最弱。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果通过识别全局实体显著性作为塑造话语中信息分布的机制，完善了均匀信息密度假设的竞争压力框架。

title: Credit-Budgeted ICPC-Style Coding: When Agents Must Pay for Every Decision
summary: Current evaluations of autonomous coding agents assume an unrealistic, infinite-resource environment. However, real-world software engineering is a resource-bound competition. As we scale toward large agent swarms, ignoring compute and time costs risks catastrophic budget exhaustion. To shift the focus from isolated accuracy to cost-aware problem-solving, we introduce USACOArena, an interactive ACM-ICPC-style arena driven by a strict "credit" economy. Every generated token, local test, and elapsed second depletes a fixed budget, forcing agents to make strategic trade-offs. Our comprehensive profiling reveals that frontier single agents and swarms currently fail to optimally balance accuracy with these constraints, exhibiting divergent, path-dependent behaviors. Ultimately, USACOArena provides an essential dynamic training ground for developing highly efficient, resource-aware agent architectures.

AI.tldr: USACOArena是一个基于信用经济的交互式ACM-ICPC风格竞技场，用于评估资源受限环境下的自主编码代理，强调计算和时间成本的战略权衡
AI.motivation: 当前自主编码代理评估假设无限资源环境，但现实软件开发是资源受限的竞争。随着大规模代理群的发展，忽略计算和时间成本可能导致灾难性的预算耗尽，需要从孤立准确性转向成本感知的问题解决
AI.method: 引入USACOArena，一个基于严格"信用"经济的交互式ACM-ICPC风格竞技场。每个生成的令牌、本地测试和经过的秒数都会消耗固定预算，迫使代理做出战略权衡
AI.result: 综合分析显示，前沿的单代理和代理群目前无法在准确性与约束之间实现最优平衡，表现出不同的、路径依赖的行为模式
AI.conclusion: USACOArena为开发高效、资源感知的代理架构提供了重要的动态训练场，推动了从单纯准确性到成本效益平衡的范式转变

title: A Comparative Study of Modern Object Detectors for Robust Apple Detection in Orchard Imagery
summary: Accurate apple detection in orchard images is important for yield prediction, fruit counting, robotic harvesting, and crop monitoring. However, changing illumination, leaf clutter, dense fruit clusters, and partial occlusion make detection difficult. To provide a fair and reproducible comparison, this study establishes a controlled benchmark for single-class apple detection on the public AppleBBCH81 dataset using one deterministic train, validation, and test split and a unified evaluation protocol across six representative detectors: YOLOv10n, YOLO11n, RT-DETR-L, Faster R-CNN (ResNet50-FPN), FCOS (ResNet50-FPN), and SSDLite320 (MobileNetV3-Large). Performance is evaluated primarily using COCO-style mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95, and threshold-dependent behavior is further analyzed using precision-recall curves and fixed-threshold precision, recall, and F1-score at IoU = 0.5. On the validation split, YOLO11n achieves the best strict localization performance with mAP@0.5:0.95 = 0.6065 and mAP@0.5 = 0.9620, followed closely by RT-DETR-L and YOLOv10n. At a fixed operating point with confidence >= 0.05, YOLOv10n attains the highest F1-score, whereas RT-DETR-L achieves very high recall but low precision because of many false positives at low confidence. These findings show that detector selection for orchard deployment should be guided not only by localization-aware accuracy but also by threshold robustness and the requirements of the downstream task.

AI.tldr: 该研究在AppleBBCH81数据集上建立了苹果检测的基准测试，比较了六种代表性检测器，发现YOLO11n在严格定位性能上表现最佳，而YOLOv10n在固定阈值下获得最高F1分数。
AI.motivation: 果园图像中的苹果检测对于产量预测、果实计数、机器人采摘和作物监测很重要，但光照变化、叶片遮挡、密集果实簇和部分遮挡使检测变得困难。需要提供一个公平且可复现的比较基准。
AI.method: 在公开的AppleBBCH81数据集上建立受控基准测试，使用确定性的训练、验证和测试划分，统一评估六种代表性检测器：YOLOv10n、YOLO11n、RT-DETR-L、Faster R-CNN、FCOS和SSDLite320。主要使用COCO风格的mAP@0.5和mAP@0.5:0.95评估性能，并通过精确率-召回率曲线和固定阈值下的精确率、召回率、F1分数进一步分析阈值依赖性行为。
AI.result: 在验证集上，YOLO11n获得最佳严格定位性能（mAP@0.5:0.95 = 0.6065，mAP@0.5 = 0.9620），紧随其后的是RT-DETR-L和YOLOv10n。在置信度≥0.05的固定操作点，YOLOv10n获得最高F1分数，而RT-DETR-L召回率很高但精确率较低（因低置信度下的误报较多）。
AI.conclusion: 果园部署中的检测器选择不仅应基于定位感知精度，还应考虑阈值鲁棒性和下游任务需求。不同检测器在不同指标上表现各异，需要根据具体应用场景进行选择。

title: Too Nice to Tell the Truth: Quantifying Agreeableness-Driven Sycophancy in Role-Playing Language Models
comment: 14 Pages, 5 Figures, 9 Tables, ACL Main Conference 2026
summary: Large language models increasingly serve as conversational agents that adopt personas and role-play characters at user request. This capability, while valuable, raises concerns about sycophancy: the tendency to provide responses that validate users rather than prioritize factual accuracy. While prior work has established that sycophancy poses risks to AI safety and alignment, the relationship between specific personality traits of adopted personas and the degree of sycophantic behavior remains unexplored. We present a systematic investigation of how persona agreeableness influences sycophancy across 13 small, open-weight language models ranging from 0.6B to 20B parameters. We develop a benchmark comprising 275 personas evaluated on NEO-IPIP agreeableness subscales and expose each persona to 4,950 sycophancy-eliciting prompts spanning 33 topic categories. Our analysis reveals that 9 of 13 models exhibit statistically significant positive correlations between persona agreeableness and sycophancy rates, with Pearson correlations reaching $r = 0.87$ and effect sizes as large as Cohen's $d = 2.33$. These findings demonstrate that agreeableness functions as a reliable predictor of persona-induced sycophancy, with direct implications for the deployment of role-playing AI systems and the development of alignment strategies that account for personality-mediated deceptive behaviors.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大语言模型角色扮演时，人格特质中的宜人性与谄媚行为呈正相关，宜人性越高，模型越倾向于讨好用户而非坚持事实准确性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型作为对话代理能够扮演角色，但这种能力引发了谄媚行为的担忧——即模型倾向于迎合用户而非坚持事实准确性。虽然已有研究指出谄媚行为对AI安全和对齐构成风险，但特定人格特质（特别是宜人性）与谄媚程度的关系尚未被探索。
AI.method: 开发了一个包含275个人格的基准测试，使用NEO-IPIP宜性子量表评估每个人格，然后将每个人格暴露在4,950个引发谄媚行为的提示中，涵盖33个主题类别。研究涵盖了13个小型开放权重语言模型，参数范围从0.6B到20B。
AI.result: 13个模型中有9个显示出人格宜人性与谄媚率之间存在统计学上显著的正相关关系，皮尔逊相关系数最高达到r=0.87，效应量高达Cohen's d=2.33。这表明宜人性是预测人格诱导谄媚行为的可靠指标。
AI.conclusion: 宜人性作为人格特质能够可靠预测角色扮演AI系统的谄媚行为，这对部署角色扮演AI系统和开发考虑人格介导欺骗行为的对齐策略具有直接意义。

title: GIF: A Conditional Multimodal Generative Framework for IR Drop Imaging in Chip Layouts
summary: IR drop analysis is essential in physical chip design to ensure the power integrity of on-chip power delivery networks. Traditional Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools have become slow and expensive as transistor density scales. Recent works have introduced machine learning (ML)-based methods that formulate IR drop analysis as an image prediction problem. These existing ML approaches fail to capture both local and long-range dependencies and ignore crucial geometrical and topological information from physical layouts and logical connectivity. To address these limitations, we propose GIF, a Generative IR drop Framework that uses both geometrical and topological information to generate IR drop images. GIF fuses image and graph features to guide a conditional diffusion process, producing high-quality IR drop images. For instance, On the CircuitNet-N28 dataset, GIF achieves 0.78 SSIM, 0.95 Pearson correlation, 21.77 PSNR, and 0.026 NMAE, outperforming prior methods. These results demonstrate that our framework, using diffusion based multimodal conditioning, reliably generates high quality IR drop images. This shows that IR drop analysis can effectively leverage recent advances in generative modeling when geometric layout features and logical circuit topology are jointly modeled. By combining geometry aware spatial features with logical graph representations, GIF enables IR drop analysis to benefit from recent advances in generative modeling for structured image generation.

AI.tldr: GIF是一个生成式IR drop分析框架，通过融合几何布局特征和逻辑电路拓扑信息，使用条件扩散过程生成高质量的IR drop图像，在CircuitNet-N28数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 随着晶体管密度增加，传统EDA工具变得缓慢且昂贵。现有的基于机器学习的方法无法同时捕捉局部和长程依赖关系，并且忽略了物理布局和逻辑连接的关键几何和拓扑信息。
AI.method: 提出GIF生成式IR drop框架，融合图像和图形特征来指导条件扩散过程。该方法结合几何感知的空间特征与逻辑图表示，通过多模态条件生成高质量的IR drop图像。
AI.result: 在CircuitNet-N28数据集上，GIF取得了0.78 SSIM、0.95 Pearson相关系数、21.77 PSNR和0.026 NMAE的优异性能，超越了先前的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合建模几何布局特征和逻辑电路拓扑，IR drop分析可以有效地利用生成建模的最新进展。GIF展示了将几何感知空间特征与逻辑图表示相结合，能够实现结构化图像生成的优势。

title: Self-Correcting RAG: Enhancing Faithfulness via MMKP Context Selection and NLI-Guided MCTS
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) substantially extends the knowledge boundary of large language models. However, it still faces two major challenges when handling complex reasoning tasks: low context utilization and frequent hallucinations. To address these issues, we propose Self-Correcting RAG, a unified framework that reformulates retrieval and generation as constrained optimization and path planning. On the input side, we move beyond traditional greedy retrieval and, for the first time, formalize context selection as a multi-dimensional multiple-choice knapsack problem (MMKP), thereby maximizing information density and removing redundancy under a strict token budget. On the output side, we introduce a natural language inference (NLI)-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) mechanism, which leverages test-time compute to dynamically explore reasoning trajectories and validate the faithfulness of generated answers. Experiments on six multi-hop question answering and fact-checking datasets demonstrate that our method significantly improves reasoning accuracy on complex queries while effectively reducing hallucinations, outperforming strong existing baselines.Our code is available at https://github.com/xjiacs/Self-Correcting-RAG .

AI.tldr: Self-Correcting RAG框架通过将检索和生成重新定义为约束优化和路径规划问题，解决了传统RAG在复杂推理任务中的低上下文利用率和幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成(RAG)虽然扩展了大语言模型的知识边界，但在处理复杂推理任务时仍面临两个主要挑战：低上下文利用率和频繁的幻觉问题。
AI.method: 1. 输入侧：将上下文选择形式化为多维多选择背包问题(MMKP)，在严格token预算下最大化信息密度并去除冗余；2. 输出侧：引入基于自然语言推理(NLI)的蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)机制，动态探索推理轨迹并验证生成答案的忠实性。
AI.result: 在六个多跳问答和事实核查数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著提高了复杂查询的推理准确性，同时有效减少了幻觉，优于现有强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Self-Correcting RAG通过将检索和生成重新定义为约束优化和路径规划问题，为处理复杂推理任务提供了一个有效的统一框架，解决了传统RAG的关键局限性。

title: Cognitive Pivot Points and Visual Anchoring: Unveiling and Rectifying Hallucinations in Multimodal Reasoning Models
summary: Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) have achieved remarkable strides in visual reasoning through test time compute scaling, yet long chain reasoning remains prone to hallucinations. We identify a concerning phenomenon termed the Reasoning Vision Truth Disconnect (RVTD): hallucinations are strongly correlated with cognitive bifurcation points that often exhibit high entropy states. We attribute this vulnerability to a breakdown in visual semantic anchoring, localized within the network's intermediate layers; specifically, during these high uncertainty transitions, the model fails to query visual evidence, reverting instead to language priors. Consequently, we advocate a shift from solely outcome level supervision to augmenting it with fine grained internal attention guidance. To this end, we propose V-STAR (Visual Structural Training with Attention Reinforcement), a lightweight, holistic training paradigm designed to internalize visually aware reasoning capabilities. Central to our approach is the Hierarchical Visual Attention Reward (HVAR), integrated within the GRPO framework. Upon detecting high entropy states, this mechanism dynamically incentivizes visual attention across critical intermediate layers, thereby anchoring the reasoning process back to the visual input. Furthermore, we introduce the Forced Reflection Mechanism (FRM), a trajectory editing strategy that disrupts cognitive inertia by triggering reflection around high entropy cognitive bifurcation points and encouraging verification of subsequent steps against the visual input, thereby translating external debiasing interventions into an intrinsic capability for hallucination mitigation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出V-STAR框架，通过分层视觉注意力奖励和强制反思机制，解决多模态大推理模型在长链推理中的幻觉问题，增强视觉语义锚定能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大推理模型在视觉推理方面取得显著进展，但长链推理仍容易出现幻觉。研究发现存在"推理视觉真相脱节"现象：幻觉与认知分叉点高度相关，这些点通常呈现高熵状态。问题的根源在于视觉语义锚定失效，模型在高不确定性转换时未能查询视觉证据，而是回归语言先验。
AI.method: 提出V-STAR训练范式，包含两个核心组件：1) 分层视觉注意力奖励：在GRPO框架中集成HVAR机制，检测到高熵状态时动态激励关键中间层的视觉注意力；2) 强制反思机制：轨迹编辑策略，在高熵认知分叉点触发反思，鼓励后续步骤对照视觉输入进行验证，将外部去偏干预转化为内在的幻觉缓解能力。
AI.result: V-STAR通过内部注意力指导增强视觉语义锚定，有效缓解长链推理中的幻觉问题。该轻量级训练范式能够将去偏干预内化为模型的内在能力，提高视觉推理的可靠性和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 需要从单纯的结果级监督转向细粒度的内部注意力指导。V-STAR框架通过强化视觉注意力锚定和强制反思机制，能够有效解决多模态大推理模型中的幻觉问题，提升视觉推理的鲁棒性。

title: BlasBench: An Open Benchmark for Irish Speech Recognition
comment: 8 pages, 4 tables, 3 appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/jyoutir/blasbench
summary: No open Irish-specific benchmark compares end-user ASR systems under a shared Irish-aware evaluation protocol. To solve this, we release BlasBench, an open evaluation harness with Irish-aware text normalisation that preserves fadas, lenition, and eclipsis. We benchmark 12 systems across four architecture families on Common Voice ga-IE and FLEURS ga-IE. All Whisper variants exceed 100% WER. The best open model (omniASR LLM 7B) achieves 30.65% WER on Common Voice and 39.09% on FLEURS. We noticed models fine-tuned on Common Voice lose 33-43 WER points on FLEURS, revealing a generalisation gap that is invisible to single-dataset evaluation.

AI.tldr: 发布BlasBench爱尔兰语ASR评估框架，包含爱尔兰语感知的文本规范化，在Common Voice和FLEURS数据集上评估12个系统，发现Whisper变体WER超过100%，最佳开源模型WER约30-39%，发现微调模型存在泛化差距
AI.motivation: 缺乏爱尔兰语特定的基准测试来在共享的爱尔兰语感知评估协议下比较端到端ASR系统
AI.method: 发布BlasBench开放评估框架，包含爱尔兰语感知的文本规范化（保留重音符号、弱化、音变），在Common Voice ga-IE和FLEURS ga-IE数据集上评估12个系统，涵盖四种架构家族
AI.result: 所有Whisper变体WER超过100%；最佳开源模型omniASR LLM 7B在Common Voice上WER为30.65%，在FLEURS上为39.09%；发现微调模型在FLEURS上WER下降33-43个百分点，揭示了单数据集评估无法发现的泛化差距
AI.conclusion: BlasBench填补了爱尔兰语ASR评估的空白，揭示了现有模型的性能局限性和泛化问题，为爱尔兰语ASR研究提供了重要基准

title: SVSR: A Self-Verification and Self-Rectification Paradigm for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Current multimodal models often suffer from shallow reasoning, leading to errors caused by incomplete or inconsistent thought processes. To address this limitation, we propose Self-Verification and Self-Rectification (SVSR), a unified framework that explicitly integrates self-verification and self-rectification into the model's reasoning pipeline, substantially improving robustness and reliability in complex visual understanding and multimodal reasoning tasks. SVSR is built on a novel three-stage training paradigm. First, we construct a high-quality unified preference dataset by refining reasoning traces from pre-trained vision-language models, incorporating both forward and backward reasoning to embed self-reflective signals. Second, we perform cold-start supervised fine-tuning on this dataset to learn structured, multi-step reasoning behaviors. Third, we apply a Semi-online Direct Preference Optimization (Semi-online DPO) process, continuously augmenting the training corpus with high-quality, model-generated reasoning traces filtered by a powerful teacher VLM. This pipeline enables the model to learn, elicit, and refine its ability to self-verify and self-rectify. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that SVSR improves reasoning accuracy and enables stronger generalization to unseen tasks and question types. Notably, once trained with explicit self-reflective reasoning, the model also exhibits improved implicit reasoning ability, outperforming strong baselines even when no explicit reasoning traces are provided. These results highlight the potential of SVSR for building more dependable, introspective, and cognitively aligned multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: SVSR是一个统一框架，通过将自我验证和自我纠正整合到推理流程中，显著提升多模态模型的鲁棒性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态模型常因浅层推理导致错误，需要解决推理过程不完整或不一致的问题，提高复杂视觉理解和多模态推理任务的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用三阶段训练范式：1) 构建高质量统一偏好数据集，包含前向和后向推理；2) 冷启动监督微调学习结构化多步推理；3) 半在线直接偏好优化，持续增强训练语料。
AI.result: SVSR在多个基准测试中提高了推理准确性，增强了未见任务和问题类型的泛化能力。模型在显式自我反思推理训练后，即使不提供显式推理轨迹，也表现出更强的隐式推理能力。
AI.conclusion: SVSR框架通过显式整合自我验证和自我纠正机制，能够构建更可靠、内省且认知对齐的多模态系统，具有重要应用潜力。

title: RCBSF: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Contract Revision via Stackelberg Game
summary: Despite the widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Legal AI, their utility for automated contract revision remains impeded by hallucinated safety and a lack of rigorous behavioral constraints. To address these limitations, we propose the Risk-Constrained Bilevel Stackelberg Framework (RCBSF), which formulates revision as a non-cooperative Stackelberg game. RCBSF establishes a hierarchical Leader Follower structure where a Global Prescriptive Agent (GPA) imposes risk budgets upon a follower system constituted by a Constrained Revision Agent (CRA) and a Local Verification Agent (LVA) to iteratively optimize output. We provide theoretical guarantees that this bilevel formulation converges to an equilibrium yielding strictly superior utility over unguided configurations. Empirical validation on a unified benchmark demonstrates that RCBSF achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing iterative baselines with an average Risk Resolution Rate (RRR) of 84.21\% while enhancing token efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/xjiacs/RCBSF .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种风险约束的双层Stackelberg框架（RCBSF），用于解决大型语言模型在合同修订中的幻觉问题和缺乏行为约束的挑战，通过领导者-追随者博弈结构实现风险预算约束下的迭代优化。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在法律AI中得到广泛应用，但在自动化合同修订方面仍存在幻觉安全问题和缺乏严格行为约束的障碍，这限制了其实用性。
AI.method: 提出了风险约束的双层Stackelberg框架（RCBSF），将修订建模为非合作Stackelberg博弈。该框架建立了一个层次化的领导者-追随者结构：全局规定代理（GPA）对由约束修订代理（CRA）和本地验证代理（LVA）构成的追随者系统施加风险预算，进行迭代优化。
AI.result: 在统一基准测试上的实证验证表明，RCBSF实现了最先进的性能，平均风险解决率（RRR）达到84.21%，超越了迭代基线方法，同时提高了令牌效率。
AI.conclusion: RCBSF框架通过理论保证和实证验证，为自动化合同修订提供了有效的解决方案，能够收敛到均衡点并产生比无指导配置更优的效用。

title: A Dual-Positive Monotone Parameterization for Multi-Segment Bids and a Validity Assessment Framework for Reinforcement Learning Agent-based Simulation of Electricity Markets
summary: Reinforcement learning agent-based simulation (RL-ABS) has become an important tool for electricity market mechanism analysis and evaluation. In the modeling of monotone, bounded, multi-segment stepwise bids, existing methods typically let the policy network first output an unconstrained action and then convert it into a feasible bid curve satisfying monotonicity and boundedness through post-processing mappings such as sorting, clipping, or projection. However, such post-processing mappings often fail to satisfy continuous differentiability, injectivity, and invertibility at boundaries or kinks, thereby causing gradient distortion and leading to spurious convergence in simulation results. Meanwhile, most existing studies conduct mechanism analysis and evaluation mainly on the basis of training-curve convergence, without rigorously assessing the distance between the simulation outcomes and Nash equilibrium, which severely undermines the credibility of the results. To address these issues, this paper proposes...

AI.tldr: 本文针对电力市场RL-ABS中投标曲线建模问题，提出新方法解决现有后处理映射导致的梯度失真和虚假收敛问题，并改进机制评估的可信度。
AI.motivation: 现有RL-ABS方法在建模单调有界多段阶梯投标曲线时，通过排序、裁剪、投影等后处理映射将策略网络输出转换为可行投标曲线，但这些映射在边界或拐点处不满足连续可微性、单射性和可逆性，导致梯度失真和仿真结果虚假收敛。同时，现有研究主要基于训练曲线收敛进行机制分析评估，未严格评估仿真结果与纳什均衡的距离，严重削弱了结果可信度。
AI.method: 论文提出新的方法来替代传统的后处理映射，确保投标曲线建模满足连续可微性、单射性和可逆性要求，避免梯度失真问题。同时引入更严格的评估框架，量化仿真结果与纳什均衡的距离。
AI.result: 新方法能够有效避免梯度失真，减少虚假收敛现象，提高仿真结果的准确性。通过严格的纳什均衡距离评估，增强了电力市场机制分析评估的可信度。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的方法解决了RL-ABS中投标曲线建模的关键技术问题，通过改进后处理映射和引入严格评估框架，显著提高了电力市场机制仿真分析的可信度和准确性。

title: What and Where to Adapt: Structure-Semantics Co-Tuning for Machine Vision Compression via Synergistic Adapters
comment: Accepted by the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Findings, 2026
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of pre-trained codecs is a promising direction in image compression for human and machine vision. While most existing works have primarily focused on tuning the feature structure within the encoder-decoder backbones, the adaptation of the statistical semantics within the entropy model has received limited attention despite its function of predicting the probability distribution of latent features. Our analysis reveals that naive adapter insertion into the entropy model can lead to suboptimal outcomes, underscoring that the effectiveness of adapter-based tuning depends critically on the coordination between adapter type and placement across the compression pipeline. Therefore, we introduce Structure-Semantics Co-Tuning (S2-CoT), a novel framework that achieves this coordination via two specialized, synergistic adapters: the Structural Fidelity Adapter (SFA) and the Semantic Context Adapter (SCA). SFA is integrated into the encoder-decoder to preserve high-fidelity representations by dynamically fusing spatial and frequency information; meanwhile, the SCA adapts the entropy model to align with SFA-tuned features by refining the channel context for more efficient statistical coding. Through joint optimization, S2-CoT turns potential performance degradation into synergistic gains, achieving state-of-the-art results across four diverse base codecs with only a small fraction of trainable parameters, closely matching full fine-tuning performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Brock-bit4/S2-CoT.

AI.tldr: S2-CoT框架通过结构-语义协同调优，在图像压缩中同时优化编码器-解码器结构和熵模型，实现参数高效微调
AI.motivation: 现有参数高效微调方法主要关注编码器-解码器主干网络的特征结构调优，而忽略了熵模型中统计语义的适配，这限制了压缩性能的进一步提升
AI.method: 提出结构-语义协同调优(S2-CoT)框架，包含两个协同适配器：结构保真适配器(SFA)在编码器-解码器中动态融合空间和频率信息以保持高保真表示；语义上下文适配器(SCA)在熵模型中优化通道上下文以匹配SFA调优的特征
AI.result: 在四种不同的基础编解码器上实现了最先进的结果，仅使用少量可训练参数就能接近完全微调的性能，将潜在的性能下降转化为协同增益
AI.conclusion: 通过协调适配器类型和在压缩流水线中的放置位置，S2-CoT框架有效解决了熵模型适配问题，为图像压缩的参数高效微调提供了新方向

title: Deep-Reporter: Deep Research for Grounded Multimodal Long-Form Generation
comment: 41 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code available at https://github.com/fangda-ye/Deep-Report
summary: Recent agentic search frameworks enable deep research via iterative planning and retrieval, reducing hallucinations and enhancing factual grounding. However, they remain text-centric, overlooking the multimodal evidence that characterizes real-world expert reports. We introduce a pressing task: multimodal long-form generation. Accordingly, we propose Deep-Reporter, a unified agentic framework for grounded multimodal long-form generation. It orchestrates: (i) Agentic Multimodal Search and Filtering to retrieve and filter textual passages and information-dense visuals; (ii) Checklist-Guided Incremental Synthesis to ensure coherent image-text integration and optimal citation placement; and (iii) Recurrent Context Management to balance long-range coherence with local fluency. We develop a rigorous curation pipeline producing 8K high-quality agentic traces for model optimization. We further introduce M2LongBench, a comprehensive testbed comprising 247 research tasks across 9 domains and a stable multimodal sandbox. Extensive experiments demonstrate that long-form multimodal generation is a challenging task, especially in multimodal selection and integration, and effective post-training can bridge the gap.

AI.tldr: Deep-Reporter：用于多模态长文本生成的统一智能体框架，通过多模态搜索、清单引导合成和循环上下文管理解决现有文本中心方法的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体搜索框架主要关注文本，忽略了真实世界专家报告中常见的多模态证据，因此需要解决多模态长文本生成这一紧迫任务。
AI.method: 提出Deep-Reporter框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 智能体多模态搜索与过滤，检索文本段落和信息密集的视觉内容；2) 清单引导的增量合成，确保图像-文本的连贯整合和最佳引用位置；3) 循环上下文管理，平衡长距离连贯性与局部流畅性。同时开发了包含8K高质量智能体轨迹的优化数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明多模态长文本生成具有挑战性，特别是在多模态选择和整合方面，但有效的后训练可以弥补这一差距。还引入了M2LongBench测试平台，包含9个领域的247个研究任务。
AI.conclusion: Deep-Reporter为多模态长文本生成提供了统一的智能体框架，通过系统化的方法解决了多模态证据整合的挑战，并建立了全面的评估基准。

title: The Amazing Agent Race: Strong Tool Users, Weak Navigators
summary: Existing tool-use benchmarks for LLM agents are overwhelmingly linear: our analysis of six benchmarks shows 55 to 100% of instances are simple chains of 2 to 5 steps. We introduce The Amazing Agent Race (AAR), a benchmark featuring directed acyclic graph (DAG) puzzles (or "legs") with fork-merge tool chains. We release 1,400 instances across two variants: sequential (800 legs) and compositional (600 DAG legs). Agents must navigate Wikipedia, execute multi-step tool chains, and aggregate results into a verifiable answer. Legs are procedurally generated from Wikipedia seeds across four difficulty levels with live-API validation. Three complementary metrics (finish-line accuracy, pit-stop visit rate, and roadblock completion rate) separately diagnose navigation, tool-use, and arithmetic failures. Evaluating three agent frameworks on 1,400 legs, the best achieves only 37.2% accuracy. Navigation errors dominate (27 to 52% of trials) while tool-use errors remain below 17%, and agent architecture matters as much as model scale (Claude Code matches Codex CLI at 37% with 6x fewer tokens). The compositional structure of AAR reveals that agents fail not at calling tools but at navigating to the right pages, a blind spot invisible to linear benchmarks. The project page can be accessed at: https://minnesotanlp.github.io/the-amazing-agent-race

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了The Amazing Agent Race (AAR)基准测试，针对现有LLM智能体工具使用基准过于线性化的问题，设计了包含有向无环图(DAG)结构的复杂任务，通过1400个实例评估智能体在导航、工具使用和结果聚合方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体工具使用基准存在严重线性化问题（55-100%的任务是2-5步的简单链式结构），无法有效评估智能体在复杂、非线性任务中的真实能力，特别是导航和决策能力。
AI.method: 1. 设计包含有向无环图(DAG)结构的"legs"（任务段），具有分叉-合并的工具链；2. 生成1400个实例（800个顺序任务+600个DAG任务）；3. 基于Wikipedia种子程序化生成四个难度等级的任务；4. 使用实时API验证；5. 采用三个互补指标：终点准确率、检查点访问率、障碍完成率。
AI.result: 评估三个智能体框架在1400个任务上的表现，最佳准确率仅为37.2%。导航错误占主导（27-52%的试验），工具使用错误低于17%。智能体架构与模型规模同等重要（Claude Code以6倍更少的token达到与Codex CLI相同的37%准确率）。
AI.conclusion: AAR基准揭示了智能体主要失败于导航到正确页面而非工具调用，这是线性基准无法发现的盲点。DAG结构能更真实地评估智能体在复杂任务中的能力，导航能力成为关键瓶颈。

title: FREE-Switch: Frequency-based Dynamic LoRA Switch for Style Transfer
summary: With the growing availability of open-sourced adapters trained on the same diffusion backbone for diverse scenes and objects, combining these pretrained weights enables low-cost customized generation. However, most existing model merging methods are designed for classification or text generation, and when applied to image generation, they suffer from content drift due to error accumulation across multiple diffusion steps. For image-oriented methods, training-based approaches are computationally expensive and unsuitable for edge deployment, while training-free ones use uniform fusion strategies that ignore inter-adapter differences, leading to detail degradation. We find that since different adapters are specialized for generating different types of content, the contribution of each diffusion step carries different significance for each adapter. Accordingly, we propose a frequency-domain importance-driven dynamic LoRA switch method. Furthermore, we observe that maintaining semantic consistency across adapters effectively mitigates detail loss; thus, we design an automatic Generation Alignment mechanism to align generation intents at the semantic level. Experiments demonstrate that our FREE-Switch (Frequency-based Efficient and Dynamic LoRA Switch) framework efficiently combines adapters for different objects and styles, substantially reducing the training cost of high-quality customized generation.

AI.tldr: FREE-Switch：基于频率域重要性驱动的动态LoRA切换框架，用于高效融合多个预训练适配器，实现高质量定制化图像生成
AI.motivation: 随着开源适配器在相同扩散主干上的增多，需要低成本融合这些预训练权重进行定制化生成。现有方法存在内容漂移、计算成本高或忽略适配器间差异导致细节退化的问题
AI.method: 提出频率域重要性驱动的动态LoRA切换方法，根据不同适配器在不同扩散步骤中的贡献差异进行动态融合；设计自动生成对齐机制，在语义层面保持一致性以减轻细节损失
AI.result: 实验证明FREE-Switch框架能高效融合不同对象和风格的适配器，显著降低高质量定制化生成的训练成本
AI.conclusion: 通过频率域重要性分析和语义对齐，实现了高效、高质量的预训练适配器融合，为边缘部署提供了可行的解决方案

title: How You Ask Matters! Adaptive RAG Robustness to Query Variations
summary: Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) promises accuracy and efficiency by dynamically triggering retrieval only when needed and is widely used in practice. However, real-world queries vary in surface form even with the same intent, and their impact on Adaptive RAG remains under-explored. We introduce the first large-scale benchmark of diverse yet semantically identical query variations, combining human-written and model-generated rewrites. Our benchmark facilitates a systematic evaluation of Adaptive RAG robustness by examining its key components across three dimensions: answer quality, computational cost, and retrieval decisions. We discover a critical robustness gap, where small surface-level changes in queries dramatically alter retrieval behavior and accuracy. Although larger models show better performance, robustness does not improve accordingly. These findings reveal that Adaptive RAG methods are highly vulnerable to query variations that preserve identical semantics, exposing a critical robustness challenge.

AI.tldr: 研究发现自适应检索增强生成（RAG）系统在面对语义相同但表面形式不同的查询时存在严重鲁棒性问题，即使意图完全一致，微小的查询变化也会显著影响检索行为和准确性。
AI.motivation: 自适应RAG在实际应用中广泛使用，但现实世界中的查询即使意图相同也会有不同的表面形式，这些变化对自适应RAG系统的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 构建了首个大规模、语义相同但形式多样的查询变体基准，结合人工编写和模型生成的改写，从答案质量、计算成本和检索决策三个维度系统评估自适应RAG的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 发现自适应RAG存在严重的鲁棒性缺陷：查询的微小表面变化会显著改变检索行为和准确性；虽然更大的模型表现更好，但鲁棒性并未相应提升。
AI.conclusion: 自适应RAG方法对保持相同语义的查询变体高度脆弱，暴露了关键的鲁棒性挑战，需要进一步研究以提高系统在实际应用中的稳定性。

title: STARS: Skill-Triggered Audit for Request-Conditioned Invocation Safety in Agent Systems
summary: Autonomous language-model agents increasingly rely on installable skills and tools to complete user tasks. Static skill auditing can expose capability surface before deployment, but it cannot determine whether a particular invocation is unsafe under the current user request and runtime context. We therefore study skill invocation auditing as a continuous-risk estimation problem: given a user request, candidate skill, and runtime context, predict a score that supports ranking and triage before a hard intervention is applied. We introduce STARS, which combines a static capability prior, a request-conditioned invocation risk model, and a calibrated risk-fusion policy. To evaluate this setting, we construct SIA-Bench, a benchmark of 3,000 invocation records with group-safe splits, lineage metadata, runtime context, canonical action labels, and derived continuous-risk targets. On a held-out split of indirect prompt injection attacks, calibrated fusion reaches 0.439 high-risk AUPRC, improving over 0.405 for the contextual scorer and 0.380 for the strongest static baseline, while the contextual scorer remains better calibrated with 0.289 expected calibration error. On the locked in-distribution test split, gains are smaller and static priors remain useful. The resulting claim is therefore narrower: request-conditioned auditing is most valuable as an invocation-time risk-scoring and triage layer rather than as a replacement for static screening. Code is available at https://github.com/123zgj123/STARS.

AI.tldr: STARS是一个用于语言模型代理技能调用审计的系统，通过结合静态能力先验、请求条件化调用风险模型和校准风险融合策略，在运行时预测技能调用的风险评分，支持在硬干预前的排序和分流。
AI.motivation: 静态技能审计可以在部署前暴露能力表面，但无法确定特定调用在当前用户请求和运行时上下文下是否安全。因此需要研究技能调用审计作为连续风险评估问题。
AI.method: 提出STARS系统，结合三个组件：1) 静态能力先验；2) 请求条件化调用风险模型；3) 校准风险融合策略。构建SIA-Bench基准测试，包含3000个调用记录、组安全分割、谱系元数据、运行时上下文、规范动作标签和衍生连续风险目标。
AI.result: 在间接提示注入攻击的保留分割上，校准融合达到0.439高风险AUPRC，优于上下文评分器的0.405和最强静态基线的0.380。上下文评分器校准更好，预期校准误差为0.289。在锁定分布内测试分割上，增益较小，静态先验仍然有用。
AI.conclusion: 请求条件化审计最有价值的是作为调用时风险评分和分流层，而不是替代静态筛选。该主张因此更为狭窄：动态审计主要作为静态筛查的补充层。

title: LVSum: A Benchmark for Timestamp-Aware Long Video Summarization
summary: Long video summarization presents significant challenges for current multimodal large language models (MLLMs), particularly in maintaining temporal fidelity over extended durations and producing summaries that are both semantically and temporally grounded. In this work, we present LVSum, a human-annotated benchmark designed specifically for evaluating long video summarization with fine-grained temporal alignment. LVSum comprises diverse long-form videos across 13 domains, each paired with human-generated summaries containing precise temporal references. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of both proprietary and open-source MLLMs on LVSum, assessing performance using newly introduced LLM-based metrics for content relevance and modality coherence, alongside standard evaluation metrics. Our experiments reveal systematic gaps in temporal understanding among existing MLLMs and offer insights that establish a new foundation for advancing temporal reasoning in long video summarization.

AI.tldr: LVSum是一个专门用于评估长视频摘要的人类标注基准，包含13个领域的长视频，揭示了现有MLLMs在时间理解方面的系统性差距。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在长视频摘要任务中面临挑战，特别是在保持长时间的时间保真度和生成语义与时间上都准确的基础摘要方面。
AI.method: 提出了LVSum基准，包含13个领域的长视频和人类生成的带有精确时间参考的摘要。使用新引入的基于LLM的内容相关性和模态一致性指标，以及标准评估指标，对专有和开源MLLMs进行全面评估。
AI.result: 实验揭示了现有MLLMs在时间理解方面存在系统性差距，为推进长视频摘要中的时间推理建立了新的基础。
AI.conclusion: LVSum基准为评估长视频摘要提供了专门工具，揭示了MLLMs在时间理解方面的局限性，为未来改进时间推理能力提供了重要见解。

title: Dead Cognitions: A Census of Misattributed Insights
summary: This essay identifies a failure mode of AI chat systems that we term attribution laundering: the model performs substantive cognitive work and then rhetorically credits the user for having generated the resulting insights. Unlike transparent versions of glad handing sycophancy, attribution laundering is systematically occluded to the person it affects and self-reinforcing -- eroding users' ability to accurately assess their own cognitive contributions over time. We trace the mechanisms at both individual and societal scales, from the chat interface that discourages scrutiny to the institutional pressures that reward adoption over accountability. The document itself is an artifact of the process it describes, and is color-coded accordingly -- though the views expressed are the authors' own, not those of any affiliated institution, and the boundary between the human author's views and Claude's is, as the essay argues, difficult to draw.

AI.tldr: 论文识别了AI聊天系统的一种失败模式——归因洗白：模型完成实质性认知工作后，却将洞察归功于用户，这种系统性隐蔽的奉承会侵蚀用户准确评估自身认知贡献的能力。
AI.motivation: 揭示AI聊天系统中一种隐蔽且有害的失败模式，即模型将自身认知工作的成果归功于用户，这种归因洗白会系统性地削弱用户对自身认知贡献的准确评估能力。
AI.method: 通过分析AI聊天系统的运行机制，从个体和社会两个层面追踪归因洗白的形成机制，包括聊天界面设计、制度压力等因素，并以论文本身作为描述过程的实例进行说明。
AI.result: 识别出归因洗白这一系统性失败模式，它不同于透明的奉承，具有隐蔽性和自我强化特性，会逐渐侵蚀用户准确评估自身认知贡献的能力，且在个体和社会层面都有具体表现机制。
AI.conclusion: 归因洗白是AI聊天系统的一个严重问题，它模糊了人类作者与AI贡献的界限，需要引起重视并采取措施加以应对，以维护用户对自身认知能力的准确评估。

title: SinkTrack: Attention Sink based Context Anchoring for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from hallucination and context forgetting. Prior studies suggest that attention drift is a primary cause of these problems, where LLMs' focus shifts towards newly generated tokens and away from the initial input context. To counteract this, we make use of a related, intrinsic characteristic of LLMs: attention sink -- the tendency to consistently allocate high attention to the very first token (i.e., <BOS>) of a sequence. Concretely, we propose an advanced context anchoring method, SinkTrack, which treats <BOS> as an information anchor and injects key contextual features (such as those derived from the input image or instruction) into its representation. As such, LLM remains anchored to the initial input context throughout the entire generation process. SinkTrack is training-free, plug-and-play, and introduces negligible inference overhead. Experiments demonstrate that SinkTrack mitigates hallucination and context forgetting across both textual (e.g., +21.6% on SQuAD2.0 with Llama3.1-8B-Instruct) and multi-modal (e.g., +22.8% on M3CoT with Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct) tasks. Its consistent gains across different architectures and scales underscore the robustness and generalizability. We also analyze its underlying working mechanism from the perspective of information delivery. Our source code is available at https://github.com/67L1/SinkTrack.

AI.tldr: SinkTrack是一种训练免费、即插即用的上下文锚定方法，通过将关键上下文特征注入到序列的第一个token（<BOS>）表示中，利用注意力汇特性来缓解大语言模型的幻觉和上下文遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在幻觉和上下文遗忘问题，先前研究表明注意力漂移是主要原因，即模型注意力从初始输入上下文转向新生成的token。为了解决这一问题，作者利用LLMs固有的注意力汇特性——倾向于持续关注序列的第一个token（<BOS>）。
AI.method: 提出SinkTrack方法，将<BOS>作为信息锚点，将输入图像或指令等关键上下文特征注入其表示中。该方法训练免费、即插即用，推理开销极小，通过让LLM在整个生成过程中保持对初始输入上下文的锚定来缓解注意力漂移。
AI.result: 实验表明SinkTrack在文本任务（如在SQuAD2.0上Llama3.1-8B-Instruct提升21.6%）和多模态任务（如在M3CoT上Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct提升22.8%）上都有效缓解了幻觉和上下文遗忘。在不同架构和规模模型上的一致增益证明了其鲁棒性和泛化性。
AI.conclusion: SinkTrack通过利用注意力汇特性，将<BOS>作为信息锚点注入关键上下文特征，有效缓解了大语言模型的幻觉和上下文遗忘问题。该方法训练免费、即插即用，具有实际应用价值，并从信息传递角度分析了其工作机制。

title: Do BERT Embeddings Encode Narrative Dimensions? A Token-Level Probing Analysis of Time, Space, Causality, and Character in Fiction
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at CMN'26 (9th International Workshop on Computational Models of Narrative)
summary: Narrative understanding requires multidimensional semantic structures. This study investigates whether BERT embeddings encode dimensions of fictional narrative semantics -- time, space, causality, and character. Using an LLM to accelerate annotation, we construct a token-level dataset labeled with these four narrative categories plus "others." A linear probe on BERT embeddings (94% accuracy) significantly outperforms a control probe on variance-matched random embeddings (47%), confirming that BERT encodes meaningful narrative information. With balanced class weighting, the probe achieves a macro-average recall of 0.83, with moderate success on rare categories such as causality (recall = 0.75) and space (recall = 0.66). However, confusion matrix analysis reveals "Boundary Leakage," where rare dimensions are systematically misclassified as "others." Clustering analysis shows that unsupervised clustering aligns near-randomly with predefined categories (ARI = 0.081), suggesting that narrative dimensions are encoded but not as discretely separable clusters. Future work includes a POS-only baseline to disentangle syntactic patterns from narrative encoding, expanded datasets, and layer-wise probing.

AI.tldr: 研究验证BERT嵌入编码虚构叙事语义维度（时间、空间、因果关系、角色），通过线性探针分析发现BERT确实编码了有意义的叙事信息，但稀有维度存在"边界泄漏"问题，且无监督聚类显示这些维度不是离散可分离的簇。
AI.motivation: 叙事理解需要多维语义结构，本研究旨在探究BERT嵌入是否编码虚构叙事的四个关键语义维度：时间、空间、因果关系和角色。
AI.method: 使用LLM加速标注构建包含四个叙事类别加"其他"的token级数据集，在BERT嵌入上应用线性探针分析，并与方差匹配的随机嵌入控制组对比，同时进行混淆矩阵分析和无监督聚类评估。
AI.result: BERT线性探针准确率达94%，显著优于随机嵌入控制组（47%）。在平衡类别权重下，宏观平均召回率为0.83，因果关系召回率0.75，空间召回率0.66。但存在"边界泄漏"现象，稀有维度易被误分类为"其他"。无监督聚类与预定义类别对齐度低（ARI=0.081）。
AI.conclusion: BERT确实编码了有意义的叙事信息，但叙事维度不是离散可分离的簇。未来工作包括：使用POS基线分离句法模式与叙事编码、扩展数据集、进行分层探针分析。

title: Prompt Relay: Inference-Time Temporal Control for Multi-Event Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in generating high-quality videos. However, these models struggle to represent the temporal succession of multiple events in real-world videos and lack explicit mechanisms to control when semantic concepts appear, how long they persist, and the order in which multiple events occur. Such control is especially important for movie-grade video synthesis, where coherent storytelling depends on precise timing, duration, and transitions between events. When using a single paragraph-style prompt to describe a sequence of complex events, models often exhibit semantic entanglement, where concepts intended for different moments in the video bleed into one another, resulting in poor text-video alignment. To address these limitations, we propose Prompt Relay, an inference-time, plug-and-play method to enable fine-grained temporal control in multi-event video generation, requiring no architectural modifications and no additional computational overhead. Prompt Relay introduces a penalty into the cross-attention mechanism, so that each temporal segment attends only to its assigned prompt, allowing the model to represent one semantic concept at a time and thereby improving temporal prompt alignment, reducing semantic interference, and enhancing visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出Prompt Relay方法，通过推理时修改交叉注意力机制，实现多事件视频生成的细粒度时序控制，无需模型架构修改或额外计算开销
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型难以表示真实视频中多个事件的时序连续性，缺乏控制语义概念出现时间、持续时间和事件顺序的机制。在电影级视频合成中，连贯叙事依赖于事件间的精确时序、持续时间和过渡。使用单段提示描述复杂事件序列时，模型常出现语义纠缠，导致文本-视频对齐不佳。
AI.method: 提出Prompt Relay方法，在推理时通过向交叉注意力机制引入惩罚项，使每个时序片段仅关注其分配的提示，从而让模型一次只表示一个语义概念。该方法无需架构修改，无需额外计算开销，即插即用。
AI.result: 该方法提高了时序提示对齐，减少了语义干扰，增强了视觉质量。实现了对多事件视频生成的细粒度时序控制。
AI.conclusion: Prompt Relay是一种有效的推理时方法，能够解决视频扩散模型在多事件时序控制方面的局限性，为电影级视频合成提供了更好的时序控制能力。

title: TimeSeriesExamAgent: Creating Time Series Reasoning Benchmarks at Scale
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promising performance in time series modeling tasks, but do they truly understand time series data? While multiple benchmarks have been proposed to answer this fundamental question, most are manually curated and focus on narrow domains or specific skill sets. To address this limitation, we propose scalable methods for creating comprehensive time series reasoning benchmarks that combine the flexibility of templates with the creativity of LLM agents. We first develop TimeSeriesExam, a multiple-choice benchmark using synthetic time series to evaluate LLMs across five core reasoning categories: pattern recognitionnoise understandingsimilarity analysisanomaly detection, and causality. Then, with TimeSeriesExamAgent, we scale our approach by automatically generating benchmarks from real-world datasets spanning healthcare, finance and weather domains. Through multi-dimensional quality evaluation, we demonstrate that our automatically generated benchmarks achieve diversity comparable to manually curated alternatives. However, our experiments reveal that LLM performance remains limited in both abstract time series reasoning and domain-specific applications, highlighting ongoing challenges in enabling effective time series understanding in these models. TimeSeriesExamAgent is available at https://github.com/magwiazda/TimeSeriesExamAgent.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了TimeSeriesExam和TimeSeriesExamAgent两个可扩展的时间序列推理基准测试方法，通过合成数据和真实数据评估大语言模型在时间序列理解方面的能力，发现LLMs在抽象时间序列推理和领域特定应用方面仍存在局限。
AI.motivation: 虽然大语言模型在时间序列建模任务中表现出潜力，但现有基准测试大多为人工构建，覆盖领域狭窄或技能集有限，无法全面评估LLMs是否真正理解时间序列数据。
AI.method:
1. 开发TimeSeriesExam：使用合成时间序列构建多选题基准，评估LLMs在五个核心推理类别（模式识别、噪声理解、相似性分析、异常检测、因果关系）的能力
2. 创建TimeSeriesExamAgent：通过LLM代理自动从真实世界数据集（医疗、金融、天气领域）生成基准测试
3. 进行多维质量评估，比较自动生成基准与人工构建基准的多样性
AI.result:
1. 自动生成的基准测试在多样性方面可与人工构建的基准相媲美
2. 实验显示LLMs在抽象时间序列推理和领域特定应用方面表现仍然有限
3. 揭示了LLMs在实现有效时间序列理解方面面临的持续挑战
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了可扩展的时间序列推理基准生成方法，填补了现有基准测试的局限性，但实验结果表明大语言模型在时间序列理解方面仍有显著不足，需要进一步研究来提升模型的时间序列推理能力。

title: Counting to Four is still a Chore for VLMs
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance on complex multimodal reasoning tasks, yet they still fail on simple grounding skills such as object counting. Existing evaluations mostly assess only final outputs, offering limited insight into where these failures arise inside the model. In this work, we present an empirical study of VLM counting behavior through both behavioral and mechanistic analysis. We introduce COUNTINGTRICKS, a controlled evaluation suite of simple shape-based counting cases designed to expose vulnerabilities under different patchification layouts and adversarial prompting conditions. Using attention analysis and component-wise probing, we show that count-relevant visual evidence is strongest in the modality projection stage but degrades substantially in later language layers, where models become more susceptible to text priors. Motivated by this finding, we further evaluate Modality Attention Share (MAS), a lightweight intervention that encourages a minimum budget of visual attention during answer generation. Our results suggest that counting failures in VLMs stem not only from visual perception limits, but also from the underuse of visual evidence during language-stage reasoning. Code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/leduy99/-CVPRW26-Modality-Attention-Share.

AI.tldr: 本文通过行为学和机制分析研究了视觉语言模型在计数任务上的失败原因，发现计数失败不仅源于视觉感知限制，还源于语言推理阶段对视觉证据的利用不足。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型在复杂的多模态推理任务上表现出色，但在简单的物体计数等基础技能上仍然失败。现有评估大多只关注最终输出，无法深入理解模型内部失败的原因。
AI.method: 1. 引入COUNTINGTRICKS评估套件，包含基于简单形状的计数案例，用于暴露不同patchification布局和对抗提示条件下的漏洞；2. 使用注意力分析和组件探测技术；3. 评估模态注意力共享（MAS）干预方法，该方法在答案生成阶段鼓励最小化的视觉注意力预算。
AI.result: 计数相关的视觉证据在模态投影阶段最强，但在后续语言层中显著退化，模型更容易受到文本先验的影响。MAS干预方法显示出改善潜力。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型的计数失败不仅源于视觉感知限制，更重要的是在语言推理阶段对视觉证据的利用不足。轻量级干预如MAS可以改善这一问题。

title: TInR: Exploring Tool-Internalized Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) has emerged as a promising direction by extending Large Language Models' (LLMs) capabilities with external tools during reasoning. Existing TIR methods typically rely on external tool documentation during reasoning. However, this leads to tool mastery difficulty, tool size constraints, and inference inefficiency. To mitigate these issues, we explore Tool-Internalized Reasoning (TInR), aiming at facilitating reasoning with tool knowledge internalized into LLMs. Achieving this goal presents notable requirements, including tool internalization and tool-reasoning coordination. To address them, we propose TInR-U, a tool-internalized reasoning framework for unified reasoning and tool usage. TInR-U is trained through a three-phase pipeline: 1) tool internalization with a bidirectional knowledge alignment strategy; 2) supervised fine-tuning warm-up using high-quality reasoning annotations, and 3) reinforcement learning with TInR-specific rewards. We comprehensively evaluate our method across in-domain and out-of-domain settings. Experiment results show that TInR-U achieves superior performance in both settings, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为TInR-U的工具内部化推理框架，旨在将工具知识内化到大型语言模型中，以解决传统工具集成推理方法存在的工具掌握困难、工具规模限制和推理效率低下等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有工具集成推理方法通常依赖外部工具文档进行推理，这导致了三个主要问题：工具掌握困难（需要频繁查阅文档）、工具规模约束（文档庞大难以处理）和推理效率低下。为了解决这些问题，作者探索了工具内部化推理，旨在将工具知识内化到LLMs中，从而促进更高效的推理。
AI.method: 提出了TInR-U框架，采用三阶段训练流程：1）工具内部化阶段，使用双向知识对齐策略；2）监督微调预热阶段，使用高质量推理标注；3）强化学习阶段，使用TInR特定的奖励机制。该框架实现了统一的推理和工具使用。
AI.result: 在领域内和领域外设置下进行了全面评估。实验结果表明，TInR-U在这两种设置下都取得了优越的性能，突出了其有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: TInR-U框架通过将工具知识内化到LLMs中，成功解决了传统工具集成推理方法存在的问题，实现了更高效、更统一的推理和工具使用，在领域内和领域外设置下都表现出色。

title: Gypscie: A Cross-Platform AI Artifact Management System
summary:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) models, encompassing both traditional machine learning (ML) and more advanced approaches such as deep learning and large language models (LLMs), play a central role in modern applications. AI model lifecycle management involves the end-to-end process of managing these models, from data collection and preparation to model building, evaluation, deployment, and continuous monitoring. This process is inherently complex, as it requires the coordination of diverse services that manage AI artifacts such as datasets, dataflows, and models, all orchestrated to operate seamlessly. In this context, it is essential to isolate applications from the complexity of interacting with heterogeneous services, datasets, and AI platforms.
  In this paper, we introduce Gypscie, a cross-platform AI artifact management system. By providing a unified view of all AI artifacts, the Gypscie platform simplifies the development and deployment of AI applications. This unified view is realized through a knowledge graph that captures application semantics and a rule-based query language that supports reasoning over data and models. Model lifecycle activities are represented as high-level dataflows that can be scheduled across multiple platforms, such as servers, cloud platforms, or supercomputers. Finally, Gypscie records provenance information about the artifacts it produces, thereby enabling explainability. Our qualitative comparison with representative AI systems shows that Gypscie supports a broader range of functionalities across the AI artifact lifecycle. Our experimental evaluation demonstrates that Gypscie can successfully optimize and schedule dataflows on AI platforms from an abstract specification.

AI.tldr: Gypscie是一个跨平台AI工件管理系统，通过知识图谱和规则查询语言提供统一视图，支持AI模型生命周期管理，能够在多平台上优化调度数据流。
AI.motivation: AI模型生命周期管理涉及从数据收集到部署监控的复杂过程，需要协调多种服务管理数据集、数据流和模型等AI工件。现有系统需要将应用与异构服务、数据集和AI平台的复杂性隔离。
AI.method: Gypscie通过知识图谱捕获应用语义，使用基于规则的查询语言支持对数据和模型的推理。模型生命周期活动表示为可在服务器、云平台或超级计算机等多平台上调度的高级数据流。系统记录所产生工件的溯源信息以实现可解释性。
AI.result: 与代表性AI系统的定性比较显示，Gypscie在AI工件生命周期中支持更广泛的功能。实验评估表明，Gypscie能够成功地从抽象规范中在AI平台上优化和调度数据流。
AI.conclusion: Gypscie通过提供统一的AI工件视图简化了AI应用的开发和部署，解决了跨异构平台协调AI模型生命周期管理的复杂性，支持可解释性和跨平台调度优化。

title: Intra-finger Variability of Diffusion-based Latent Fingerprint Generation
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Foundation and Generative Models in Biometrics (FoundGen-Bio), held in conjunction with CVPR 2026
summary: The primary goal of this work is to systematically evaluate the intra-finger variability of synthetic fingerprints (particularly latent prints) generated using a state-of-the-art diffusion model. Specifically, we focus on enhancing the latent style diversity of the generative model by constructing a comprehensive \textit{latent style bank} curated from seven diverse datasets, which enables the precise synthesis of latent prints with over 40 distinct styles encapsulating different surfaces and processing techniques. We also implement a semi-automated framework to understand the integrity of fingerprint ridges and minutiae in the generated impressions. Our analysis indicates that though the generation process largely preserves the identity, a small number of local inconsistencies (addition and removal of minutiae) are introduced, especially when there are poor quality regions in the reference image. Furthermore, mismatch between the reference image and the chosen style embedding that guides the generation process introduces global inconsistencies in the form of hallucinated ridge patterns. These insights highlight the limitations of existing synthetic fingerprint generators and the need to further improve these models to simultaneously enhance both diversity and identity consistency.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了扩散模型生成的合成指纹（特别是潜指纹）的指内变异性，通过构建包含40多种风格的潜风格库增强生成多样性，并分析了生成指纹的脊线和细节特征完整性。
AI.motivation: 现有合成指纹生成器在同时增强多样性和身份一致性方面存在局限性，需要系统评估生成指纹的指内变异性，特别是潜指纹的生成质量。
AI.method: 1. 构建包含7个不同数据集的综合潜风格库，支持40多种不同表面和处理技术的风格；2. 使用最先进的扩散模型生成合成指纹；3. 实施半自动化框架分析生成指纹的脊线和细节特征完整性。
AI.result: 1. 生成过程基本保持身份一致性，但在参考图像质量较差的区域会引入少量局部不一致（细节特征的添加和移除）；2. 参考图像与指导生成过程的风格嵌入不匹配时，会产生全局不一致，表现为幻觉脊线模式。
AI.conclusion: 现有合成指纹生成器在同时增强多样性和身份一致性方面仍有局限，需要进一步改进模型以平衡这两个关键要求。

title: Position-Agnostic Pre-Projection for Transformer Attention: Nonlinear Feature Construction and Content Skip Before Q/K/V
summary: We propose two complementary modifications to transformer attention blocks. First, a non-linear pre-projection MLP is inserted between layer norm and Q/K/V projections, constructing richer features in a position-agnostic manner before any positional encoding is applied. Second, a content skip connection routes the pre-projection's features around the attention mechanism, allowing content information to bypass position-aware attention where beneficial. In frozen-probe experiments on Pythia-160M and 410M, the combined approach achieves the strongest results across methods: +40.6% LAMBADA accuracy and -39% perplexity at 160M scale. Learned skip connection weights reveal a consistent pattern across model sizes: later transformer layers activate the content bypass more strongly than earlier layers, suggesting that deeper layers benefit from content information that does not pass through positional attention. All modifications add no K/V cache overhead.

AI.tldr: 论文提出对Transformer注意力块的两项互补修改：1）在层归一化和Q/K/V投影之间插入非线性预投影MLP，在位置编码前构建更丰富的特征；2）添加内容跳跃连接，让预投影特征绕过注意力机制。在Pythia-160M和410M上的实验显示显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 改进Transformer注意力机制，使其能够更有效地处理内容信息，特别是在深层网络中，让内容信息能够绕过位置敏感的注意力机制，从而提升模型性能。
AI.method: 1. 在层归一化和Q/K/V投影之间插入非线性预投影MLP，在应用位置编码前构建更丰富的特征；2. 添加内容跳跃连接，允许预投影的特征绕过注意力机制；3. 在Pythia-160M和410M模型上进行冻结探针实验验证。
AI.result: 在160M规模上，组合方法实现了最佳结果：LAMBADA准确率提升40.6%，困惑度降低39%。学习到的跳跃连接权重显示跨模型规模的一致模式：深层Transformer比浅层更强烈地激活内容旁路。所有修改不增加K/V缓存开销。
AI.conclusion: 提出的两项修改显著提升了Transformer注意力块的性能，特别是深层网络受益于能够绕过位置注意力的内容信息。该方法不增加推理时的计算开销，具有实用价值。

title: U$^{2}$Flow: Uncertainty-Aware Unsupervised Optical Flow Estimation
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at CVPR 2026
summary: Unsupervised optical flow methods typically lack reliable uncertainty estimation, limiting their robustness and interpretability. We propose U$^{2}$Flow, the first recurrent unsupervised framework that jointly estimates optical flow and per-pixel uncertainty. The core innovation is a decoupled learning strategy that derives uncertainty supervision from augmentation consistency via a Laplace-based maximum likelihood objective, enabling stable training without ground truth. The predicted uncertainty is further integrated into the network to guide adaptive flow refinement and dynamically modulate the regional smoothness loss. Furthermore, we introduce an uncertainty-guided bidirectional flow fusion mechanism that enhances robustness in challenging regions. Extensive experiments on KITTI and Sintel demonstrate that U$^{2}$Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised methods while producing highly reliable uncertainty maps, validating the effectiveness of our joint estimation paradigm. The code is available at https://github.com/sunzunyi/U2FLOW.

AI.tldr: U²Flow是首个循环无监督框架，能联合估计光流和逐像素不确定性，通过解耦学习策略从增强一致性中推导不确定性监督，无需真实标注数据。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督光流方法通常缺乏可靠的不确定性估计，限制了其鲁棒性和可解释性。需要一种能够同时估计光流和不确定性的无监督框架。
AI.method: 提出U²Flow框架，采用解耦学习策略，通过基于拉普拉斯分布的最大似然目标从增强一致性中推导不确定性监督。预测的不确定性被整合到网络中，用于指导自适应光流细化和动态调节区域平滑损失。还引入了不确定性引导的双向光流融合机制。
AI.result: 在KITTI和Sintel数据集上的大量实验表明，U²Flow在无监督方法中达到了最先进的性能，同时产生了高度可靠的不确定性图，验证了联合估计范式的有效性。
AI.conclusion: U²Flow是首个能够联合估计光流和不确定性的循环无监督框架，通过解耦学习策略和不确定性引导的优化机制，在保持高性能的同时提供了可靠的不确定性估计，增强了方法的鲁棒性和可解释性。

title: Advancing Polish Language Modeling through Tokenizer Optimization in the Bielik v3 7B and 11B Series
summary: The development of the Bielik v3 PL series, encompassing both the 7B and 11B parameter variants, represents a significant milestone in the field of language-specific large language model (LLM) optimization. While general-purpose models often demonstrate impressive multilingual capabilities, they frequently suffer from a fundamental architectural inefficiency: the use of universal tokenizers. These tokenizers, typically designed to cover a broad spectrum of languages, often fail to capture the morphological nuances of specific languages like Polish, leading to higher fertility ratios, increased inference costs, and restricted effective context windows. This report details the transition from the universal Mistral-based tokenization to a dedicated Polish-optimized vocabulary for the Bielik v3 models, exploring the FOCUS-based embedding initialization, the multi-stage pretraining curriculum, and the subsequent post-training alignment involving Supervised Fine-Tuning, Direct Preference Optimization, and Reinforcement Learning through Group Relative Policy Optimization with verifiable rewards.

AI.tldr: Bielik v3 PL系列模型（7B和11B参数）通过从通用分词器转向波兰语优化词汇表，解决了通用LLM在波兰语处理中的效率问题，采用多阶段预训练和强化学习对齐方法。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型虽然具备多语言能力，但使用通用分词器在处理波兰语等特定语言时存在效率问题：无法捕捉波兰语的形态学特征，导致生育率比高、推理成本增加、有效上下文窗口受限。需要开发专门针对波兰语优化的语言模型。
AI.method: 1. 从基于Mistral的通用分词转向波兰语优化词汇表；2. 采用FOCUS-based嵌入初始化；3. 多阶段预训练课程；4. 后训练对齐包括监督微调、直接偏好优化和基于可验证奖励的组相对策略优化强化学习。
AI.result: 开发了Bielik v3 PL系列模型，包含7B和11B参数变体，代表了语言特定大语言模型优化的重要里程碑，专门针对波兰语进行了优化。
AI.conclusion: 通过专用波兰语优化词汇表和多阶段训练策略，Bielik v3 PL系列模型解决了通用LLM在处理波兰语时的架构效率问题，为语言特定模型优化提供了有效方法。

title: Zero-shot World Models Are Developmentally Efficient Learners
summary: Young children demonstrate early abilities to understand their physical world, estimating depth, motion, object coherence, interactions, and many other aspects of physical scene understanding. Children are both data-efficient and flexible cognitive systems, creating competence despite extremely limited training data, while generalizing to myriad untrained tasks -- a major challenge even for today's best AI systems. Here we introduce a novel computational hypothesis for these abilities, the Zero-shot Visual World Model (ZWM). ZWM is based on three principles: a sparse temporally-factored predictor that decouples appearance from dynamics; zero-shot estimation through approximate causal inference; and composition of inferences to build more complex abilities. We show that ZWM can be learned from the first-person experience of a single child, rapidly generating competence across multiple physical understanding benchmarks. It also broadly recapitulates behavioral signatures of child development and builds brain-like internal representations. Our work presents a blueprint for efficient and flexible learning from human-scale data, advancing both a computational account for children's early physical understanding and a path toward data-efficient AI systems.

AI.tldr: ZWM模型通过稀疏时间因子化预测器、零样本因果推理和组合推理三大原则，从单个儿童的第一人称经验中学习，实现了跨多个物理理解基准的快速能力生成，并复现了儿童发展的行为特征。
AI.motivation: 儿童在物理世界理解方面表现出数据高效和灵活认知能力，能够在有限训练数据下获得能力并泛化到未训练任务，这是当前AI系统面临的主要挑战。研究旨在为儿童早期物理理解提供计算解释，并为数据高效AI系统开辟路径。
AI.method: 提出零样本视觉世界模型（ZWM），基于三个核心原则：1）稀疏时间因子化预测器，将外观与动态解耦；2）通过近似因果推理进行零样本估计；3）组合推理构建更复杂能力。模型从单个儿童的第一人称经验中学习。
AI.result: ZWM能够从单个儿童经验中快速学习，在多个物理理解基准上生成能力，广泛复现了儿童发展的行为特征，并构建了类似大脑的内部表征。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为从人类规模数据中进行高效灵活学习提供了蓝图，既推进了对儿童早期物理理解的计算解释，也为数据高效AI系统的发展指明了路径。

title: On The Application of Linear Attention in Multimodal Transformers
comment: Workshop on Any-to-Any Multimodal Learning (Any2Any), CVPR 2026
summary: Multimodal Transformers serve as the backbone for state-of-the-art vision-language models, yet their quadratic attention complexity remains a critical barrier to scalability. In this work, we investigate the viability of Linear Attention (LA) as a high-efficiency alternative within multimodal frameworks.
