By integrating LA, we reduce the computational overhead from quadratic to linear relative to sequence length while preserving competitive performance. We evaluate our approach across ViT-S/16, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16 architectures trained on the LAION-400M dataset, with validation focused on ImageNet-21K zero-shot accuracy. Our systematic evaluation demonstrates that Linear Attention not only yields significant computational savings but also adheres to the same scaling laws as standard softmax attention. These findings position Linear Attention as a robust, scalable solution for next-generation multimodal Transformers tasked with processing increasingly large and complex datasets.

AI.tldr: 线性注意力机制可替代传统softmax注意力，将计算复杂度从二次降为线性，在多模态Transformer中保持竞争力的同时显著提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态Transformer中的二次注意力计算复杂度限制了模型的可扩展性，需要寻找更高效的计算替代方案。
AI.method: 在多模态框架中集成线性注意力机制，在ViT-S/16、ViT-B/16和ViT-L/16架构上进行评估，使用LAION-400M数据集训练，以ImageNet-21K零样本准确率为验证指标。
AI.result: 线性注意力不仅显著节省计算资源，而且遵循与标准softmax注意力相同的缩放规律，在保持竞争力的性能同时将计算开销从二次降为线性。
AI.conclusion: 线性注意力是下一代多模态Transformer处理大规模复杂数据集的稳健、可扩展解决方案。

title: OccuBench: Evaluating AI Agents on Real-World Professional Tasks via Language World Models
summary: AI agents are expected to perform professional work across hundreds of occupational domains (from emergency department triage to nuclear reactor safety monitoring to customs import processing), yet existing benchmarks can only evaluate agents in the few domains where public environments exist. We introduce OccuBench, a benchmark covering 100 real-world professional task scenarios across 10 industry categories and 65 specialized domains, enabled by Language World Models (LWMs) that simulate domain-specific environments through LLM-driven tool response generation. Our multi-agent synthesis pipeline automatically produces evaluation instances with guaranteed solvability, calibrated difficulty, and document-grounded diversity. OccuBench evaluates agents along two complementary dimensions: task completion across professional domains and environmental robustness under controlled fault injection (explicit errors, implicit data degradation, and mixed faults). We evaluate 15 frontier models across 8 model families and find that: (1) no single model dominates all industries, as each has a distinct occupational capability profile; (2) implicit faults (truncated data, missing fields) are harder than both explicit errors (timeouts, 500s) and mixed faults, because they lack overt error signals and require the agent to independently detect data degradation; (3) larger models, newer generations, and higher reasoning effort consistently improve performance. GPT-5.2 improves by 27.5 points from minimal to maximum reasoning effort; and (4) strong agents are not necessarily strong environment simulators. Simulator quality is critical for LWM-based evaluation reliability. OccuBench provides the first systematic cross-industry evaluation of AI agents on professional occupational tasks.

AI.tldr: OccuBench是一个覆盖100个真实世界专业任务场景的AI代理评估基准，涵盖10个行业类别和65个专业领域，使用语言世界模型模拟领域特定环境，评估代理的任务完成能力和环境鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只能在少数有公共环境的领域评估AI代理，而AI代理需要在数百个职业领域执行专业工作，因此需要创建一个能够系统评估跨行业专业任务能力的基准。
AI.method: 使用语言世界模型通过LLM驱动的工具响应生成来模拟领域特定环境，采用多代理合成管道自动生成评估实例，确保可解性、校准难度和基于文档的多样性，评估维度包括任务完成度和环境鲁棒性（显式错误、隐式数据退化、混合故障注入）。
AI.result: 评估15个前沿模型发现：1）没有单一模型在所有行业占主导，每个模型有独特的职业能力特征；2）隐式故障比显式错误和混合故障更难处理；3）更大模型、更新世代和更高推理努力持续提升性能；4）强大的代理不一定是强大的环境模拟器，模拟器质量对评估可靠性至关重要。
AI.conclusion: OccuBench为AI代理在专业职业任务上提供了首个系统性跨行业评估框架，揭示了模型在不同职业领域的能力差异和环境鲁棒性挑战，强调了环境模拟器质量对评估可靠性的重要性。

title: VeriTrans: Fine-Tuned LLM-Assisted NL-to-PL Translation via a Deterministic Neuro-Symbolic Pipeline
summary: \textbf{VeriTrans} is a reliability-first ML system that compiles natural-language requirements into solver-ready logic with validator-gated reliability. The pipeline integrates an instruction-tuned NL$\!\to\!$PL translator, round-trip reconstruction (PL$\!\to\!$NL) used as a high-precision acceptance gate, and canonical PL$\!\to\!$CNF compilation, all executed via fixed API configuration (temperature$=0$; fine-tuning runs use seed$=42$) and per-item artifact logging (prompts, outputs, hashes) to support auditability and replay-driven debugging. On \textbf{SatBench} (2{,}100 specifications), VeriTrans achieves 94.46\% SAT/UNSAT correctness and 87.73\% median round-trip similarity. Compact fine-tuning on 100--150 curated examples improves fidelity by about 1--1.5\,pp without increasing latency (mean 25.8\,s/spec on our 201-spec runtime subset). A thresholded acceptance policy on the round-trip score exposes a reliability--coverage knob: at $τ{=}75$, roughly 68\% of items are retained with $\sim$94\% correctness on the accepted set. Validator overhead contributes $<15\%$ of end-to-end runtime, and all prompts/responses and timing metadata are logged to enable replay-driven debugging and regression testing. By separating learned translation from symbolic verification and enforcing deterministic, validator-gated acceptance, VeriTrans turns NL$\!\to\!$logic front-ends into auditable, reproducible components for reliability-critical workflows.

AI.tldr: VeriTrans是一个可靠性优先的ML系统，将自然语言需求编译为可求解的逻辑公式，通过验证器门控确保可靠性，在SAT/UNSAT正确性上达到94.46%，支持审计和重放调试。
AI.motivation: 将自然语言需求转化为逻辑公式的传统方法缺乏可靠性和可审计性，特别是在可靠性关键的工作流程中。需要一种能够确保高正确性、支持审计和重放调试的系统。
AI.method: 系统包含三个主要组件：1) 指令调优的NL→PL翻译器；2) 往返重建(PL→NL)作为高精度接受门；3) 规范PL→CNF编译。采用固定API配置(temperature=0，种子=42)和逐项工件日志记录，支持审计和重放调试。
AI.result: 在SatBench(2100个规范)上达到94.46%的SAT/UNSAT正确性和87.73%的中位往返相似度。使用100-150个精选示例进行紧凑微调可将保真度提高1-1.5个百分点，平均延迟25.8秒/规范。验证器开销占端到端运行时间的<15%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将学习翻译与符号验证分离，并强制执行确定性、验证器门控的接受机制，VeriTrans将NL→逻辑前端转变为可审计、可复现的组件，适用于可靠性关键的工作流程。

title: Spotlight and Shadow: Attention-Guided Dual-Anchor Introspective Decoding for MLLM Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities yet continue to suffer from hallucination, where generated text contradicts visual content. In this paper, we introduce Dual-Anchor Introspective Decoding (DaID), a novel contrastive decoding framework that dynamically calibrates each token generation by mining the model's internal perceptual discrepancies. Specifically, DaID identifies a Spotlight layer to amplify visual factual signals and a Shadow layer to suppress textual inertia. By leveraging visual attention distributions to guide this dual-anchor selection process, our method ensures precise, token-specific adaptation. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks and MLLMs demonstrate that DaID significantly mitigates hallucination while enhancing general reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出DaID框架，通过挖掘模型内部感知差异来动态校准token生成，显著减少多模态大语言模型的幻觉问题
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽然具备强大的推理能力，但仍存在幻觉问题，即生成的文本与视觉内容相矛盾。需要一种方法来减少这种幻觉，同时保持模型的推理能力。
AI.method: 提出双锚点内省解码框架，通过识别Spotlight层来增强视觉事实信号，识别Shadow层来抑制文本惯性。利用视觉注意力分布来指导双锚点选择过程，实现精确的token级适应。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试和多模态大语言模型上的实验结果表明，DaID显著减轻了幻觉问题，同时增强了通用推理能力。
AI.conclusion: DaID通过挖掘模型内部感知差异的动态校准机制，有效解决了多模态大语言模型的幻觉问题，提升了模型的准确性和可靠性。

title: AOP-Smart: A RAG-Enhanced Large Language Model Framework for Adverse Outcome Pathway Analysis
summary: Adverse Outcome Pathways (AOPs) are an important knowledge framework in toxicological research and risk assessment. In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have gradually been applied to AOP-related question answering and mechanistic reasoning tasks. However, due to the existence of the hallucination problem, that is, the model may generate content that is inconsistent with facts or lacks evidence, their reliability is still limited. To address this issue, this study proposes an AOP-oriented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework, AOP-Smart. Based on the official XML data from AOP-Wiki, this method uses Key Events (KEs), Key Event Relationships (KERs), and specific AOP information to retrieve relevant knowledge for user questions, thereby improving the reliability of the generated results of large language models. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method, this study constructed a test set containing 20 AOP-related question answering tasks, covering KE identification, upstream and downstream KE retrieval, and complex AOP retrieval tasks. Experiments were conducted on three mainstream large language models, Gemini, DeepSeek, and ChatGPT, and comparative tests were performed under two settings: without RAG and with RAG. The experimental results show that, without using RAG, the accuracies of GPT, DeepSeek, and Gemini were 15.0\%, 35.0\%, and 20.0\%, respectively; after using RAG, their accuracies increased to 95.0\%, 100.0\%, and 95.0\%, respectively. The results indicate that AOP-Smart can significantly alleviate the hallucination problem of large language models in AOP knowledge tasks, and greatly improve the accuracy and consistency of their answers.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出AOP-Smart框架，通过检索增强生成技术解决大语言模型在AOP知识问答中的幻觉问题，显著提升回答准确性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在AOP相关问答和机制推理任务中存在幻觉问题，可能生成与事实不符或缺乏证据的内容，限制了其可靠性。
AI.method: 基于AOP-Wiki官方XML数据，利用关键事件、关键事件关系和特定AOP信息检索相关知识，构建AOP-Smart检索增强生成框架。
AI.result: 在20个AOP相关问答任务测试中，使用RAG后GPT准确率从15.0%提升至95.0%，DeepSeek从35.0%提升至100.0%，Gemini从20.0%提升至95.0%。
AI.conclusion: AOP-Smart能显著缓解大语言模型在AOP知识任务中的幻觉问题，大幅提高回答的准确性和一致性。

title: ClawVM: Harness-Managed Virtual Memory for Stateful Tool-Using LLM Agents
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables; accepted at EuroMLSys '26 (6th Workshop on Machine Learning and Systems, co-located with EuroSys 2026)
summary: Stateful tool-using LLM agents treat the context window as working memory, yet today's agent harnesses manage residency and durability as best-effort, causing recurring failures: lost state after compaction, bypassed flushes on reset, and destructive writeback. We present \textsc{ClawVM}, a virtual memory layer that manages state as typed pages with minimum-fidelity invariants, multi-resolution representations under a token budget, and validated writeback at every lifecycle boundary. Because the harness already assembles prompts, mediates tools, and observes lifecycle events, it is the natural enforcement point; placing the contract there makes residency and durability deterministic and auditable. Across synthetic workloads, 12 real-session traces, and adversarial stress tests, \textsc{ClawVM} eliminates all policy-controllable faults whenever the minimum-fidelity set fits within the token budget, confirmed by an offline oracle, and adds median <50 microseconds of policy-engine overhead per turn.

AI.tldr: ClawVM是一个虚拟内存层，为LLM代理提供确定性的状态管理，通过类型化页面、多分辨率表示和验证写回机制，消除状态丢失等故障。
AI.motivation: 当前基于状态的工具使用LLM代理将上下文窗口作为工作内存，但现有的代理框架在状态驻留和持久性管理上采用尽力而为的方式，导致频繁故障：压缩后状态丢失、重置时绕过刷新、破坏性写回等。
AI.method: ClawVM是一个虚拟内存层，通过以下机制管理状态：1) 类型化页面和最小保真度不变性；2) 在令牌预算下的多分辨率表示；3) 每个生命周期边界的验证写回。由于代理框架已经负责组装提示、协调工具和观察生命周期事件，因此将其作为自然执行点。
AI.result: 在合成工作负载、12个真实会话跟踪和对抗性压力测试中，ClawVM消除了所有策略可控的故障（当最小保真度集合适合令牌预算时），并通过离线预言机确认。每轮策略引擎开销中位数小于50微秒。
AI.conclusion: ClawVM通过在代理框架中实施虚拟内存层，使状态驻留和持久性变得确定性和可审计，解决了当前LLM代理状态管理的根本问题。

title: DocRevive: A Unified Pipeline for Document Text Restoration
summary: In Document Understanding, the challenge of reconstructing damaged, occluded, or incomplete text remains a critical yet unexplored problem. Subsequent document understanding tasks can benefit from a document reconstruction process. In response, this paper presents a novel unified pipeline combining state-of-the-art Optical Character Recognition (OCR), advanced image analysis, masked language modeling, and diffusion-based models to restore and reconstruct text while preserving visual integrity. We create a synthetic dataset of 30{,}078 degraded document images that simulates diverse document degradation scenarios, setting a benchmark for restoration tasks. Our pipeline detects and recognizes text, identifies degradation with an occlusion detector, and uses an inpainting model for semantically coherent reconstruction. A diffusion-based module seamlessly reintegrates text, matching font, size, and alignment. To evaluate restoration quality, we propose a Unified Context Similarity Metric (UCSM), incorporating edit, semantic, and length similarities with a contextual predictability measure that penalizes deviations when the correct text is contextually obvious. Our work advances document restoration, benefiting archival research and digital preservation while setting a new standard for text reconstruction. The OPRB dataset and code are available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/kpurkayastha/OPRB}{Hugging Face} and \href{https://github.com/kunalpurkayastha/DocRevive}{Github} respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DocRevive统一流水线，结合OCR、图像分析、掩码语言建模和扩散模型，修复受损文档文本并保持视觉完整性，创建了包含30,078张退化文档图像的OPRB数据集，并提出统一上下文相似度指标评估修复质量。
AI.motivation: 文档理解中，修复受损、遮挡或不完整文本是一个关键但尚未充分探索的问题。文档重建过程能够提升后续文档理解任务的效果，对档案研究和数字保存具有重要意义。
AI.method: 提出统一流水线：1) 使用最先进OCR检测识别文本；2) 通过遮挡检测器识别退化区域；3) 使用修复模型进行语义连贯重建；4) 扩散模型模块无缝重新集成文本，匹配字体、大小和对齐方式。创建了包含30,078张退化文档图像的OPRB合成数据集。
AI.result: 开发了完整的文档修复系统，创建了OPRB基准数据集，提出了统一上下文相似度指标来评估修复质量，该指标结合编辑、语义和长度相似度，并包含上下文可预测性度量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了文档修复领域，有益于档案研究和数字保存，为文本重建设定了新标准。OPRB数据集和代码已在Hugging Face和GitHub上开源。

title: HTAA: Enhancing LLM Planning via Hybrid Toolset Agentization & Adaptation
summary: Enabling large language models to scale and reliably use hundreds of tools is critical for real-world applications, yet challenging due to the inefficiency and error accumulation inherent in flat tool-calling architectures. To address this, we propose Hybrid Toolset Agentization & Adaptation (HTAA), a hierarchical framework for scalable tool-use planning. We propose a novel toolset agentization paradigm, which encapsulates frequently co-used tools into specialized agent tools, thereby reducing the planner's action space and mitigating redundancy. To ensure effective coordination, we design Asymmetric Planner Adaptation, a trajectory-based training paradigm that aligns the high-level planner with agent tools via backward reconstruction and forward refinement. To validate the performance of HTAA, we conduct experiments on a real-world internal dataset, InfoVerify, based on the POI validation workflow of China's largest online large-scale ride-hailing platform, featuring long-horizon executable tool trajectories. Experiments on InfoVerify and widely-used benchmarks show that HTAA consistently achieves higher task success rates, requires short tool calling trajectories, and significantly reduces context overhead compared to strong baselines. Furthermore, in a production deployment, HTAA substantially reduces manual validation effort and operational cost, demonstrating its practical efficacy.

AI.tldr: HTAA提出分层框架解决大语言模型工具调用扩展问题，通过工具集代理化和非对称规划器适应实现高效工具使用规划
AI.motivation: 解决大语言模型在真实应用中扩展使用数百个工具的挑战，传统平面工具调用架构存在效率低下和错误累积问题
AI.method: HTAA框架包含：1) 工具集代理化范式，将经常共同使用的工具封装成专用代理工具；2) 非对称规划器适应，基于轨迹的训练范式通过后向重构和前向精炼对齐高层规划器与代理工具
AI.result: 在真实世界内部数据集InfoVerify和广泛使用的基准测试中，HTAA持续获得更高的任务成功率，需要更短的工具调用轨迹，显著减少上下文开销；在生产部署中大幅减少人工验证工作和运营成本
AI.conclusion: HTAA通过分层框架有效解决了大语言模型工具调用扩展问题，在实际应用中展现出显著效果和实用价值

title: Attention-Guided Dual-Stream Learning for Group Engagement Recognition: Fusing Transformer-Encoded Motion Dynamics with Scene Context via Adaptive Gating
summary: Student engagement is crucial for improving learning outcomes in group activities. Highly engaged students perform better both individually and contribute to overall group success. However, most existing automated engagement recognition methods are designed for online classrooms or estimate engagement at the individual level. Addressing this gap, we propose DualEngage, a novel two-stream framework for group-level engagement recognition from in-classroom videos. It models engagement as a joint function of both individual and group-level behaviors. The primary stream models person-level motion dynamics by detecting and tracking students, extracting dense optical flow with the Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms network, encoding temporal motion patterns using a transformer encoder, and finally aggregating per-student representations through attention pooling into a unified representation. The secondary stream captures scene-level spatiotemporal information from the full video clip, leveraging a pretrained three-dimensional Residual Network. The two-stream representations are combined via softmax-gated fusion, which dynamically weights each stream's contribution based on the joint context of both features. DualEngage learns a joint representation of individual actions with overarching group dynamics. We evaluate the proposed approach using fivefold cross-validation on the Classroom Group Engagement Dataset developed by Ocean University of China, achieving an average classification accuracy of 0.9621+/-0.0161 with a macro-averaged F1 of 0.9530+/-0.0204. To understand the contribution of each branch, we further conduct an ablation study comparing single-stream variants against the two-stream model. This work is among the first in classroom engagement recognition to adopt a dual-stream design that explicitly leverages motion cues as an estimator.

AI.tldr: DualEngage是一个双流框架，用于从课堂视频中进行群体层面的参与度识别，通过结合个体运动动态和场景级时空信息来建模参与度。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化参与度识别方法主要针对在线课堂或个体层面，缺乏对群体层面参与度的识别。群体参与度对学生学习成果至关重要，需要同时考虑个体行为和群体动态。
AI.method: 提出DualEngage双流框架：主流通过检测跟踪学生、提取密集光流、使用transformer编码器编码时间运动模式，并通过注意力池化聚合个体表示；次流使用预训练的3D残差网络捕捉完整视频片段的场景级时空信息。两流表示通过softmax门控融合动态加权结合。
AI.result: 在中国海洋大学开发的课堂群体参与度数据集上，通过五折交叉验证获得平均分类准确率0.9621±0.0161，宏平均F1分数0.9530±0.0204。消融研究表明双流设计优于单流变体。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是课堂参与度识别中首批采用双流设计并明确利用运动线索作为估计器的方法之一，成功建模了个体行为与群体动态的联合表示，为群体参与度识别提供了有效框架。

title: Mem$^2$Evolve: Towards Self-Evolving Agents via Co-Evolutionary Capability Expansion and Experience Distillation
summary: While large language model--powered agents can self-evolve by accumulating experience or by dynamically creating new assets (i.e., tools or expert agents), existing frameworks typically treat these two evolutionary processes in isolation. This separation overlooks their intrinsic interdependence: the former is inherently bounded by a manually predefined static toolset, while the latter generates new assets from scratch without experiential guidance, leading to limited capability growth and unstable evolution. To address this limitation, we introduce a novel paradigm of co-evolutionary Capability Expansion and Experience Distillation. Guided by this paradigm, we propose the \textbf{Mem$^{\textbf{2}}$Evolve}, which integrates two core components: \textbf{Experience Memory} and \textbf{Asset Memory}. Specifically, Mem$^{2}$Evolve leverages accumulated experience to guide the dynamic creation of assets, thereby expanding the agent's capability space while simultaneously acquiring new experience to achieve co-evolution. Extensive experiments across 6 task categories and 8 benchmarks demonstrate that Mem$^{2}$Evolve achieves improvement of 18.53\% over standard LLMs, 11.80\% over agents evolving solely through experience, and 6.46\% over those evolving solely through asset creation, establishing it as a substantially more effective and stable self-evolving agent framework. Code is available at: https://buaa-irip-llm.github.io/Mem2Evolve.

AI.tldr: Mem²Evolve提出了一种新的协同进化范式，将能力扩展与经验蒸馏相结合，通过经验记忆和资产记忆实现智能体的自我进化，相比单独进化的方法有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语言模型智能体进化框架通常将经验积累和资产创建（工具或专家智能体）这两个进化过程分开处理，忽略了它们的内在相互依赖性。经验积累受限于手动预定义的静态工具集，而资产创建则缺乏经验指导，导致能力增长有限和进化不稳定。
AI.method: 提出了协同进化的能力扩展与经验蒸馏范式，并基于此设计了Mem²Evolve框架。该框架包含两个核心组件：经验记忆和资产记忆。通过积累的经验指导动态创建资产，扩展智能体的能力空间，同时获取新经验实现协同进化。
AI.result: 在6个任务类别和8个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，Mem²Evolve相比标准LLM提升了18.53%，相比仅通过经验进化的智能体提升了11.80%，相比仅通过资产创建进化的智能体提升了6.46%，成为一个更有效和稳定的自我进化智能体框架。
AI.conclusion: Mem²Evolve通过协同进化范式成功解决了现有智能体进化框架中经验积累和资产创建分离的问题，实现了更有效和稳定的自我进化，为智能体能力扩展提供了新思路。

title: MatRes: Zero-Shot Test-Time Model Adaptation for Simultaneous Matching and Restoration
summary: Real-world image pairs often exhibit both severe degradations and large viewpoint changes, making image restoration and geometric matching mutually interfering tasks when treated independently. In this work, we propose MatRes, a zero-shot test-time adaptation framework that jointly improves restoration quality and correspondence estimation using only a single low-quality and high-quality image pair. By enforcing conditional similarity at corresponding locations, MatRes updates only lightweight modules while keeping all pretrained components frozen, requiring no offline training or additional supervision. Extensive experiments across diverse combinations show that MatRes yields significant gains in both restoration and geometric alignment compared to using either restoration or matching models alone. MatRes offers a practical and widely applicable solution for real-world scenarios where users commonly capture multiple images of a scene with varying viewpoints and quality, effectively addressing the often-overlooked mutual interference between matching and restoration.

AI.tldr: MatRes是一个零样本测试时自适应框架，通过单对低质量-高质量图像联合提升图像恢复质量和对应点估计，无需离线训练或额外监督。
AI.motivation: 现实世界图像对常同时存在严重退化和大视角变化，导致图像恢复和几何匹配这两个任务相互干扰。现有方法独立处理这两个任务时效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出MatRes框架，通过强制对应位置的相似性条件，仅更新轻量级模块而保持所有预训练组件冻结，实现零样本测试时自适应，无需离线训练或额外监督。
AI.result: 在多种组合的广泛实验中，MatRes相比单独使用恢复或匹配模型，在恢复质量和几何对齐方面都取得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: MatRes为现实场景提供了一种实用且广泛适用的解决方案，有效解决了匹配和恢复之间常被忽视的相互干扰问题。

title: YIELD: A Large-Scale Dataset and Evaluation Framework for Information Elicitation Agents
summary: Most conversational agents (CAs) are designed to satisfy user needs through user-driven interactions. However, many real-world settings, such as academic interviewing, judicial proceedings, and journalistic investigations, involve broader institutional decision-making processes and require agents that can elicit information from users. In this paper, we introduce Information Elicitation Agents (IEAs) in which the agent's goal is to elicit information from users to support the agent's institutional or task-oriented objectives. To enable systematic research on this setting, we present YIELD, a 26M-token dataset of 2,281 ethically sourced, human-to-human dialogues. Moreover, we formalize information elicitation as a finite-horizon POMDP and propose novel metrics tailored to IEAs. Pilot experiments on multiple foundation LLMs show that training on YIELD improves their alignment with real elicitation behavior and findings are corroborated by human evaluation. We release YIELD under CC BY 4.0. The dataset, project code, evaluation tools, and fine-tuned model adapters are available at: https://github.com/infosenselab/yield.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了信息获取代理（IEAs），旨在从用户处获取信息以支持机构或任务目标，并提出了YIELD数据集和评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有对话代理主要满足用户需求，但在学术访谈、司法程序、新闻调查等机构决策场景中，需要能够主动从用户处获取信息的代理。
AI.method: 1) 提出信息获取代理（IEAs）概念；2) 构建YIELD数据集（26M token，2,281个伦理来源的人对人对话）；3) 将信息获取形式化为有限时域POMDP；4) 设计针对IEAs的新评估指标。
AI.result: 在多个基础大语言模型上的实验表明，使用YIELD训练能提高模型与真实信息获取行为的对齐度，人类评估也证实了这一发现。
AI.conclusion: 信息获取代理是对话系统的重要研究方向，YIELD数据集和相关工具为系统研究提供了基础，相关资源已开源。

title: When Verification Fails: How Compositionally Infeasible Claims Escape Rejection
summary: Scientific claim verification, the task of determining whether claims are entailed by scientific evidence, is fundamental to establishing discoveries in evidence while preventing misinformation. This process involves evaluating each asserted constraint against validated evidence. Under the Closed-World Assumption (CWA), a claim is accepted if and only if all asserted constraints are positively supported. We show that existing verification benchmarks cannot distinguish models enforcing this standard from models applying a simpler shortcut called salient-constraint checking, which applies CWA's rejection criterion only to the most salient constraint and accepts when that constraint is supported. Because existing benchmarks construct infeasible claims by perturbing a single salient element they are insufficient at distinguishing between rigorous claim verification and simple salient-constraint reliance. To separate the two, we construct compositionally infeasible claims where the salient constraint is supported but a non-salient constraint is contradicted. Across model families and modalities, models that otherwise saturate existing benchmarks consistently over-accept these claims, confirming the prevalence of such shortcut reasoning. Via model context interventions, we show that different models and prompting strategies occupy distinct positions on a shared ROC curve, indicating that the gap between model families reflects differences in verification threshold rather than underlying reasoning ability, and that the compositional inference bottleneck is a structural property of current verification behavior that strategy guidance alone cannot overcome.

AI.tldr: 现有科学声明验证基准无法区分严格验证模型与仅检查最显著约束的捷径模型，作者通过构建组合不可行声明来揭示当前模型普遍依赖捷径推理的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有科学声明验证基准存在缺陷，无法区分真正遵循封闭世界假设（CWA）的严格验证模型与仅检查最显著约束的捷径模型，需要新的评估方法来揭示模型的真实推理能力。
AI.method: 构建组合不可行声明，其中显著约束得到支持但非显著约束被反驳，以此区分严格验证与捷径推理；通过模型上下文干预分析不同模型和提示策略在ROC曲线上的表现。
AI.result: 跨模型家族和模态的实验表明，即使在现有基准上表现饱和的模型也会过度接受组合不可行声明，确认了捷径推理的普遍性；不同模型和提示策略位于共享ROC曲线的不同位置，表明模型间的差异主要反映验证阈值而非基础推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 当前科学声明验证模型普遍依赖捷径推理而非严格验证，组合推理瓶颈是当前验证行为的结构性特征，仅靠策略指导无法克服；需要新的评估方法和模型改进来解决这一根本问题。

title: Safety Guarantees in Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning for Cascade Dynamical Systems
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures; submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: This paper considers the problem of zero-shot safety guarantees for cascade dynamical systems. These are systems where a subset of the states (the inner states) affects the dynamics of the remaining states (the outer states) but not vice-versa. We define safety as remaining on a set deemed safe for all times with high probability. We propose to train a safe RL policy on a reduced-order model, which ignores the dynamics of the inner states, but it treats it as an action that influences the outer state. Thus, reducing the complexity of the training. When deployed in the full system the trained policy is combined with a low-level controller whose task is to track the reference provided by the RL policy. Our main theoretical contribution is a bound on the safe probability in the full-order system. In particular, we establish the interplay between the probability of remaining safe after the zero-shot deployment and the quality of the tracking of the inner states. We validate our theoretical findings on a quadrotor navigation task, demonstrating that the preservation of the safety guarantees is tied to the bandwidth and tracking capabilities of the low-level controller.

AI.tldr: 本文研究级联动力系统的零样本安全保证问题，提出在降阶模型上训练安全RL策略，然后在完整系统中部署时结合底层控制器，并给出了完整系统安全概率的理论边界。
AI.motivation: 级联动力系统（内状态影响外状态但反之不成立）的安全保证具有挑战性。传统方法在完整系统上训练RL策略复杂度高，本文旨在通过降阶模型训练简化复杂度，同时保证部署到完整系统时的安全性能。
AI.method: 1) 在忽略内状态动力学的降阶模型上训练安全RL策略，将内状态视为影响外状态的动作；2) 部署时将训练好的策略与底层控制器结合，底层控制器负责跟踪RL策略提供的参考信号；3) 建立完整系统安全概率的理论边界，分析安全保持与内状态跟踪质量的关系。
AI.result: 建立了完整系统安全概率的理论边界，表明安全保持概率与底层控制器的带宽和跟踪能力密切相关。在四旋翼导航任务上的实验验证了理论发现，证明安全保证的保持确实依赖于底层控制器的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过降阶模型训练安全RL策略可以显著降低训练复杂度，同时在完整系统中部署时结合适当的底层控制器可以保持安全保证。理论边界为系统设计提供了指导，强调了控制器跟踪性能对安全保持的重要性。

title: When Valid Signals Fail: Regime Boundaries Between LLM Features and RL Trading Policies
summary: Can large language models (LLMs) generate continuous numerical features that improve reinforcement learning (RL) trading agents? We build a modular pipeline where a frozen LLM serves as a stateless feature extractor, transforming unstructured daily news and filings into a fixed-dimensional vector consumed by a downstream PPO agent. We introduce an automated prompt-optimization loop that treats the extraction prompt as a discrete hyperparameter and tunes it directly against the Information Coefficient - the Spearman rank correlation between predicted and realized returns - rather than NLP losses. The optimized prompt discovers genuinely predictive features (IC above 0.15 on held-out data). However, these valid intermediate representations do not automatically translate into downstream task performance: during a distribution shift caused by a macroeconomic shock, LLM-derived features add noise, and the augmented agent under-performs a price-only baseline. In a calmer test regime the agent recovers, yet macroeconomic state variables remain the most robust driver of policy improvement. Our findings highlight a gap between feature-level validity and policy-level robustness that parallels known challenges in transfer learning under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: LLM提取的数值特征在特征层面具有预测性，但在强化学习交易代理中面临分布偏移时的鲁棒性挑战
AI.motivation: 探索大型语言模型能否生成连续数值特征来改进强化学习交易代理的性能
AI.method: 构建模块化管道：冻结的LLM作为无状态特征提取器，将新闻和文件转换为固定维度向量，供下游PPO代理使用；引入自动提示优化循环，将提取提示作为离散超参数，直接针对信息系数进行优化
AI.result: 优化的提示发现了真正具有预测性的特征（在保留数据上IC超过0.15），但在宏观经济冲击导致的分布偏移期间，LLM衍生特征增加了噪声，增强代理表现不如仅使用价格数据的基线；在平静测试环境中代理恢复，但宏观经济状态变量仍是策略改进的最稳健驱动因素
AI.conclusion: 研究发现特征层面有效性与策略层面鲁棒性之间存在差距，这与分布偏移下迁移学习的已知挑战相平行

title: Global monitoring of methane point sources using deep learning on hyperspectral radiance measurements from EMIT
summary: Anthropogenic methane (CH4) point sources drive near-term climate forcing, safety hazards, and system inefficiencies. Space-based imaging spectroscopy is emerging as a tool for identifying emissions globally, but existing approaches largely rely on manual plume identification. Here we present the Methane Analysis and Plume Localization with EMIT (MAPL-EMIT) model, an end-to-end vision transformer framework that leverages the complete radiance spectrum from the Earth Surface Mineral Dust Source Investigation (EMIT) instrument to jointly retrieve methane enhancements across all pixels within a scene. This approach brings together spectral and spatial context to significantly lower detection limits. MAPL-EMIT simultaneously supports enhancement quantification, plume delineation, and source localization, even for multiple overlapping plumes. The model was trained on 3.6 million physics-based synthetic plumes injected into global EMIT radiance data. Synthetic evaluation confirms the model's ability to identify plumes with high recall and precision and to capture weaker plumes relative to existing matched-filter approaches. On real-world benchmarks, MAPL-EMIT captures 79% of known hand-annotated NASA L2B plume complexes across a test set of 1084 EMIT granules, while capturing twice as many plausible plumes than identified by human analysts. Further validation against coincident airborne data, top-emitting landfills, and controlled release experiments confirms the model's ability to identify previously uncaptured sources. By incorporating model-generated metrics such as spectral fit scores and estimated noise levels, the framework can further limit false-positive rates. Overall, MAPL-EMIT enables high-throughput implementation on the full EMIT catalog, shifting methane monitoring from labor-intensive workflows to a rapid, scalable paradigm for global plume mapping at the facility scale.

AI.tldr: MAPL-EMIT是一个端到端的视觉Transformer框架，利用EMIT仪器的完整辐射光谱数据，联合检索场景中所有像素的甲烷增强，实现甲烷点源排放的高通量自动检测。
AI.motivation: 人为甲烷点源排放导致近期气候强迫、安全危害和系统效率低下。现有基于空间的成像光谱方法主要依赖人工羽流识别，需要自动化、可扩展的解决方案。
AI.method: 开发了MAPL-EMIT模型，这是一个端到端的视觉Transformer框架，利用EMIT仪器的完整辐射光谱数据，结合光谱和空间上下文信息，联合检索场景中所有像素的甲烷增强。模型在360万个基于物理的合成羽流数据上训练，这些羽流被注入到全球EMIT辐射数据中。
AI.result: 在1084个EMIT颗粒的测试集中，MAPL-EMIT捕获了79%已知手工标注的NASA L2B羽流复合体，同时捕获了人类分析师识别数量的两倍可信羽流。与同步机载数据、顶级排放垃圾填埋场和受控释放实验的验证证实了模型识别先前未捕获源的能力。
AI.conclusion: MAPL-EMIT实现了对完整EMIT目录的高通量处理，将甲烷监测从劳动密集型工作流程转变为快速、可扩展的全球设施尺度羽流制图范式。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Web-Conditioned Scientific Fact-Checking
summary: Scientific fact-checking is vital for assessing claims in specialized domains such as biomedicine and materials science, yet existing systems often hallucinate or apply inconsistent reasoning, especially when verifying technical, compositional claims against an evidence snippet under source and cost/latency constraints. We present a pipeline centered on atomic predicate-argument decomposition and calibrated, uncertainty-gated corroboration: atomic facts are aligned to local snippets via embeddings, verified by a compact evidence-grounded checker, and only facts with uncertain support trigger domain-restricted web search over authoritative sources. The system supports both binary and tri-valued classification where it predicts labels from Supported, Refuted, NEI for three-way tasks. We evaluate under two regimes, Context-Only (no web) and Context+Web (uncertainty-gated web corroboration); when retrieved evidence conflicts with the provided context, we abstain with NEI rather than overriding the context. On multiple benchmarks, our framework surpasses the strongest benchmarks. In our experiments, web corroboration was invoked for only a minority of atomic facts on average, indicating that external evidence is consulted selectively under calibrated uncertainty rather than routinely. Overall, coupling atomic granularity with calibrated, uncertainty-gated corroboration yields more interpretable and context-conditioned verification, making the approach well-suited to high-stakes, single-document settings that demand traceable rationales, predictable cost/latency, and conservative.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于原子谓词-论元分解和校准不确定性门控佐证的科学事实核查系统，通过原子事实分解、本地片段对齐、紧凑证据核查和不确定性触发的权威网络搜索，实现了更可靠、可解释且成本可控的科学事实验证。
AI.motivation: 现有科学事实核查系统在处理生物医学和材料科学等专业领域的复合性技术声明时，经常出现幻觉或推理不一致的问题，特别是在有来源和成本/延迟约束的情况下验证技术性复合声明时。需要一种既能保证准确性又能控制成本的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用原子谓词-论元分解将复杂声明分解为原子事实，通过嵌入对齐到本地证据片段，使用紧凑的证据基础核查器验证，仅对支持不确定的原子事实触发基于权威来源的领域限制网络搜索。系统支持二元和三值分类（支持、反驳、NEI），提供两种评估机制：仅上下文（无网络）和上下文+网络（不确定性门控网络佐证）。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，该框架超越了最强的基准系统。实验表明，网络佐证平均仅对少数原子事实触发，表明外部证据是在校准的不确定性下选择性地咨询而非常规使用。当检索到的证据与提供的上下文冲突时，系统选择NEI（无足够信息）而非覆盖上下文。
AI.conclusion: 将原子粒度分解与校准的不确定性门控佐证相结合，能够产生更可解释和上下文条件化的验证，特别适用于高风险、单文档设置，这些场景需要可追溯的推理依据、可预测的成本/延迟和保守的验证策略。

title: PEMANT: Persona-Enriched Multi-Agent Negotiation for Travel
summary: Modeling household-level trip generation is fundamental to accurate demand forecasting, traffic flow estimation, and urban system planning. Existing studies were mostly based on classical machine learning models with limited predictive capability, while recent LLM-based approaches have yet to incorporate behavioral theory or intra-household interaction dynamics, both of which are critical for modeling realistic collective travel decisions. To address these limitations, we propose a novel LLM-based framework, named Persona-Enriched Multi-Agent Negotiation for Travel (PEMANT), which first integrates behavioral theory for individualized persona modeling and then conducts household-level trip planning negotiations via a structured multi-agent conversation. Specifically, PEMANT transforms static sociodemographic attributes into coherent narrative profiles that explicitly encode household-level attitudes, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral controls, following our proposed Household-Aware Chain-of-Planned-Behavior (HA-CoPB) framework. Building on these theory-grounded personas, PEMANT captures real-world household decision negotiation via a structured two-phase multi-agent conversation framework with a novel persona-alignment control mechanism. Evaluated on both national and regional household travel survey datasets, PEMANT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks across datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出PEMANT框架，通过行为理论构建个性化角色模型，并采用结构化多智能体对话进行家庭层面出行规划协商，显著提升家庭出行生成预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要基于预测能力有限的经典机器学习模型，而最近的LLM方法尚未纳入行为理论或家庭内部互动动态，这两者对建模现实集体出行决策至关重要。
AI.method: 提出PEMANT框架：1) 通过HA-CoPB框架将静态社会人口属性转化为连贯的叙事档案，编码家庭层面的态度、主观规范和感知行为控制；2) 基于理论角色，通过结构化两阶段多智能体对话框架进行家庭决策协商，包含新颖的角色对齐控制机制。
AI.result: 在国家和区域家庭出行调查数据集上评估，PEMANT在多个数据集上始终优于最先进的基准方法。
AI.conclusion: PEMANT通过整合行为理论和多智能体协商机制，有效解决了现有方法在家庭出行生成建模中的局限性，为现实集体出行决策提供了更准确的预测框架。

title: Mining Attribute Subspaces for Efficient Fine-tuning of 3D Foundation Models
summary: With the emergence of 3D foundation models, there is growing interest in fine-tuning them for downstream tasks, where LoRA is the dominant fine-tuning paradigm. As 3D datasets exhibit distinct variations in texture, geometry, camera motion, and lighting, there are interesting fundamental questions: 1) Are there LoRA subspaces associated with each type of variation? 2) Are these subspaces disentangled (i.e., orthogonal to each other)? 3) How do we compute them effectively? This paper provides answers to all these questions. We introduce a robust approach that generates synthetic datasets with controlled variations, fine-tunes a LoRA adapter on each dataset, and extracts a LoRA sub-space associated with each type of variation. We show that these subspaces are approximately disentangled. Integrating them leads to a reduced LoRA subspace that enables efficient LoRA fine-tuning with improved prediction accuracy for downstream tasks. In particular, we show that such a reduced LoRA subspace, despite being derived entirely from synthetic data, generalizes to real datasets. An ablation study validates the effectiveness of the choices in our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从合成数据中提取解耦的LoRA子空间的方法，用于3D基础模型的高效微调，这些子空间能泛化到真实数据集并提升下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 随着3D基础模型的出现，需要对其进行下游任务微调，而LoRA是主要的微调范式。由于3D数据集在纹理、几何、相机运动和光照等方面存在显著变化，需要研究：1）是否存在与每种变化类型相关的LoRA子空间？2）这些子空间是否解耦（相互正交）？3）如何有效计算它们？
AI.method: 提出了一种稳健的方法：生成具有受控变化的合成数据集，在每个数据集上微调LoRA适配器，提取与每种变化类型相关的LoRA子空间。这些子空间近似解耦，整合它们可以得到一个缩减的LoRA子空间，用于高效微调。
AI.result: 研究表明这些子空间近似解耦，整合后的缩减LoRA子空间能提高下游任务的预测准确性。尽管完全从合成数据中推导，这种缩减的LoRA子空间能泛化到真实数据集。消融研究验证了方法中各项选择的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文回答了关于3D数据集变化与LoRA子空间关系的三个基本问题，提出了一种从合成数据中提取解耦LoRA子空间的有效方法，该方法能泛化到真实数据并提升微调效率与性能。

title: A Systematic Analysis of the Impact of Persona Steering on LLM Capabilities
summary: Imbuing Large Language Models (LLMs) with specific personas is prevalent for tailoring interaction styles, yet the impact on underlying cognitive capabilities remains unexplored. We employ the Neuron-based Personality Trait Induction (NPTI) framework to induce Big Five personality traits in LLMs and evaluate performance across six cognitive benchmarks. Our findings reveal that persona induction produces stable, reproducible shifts in cognitive task performance beyond surface-level stylistic changes. These effects exhibit strong task dependence: certain personalities yield consistent gains on instruction-following, while others impair complex reasoning. Effect magnitude varies systematically by trait dimension, with Openness and Extraversion exerting the most robust influence. Furthermore, LLM effects show 73.68% directional consistency with human personality-cognition relationships. Capitalizing on these regularities, we propose Dynamic Persona Routing (DPR), a lightweight query-adaptive strategy that outperforms the best static persona without additional training.

AI.tldr: 研究通过NPTI框架给LLMs注入人格特质，发现人格诱导不仅改变交互风格，还稳定影响认知能力表现，不同人格在不同任务上效果差异显著，且与人类人格-认知关系高度一致，据此提出动态人格路由策略。
AI.motivation: 当前为LLMs赋予特定人格主要关注交互风格定制，但人格对底层认知能力的影响尚未被探索。研究旨在系统评估人格诱导对LLM认知表现的影响，并探索其与人类认知模式的关联。
AI.method: 采用基于神经元的人格特质诱导（NPTI）框架，在LLMs中诱导大五人格特质，然后在六个认知基准测试中评估性能。进一步提出动态人格路由（DPR）策略，根据查询自适应选择最优人格。
AI.result: 人格诱导产生稳定可复现的认知任务表现变化，效果具有强任务依赖性：某些人格在指令遵循任务上表现提升，而其他人格损害复杂推理。开放性和外向性特质影响最显著。LLM效果与人类人格-认知关系有73.68%方向一致性。DPR策略无需额外训练即可超越最佳静态人格。
AI.conclusion: 人格诱导对LLM认知能力有实质性影响，这些影响模式与人类认知心理学发现高度一致。基于这些规律设计的动态人格路由策略能够优化LLM性能，为个性化AI系统设计提供了新思路。

title: Tracing the Roots: A Multi-Agent Framework for Uncovering Data Lineage in Post-Training LLMs
summary: Post-training data plays a pivotal role in shaping the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet datasets are often treated as isolated artifacts, overlooking the systemic connections that underlie their evolution. To disentangle these complex relationships, we introduce the concept of \textbf{data lineage} to the LLM ecosystem and propose an automated multi-agent framework to reconstruct the evolutionary graph of dataset development. Through large-scale lineage analysis, we characterize domain-specific structural patterns, such as vertical refinement in math-oriented datasets and horizontal aggregation in general-domain corpora. Moreover, we uncover pervasive systemic issues, including \textit{structural redundancy} induced by implicit dataset intersections and the \textit{propagation of benchmark contamination} along lineage paths. To demonstrate the practical value of lineage analysis for data construction, we leverage the reconstructed lineage graph to create a \textit{lineage-aware diversity-oriented dataset}. By anchoring instruction sampling at upstream root sources, this approach mitigates downstream homogenization and hidden redundancy, yielding a more diverse post-training corpus. We further highlight lineage-centric analysis as an efficient and robust topological alternative to sample-level dataset comparison for large-scale data ecosystems. By grounding data construction in explicit lineage structures, our work advances post-training data curation toward a more systematic and controllable paradigm.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了数据谱系概念和自动化多智能体框架，用于重建LLM后训练数据集的演化图，揭示了数据集间的结构模式和系统性问题，并展示了谱系分析在构建多样性数据集方面的实用价值。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM后训练数据集通常被当作孤立产物处理，忽视了数据集演化过程中的系统性联系，这限制了我们对数据生态系统整体结构的理解和对数据质量问题的识别。
AI.method: 引入数据谱系概念，提出自动化多智能体框架来重建数据集发展的演化图，通过大规模谱系分析识别结构模式，并利用谱系图构建谱系感知的多样性导向数据集。
AI.result: 揭示了特定领域的结构模式（如数学数据集的垂直细化和通用领域语料库的水平聚合），发现了普遍存在的系统性问题（结构冗余和基准污染传播），并展示了谱系感知数据集在缓解同质化和隐藏冗余方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 数据谱系分析为大规模数据生态系统提供了高效稳健的拓扑替代方案，将数据构建建立在明确的谱系结构基础上，推动了后训练数据管理向更系统化和可控的范式发展。

title: ABot-Claw: A Foundation for Persistent, Cooperative, and Self-Evolving Robotic Agents
summary: Current embodied intelligent systems still face a substantial gap between high-level reasoning and low-level physical execution in open-world environments. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide strong perception and intuitive responses, their open-loop nature limits long-horizon performance. Agents incorporating System 2 cognitive mechanisms improve planning, but usually operate in closed sandboxes with predefined toolkits and limited real-system control. OpenClaw provides a localized runtime with full system privileges, but lacks the embodied control architecture required for long-duration, multi-robot execution. We therefore propose ABot-Claw, an embodied extension of OpenClaw that integrates: 1) a unified embodiment interface with capability-driven scheduling for heterogeneous robot coordination; 2) a visual-centric cross-embodiment multimodal memory for persistent context retention and grounded retrieval; and 3) a critic-based closed-loop feedback mechanism with a generalist reward model for online progress evaluation, local correction, and replanning. With a decoupled architecture spanning the OpenClaw layer, shared service layer, and robot embodiment layer, ABot-Claw enables real-world interaction, closes the loop from natural language intent to physical action, and supports progressively self-evolving robotic agents in open, dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: ABot-Claw是一个具身智能系统，扩展了OpenClaw，通过统一接口、视觉记忆和闭环反馈机制，实现多机器人协调和开放环境中的长期执行。
AI.motivation: 当前具身智能系统存在高层推理与低层物理执行之间的鸿沟。VLA模型虽然感知能力强，但开环特性限制了长期性能；System 2认知机制通常只在封闭环境中工作；OpenClaw缺乏具身控制架构。需要解决多机器人协调、长期执行和开放环境适应性问题。
AI.method: 1) 统一具身接口与能力驱动调度，协调异构机器人；2) 视觉中心跨具身多模态记忆，保持持久上下文和接地检索；3) 基于批评者的闭环反馈机制，使用通用奖励模型进行在线评估、局部修正和重规划。采用解耦架构，包含OpenClaw层、共享服务层和机器人具身层。
AI.result: ABot-Claw实现了真实世界交互，从自然语言意图到物理动作的闭环，支持在开放动态环境中逐步自我演进的机器人代理。
AI.conclusion: ABot-Claw通过整合具身控制架构，解决了现有系统的局限性，实现了多机器人协调和长期执行，为开放动态环境中的具身智能提供了有效解决方案。

title: Shared Emotion Geometry Across Small Language Models: A Cross-Architecture Study of Representation, Behavior, and Methodological Confounds
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, 1 table in main text + appendix. Ongoing series on Model Medicine
summary: We extract 21-emotion vector sets from twelve small language models (six architectures x base/instruct, 1B-8B parameters) under a unified comprehension-mode pipeline at fp16 precision, and compare the resulting geometries via representational similarity analysis on raw cosine RDMs. The five mature architectures (Qwen 2.5 1.5B, SmolLM2 1.7B, Llama 3.2 3B, Mistral 7B v0.3, Llama 3.1 8B) share nearly identical 21-emotion geometry, with pairwise RDM Spearman correlations of 0.74-0.92. This universality persists across diametrically opposed behavioral profiles: Qwen 2.5 and Llama 3.2 occupy opposite poles of MTI Compliance facets yet produce nearly identical emotion RDMs (rho = 0.81), so behavioral facet differences arise above the shared emotion representation. Gemma-3 1B base, the one immature case in our dataset, exhibits extreme residual-stream anisotropy (0.997) and is restructured by RLHF across all geometric descriptors, whereas the five already-mature families show within-family base x instruct RDM correlations of rho >= 0.92 (Mistral 7B v0.3 at rho = 0.985), suggesting RLHF restructures only representations that are not yet organized. Methodologically, we show that what prior work has read as a single comprehension-vs-generation method effect in fact decomposes into four distinct layers -- a coarse method-dependent dissociation, robust sub-parameter sensitivity within generation, a true precision (fp16 vs INT8) effect, and a conflated cross-experiment bias that distorts in opposite directions for different models -- so that a single rho between two prior emotion-vector studies is not a safe basis for interpretation without the layered decomposition.

AI.tldr: 研究从12个小语言模型中提取21维情感向量，发现成熟架构的情感几何结构高度一致，而行为差异源于共享情感表征之上的处理层。RLHF主要重组未成熟模型的情感表征，对已成熟模型影响有限。
AI.motivation: 探究不同小语言模型在情感表征几何结构上的一致性，以及RLHF对齐训练对情感表征的影响，同时澄清先前研究中方法效应的混淆因素。
AI.method: 使用统一的理解模式流水线在fp16精度下从12个小语言模型（6种架构×基础/指令版本，1B-8B参数）提取21维情感向量集，通过原始余弦RDM进行表征相似性分析，比较情感几何结构。
AI.result: 五个成熟架构（Qwen 2.5 1.5B, SmolLM2 1.7B, Llama 3.2 3B, Mistral 7B v0.3, Llama 3.1 8B）具有几乎相同的21维情感几何结构，RDM Spearman相关系数在0.74-0.92之间。这种普遍性存在于行为特征完全相反的模型中。Gemma-3 1B基础版作为未成熟案例，表现出极端残差流各向异性（0.997），RLHF重组了其所有几何描述符。成熟家族的基座版与指令版RDM相关系数≥0.92，表明RLHF主要重组尚未组织的表征。
AI.conclusion: 成熟语言模型共享基本的情感表征几何结构，行为差异源于共享表征之上的处理层。RLHF主要影响未成熟模型的情感表征组织。先前研究中的单一方法效应实际上包含四个不同层次：粗粒度方法依赖解离、生成模式内的子参数敏感性、真实精度效应和混淆的跨实验偏差，需要分层分解才能正确解释。

title: CHAIRO: Contextual Hierarchical Analogical Induction and Reasoning Optimization for LLMs
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 main conference; under official publication process
summary:
Content moderation in online platforms faces persistent challenges due to the evolving complexity of user-generated content and the limitations of traditional rule-based and machine learning approaches. While recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled more sophisticated moderation via direct prompting or fine-tuning, these approaches often exhibit limited generalization, interpretability, and adaptability to unseen or ambiguous cases.
  In this work, we propose a novel moderation framework that leverages analogical examples to enhance rule induction and decision reliability. Our approach integrates end-to-end optimization of analogical retrieval, rule generation, and moderation classification, enabling the dynamic adaptation of moderation rules to diverse content scenarios. Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms both rule-injected fine-tuning baselines and multi-stage static RAG pipelines in terms of moderation accuracy and rule quality. Further evaluations, including human assessments and external model generalization tests, confirm that our framework produces rules with better clarity, interpretability, and applicability. These findings show that analogical example-driven methods can advance robust, explainable, and generalizable content moderation in real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出基于类比示例的内容审核框架，通过端到端优化类比检索、规则生成和分类决策，显著提升审核准确性和规则质量
AI.motivation: 在线平台内容审核面临用户生成内容复杂性增加和传统方法局限性的挑战。现有基于大语言模型的直接提示或微调方法在泛化性、可解释性和适应性方面存在不足，难以处理未见或模糊案例。
AI.method: 提出新颖的审核框架，利用类比示例增强规则归纳和决策可靠性。该方法集成端到端优化：1）类比检索，2）规则生成，3）审核分类，实现规则对不同内容场景的动态适应。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在审核准确性和规则质量方面显著优于规则注入微调基线和多阶段静态RAG流程。人类评估和外部模型泛化测试证实，该框架生成的规则具有更好的清晰度、可解释性和适用性。
AI.conclusion: 类比示例驱动的方法能够推进现实应用中稳健、可解释且可泛化的内容审核，为在线平台内容管理提供更有效的解决方案。

title: Degradation-Consistent Paired Training for Robust AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors suffer significant performance degradation under real-world image corruptions such as JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and resolution downsampling. We observe that state-of-the-art methods, including B-Free, treat degradation robustness as a byproduct of data augmentation rather than an explicit training objective. In this work, we propose Degradation-Consistent Paired Training (DCPT), a simple yet effective training strategy that explicitly enforces robustness through paired consistency constraints. For each training image, we construct a clean view and a degraded view, then impose two constraints: a feature consistency loss that minimizes the cosine distance between clean and degraded representations, and a prediction consistency loss based on symmetric KL divergence that aligns output distributions across views. DCPT adds zero additional parameters and zero inference overhead. Experiments on the Synthbuster benchmark (9 generators, 8 degradation conditions) demonstrate that DCPT improves the degraded-condition average accuracy by 9.1 percentage points compared to an identical baseline without paired training, while sacrificing only 0.9% clean accuracy. The improvement is most pronounced under JPEG compression (+15.7% to +17.9%). Ablation further reveals that adding architectural components leads to overfitting on limited training data, confirming that training objective improvement is more effective than architectural augmentation for degradation robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出DCPT训练策略，通过配对一致性约束显式增强AI生成图像检测器在图像退化条件下的鲁棒性，无需额外参数和推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器在真实世界图像退化（如JPEG压缩、高斯模糊、分辨率下采样）下性能显著下降。当前方法将退化鲁棒性视为数据增强的副产品而非明确的训练目标。
AI.method: 提出退化一致性配对训练（DCPT）：为每个训练图像构建干净视图和退化视图，施加两个约束：1）特征一致性损失（最小化干净和退化表示间的余弦距离）；2）基于对称KL散度的预测一致性损失（对齐跨视图的输出分布）。
AI.result: 在Synthbuster基准测试（9个生成器，8种退化条件）上，DCPT将退化条件下的平均准确率提升9.1个百分点，仅牺牲0.9%的干净准确率。JPEG压缩下提升最显著（+15.7%至+17.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 训练目标改进比架构增强对退化鲁棒性更有效。DCPT无需额外参数和推理开销，通过显式的配对一致性约束显著提升检测器在退化条件下的鲁棒性。

title: ks-pret-5m: a 5 million word, 12 million token kashmiri pretraining dataset
summary: We present KS-PRET-5M, the largest publicly available pretraining dataset for the Kashmiri language, comprising 5,090,244 (5.09M) words, 27,692,959 (27.6M) characters, and a vocabulary of 295,433 (295.4K) unique word types. We assembled the dataset from two source classes: digitized archival and literary material, encompassing literature, news, biographies, novels, poetry, religious scholarship, and academic writing, recovered from the proprietary InPage desktop-publishing format using the converter of Malik~\cite{malik2024inpage}, and Unicode-native text collected from Kashmiri-language web sources. All text was processed through an eleven-stage cleaning pipeline that achieves a mean Kashmiri script ratio of 0.9965, reducing Devanagari contamination to 146 characters across the full dataset. We tokenized the dataset empirically using google/muril-base-cased, yielding a subword ratio of 2.383 tokens per word and a total of approximately 12.13 million subword tokens, substantially higher than prior estimates derived from non-Kashmiri Perso-Arabic analogues. KS-PRET-5M is released as a single continuous text stream under CC~BY~4.0 to support language model pretraining, tokenizer training, and computational linguistic research for Kashmiri.

AI.tldr: KS-PRET-5M是最大的克什米尔语公开预训练数据集，包含509万单词、2769万字符和29.5万独特词型，支持语言模型预训练和计算语言学研究。
AI.motivation: 克什米尔语缺乏大规模的公开预训练数据集，现有资源有限且存在脚本污染问题，阻碍了该语言的计算语言学研究和发展。
AI.method: 从两类来源收集数据：1) 使用Malik转换器从InPage桌面出版格式恢复的数字化档案和文学材料；2) 从克什米尔语网络源收集的Unicode原生文本。所有文本经过11阶段清洗流程，确保克什米尔脚本比例达到0.9965。
AI.result: 创建了包含509万单词、2769万字符、29.5万独特词型的数据集，天城体污染减少到仅146个字符。使用google/muril-base-cased分词后，每个单词平均2.383个子词，总计约1213万子词标记。
AI.conclusion: KS-PRET-5M是最大的克什米尔语公开预训练数据集，以CC BY 4.0许可发布，支持语言模型预训练、分词器训练和计算语言学研究，填补了该语言资源空白。

title: CARO: Chain-of-Analogy Reasoning Optimization for Robust Content Moderation
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 findings; under official publication process
summary: Current large language models (LLMs), even those explicitly trained for reasoning, often struggle with ambiguous content moderation cases due to misleading "decision shortcuts" embedded in context. Inspired by cognitive psychology insights into expert moderation, we introduce \caro (Chain-of-Analogy Reasoning Optimization), a novel two-stage training framework to induce robust analogical reasoning in LLMs. First, \caro bootstraps analogical reasoning chains via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on moderation data and performs supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Second, we propose a customized direct preference optimization (DPO) approach to reinforce analogical reasoning behaviors explicitly. Unlike static retrieval methods, \caro dynamically generates tailored analogical references during inference, effectively mitigating harmful decision shortcuts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \caro substantially outperforms state-of-the-art reasoning models (DeepSeek R1, QwQ), specialized moderation models (LLaMA Guard), and advanced fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented methods, achieving an average F1 score improvement of 24.9\% on challenging ambiguous moderation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CARO是一个两阶段训练框架，通过类比推理优化来解决LLMs在内容审核中的模糊案例问题，显著提升性能
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型即使在专门训练推理能力后，仍难以处理模糊的内容审核案例，因为存在误导性的"决策捷径"
AI.method: 提出CARO两阶段框架：1) 通过检索增强生成引导类比推理链并进行监督微调；2) 定制直接偏好优化方法强化类比推理行为
AI.result: CARO显著优于最先进的推理模型、专业审核模型和先进微调方法，在模糊审核基准上平均F1分数提升24.9%
AI.conclusion: CARO通过动态生成定制化类比参考，有效缓解有害决策捷径，为LLMs在复杂内容审核任务中提供了强大的类比推理能力

title: Long-Horizon Streaming Video Generation via Hybrid Attention with Decoupled Distillation
summary: Streaming video generation (SVG) distills a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model into an autoregressive model equipped with sliding window attention (SWA). However, SWA inevitably loses distant history during long video generation, and its computational overhead remains a critical challenge to real-time deployment. In this work, we propose Hybrid Forcing, which jointly optimizes temporal information retention and computational efficiency through a hybrid attention design. First, we introduce lightweight linear temporal attention to preserve long-range dependencies beyond the sliding window. In particular, we maintain a compact key-value state to incrementally absorb evicted tokens, retaining temporal context with negligible memory and computational overhead. Second, we incorporate block-sparse attention into the local sliding window to reduce redundant computation within short-range modeling, reallocating computational capacity toward more critical dependencies. Finally, we introduce a decoupled distillation strategy tailored to the hybrid attention design. A few-step initial distillation is performed under dense attention, then the distillation of our proposed linear temporal and block-sparse attention is activated for streaming modeling, ensuring stable optimization. Extensive experiments on both short- and long-form video generation benchmarks demonstrate that Hybrid Forcing consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, our model achieves real-time, unbounded 832x480 video generation at 29.5 FPS on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU without quantization or model compression. The source code and trained models are available at https://github.com/leeruibin/hybrid-forcing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Hybrid Forcing方法，通过混合注意力设计解决流式视频生成中滑动窗口注意力丢失历史信息和计算开销大的问题，实现了实时、无限制的长视频生成。
AI.motivation: 当前流式视频生成方法使用滑动窗口注意力，但在生成长视频时会不可避免地丢失远距离历史信息，同时其计算开销对实时部署构成关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出混合注意力设计：1) 引入轻量级线性时间注意力来保留滑动窗口之外的长距离依赖关系；2) 在局部滑动窗口内加入块稀疏注意力以减少短距离建模中的冗余计算；3) 提出解耦蒸馏策略，先进行密集注意力下的初步蒸馏，再激活线性时间和块稀疏注意力的蒸馏。
AI.result: 在短格式和长格式视频生成基准测试中均达到最先进性能，在单块NVIDIA H100 GPU上实现了29.5 FPS的实时、无限制832x480视频生成，无需量化或模型压缩。
AI.conclusion: Hybrid Forcing通过混合注意力设计有效解决了流式视频生成中的历史信息保留和计算效率问题，实现了高质量、实时的长视频生成。

title: Cooperation in Human and Machine Agents: Promise Theory Considerations
summary: Agent based systems are more common than we may think. A Promise Theory perspective on cooperation, in systems of human-machine agents, offers a unified perspective on organization and functional design with semi-automated efforts, in terms of the abstract properties of autonomous agents, This applies to human efforts, hardware systems, software, and artificial intelligence, with and without management. One may ask how does a reasoning system of components keep to an intended purpose? As the agent paradigm is now being revived, in connection with artificial intelligence agents, I revisit established principles of agent cooperation, as applied to humans, machines, and their mutual interactions. Promise Theory represents the fundamentals of signalling, comprehension, trust, risk, and feedback between agents, and offers some lessons about success and failure.

AI.tldr: 从承诺理论视角分析人机代理系统中的合作，为组织设计和功能实现提供统一框架
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能代理的复兴，需要重新审视人机代理系统中的合作原则，理解如何让由组件构成的推理系统保持其预期目的
AI.method: 采用承诺理论作为分析框架，研究自主代理之间的信号传递、理解、信任、风险和反馈等基本机制
AI.result: 承诺理论为人类、机器及其相互交互中的合作提供了统一视角，揭示了成功与失败的经验教训
AI.conclusion: 承诺理论为理解和管理人机代理系统中的合作提供了理论基础，适用于人类努力、硬件系统、软件和人工智能等各种场景

title: BITS Pilani at SemEval-2026 Task 9: Structured Supervised Fine-Tuning with DPO Refinement for Polarization Detection
summary:
The POLAR SemEval-2026 Shared Task aims to detect online polarization and focuses on the classification and identification of multilingual, multicultural, and multi-event polarization.
  Accurate computational detection of online polarization is challenging due to nuanced rhetoric, implicit framing, and the high cost of human-in-the-loop annotation. Building on recent findings that contextual prompting enables large language models to function as strong polarization detectors, we present a two-stage approach for detecting political polarization in social media text that combines structured supervised fine-tuning with Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) refinement.
  We fine-tune Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct with LoRA using an interpretable slot-filling template (target, claim type, manifestation checklist, and justification). We then apply DPO with automatically generated preference pairs to reduce costly false negatives. Experiments on the SemEval 2026 POLAR shared task dataset show that preference-based refinement improves both accuracy and decreases false negatives without extra annotation. On the English development set, DPO increases recall from 0.5085 to 0.7797 and improves macro-F1 by ~5 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段方法，结合结构化监督微调和DPO优化，用于检测社交媒体文本中的政治极化，在SemEval 2026 POLAR共享任务数据集上显著提升了召回率和F1分数。
AI.motivation: 在线极化检测面临挑战：修辞微妙、框架隐含、人工标注成本高。基于大语言模型作为极化检测器的研究发现，需要更有效的自动化方法来提高检测准确性。
AI.method: 采用两阶段方法：1) 使用可解释的槽填充模板（目标、主张类型、表现清单、理由）对Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct进行LoRA微调；2) 应用直接偏好优化（DPO）与自动生成的偏好对，以减少代价高昂的假阴性。
AI.result: 在SemEval 2026 POLAR共享任务数据集上，基于偏好的优化提高了准确性并减少了假阴性。在英文开发集上，DPO将召回率从0.5085提升到0.7797，宏F1提高了约5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: DPO优化能够有效提升极化检测模型的性能，特别是在减少假阴性方面，且无需额外的人工标注成本，为在线极化检测提供了一种高效的技术方案。

title: A Progressive Training Strategy for Vision-Language Models to Counteract Spatio-Temporal Hallucinations in Embodied Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made significant strides in static image understanding but continue to face critical hurdles in spatiotemporal reasoning. A major bottleneck is "multi-image reasoning hallucination", where a massive performance drop between forward and reverse temporal queries reveals a dependence on superficial shortcuts instead of genuine causal understanding. To mitigate this, we first develop a new Chain-of-Thought (CoT) dataset that decomposes intricate reasoning into detailed spatiotemporal steps and definitive judgments. Building on this, we present a progressive training framework: it initiates with supervised pre-training on our CoT dataset to instill logical structures, followed by fine-tuning with scalable weakly-labeled data for broader generalization. Our experiments demonstrate that this approach not only improves backbone accuracy but also slashes the forward-backward performance gap from over 70\% to only 6.53\%. This confirms the method's ability to develop authentic dynamic reasoning and reduce the inherent temporal biases of current VLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种渐进式训练框架，通过思维链数据集和弱监督数据减少视觉语言模型在时空推理中的幻觉问题，将前向-后向性能差距从70%降至6.53%
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在静态图像理解方面取得显著进展，但在时空推理方面仍面临关键障碍。主要瓶颈是"多图像推理幻觉"，即前向和后向时间查询之间的巨大性能差距表明模型依赖表面捷径而非真正的因果理解
AI.method: 1. 开发新的思维链数据集，将复杂推理分解为详细的时空步骤和确定性判断；2. 提出渐进式训练框架：首先在思维链数据集上进行监督预训练以建立逻辑结构，然后使用可扩展的弱标记数据进行微调以实现更广泛的泛化
AI.result: 该方法不仅提高了骨干模型的准确性，还将前向-后向性能差距从超过70%大幅降低到仅6.53%。这证实了该方法能够发展真实的动态推理能力，并减少当前视觉语言模型固有的时间偏差
AI.conclusion: 通过思维链分解和渐进式训练，可以有效缓解视觉语言模型在时空推理中的幻觉问题，提升其因果理解能力和动态推理性能

title: Dual-Branch Remote Sensing Infrared Image Super-Resolution
summary: Remote sensing infrared image super-resolution aims to recover sharper thermal observations from low-resolution inputs while preserving target contours, scene layout, and radiometric stability. Unlike visible-image super-resolution, thermal imagery is weakly textured and more sensitive to unstable local sharpening, which makes complementary local and global modeling especially important. This paper presents our solution to the NTIRE 2026 Infrared Image Super-Resolution Challenge, a dual-branch system that combines a HAT-L branch and a MambaIRv2-L branch. The inference pipeline applies test-time local conversion on HAT, eight-way self-ensemble on MambaIRv2, and fixed equal-weight image-space fusion. We report both the official challenge score and a reproducible evaluation on 12 synthetic times-four thermal samples derived from Caltech Aerial RGB-Thermal, on which the fused output outperforms either single branch in PSNR, SSIM, and the overall Score. The results suggest that infrared super-resolution benefits from explicit complementarity between locally strong transformer restoration and globally stable state-space modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于NTIRE 2026红外图像超分辨率挑战的双分支系统，结合HAT-L和MambaIRv2-L分支，通过测试时局部转换、八路自集成和固定等权重融合，在红外图像超分辨率任务中取得了优异性能。
AI.motivation: 红外遥感图像超分辨率需要从低分辨率输入恢复更清晰的热观测，同时保持目标轮廓、场景布局和辐射稳定性。与可见光图像相比，热图像纹理较弱，对局部锐化更敏感，因此需要互补的局部和全局建模。
AI.method: 提出双分支系统：HAT-L分支（局部强变换器恢复）和MambaIRv2-L分支（全局稳定状态空间建模）。推理流程包括：对HAT进行测试时局部转换，对MambaIRv2进行八路自集成，最后进行固定等权重的图像空间融合。
AI.result: 在NTIRE 2026挑战赛官方评分和12个合成四倍热样本（来自Caltech Aerial RGB-Thermal）的可复现评估中，融合输出在PSNR、SSIM和总体评分上均优于任一单分支。结果表明红外超分辨率受益于局部强变换器恢复和全局稳定状态空间建模的显式互补性。
AI.conclusion: 红外图像超分辨率通过结合局部强变换器恢复（HAT-L）和全局稳定状态空间建模（MambaIRv2-L）的双分支系统，实现了更好的性能，证明了互补的局部和全局建模对热图像超分辨率的重要性。

title: DeCoVec: Building Decoding Space based Task Vector for Large Language Models via In-Context Learning
summary: Task vectors, representing directions in model or activation spaces that encode task-specific behaviors, have emerged as a promising tool for steering large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches typically require fine-tuning or invasive manipulation of internal states, limiting their flexibility and scalability. We propose \textsc{DeCoVec} (Decoding Space based Task Vector), a training-free and non-invasive framework that constructs task vectors directly in the \textit{decoding space} by leveraging in-context learning (ICL). Specifically, \textsc{DeCoVec} captures the task essence as the difference between the output logit distributions of few-shot and zero-shot prompts, then steers generation by injecting this vector into the decoding process. Experiments across seven LLMs (0.5B--9B) on TruthfulQA, Math-500, and AQUA-RAT show that \textsc{DeCoVec} consistently outperforms standard few-shot baselines, with gains up to +5.50 average accuracy. Further analysis demonstrates that \textsc{DeCoVec} effectively suppresses generation degeneration and logical flaws while exhibiting strong robustness to demonstration ordering, all without incurring additional input token costs. Our method offers a training-free and non-invasive solution for LLM steering without requiring weight updates or auxiliary models.

AI.tldr: DeCoVec提出了一种无需训练、非侵入式的任务向量构建方法，直接在解码空间中通过上下文学习创建任务向量，用于引导大语言模型的生成，在多个任务上显著优于标准少样本基线。
AI.motivation: 现有任务向量方法通常需要微调或侵入式地操纵内部状态，限制了灵活性和可扩展性。需要一种无需训练、非侵入式的解决方案来引导大语言模型。
AI.method: DeCoVec直接在解码空间中构建任务向量，通过计算少样本提示和零样本提示的输出logit分布差异来捕获任务本质，然后将该向量注入解码过程以引导生成。
AI.result: 在7个LLM（0.5B-9B）上对TruthfulQA、Math-500和AQUA-RAT的实验表明，DeCoVec始终优于标准少样本基线，平均准确率提升高达+5.50。能有效抑制生成退化和逻辑缺陷，对演示顺序具有强鲁棒性，且不增加额外输入token成本。
AI.conclusion: DeCoVec提供了一种无需训练、非侵入式的LLM引导解决方案，无需权重更新或辅助模型，在解码空间中直接操作任务向量，具有实用性和可扩展性优势。

title: A Dual Cross-Attention Graph Learning Framework For Multimodal MRI-Based Major Depressive Disorder Detection
summary: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a prevalent mental disorder associated with complex neurobiological changes that cannot be fully captured using a single imaging modality. The use of multimodal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides a more comprehensive understanding of brain changes by combining structural and functional data. Despite this, the effective integration of these modalities remains challenging. In this study, we propose a dual cross-attention-based multimodal fusion framework that explicitly models bidirectional interactions between structural MRI (sMRI) and resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) representations. The proposed approach is tested on the large-scale REST-meta-MDD dataset using both structural and functional brain atlas configurations. Numerous experiments conducted under a 10-fold stratified cross-validation demonstrated that the proposed fusion algorithm achieves robust and competitive performance across all atlas types. The proposed method consistently outperforms conventional feature-level concatenation for functional atlases, while maintaining comparable performance for structural atlases. The most effective dual cross-attention multimodal model obtained 84.71% accuracy, 86.42% sensitivity, 82.89% specificity, 84.34% precision, and 85.37% F1-score. These findings emphasize the importance of explicitly modeling cross-modal interactions for multimodal neuroimaging-based MDD classification.

AI.tldr: 提出基于双交叉注意力的多模态融合框架，用于整合结构MRI和功能MRI数据，在抑郁症分类任务中取得优于传统特征拼接方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 抑郁症是一种复杂的神经精神疾病，单一成像模态无法全面捕捉其神经生物学变化。多模态MRI结合结构和功能数据能提供更全面的理解，但有效整合这些模态仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出双交叉注意力多模态融合框架，显式建模结构MRI和静息态功能MRI表示之间的双向交互。在REST-meta-MDD数据集上测试，使用结构和功能脑图谱配置，采用10折分层交叉验证。
AI.result: 该方法在所有图谱类型上都表现出稳健且有竞争力的性能。对于功能图谱，始终优于传统的特征级拼接方法；对于结构图谱，保持相当的性能。最佳模型达到84.71%准确率、86.42%灵敏度、82.89%特异性、84.34%精确度和85.37% F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了显式建模跨模态交互对于基于多模态神经影像的抑郁症分类的重要性，提出的双交叉注意力框架能有效整合结构和功能MRI信息。

title: Thinking Fast, Thinking Wrong: Intuitiveness Modulates LLM Counterfactual Reasoning in Policy Evaluation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for causal and counterfactual reasoning, yet their reliability in real-world policy evaluation remains underexplored. We construct a benchmark of 40 empirical policy evaluation cases drawn from economics and social science, each grounded in peer-reviewed evidence and classified by intuitiveness -- whether the empirical finding aligns with (obvious), is unclear relative to (ambiguous), or contradicts (counter-intuitive) common prior expectations. We evaluate four frontier LLMs across five prompting strategies with 2,400 experimental trials and analyze the results using mixed-effects logistic regression. Our findings reveal three key results: (1) a chain-of-thought (CoT) paradox, where chain-of-thought prompting dramatically improves performance on obvious cases but this benefit is nearly eliminated on counter-intuitive ones (interaction OR = 0.053, $p < 0.001$); (2) intuitiveness as the dominant factor, explaining more variance than model choice or prompting strategy (ICC = 0.537); and (3) a knowledge-reasoning dissociation, where citation-based familiarity is unrelated to accuracy ($p = 0.53$), suggesting models possess relevant knowledge but fail to reason with it when findings contradict intuition. We frame these results through the lens of dual-process theory (System 1 vs. System 2) and argue that current LLMs' "slow thinking" may be little more than "slow talking" -- they produce the form of deliberative reasoning without the substance.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在政策评估中存在直觉偏见：思维链提示对明显案例有效，但对反直觉案例几乎无效，表明模型推理能力有限。
AI.motivation: 虽然大型语言模型越来越多地用于因果和反事实推理，但它们在现实世界政策评估中的可靠性尚未得到充分探索。研究者希望了解LLMs在面对不同直觉程度的实证研究时，其推理能力的真实表现。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含40个经济学和社会科学实证政策评估案例的基准，每个案例都基于同行评审证据，并按直觉程度分类（明显、模糊、反直觉）。评估了四种前沿LLM在五种提示策略下的表现，进行了2400次实验，并使用混合效应逻辑回归分析结果。
AI.result: 发现三个关键结果：1）思维链悖论：思维链提示对明显案例显著提升性能，但对反直觉案例几乎无效；2）直觉性是主导因素，解释的方差比模型选择或提示策略更多；3）知识与推理分离：基于引用的熟悉度与准确性无关，表明模型拥有相关知识但无法在发现与直觉矛盾时进行推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过双过程理论（系统1 vs 系统2）的视角解释结果，认为当前LLMs的"慢思考"可能只是"慢说话"——它们产生了深思熟虑推理的形式，但没有实质内容。

title: PhyMix: Towards Physically Consistent Single-Image 3D Indoor Scene Generation with Implicit--Explicit Optimization
summary: Existing single-image 3D indoor scene generators often produce results that look visually plausible but fail to obey real-world physics, limiting their reliability in robotics, embodied AI, and design. To examine this gap, we introduce a unified Physics Evaluator that measures four main aspects: geometric priors, contact, stability, and deployability, which are further decomposed into nine sub-constraints, establishing the first benchmark to measure physical consistency. Based on this evaluator, our analysis shows that state-of-the-art methods remain largely physics-unaware. To overcome this limitation, we further propose a framework that integrates feedback from the Physics Evaluator into both training and inference, enhancing the physical plausibility of generated scenes. Specifically, we propose PhyMix, which is composed of two complementary components: (i) implicit alignment via Scene-GRPO, a critic-free group-relative policy optimization that leverages the Physics Evaluator as a preference signal and biases sampling towards physically feasible layouts, and (ii) explicit refinement via a plug-and-play Test-Time Optimizer (TTO) that uses differentiable evaluator signals to correct residual violations during generation. Overall, our method unifies evaluation, reward shaping, and inference-time correction, producing 3D indoor scenes that are visually faithful and physically plausible. Extensive synthetic evaluations confirm state-of-the-art performance in both visual fidelity and physical plausibility, and extensive qualitative examples in stylized and real-world images further showcase the robustness of the method. We will release codes and models upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出统一物理评估器衡量3D室内场景生成的物理一致性，并基于此开发PhyMix框架，通过隐式对齐和显式优化提升生成场景的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像3D室内场景生成器虽然视觉上合理，但不符合真实世界物理规律，限制了在机器人、具身AI和设计领域的可靠性应用。
AI.method: 提出统一物理评估器衡量几何先验、接触、稳定性和可部署性四个主要方面；开发PhyMix框架，包含Scene-GRPO隐式对齐和测试时优化器显式修正。
AI.result: 合成评估显示在视觉保真度和物理合理性方面达到最先进性能；在风格化和真实图像上的定性示例展示了方法的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法统一了评估、奖励塑造和推理时修正，能够生成视觉逼真且物理合理的3D室内场景，解决了现有方法物理意识不足的问题。

title: SHARE: Social-Humanities AI for Research and Education
summary: This intermediate technical report introduces the SHARE family of base models and the MIRROR user interface. The SHARE models are the first causal language models fully pretrained by and for the social sciences and humanities (SSH). Their performance in modelling SSH texts is close to that of general purpose models (Phi-4) which use 100 times more tokens, as shown by our custom SSH Cloze benchmark. The MIRROR user interface is designed for reviewing text inputs from the SSH disciplines while preserving critical engagement. By prototyping a generative AI interface that does not generate any text, we propose a way to harness the capabilities of the SHARE models without compromising the integrity of SSH principles and norms.

AI.tldr: SHARE模型是首个专为社会科学与人文科学（SSH）预训练的因果语言模型，性能接近使用100倍数据量的通用模型；MIRROR界面通过不生成文本的设计，让SSH学者能批判性使用AI能力
AI.motivation: 为社会科学与人文科学（SSH）领域开发专门的AI模型和界面，解决通用AI模型在SSH文本处理中的局限性，同时保持SSH学科的批判性参与原则
AI.method: 开发SHARE系列基础模型（专为SSH预训练的因果语言模型）和MIRROR用户界面（不生成文本的生成式AI界面，专注于文本审查和批判性参与）
AI.result: SHARE模型在SSH文本建模性能上接近使用100倍数据量的通用模型（如Phi-4），通过自定义的SSH Cloze基准测试验证；MIRROR界面实现了不生成文本的生成式AI设计
AI.conclusion: SHARE模型和MIRROR界面为SSH领域提供了专门的AI解决方案，既能利用AI能力又不会损害SSH原则和规范，通过创新的界面设计实现了批判性参与

title: Agent Mentor: Framing Agent Knowledge through Semantic Trajectory Analysis
summary:
AI agent development relies heavily on natural language prompting to define agents' tasks, knowledge, and goals. These prompts are interpreted by Large Language Models (LLMs), which govern agent behavior. Consequently, agentic performance is susceptible to variability arising from imprecise or ambiguous prompt formulations. Identifying and correcting such issues requires examining not only the agent's code, but also the internal system prompts generated throughout its execution lifecycle, as reflected in execution logs.
  In this work, we introduce an analytics pipeline implemented as part of the Agent Mentor open-source library that monitors and incrementally adapts the system prompts defining another agent's behavior. The pipeline improves performance by systematically injecting corrective instructions into the agent's knowledge. We describe its underlying mechanism, with particular emphasis on identifying semantic features associated with undesired behaviors and using them to derive corrective statements.
  We evaluate the proposed pipeline across three exemplar agent configurations and benchmark tasks using repeated execution runs to assess effectiveness. These experiments provide an initial exploration of automating such a mentoring pipeline within future agentic governance frameworks. Overall, the approach demonstrates consistent and measurable accuracy improvements across diverse configurations, particularly in settings dominated by specification ambiguity. For reproducibility, we released our code as open source under the Agent Mentor library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Agent Mentor开源库的分析管道，通过监控和自适应调整AI代理的系统提示来提升性能，特别针对提示模糊性导致的性能波动问题。
AI.motivation: AI代理开发严重依赖自然语言提示来定义任务、知识和目标，这些提示由大语言模型解释并控制代理行为。然而，代理性能容易因不精确或模糊的提示表述而产生波动。识别和纠正这些问题需要检查代理代码以及执行生命周期中生成的内部系统提示。
AI.method: 在Agent Mentor开源库中实现了一个分析管道，监控并逐步调整定义其他代理行为的系统提示。该管道通过系统性地向代理知识中注入纠正指令来改进性能，重点在于识别与不良行为相关的语义特征，并利用这些特征推导纠正语句。
AI.result: 在三个示例代理配置和基准任务上通过重复执行运行评估了该管道。实验表明，该方法在不同配置下都实现了持续且可测量的准确性改进，特别是在规范模糊性主导的场景中表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为未来代理治理框架中自动化指导管道提供了初步探索，展示了通过监控和自适应调整系统提示来提升AI代理性能的有效途径。代码已作为Agent Mentor库开源发布以确保可复现性。

title: VGA-Bench: A Unified Benchmark and Multi-Model Framework for Video Aesthetics and Generation Quality Evaluation
summary: The rapid advancement of AIGC-based video generation has underscored the critical need for comprehensive evaluation frameworks that go beyond traditional generation quality metrics to encompass aesthetic appeal. However, existing benchmarks remain largely focused on technical fidelity, leaving a significant gap in holistic assessment-particularly with respect to perceptual and artistic qualities. To address this limitation, we introduce VGA-Bench, a unified benchmark for joint evaluation of video generation quality and aesthetic quality. VGA-Bench is built upon a principled three-tier taxonomy: Aesthetic Quality, Aesthetic Tagging, and Generation Quality, each decomposed into multiple fine-grained sub-dimensions to enable systematic assessment. Guided by this taxonomy, we design 1,016 diverse prompts and generate a large-scale dataset of over 60,000 videos using 12 video generation models, ensuring broad coverage across content, style, and artifacts. To enable scalable and automated evaluation, we annotate a subset of the dataset via human labeling and develop three dedicated multi-task neural assessors: VAQA-Net for aesthetic quality prediction, VTag-Net for automatic aesthetic tagging, and VGQA-Net for generation and basic quality attributes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our models achieve reliable alignment with human judgments, offering both accuracy and efficiency. We release VGA-Bench as a public benchmark to foster research in AIGC evaluation, with applications in content moderation, model debugging, and generative model optimization.

AI.tldr: VGA-Bench是一个统一的视频生成质量与美学质量联合评估基准，通过三层分类体系（美学质量、美学标签、生成质量）和多任务神经网络评估器实现自动化评估。
AI.motivation: 当前AIGC视频生成技术快速发展，但现有评估基准主要关注技术保真度，缺乏对感知和艺术品质的全面评估，存在评估体系不完整的问题。
AI.method: 1. 建立三层分类体系：美学质量、美学标签、生成质量，每个维度细分为多个子维度；2. 设计1016个多样化提示词，使用12个视频生成模型生成超过6万个视频；3. 通过人工标注子集，开发三个多任务神经网络评估器：VAQA-Net（美学质量预测）、VTag-Net（自动美学标签）、VGQA-Net（生成和基础质量属性）。
AI.result: 实验表明，开发的评估模型与人类判断具有可靠的一致性，在准确性和效率方面表现良好。VGA-Bench作为公开基准发布，支持AIGC评估研究。
AI.conclusion: VGA-Bench填补了视频生成评估中美学质量评估的空白，提供了一个系统化的联合评估框架，可用于内容审核、模型调试和生成模型优化等应用。

title: Evaluating Memory Capability in Continuous Lifelog Scenario
summary: Nowadays, wearable devices can continuously lifelog ambient conversations, creating substantial opportunities for memory systems. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on online one-on-one chatting or human-AI interactions, thus neglecting the unique demands of real-world scenarios. Given the scarcity of public lifelogging audio datasets, we propose a hierarchical synthesis framework to curate \textbf{\textsc{LifeDialBench}}, a novel benchmark comprising two complementary subsets: \textbf{EgoMem}, built on real-world egocentric videos, and \textbf{LifeMem}, constructed using simulated virtual community. Crucially, to address the issue of temporal leakage in traditional offline settings, we propose an \textbf{Online Evaluation} protocol that strictly adheres to temporal causality, ensuring systems are evaluated in a realistic streaming fashion. Our experimental results reveal a counterintuitive finding: current sophisticated memory systems fail to outperform a simple RAG-based baseline. This highlights the detrimental impact of over-designed structures and lossy compression in current approaches, emphasizing the necessity of high-fidelity context preservation for lifelog scenarios. We release our code and data at https://github.com/qys77714/LifeDialBench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了LifeDialBench基准测试，用于评估现实世界中可穿戴设备连续记录环境对话的记忆系统性能，包含两个子集并引入了在线评估协议，发现当前复杂记忆系统表现不如简单的RAG基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要关注在线一对一聊天或人机交互，忽视了现实场景中可穿戴设备连续记录环境对话的独特需求，且缺乏公开的生命日志音频数据集。
AI.method: 提出了分层合成框架构建LifeDialBench基准，包含基于真实世界自我中心视频的EgoMem和基于模拟虚拟社区的LifeMem两个子集，并设计了严格遵守时间因果性的在线评估协议。
AI.result: 实验结果显示当前复杂的记忆系统无法超越简单的RAG基线方法，表明过度设计的结构和有损压缩在当前方法中具有负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 强调了在生命日志场景中保持高保真上下文的重要性，当前方法需要改进以更好地处理现实世界的连续对话记录需求。

title: From Perception to Planning: Evolving Ego-Centric Task-Oriented Spatiotemporal Reasoning via Curriculum Learning
summary: Modern vision-language models achieve strong performance in static perception, but remain limited in the complex spatiotemporal reasoning required for embodied, egocentric tasks. A major source of failure is their reliance on temporal priors learned from passive video data, which often leads to spatiotemporal hallucinations and poor generalization in dynamic environments. To address this, we present EgoTSR, a curriculum-based framework for learning task-oriented spatiotemporal reasoning. EgoTSR is built on the premise that embodied reasoning should evolve from explicit spatial understanding to internalized task-state assessment and finally to long-horizon planning. To support this paradigm, we construct EgoTSR-Data, a large-scale dataset comprising 46 million samples organized into three stages: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision, weakly supervised tagging, and long-horizon sequences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EgoTSR effectively eliminates chronological biases, achieving 92.4% accuracy on long-horizon logical reasoning tasks while maintaining high fine-grained perceptual precision, significantly outperforming existing open-source and closed-source state-of-the-art models.

AI.tldr: EgoTSR是一个基于课程学习的任务导向时空推理框架，通过三阶段训练有效解决视觉语言模型在具身任务中的时空幻觉问题，在长时程逻辑推理任务上达到92.4%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉语言模型在静态感知方面表现良好，但在具身、自我中心任务所需的复杂时空推理方面仍然有限。主要失败原因是它们依赖从被动视频数据学习的时间先验，这常导致时空幻觉和在动态环境中泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出EgoTSR框架，基于课程学习理念，从显式空间理解到内部化任务状态评估，再到长时程规划。构建EgoTSR-Data数据集，包含4600万个样本，分为三个阶段：思维链监督、弱监督标注和长时程序列。
AI.result: EgoTSR有效消除了时序偏差，在长时程逻辑推理任务上达到92.4%的准确率，同时保持高细粒度感知精度，显著优于现有的开源和闭源最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: EgoTSR通过课程学习框架成功解决了视觉语言模型在具身任务中的时空推理问题，为具身智能的发展提供了有效的解决方案。
