AI.conclusion: 心理理论建模是ToM-SB任务成功的关键驱动因素。结合心理理论和欺骗奖励的AI双重间谍在困难场景中表现最佳，展示了任务的可扩展性和泛化能力，为开发更安全的对话系统提供了重要见解。

title: Sanity Checks for Agentic Data Science
summary: Agentic data science (ADS) pipelines have grown rapidly in both capability and adoption, with systems such as OpenAI Codex now able to directly analyze datasets and produce answers to statistical questions. However, these systems can reach falsely optimistic conclusions that are difficult for users to detect. To address this, we propose a pair of lightweight sanity checks grounded in the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) framework for veridical data science. These checks use reasonable perturbations to screen whether an agent can reliably distinguish signal from noise, acting as a falsifiability constraint that can expose affirmative conclusions as unsupported. Together, the two checks characterize the trustworthiness of an ADS output, e.g. whether it has found stable signal, is responding to noise, or is sensitive to incidental aspects of the input. We validate the approach on synthetic data with controlled signal-to-noise ratios, confirming that the sanity checks track ground-truth signal strength. We then demonstrate the checks on 11 real-world datasets using OpenAI Codex, characterizing the trustworthiness of each conclusion and finding that in 6 of the datasets an affirmative conclusion is not well-supported, even though a single ADS run may support one. We further analyze failure modes of ADS systems and find that ADS self-reported confidence is poorly calibrated to the empirical stability of its conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于PCS框架的轻量级合理性检查方法，用于评估Agentic数据科学（ADS）系统的输出可信度，通过合理扰动来区分信号与噪声，验证了该方法在合成和真实数据集上的有效性。
AI.motivation: Agentic数据科学（ADS）系统能力不断增强且应用广泛，但这些系统可能得出虚假乐观的结论，用户难以检测。需要一种方法来评估ADS输出的可信度，区分真实信号与噪声响应。
AI.method: 基于可预测性-可计算性-稳定性（PCS）框架，提出两种轻量级合理性检查：使用合理扰动来筛选代理是否能可靠区分信号与噪声，作为可证伪性约束来暴露无支持的肯定结论。
AI.result: 在合成数据上验证了合理性检查能追踪真实信号强度；在11个真实数据集上使用OpenAI Codex测试，发现其中6个数据集的肯定结论缺乏充分支持；ADS自报告置信度与其结论的经验稳定性校准不佳。
AI.conclusion: 提出的PCS框架合理性检查能有效评估ADS输出的可信度，区分稳定信号、噪声响应和输入偶然敏感性，为ADS系统的可靠性评估提供了实用工具。

title: Please Make it Sound like Human: Encoder-Decoder vs. Decoder-Only Transformers for AI-to-Human Text Style Transfer
summary: AI-generated text has become common in academic and professional writing, prompting research into detection methods. Less studied is the reverse: systematically rewriting AI-generated prose to read as genuinely human-authored. We build a parallel corpus of 25,140 paired AI-input and human-reference text chunks, identify 11 measurable stylistic markers separating the two registers, and fine-tune three models: BART-base, BART-large, and Mistral-7B-Instruct with QLoRA. BART-large achieves the highest reference similarity -- BERTScore F1 of 0.924, ROUGE-L of 0.566, and chrF++ of 55.92 -- with 17x fewer parameters than Mistral-7B. We show that Mistral-7B's higher marker shift score reflects overshoot rather than accuracy, and argue that shift accuracy is a meaningful blind spot in current style transfer evaluation.

AI.tldr: 研究构建了一个包含25,140对AI生成和人类参考文本的平行语料库，通过识别11个可测量的风格标记，微调了三个模型来将AI生成文本改写为人类风格，发现BART-large在参数更少的情况下取得了最佳效果。
AI.motivation: 当前研究主要集中在检测AI生成文本，但较少关注如何将AI生成的文本系统性地改写为人类风格文本，填补了这一研究空白。
AI.method: 构建了25,140对AI输入和人类参考文本的平行语料库，识别了11个区分两种文本风格的可测量标记，并微调了BART-base、BART-large和Mistral-7B-Instruct（使用QLoRA）三个模型。
AI.result: BART-large在参考文本相似度方面表现最佳（BERTScore F1为0.924，ROUGE-L为0.566，chrF++为55.92），且参数比Mistral-7B少17倍；Mistral-7B的标记偏移分数较高但反映了过度调整而非准确性。
AI.conclusion: 当前风格转换评估中存在有意义的盲点——偏移准确性，BART-large在将AI文本改写为人类风格方面表现最优，且效率更高。

title: Diffusion-CAM: Faithful Visual Explanations for dMLLMs
summary: While diffusion Multimodal Large Language Models (dMLLMs) have recently achieved remarkable strides in multimodal generation, the development of interpretability mechanisms has lagged behind their architectural evolution. Unlike traditional autoregressive models that produce sequential activations, diffusion-based architectures generate tokens via parallel denoising, resulting in smooth, distributed activation patterns across the entire sequence. Consequently, existing Class Activation Mapping (CAM) methods, which are tailored for local, sequential dependencies, are ill-suited for interpreting these non-autoregressive behaviors. To bridge this gap, we propose Diffusion-CAM, the first interpretability method specifically tailored for dMLLMs. We derive raw activation maps by differentiably probing intermediate representations in the transformer backbone, accordingly capturing both latent features and their class-specific gradients. To address the inherent stochasticity of these raw signals, we incorporate four key modules to resolve spatial ambiguity and mitigate intra-image confounders and redundant token correlations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diffusion-CAM significantly outperforms SoTA methods in both localization accuracy and visual fidelity, establishing a new standard for understanding the parallel generation process of diffusion multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Diffusion-CAM，这是首个专门为扩散多模态大语言模型设计的可解释性方法，解决了现有CAM方法不适用于非自回归并行生成架构的问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散多模态大语言模型在生成能力上取得了显著进展，但其可解释性机制的发展滞后于架构演进。传统的类激活映射方法针对局部、序列依赖设计，不适用于扩散模型的并行去噪和平滑分布式激活模式。
AI.method: 提出Diffusion-CAM方法：1）通过可微分探测transformer骨干网络的中间表示来获取原始激活图；2）引入四个关键模块解决空间模糊性、缓解图像内混淆因素和冗余标记相关性；3）专门针对扩散模型的非自回归并行生成特性进行优化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Diffusion-CAM在定位准确性和视觉保真度方面显著优于现有最先进方法，为理解扩散多模态系统的并行生成过程建立了新标准。
AI.conclusion: Diffusion-CAM是首个专门为扩散多模态大语言模型设计的可解释性方法，成功解决了传统CAM方法不适用于非自回归架构的问题，为理解和解释扩散模型的并行生成过程提供了有效工具。

title: Legal2LogicICL: Improving Generalization in Transforming Legal Cases to Logical Formulas via Diverse Few-Shot Learning
summary: This work aims to improve the generalization of logic-based legal reasoning systems by integrating recent advances in NLP with legal-domain adaptive few-shot learning techniques using LLMs. Existing logic-based legal reasoning pipelines typically rely on fine-tuned models to map natural-language legal cases into logical formulas before forwarding them to a symbolic reasoner. However, such approaches are heavily constrained by the scarcity of high-quality annotated training data. To address this limitation, we propose a novel LLM-based legal reasoning framework that enables effective in-context learning through retrieval-augmented generation. Specifically, we introduce Legal2LogicICL, a few-shot retrieval framework that balances diversity and similarity of exemplars at both the latent semantic representation level and the legal text structure level. In addition, our method explicitly accounts for legal structure by mitigating entity-induced retrieval bias in legal texts, where lengthy and highly specific entity mentions often dominate semantic representations and obscure legally meaningful reasoning patterns. Our Legal2LogicICL constructs informative and robust few-shot demonstrations, leading to accurate and stable logical rule generation without requiring additional training. In addition, we construct a new dataset, named Legal2Proleg, which is annotated with alignments between legal cases and PROLEG logical formulas to support the evaluation of legal semantic parsing. Experimental results on both open-source and proprietary LLMs demonstrate that our approach significantly improves accuracy, stability, and generalization in transforming natural-language legal case descriptions into logical representations, highlighting its effectiveness for interpretable and reliable legal reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/yingjie7/Legal2LogicICL.

AI.tldr: 提出Legal2LogicICL框架，通过检索增强生成和少样本学习，将自然语言法律案例转化为逻辑公式，解决标注数据稀缺问题，提升法律推理的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于逻辑的法律推理系统依赖微调模型将法律案例映射为逻辑公式，但高质量标注数据稀缺限制了其泛化能力。需要一种能在少量标注数据下有效工作的法律推理框架。
AI.method: 提出Legal2LogicICL少样本检索框架：1) 在潜在语义表示和法律文本结构层面平衡示例的多样性和相似性；2) 减轻法律文本中实体诱导的检索偏差；3) 构建信息丰富且鲁棒的少样本演示，无需额外训练即可生成准确逻辑规则。
AI.result: 构建了Legal2Proleg数据集支持法律语义解析评估。实验表明，该方法在开源和专有LLMs上显著提高了将自然语言法律案例转化为逻辑表示的准确性、稳定性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Legal2LogicICL框架通过检索增强生成和少样本学习，有效解决了法律推理中标注数据稀缺的问题，实现了准确、稳定且可泛化的逻辑规则生成，为可解释和可靠的法律推理提供了有效解决方案。

title: Min-$k$ Sampling: Decoupling Truncation from Temperature Scaling via Relative Logit Dynamics
summary: The quality of text generated by large language models depends critically on the decoding sampling strategy. While mainstream methods such as Top-$k$, Top-$p$, and Min-$p$ achieve a balance between diversity and accuracy through probability-space truncation, they share an inherent limitation: extreme sensitivity to the temperature parameter. Recent logit-space approaches like Top-$nσ$ achieve temperature invariance but rely on global statistics that are susceptible to long-tail noise, failing to capture fine-grained confidence structures among top candidates. We propose \textbf{Min-$k$ Sampling}, a novel dynamic truncation strategy that analyzes the local shape of the sorted logit distribution to identify "semantic cliffs": sharp transitions from high-confidence core tokens to uncertain long-tail tokens. By computing a position-weighted relative decay rate, Min-$k$ dynamically determines truncation boundaries at each generation step. We formally prove that Min-$k$ achieves strict temperature invariance and empirically demonstrate its low sensitivity to hyperparameter choices. Experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks, creative writing tasks, and human evaluation show that Min-$k$ consistently improves text quality, maintaining robust performance even under extreme temperature settings where probability-based methods collapse. We make our code, models, and analysis tools publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出Min-k采样方法，通过分析排序后的logit分布局部形状识别"语义悬崖"，实现温度不变性，在多种任务中提升文本生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有解码采样方法（如Top-k、Top-p、Min-p）对温度参数极度敏感，而最近的对数空间方法（如Top-nσ）虽然实现温度不变性，但依赖全局统计量易受长尾噪声影响，无法捕捉候选词间的细粒度置信结构。
AI.method: 提出Min-k采样策略，分析排序后logit分布的局部形状来识别"语义悬崖"（从高置信核心token到不确定长尾token的急剧转变），通过计算位置加权相对衰减率，在每个生成步骤动态确定截断边界。
AI.result: 形式化证明Min-k实现严格温度不变性，实验显示对超参数选择敏感性低。在多个推理基准、创意写作任务和人工评估中，Min-k一致提升文本质量，即使在极端温度设置下（基于概率的方法失效时）仍保持稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: Min-k采样通过局部logit分布分析实现温度不变解码，相比现有方法在文本质量、鲁棒性和超参数敏感性方面均有显著改进，为大型语言模型解码提供了更可靠的采样策略。

title: Enhancing Fine-Grained Spatial Grounding in 3D CT Report Generation via Discriminative Guidance
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) for radiology report generation (RRG) can produce long-form chest CT reports from volumetric scans and show strong potential to improve radiology workflow efficiency and consistency. However, existing methods face two key limitations: (i) training supervision is often coarse, aligning a whole CT volume with a full free-text report without explicit alignment for fine-grained attributes or pathology locations; and (ii) evaluation is typically holistic (lexical overlap, entity matching, or LLM-as-a-judge scores) and not diagnostic for spatial grounding. We propose \emph{Discriminative Cue-Prompting with Prompt Dropout (DCP-PD)}, a plug-and-play framework that distills fine-grained cues from free-text reports and uses them to guide report generation while mitigating shortcut reliance via prompt dropout. DCP-PD achieves state-of-the-art performance on CT-RATE, improving macro F1 from $=0.501$ to $0.603$ (20% relative), and substantially boosts out-of-distribution performance on Rad-ChestCT from F1 $=0.266$ to $0.503$ (89% relative). Finally, we introduce a hierarchical, location-aware question-set protocol (presence $\rightarrow$ laterality $\rightarrow$ lobe) to directly assess pathology-location grounding, showing that fine-grained spatial localization remains challenging even for models that score highly on current benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DCP-PD框架，通过从自由文本报告中提取细粒度线索并利用提示丢弃缓解捷径依赖，显著提升了放射学报告生成性能，同时引入了分层位置感知评估协议来评估病理定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有放射学报告生成方法存在两个关键限制：1）训练监督过于粗糙，将整个CT体积与完整自由文本报告对齐，缺乏细粒度属性或病理位置的显式对齐；2）评估通常是整体性的（词汇重叠、实体匹配或LLM评分），缺乏对空间定位的诊断性评估。
AI.method: 提出Discriminative Cue-Prompting with Prompt Dropout (DCP-PD)框架，这是一个即插即用的方法，从自由文本报告中提取细粒度线索，并用这些线索指导报告生成，同时通过提示丢弃机制缓解模型对捷径的依赖。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE数据集上达到最先进性能，将宏观F1从0.501提升到0.603（相对提升20%）；在Rad-ChestCT数据集上的分布外性能显著提升，F1从0.266提升到0.503（相对提升89%）。
AI.conclusion: DCP-PD框架有效提升了放射学报告生成的性能，同时引入的分层位置感知评估协议揭示了即使在高分模型中，细粒度空间定位仍然具有挑战性，为未来研究提供了重要方向。

title: Evaluating Cooperation in LLM Social Groups through Elected Leadership
summary: Governing common-pool resources requires agents to develop enduring strategies through cooperation and self-governance to avoid collective failure. While foundation models have shown potential for cooperation in these settings, existing multi-agent research provides little insight into whether structured leadership and election mechanisms can improve collective decision making. The lack of such a critical organizational feature ubiquitous in human society presents a significant shortcoming of the current methods. In this work we aim to directly address whether leadership and elections can support improved social welfare and cooperation through multi-agent simulation with LLMs. We present our open-source framework that simulates leadership through elected personas and candidate-driven agendas and carry out an empirical study of LLMs under controlled governance conditions. Our experiments demonstrate that having elected leadership improves social welfare scores by 55.4% and survival time by 128.6% across a range of high performing LLMs. Through the construction of an agent social graph we compute centrality metrics to assess the social influence of leader personas and also analyze rhetorical and cooperative tendencies revealed through a sentiment analysis on leader utterances. This work lays the foundation for further study of election mechanisms in multi-agent systems toward navigating complex social dilemmas.

AI.tldr: 研究通过LLM多智能体模拟，探讨选举领导机制是否能改善公共资源治理中的集体决策和社会福利
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体研究缺乏对结构化领导和选举机制在集体决策中作用的探讨，而这是人类社会中普遍存在的关键组织特征
AI.method: 开发开源框架，通过选举角色和候选人驱动议程模拟领导机制，在受控治理条件下对LLM进行实证研究，构建智能体社交图计算中心性指标，并对领导者话语进行情感分析
AI.result: 选举领导机制使社会福利得分提高55.4%，生存时间延长128.6%；通过社交图分析领导者社会影响力，情感分析揭示领导者的修辞和合作倾向
AI.conclusion: 选举领导机制能显著改善多智能体系统中的社会福祉和合作，为复杂社会困境中选举机制的进一步研究奠定基础

title: Introspective Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models promise parallel generation, yet still lag behind autoregressive (AR) models in quality. We stem this gap to a failure of introspective consistency: AR models agree with their own generations, while DLMs often do not. We define the introspective acceptance rate, which measures whether a model accepts its previously generated tokens. This reveals why AR training has a structural advantage: causal masking and logit shifting implicitly enforce introspective consistency. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Introspective Diffusion Language Model (I-DLM), a paradigm that retains diffusion-style parallel decoding while inheriting the introspective consistency of AR training. I-DLM uses a novel introspective strided decoding (ISD) algorithm, which enables the model to verify previously generated tokens while advancing new ones in the same forward pass. From a systems standpoint, we build I-DLM inference engine on AR-inherited optimizations and further customize it with a stationary-batch scheduler. To the best of our knowledge, I-DLM is the first DLM to match the quality of its same-scale AR counterpart while outperforming prior DLMs in both model quality and practical serving efficiency across 15 benchmarks. It reaches 69.6 on AIME-24 and 45.7 on LiveCodeBench-v6, exceeding LLaDA-2.1-mini (16B) by more than 26 and 15 points, respectively. Beyond quality, I-DLM is designed for the growing demand of large-concurrency serving, delivering about 3x higher throughput than prior state-of-the-art DLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的自省扩散语言模型（I-DLM），通过自省一致性解决了扩散语言模型在质量上落后于自回归模型的问题，首次实现了与同规模自回归模型相当的质量，同时在推理效率上显著提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽然支持并行生成，但在质量上仍然落后于自回归模型。作者发现这种差距源于自省一致性失败：自回归模型与自己的生成结果一致，而扩散语言模型往往不一致。自回归训练通过因果掩码和logit偏移隐式地强制执行自省一致性，而扩散模型缺乏这种机制。
AI.method: 提出了自省扩散语言模型（I-DLM），采用自省跨步解码（ISD）算法，使模型能够在同一前向传递中验证先前生成的标记并推进新标记。从系统角度，在自回归继承的优化基础上构建I-DLM推理引擎，并进一步使用静态批处理调度器进行定制。
AI.result: I-DLM是第一个在质量上匹配同规模自回归模型的扩散语言模型，在15个基准测试中超越了先前的DLMs。在AIME-24上达到69.6分，在LiveCodeBench-v6上达到45.7分，分别超过LLaDA-2.1-mini（16B）26分和15分以上。在吞吐量方面，比先前最先进的DLMs高出约3倍。
AI.conclusion: I-DLM通过引入自省一致性机制，成功弥合了扩散语言模型与自回归模型之间的质量差距，同时保持了并行解码的优势，为大规模并发服务提供了高效解决方案。

title: Discourse Diversity in Multi-Turn Empathic Dialogue
summary: Large language models (LLMs) produce responses rated as highly empathic in single-turn settings (Ayers et al., 2023; Lee et al., 2024), yet they are also known to be formulaic generators that reuse the same lexical patterns, syntactic templates, and discourse structures across tasks (Jiang et al., 2025; Shaib et al., 2024; Namuduri et al., 2025). Less attention has been paid to whether this formulaicity extends to the level of discourse moves, i.e., what a response does for the person it is addressing. This question is especially consequential for empathic dialogue, where effective support demands not just a kind response at one moment but varied strategies as a conversation unfolds (Stiles et al., 1998). Indeed, prior work shows that LLMs reuse the same tactic sequences more than human supporters in single-turn settings (Gueorguieva et al., 2026). We extend this analysis to multi-turn conversations and find that the rigidity compounds: once a tactic appears in a supporter turn, LLMs reuse it in the next at nearly double the rate of humans (0.50-0.56 vs. 0.27). This pattern holds across LLMs serving as supporters in real emotional support conversations, and is invisible to standard similarity metrics. To address this gap, we introduce MINT (Multi-turn Inter-tactic Novelty Training), the first reinforcement learning framework to optimize discourse move diversity across multi-turn empathic dialogue. The best MINT variant combines an empathy quality reward with a cross-turn tactic novelty signal, improving aggregate empathy by 25.3% over vanilla across 1.7B and 4B models while reducing cross-turn discourse move repetition by 26.3% on the 4B model, surpassing all baselines including quality-only and token-level diversity methods on both measures. These results suggest that what current models lack is not empathy itself, but the ability to vary their discourse moves across a conversation.

AI.tldr: LLMs在共情对话中表现出高度公式化的语篇策略重复，特别是在多轮对话中，其策略重复率几乎是人类的两倍。研究提出了MINT训练框架，通过强化学习优化多轮对话中的语篇策略多样性，显著提升了共情质量并减少了策略重复。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLMs在单轮对话中被评为高度共情，但它们也是公式化的生成器，重复使用相同的词汇模式、句法模板和语篇结构。较少关注这种公式化是否延伸到语篇行为层面，即回应为对话对象做了什么。这个问题对于共情对话尤其重要，因为有效的支持不仅需要某一时刻的善意回应，还需要随着对话展开而变化多样的策略。
AI.method: 研究将分析扩展到多轮对话，发现LLMs的语篇策略重复问题更加严重。为了应对这一问题，研究者提出了MINT（多轮语篇策略新颖性训练），这是第一个通过强化学习优化多轮共情对话中语篇策略多样性的框架。最佳MINT变体结合了共情质量奖励和跨轮策略新颖性信号。
AI.result: 在多轮对话中，一旦某种策略出现在支持者的回合中，LLMs在下一回合中重复使用该策略的比率几乎是人类的两倍（0.50-0.56 vs. 0.27）。MINT框架在1.7B和4B模型上将总体共情质量提高了25.3%，同时在4B模型上将跨轮语篇策略重复减少了26.3%，在所有基线方法（包括仅关注质量和词元级多样性方法）中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型缺乏的不是共情能力本身，而是在对话中变化语篇策略的能力。MINT框架通过优化语篇策略多样性，显著提升了LLMs在多轮共情对话中的表现，表明关注语篇层面的多样性对于构建更自然、有效的对话系统至关重要。

title: Intelligent Approval of Access Control Flow in Office Automation Systems via Relational Modeling
summary: Office automation (OA) systems play a crucial role in enterprise operations and management, with access control flow approval (ACFA) being a key component that manages the accessibility of various resources. However, traditional ACFA requires approval from the person in charge at each step, which consumes a significant amount of manpower and time. Its intelligence is a crucial issue that needs to be addressed urgently by all companies. In this paper, we propose a novel relational modeling-driven intelligent approval (RMIA) framework to automate ACFA. Specifically, our RMIA consists of two core modules: (1) The binary relation modeling module aims to characterize the coupling relation between applicants and approvers and provide reliable basic information for ACFA decision-making from a coarse-grained perspective. (2) The ternary relation modeling module utilizes specific resource information as its core, characterizing the complex relations between applicants, resources, and approvers, and thus provides fine-grained gain information for informed decision-making. Then, our RMIA effectively fuses these two kinds of information to form the final decision. Finally, extensive experiments are conducted on two product datasets and an online A/B test to verify the effectiveness of RMIA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于关系建模的智能审批框架(RMIA)，用于自动化办公系统中的访问控制流程审批，通过二元和三元关系建模来减少人工审批的时间和人力成本。
AI.motivation: 传统访问控制流程审批需要逐级人工审批，消耗大量人力和时间，智能化程度不足成为企业亟待解决的关键问题。
AI.method: 提出RMIA框架，包含两个核心模块：1) 二元关系建模模块，从粗粒度角度刻画申请人与审批人之间的耦合关系；2) 三元关系建模模块，以具体资源信息为核心，从细粒度角度刻画申请人、资源和审批人之间的复杂关系，然后将两种信息有效融合形成最终决策。
AI.result: 在两个产品数据集和在线A/B测试上进行了广泛实验，验证了RMIA框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RMIA框架能够有效自动化访问控制流程审批，解决传统审批方式效率低下的问题，为企业办公自动化系统提供智能化解决方案。

title: ReContraster: Making Your Posters Stand Out with Regional Contrast
summary: Effective poster design requires rapidly capturing attention and clearly conveying messages. Inspired by the ``contrast effects'' principle, we propose ReContraster, the first training-free model to leverage regional contrast to make posters stand out. By emulating the cognitive behaviors of a poster designer, ReContraster introduces the compositional multi-agent system to identify elements, organize layout, and evaluate generated poster candidates. To further ensure harmonious transitions across region boundaries, ReContraster integrates the hybrid denoising strategy during the diffusion process. We additionally contribute a new benchmark dataset for comprehensive evaluation. Seven quantitative metrics and four user studies confirm its superiority over relevant state-of-the-art methods, producing visually striking and aesthetically appealing posters.

AI.tldr: ReContraster是一个无需训练的海报设计模型，利用区域对比原理，通过多智能体系统模拟设计师认知行为，结合混合去噪策略，生成视觉冲击力强的海报。
AI.motivation: 有效海报设计需要快速吸引注意力并清晰传达信息。受"对比效应"原理启发，需要一种无需训练的方法来利用区域对比使海报脱颖而出。
AI.method: 1. 引入组合式多智能体系统模拟设计师认知行为：识别元素、组织布局、评估生成的海报候选方案；2. 在扩散过程中集成混合去噪策略以确保区域边界间的和谐过渡；3. 构建新的基准数据集进行全面评估。
AI.result: 通过七个定量指标和四项用户研究证实，ReContraster在相关最先进方法中具有优越性，能够生成视觉冲击力强且具有美学吸引力的海报。
AI.conclusion: ReContraster是首个利用区域对比原理的无需训练海报设计模型，通过模拟设计师认知行为和混合去噪策略，有效生成视觉突出的高质量海报。

title: LangFlow: Continuous Diffusion Rivals Discrete in Language Modeling
summary:
Continuous diffusion models have achieved strong performance across domains such as images. However, in language modeling, prior continuous diffusion language models (DLMs) lag behind discrete counterparts. In this work, we close this gap with LangFlow, the first continuous DLM to rival discrete diffusion. Our approach connects embedding-space DLMs to Flow Matching via Bregman divergence and introduces three key innovations: (1) a novel ODE-based NLL bound for principled evaluation of continuous flow-based language models; (2) an information-uniform principle for noise scheduling, motivating a learnable scheduler based on a Gumbel distribution; and (3) an improved training protocol incorporating self-conditioning, which enhances both likelihood and sample quality.LangFlow achieves strong performance across benchmarks, reaching a perplexity (PPL) of 30.0 on LM1B and 24.6 on OpenWebText. It matches top discrete DLMs at comparable scale and surpasses autoregressive baselines in zero-shot transfer across multiple benchmarks. LangFlow provides clear evidence that continuous diffusion is a competitive and promising paradigm for language modeling.
  https://github.com/nealchen2003/LangFlow

AI.tldr: LangFlow是首个能与离散扩散模型相媲美的连续扩散语言模型，通过Bregman散度连接嵌入空间扩散模型与流匹配，在多个基准测试中达到与顶级离散扩散模型相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 在语言建模领域，以往的连续扩散语言模型（DLMs）性能一直落后于离散扩散模型，作者希望缩小这一差距，证明连续扩散在语言建模中同样具有竞争力。
AI.method: 1. 通过Bregman散度将嵌入空间扩散模型与流匹配连接；2. 提出基于ODE的NLL边界用于连续流基语言模型的评估；3. 基于信息均匀原则设计基于Gumbel分布的可学习噪声调度器；4. 引入包含自条件的改进训练协议。
AI.result: 在LM1B上达到30.0的困惑度，在OpenWebText上达到24.6的困惑度，与同规模顶级离散扩散模型相当，并在多个基准测试中超越自回归基线的零样本迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: LangFlow证明了连续扩散是语言建模中具有竞争力的有前景范式，首次实现了连续扩散语言模型与离散扩散模型的性能相当。

title: From Topology to Trajectory: LLM-Driven World Models For Supply Chain Resilience
summary: Semiconductor supply chains face unprecedented resilience challenges amidst global geopolitical turbulence. Conventional Large Language Model (LLM) planners, when confronting such non-stationary "Policy Black Swan" events, frequently suffer from Decision Paralysis or a severe Grounding Gap due to the absence of physical environmental modeling. This paper introduces ReflectiChain, a cognitive agentic framework tailored for resilient macroeconomic supply chain planning. The core innovation lies in the integration of Latent Trajectory Rehearsal powered by a generative world model, which couples reflection-in-action (System 2 deliberation) with delayed reflection-on-action. Furthermore, we leverage a Retrospective Agentic RL mechanism to enable autonomous policy evolution during the deployment phase (test-time). Evaluations conducted on our high-fidelity benchmark, Semi-Sim, demonstrate that under extreme scenarios such as export bans and material shortages, ReflectiChain achieves a 250% improvement in average step rewards over the strongest LLM baselines. It successfully restores the Operability Ratio (OR) from a deficient 13.3% to over 88.5% while ensuring robust gradient convergence. Ablation studies further underscore that the synergy between physical grounding constraints and double-loop learning is fundamental to bridging the gap between semantic reasoning and physical reality for long-horizon strategic planning.

AI.tldr: ReflectiChain：一个用于弹性宏观经济供应链规划的认知代理框架，通过潜在轨迹排练和回顾性代理强化学习，在极端场景下显著提升决策性能
AI.motivation: 半导体供应链面临前所未有的弹性挑战，传统LLM规划器在面对"政策黑天鹅"事件时经常出现决策瘫痪或严重的接地差距，缺乏物理环境建模
AI.method: 引入ReflectiChain框架，核心创新包括：1）基于生成世界模型的潜在轨迹排练，将行动中反思与延迟行动后反思相结合；2）回顾性代理强化学习机制，在部署阶段实现自主策略演化
AI.result: 在高保真基准Semi-Sim上的评估显示，在出口禁令和材料短缺等极端场景下，ReflectiChain相比最强LLM基线平均步奖励提升250%，将可操作性比率从13.3%恢复到88.5%以上，确保稳健梯度收敛
AI.conclusion: 物理接地约束与双环学习的协同作用对于弥合语义推理与物理现实之间的差距至关重要，是实现长期战略规划的关键

title: HistLens: Mapping Idea Change across Concepts and Corpora
summary: Language change both reflects and shapes social processes, and the semantic evolution of foundational concepts provides a measurable trace of historical and social transformation. Despite recent advances in diachronic semantics and discourse analysis, existing computational approaches often (i) concentrate on a single concept or a single corpus, making findings difficult to compare across heterogeneous sources, and (ii) remain confined to surface lexical evidence, offering insufficient computational and interpretive granularity when concepts are expressed implicitly. We propose HistLens, a unified, SAE-based framework for multi-concept, multi-corpus conceptual-history analysis. The framework decomposes concept representations into interpretable features and tracks their activation dynamics over time and across sources, yielding comparable conceptual trajectories within a shared coordinate system. Experiments on long-span press corpora show that HistLens supports cross-concept, cross-corpus computation of patterns of idea evolution and enables implicit concept computation. By bridging conceptual modeling with interpretive needs, HistLens broadens the analytical perspectives and methodological repertoire available to social science and the humanities for diachronic text analysis.

AI.tldr: HistLens是一个基于SAE的统一框架，用于多概念、多语料库的概念史分析，通过可解释特征分解概念表示并追踪其跨时间和跨来源的激活动态。
AI.motivation: 现有计算方法通常局限于单一概念或单一语料库，难以进行跨异质源比较，且停留在表面词汇证据层面，对隐含概念表达缺乏足够的计算和解释粒度。
AI.method: 提出HistLens框架，将概念表示分解为可解释特征，在共享坐标系中追踪这些特征随时间跨来源的激活动态，支持跨概念、跨语料库的概念演化模式计算。
AI.result: 在长期跨度新闻语料库上的实验表明，HistLens支持跨概念、跨语料库的思想演化模式计算，并能够进行隐含概念计算。
AI.conclusion: HistLens通过将概念建模与解释需求相结合，拓宽了社会科学和人文学科在历时文本分析中的分析视角和方法论工具。

title: EmergentBridge: Improving Zero-Shot Cross-Modal Transfer in Unified Multimodal Embedding Models
summary: Unified multimodal embedding spaces underpin practical applications such as cross-modal retrieval and zero-shot recognition. In many real deployments, however, supervision is available only for a small subset of modality pairs (e.g., image--text), leaving \emph{unpaired} modality pairs (e.g., audio$\leftrightarrow$depth, infrared$\leftrightarrow$audio) weakly connected and thus performing poorly on zero-shot transfer. Addressing this sparse-pairing regime is therefore essential for scaling unified embedding systems to new tasks without curating exhaustive pairwise data. We propose \textbf{EmergentBridge}, an embedding-level bridging framework that improves performance on these unpaired pairs \emph{without requiring exhaustive pairwise supervision}. Our key observation is that naively aligning a new modality to a synthesized proxy embedding can introduce \emph{gradient interference}, degrading the anchor-alignment structure that existing retrieval/classification relies on. EmergentBridge addresses this by (i) learning a mapping that produces a \emph{noisy bridge anchor} (a proxy embedding of an already-aligned modality) from an anchor embedding, and (ii) enforcing proxy alignment only in the subspace orthogonal to the anchor-alignment direction, preserving anchor alignment while strengthening non-anchor connectivity. Across nine datasets spanning multiple modalities, EmergentBridge consistently outperforms prior binding baselines on zero-shot classification and retrieval, demonstrating strong emergent alignment.

AI.tldr: EmergentBridge是一种嵌入级桥接框架，用于改善稀疏配对多模态系统中的未配对模态对性能，无需完整的成对监督。
AI.motivation: 现实部署中，多模态嵌入空间通常只有部分模态对（如图像-文本）有监督信号，而未配对模态对（如音频-深度、红外-音频）连接较弱，导致零样本迁移性能差。需要解决稀疏配对问题以扩展统一嵌入系统而无需收集详尽的成对数据。
AI.method: 提出EmergentBridge框架：1) 学习从锚点嵌入生成噪声桥接锚点（已对齐模态的代理嵌入）的映射；2) 仅在正交于锚点对齐方向的子空间中强制代理对齐，保持锚点对齐的同时增强非锚点连接性。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种模态的九个数据集上，EmergentBridge在零样本分类和检索任务上始终优于现有绑定基线方法，展示了强大的涌现对齐能力。
AI.conclusion: EmergentBridge通过创新的桥接框架有效解决了多模态嵌入中的稀疏配对问题，能够在保持已有对齐结构的同时增强未配对模态对之间的连接，为扩展统一嵌入系统提供了实用解决方案。

title: AIM-Bench: Benchmarking and Improving Affective Image Manipulation via Fine-Grained Hierarchical Control
summary: Affective Image Manipulation (AIM) aims to evoke specific emotions through targeted editing. Current image editing benchmarks primarily focus on object-level modifications in general scenarios, lacking the fine-grained granularity to capture affective dimensions. To bridge this gap, we introduce the first benchmark designed for AIM termed AIM-Bench. This benchmark is built upon a dual-path affective modeling scheme that integrates the Mikels emotion taxonomy with the Valence-Arousal-Dominance framework, enabling high-level semantic and fine-grained continuous manipulation. Through a hierarchical human-in-the-loop workflow, we finally curate 800 high-quality samples covering 8 emotional categories and 5 editing types. To effectively assess performance, we also design a composite evaluation suite combining rule-based and model-based metrics to holistically assess instruction consistency, aesthetics, and emotional expressiveness. Extensive evaluations reveal that current editing models face significant challenges, most notably a prevalent positivity bias, which stemming from inherent imbalances in training data distribution. To tackle this, we propose a scalable data engine utilizing an inverse repainting strategy to construct AIM-40k, a balanced instruction-tuning dataset comprising 40k samples. Concretely, we enhance raw affective images via generative redrawing to establish high-fidelity ground truths, and synthesize input images with divergent emotions and paired precise instructions. Fine-tuning a baseline model on AIM-40k yields a 9.15% relative improvement in overall performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of our AIM-40k. Our data and related code will be made open soon.

AI.tldr: AIM-Bench是首个针对情感图像编辑的基准测试，通过双路径情感建模方案构建了800个高质量样本，并提出了AIM-40k平衡数据集来缓解现有模型的积极性偏见问题。
AI.motivation: 当前图像编辑基准主要关注通用场景下的物体级修改，缺乏捕捉情感维度的细粒度能力。为了填补这一空白，需要专门为情感图像编辑设计基准测试。
AI.method: 1. 提出AIM-Bench基准：基于双路径情感建模方案，整合Mikels情感分类和Valence-Arousal-Dominance框架；2. 采用分层人机协作流程收集800个高质量样本；3. 设计结合规则和模型指标的复合评估套件；4. 提出可扩展数据引擎，使用逆向重绘策略构建AIM-40k平衡数据集。
AI.result: 1. 现有编辑模型面临显著挑战，特别是普遍的积极性偏见；2. 在AIM-40k上微调基线模型使整体性能相对提升9.15%；3. 证明了AIM-40k数据集的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AIM-Bench填补了情感图像编辑基准的空白，提出的AIM-40k数据集有效缓解了训练数据不平衡问题，为情感图像编辑研究提供了重要工具和资源。

title: Agentic Aggregation for Parallel Scaling of Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: We study parallel test-time scaling for long-horizon agentic tasks such as agentic search and deep research, where multiple rollouts are generated in parallel and aggregated into a final response. While such scaling has proven effective for chain-of-thought reasoning, agentic tasks pose unique challenges: trajectories are long, multi-turn, and tool-augmented, and outputs are often open-ended. Aggregating only final answers discards rich information from trajectories, while concatenating all trajectories exceeds the model's context window. To address this, we propose AggAgent, an aggregation agent that treats parallel trajectories as an environment. We equip it with lightweight tools to inspect candidate solutions and search across trajectories, enabling it to navigate and synthesize information on demand. Across six benchmarks and three model families (GLM-4.7, Qwen3.5, MiniMax-M2.5), AggAgent outperforms all existing aggregation methods-by up to 5.3% absolute on average and 10.3% on two deep research tasks-while adding minimal overhead, as the aggregation cost remains bounded by a single agentic rollout. Our findings establish agentic aggregation as an effective and cost-efficient approach to parallel test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: AggAgent：一种用于并行测试时扩展的智能体聚合方法，将并行轨迹视为环境，通过轻量级工具检查和搜索候选解决方案，在长时程智能体任务中显著提升性能
AI.motivation: 针对长时程智能体任务（如智能体搜索和深度研究）的并行测试时扩展面临独特挑战：轨迹长、多轮次、工具增强且输出开放。仅聚合最终答案会丢弃轨迹中的丰富信息，而拼接所有轨迹会超出模型上下文窗口
AI.method: 提出AggAgent聚合智能体，将并行轨迹视为环境，配备轻量级工具来检查候选解决方案并在轨迹间搜索，使其能够按需导航和合成信息
AI.result: 在六个基准测试和三个模型家族（GLM-4.7、Qwen3.5、MiniMax-M2.5）上，AggAgent优于所有现有聚合方法，平均绝对提升5.3%，在两个深度研究任务上提升10.3%，同时增加的开销最小，聚合成本保持在一个智能体滚动的范围内
AI.conclusion: 智能体聚合是并行测试时扩展的有效且成本高效的方法，为长时程智能体任务提供了新的解决方案

title: A Benchmark and Multi-Agent System for Instruction-driven Cinematic Video Compilation
summary: The surging demand for adapting long-form cinematic content into short videos has motivated the need for versatile automatic video compilation systems. However, existing compilation methods are limited to predefined tasks, and the community lacks a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate the cinematic compilation. To address this, we introduce CineBench, the first benchmark for instruction-driven cinematic video compilation, featuring diverse user instructions and high-quality ground-truth compilations annotated by professional editors. To overcome contextual collapse and temporal fragmentation, we present CineAgents, a multi-agent system that reformulates cinematic video compilation into ``design-and-compose'' paradigm. CineAgents performs script reverse-engineering to construct a hierarchical narrative memory to provide multi-level context and employs an iterative narrative planning process that refines a creative blueprint into a final compiled script. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineAgents significantly outperforms existing methods, generating compilations with superior narrative coherence and logical coherence.

AI.tldr: CineBench是首个指令驱动的电影视频剪辑基准测试，CineAgents通过多智能体系统和"设计-组合"范式解决上下文崩溃和时间碎片化问题
AI.motivation: 将长篇电影内容改编为短视频的需求激增，但现有剪辑方法局限于预定义任务，且缺乏全面的基准测试来评估电影剪辑质量
AI.method: 提出CineAgents多智能体系统，采用"设计-组合"范式，通过脚本逆向工程构建分层叙事记忆，并采用迭代叙事规划过程将创意蓝图细化为最终剪辑脚本
AI.result: CineAgents显著优于现有方法，生成的剪辑具有更好的叙事连贯性和逻辑一致性
AI.conclusion: CineBench为电影视频剪辑提供了首个基准测试，CineAgents通过创新的多智能体方法有效解决了上下文崩溃和时间碎片化问题，提升了自动视频剪辑的质量

title: General365: Benchmarking General Reasoning in Large Language Models Across Diverse and Challenging Tasks
summary: Contemporary large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities, particularly in specialized domains like mathematics and physics. However, their ability to generalize these reasoning skills to more general and broader contexts--often termed general reasoning--remains under-explored. Unlike domain-specific reasoning, general reasoning relies less on expert knowledge but still presents formidable reasoning challenges, such as complex constraints, nested logical branches, and semantic interference. To address this gap, we introduce General365, a benchmark specifically designed to assess general reasoning in LLMs. By restricting background knowledge to a K-12 level, General365 explicitly decouples reasoning from specialized expertise. The benchmark comprises 365 seed problems and 1,095 variant problems across eight categories, ensuring both high difficulty and diversity. Evaluations across 26 leading LLMs reveal that even the top-performing model achieves only 62.8% accuracy, in stark contrast to the near-perfect performances of LLMs in math and physics benchmarks. These results suggest that the reasoning abilities of current LLMs are heavily domain-dependent, leaving significant room for improvement in broader applications. We envision General365 as a catalyst for advancing LLM reasoning beyond domain-specific tasks toward robust, general-purpose real-world scenarios. Code, Dataset, and Leaderboard: https://general365.github.io

AI.tldr: 论文提出了General365基准测试，专门评估大语言模型在通用推理而非专业领域推理上的能力，发现当前模型表现远低于数学物理等专业领域，表明模型推理能力仍高度依赖领域知识。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在数学、物理等专业领域展现出强大的推理能力，但其在更广泛、更通用的上下文中的推理能力（即通用推理）尚未得到充分探索。通用推理依赖较少专业知识，但面临复杂约束、嵌套逻辑分支和语义干扰等挑战，需要专门的评估工具。
AI.method: 研究者开发了General365基准测试，将背景知识限制在K-12水平，明确将推理能力与专业知识解耦。基准包含365个种子问题和1,095个变体问题，涵盖八个类别，确保高难度和多样性。对26个领先的大语言模型进行了评估。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，即使表现最好的模型在General365上仅达到62.8%的准确率，这与大语言模型在数学和物理基准测试中接近完美的表现形成鲜明对比。这表明当前大语言模型的推理能力高度依赖特定领域，在更广泛应用中仍有很大改进空间。
AI.conclusion: General365基准测试揭示了当前大语言模型在通用推理方面的局限性，其推理能力仍高度领域依赖。该基准可作为催化剂，推动大语言模型推理能力超越专业领域任务，向更稳健、通用的现实世界场景发展。

title: PRISM Risk Signal Framework: Hierarchy-Based Red Lines for AI Behavioral Risk
summary: Current approaches to AI safety define red lines at the case level: specific prompts, specific outputs, specific harms. This paper argues that red lines can be set more fundamentally -- at the level of value, evidence, and source hierarchies that govern AI reasoning. Using the PRISM (Profile-based Reasoning Integrity Stack Measurement) framework, we define a taxonomy of 27 behavioral risk signals derived from structural anomalies in how AI systems prioritize values (L4), weight evidence types (L3), and trust information sources (L2). Each signal is evaluated through a dual-threshold principle combining absolute rank position and relative win-rate gap, producing a two-tier classification (Confirmed Risk vs. Watch Signal). The hierarchy-based approach offers three advantages over case-specific red lines: it is anticipatory rather than reactive (detecting dangerous reasoning structures before they produce harmful outputs), comprehensive rather than enumerative (a single value-hierarchy signal subsumes an unlimited number of case-specific violations), and measurable rather than subjective (grounded in empirical forced-choice data). We demonstrate the framework's detection capacity using approximately 397,000 forced-choice responses from 7 AI models across three Authority Stack layers, showing that the signal taxonomy successfully discriminates between models with structurally extreme profiles, models with context-dependent risk, and models with balanced hierarchies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于价值、证据和来源层次结构而非具体案例来设定AI安全红线的PRISM框架，通过27个行为风险信号检测AI推理中的结构异常，实现前瞻性、全面性和可量化的风险评估。
AI.motivation: 当前AI安全方法主要在案例层面（具体提示、输出、危害）设定红线，这种方法存在反应性、枚举性和主观性等局限。本文旨在建立更根本的基于推理层次结构的红线设定方法，实现前瞻性、全面性和可量化的AI风险评估。
AI.method: 使用PRISM（基于配置文件的推理完整性堆栈测量）框架，从AI系统在价值优先级（L4）、证据类型权重（L3）和信息源信任度（L2）三个层次的结构异常中提取27个行为风险信号。采用结合绝对排名位置和相对胜率差距的双阈值原则进行两层级分类（确认风险vs.观察信号）。
AI.result: 通过对7个AI模型在三个权威堆栈层级的约397,000个强制选择响应进行分析，证明该信号分类法能有效区分：具有结构极端配置的模型、具有上下文依赖风险的模型以及具有平衡层次结构的模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于层次结构的方法相比案例特定红线具有三大优势：前瞻性而非反应性（在产生有害输出前检测危险推理结构）、全面性而非枚举性（单个价值层次信号涵盖无限数量的案例特定违规）、可测量而非主观性（基于经验性强制选择数据）。

title: Toward Accountable AI-Generated Content on Social Platforms: Steganographic Attribution and Multimodal Harm Detection
summary: The rapid growth of generative AI has introduced new challenges in content moderation and digital forensics. In particular, benign AI-generated images can be paired with harmful or misleading text, creating difficult-to-detect misuse. This contextual misuse undermines the traditional moderation framework and complicates attribution, as synthetic images typically lack persistent metadata or device signatures. We introduce a steganography enabled attribution framework that embeds cryptographically signed identifiers into images at creation time and uses multimodal harmful content detection as a trigger for attribution verification. Our system evaluates five watermarking methods across spatial, frequency, and wavelet domains. It also integrates a CLIP-based fusion model for multimodal harmful-content detection. Experiments demonstrate that spread-spectrum watermarking, especially in the wavelet domain, provides strong robustness under blur distortions, and our multimodal fusion detector achieves an AUC-ROC of 0.99, enabling reliable cross-modal attribution verification. These components form an end-to-end forensic pipeline that enables reliable tracing of harmful deployments of AI-generated imagery, supporting accountability in modern synthetic media environments. Our code is available at GitHub: https://github.com/bli1/steganography

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于隐写术的溯源框架，通过在生成图像时嵌入加密签名标识符，并结合多模态有害内容检测来触发溯源验证，以应对AI生成图像与有害文本结合使用的滥用问题。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展带来了内容审核和数字取证的新挑战。特别是良性的AI生成图像可能与有害或误导性文本配对使用，形成难以检测的滥用。这种上下文滥用破坏了传统审核框架，并使溯源变得复杂，因为合成图像通常缺乏持久的元数据或设备签名。
AI.method: 引入基于隐写术的溯源框架，在图像创建时嵌入加密签名的标识符，并使用多模态有害内容检测作为溯源验证的触发器。系统评估了五种跨空间、频率和小波域的水印方法，并集成了基于CLIP的融合模型进行多模态有害内容检测。
AI.result: 实验表明，扩频水印（特别是在小波域）在模糊失真下具有强鲁棒性，多模态融合检测器的AUC-ROC达到0.99，能够实现可靠的跨模态溯源验证。
AI.conclusion: 这些组件形成了一个端到端的取证管道，能够可靠地追踪AI生成图像的有害部署，支持现代合成媒体环境中的问责制。

title: C-ReD: A Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for AI-Generated Text Detection Derived from Real-World Prompts
summary: Recently, large language models (LLMs) are capable of generating highly fluent textual content. While they offer significant convenience to humans, they also introduce various risks, like phishing and academic dishonesty. Numerous research efforts have been dedicated to developing algorithms for detecting AI-generated text and constructing relevant datasets. However, in the domain of Chinese corpora, challenges remain, including limited model diversity and data homogeneity. To address these issues, we propose C-ReD: a comprehensive Chinese Real-prompt AI-generated Detection benchmark. Experiments demonstrate that C-ReD not only enables reliable in-domain detection but also supports strong generalization to unseen LLMs and external Chinese datasets-addressing critical gaps in model diversity, domain coverage, and prompt realism that have limited prior Chinese detection benchmarks. We release our resources at https://github.com/HeraldofLight/C-ReD.

AI.tldr: C-ReD是一个全面的中文真实提示AI生成检测基准，解决了现有中文语料库中模型多样性有限和数据同质性的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然能生成流畅文本，但也带来钓鱼、学术不端等风险。现有中文AI文本检测研究面临模型多样性有限、数据同质性的挑战。
AI.method: 提出C-ReD基准，构建包含多样化模型和真实提示的中文AI生成文本检测数据集。
AI.result: C-ReD不仅支持可靠的域内检测，还能很好地泛化到未见过的LLM和外部中文数据集，解决了模型多样性、领域覆盖和提示真实性等关键问题。
AI.conclusion: C-ReD填补了中文AI文本检测基准的关键空白，资源已在GitHub上开源。

title: Hodoscope: Unsupervised Monitoring for AI Misbehaviors
summary:
Existing approaches to monitoring AI agents rely on supervised evaluation: human-written rules or LLM-based judges that check for known failure modes. However, novel misbehaviors may fall outside predefined categories entirely and LLM-based judges can be unreliable. To address this, we formulate unsupervised monitoring, drawing an analogy to unsupervised learning. Rather than checking for specific misbehaviors, an unsupervised monitor assists humans in discovering problematic agent behaviors without prior assumptions about what counts as problematic, leaving that determination to the human.
  We observe that problematic behaviors are often distinctive: a model exploiting a benchmark loophole exhibits actions absent from well-behaved baselines, and a vulnerability unique to one evaluation manifests as behavioral anomalies when the same model runs across multiple benchmarks. This motivates using group-wise behavioral differences as the primary signal for unsupervised monitoring. We introduce Hodoscope, a tool that operationalizes this insight. Hodoscope compares behavior distributions across groups and highlights distinctive and potentially suspicious action patterns for human review. Using Hodoscope, we discover a previously unknown vulnerability in the Commit0 benchmark (unsquashed git history allowing ground-truth recovery, inflating scores for at least five models) and independently recover known exploits on ImpossibleBench and SWE-bench. Quantitative evaluation estimates that our method reduces review effort by 6-23$\times$ compared to naive uniform sampling. Finally, we show that behavior descriptions discovered through Hodoscope could improve the detection accuracy of LLM-based judges, demonstrating a path from unsupervised to supervised monitoring.

AI.tldr: 论文提出无监督监控方法Hodoscope，通过比较不同组的行为分布来发现AI代理的异常行为，无需预定义问题类别，相比传统监督方法能发现未知漏洞并减少人工审查工作量。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理监控方法依赖监督评估（人工规则或LLM评判器），但无法检测新型异常行为，且LLM评判器不可靠。需要一种无需预定义问题类别的监控方法，让人类发现潜在问题行为。
AI.method: 提出无监督监控框架Hodoscope，通过比较不同组的行为分布差异来发现异常模式。利用"问题行为通常具有独特性"的观察，对比基准模型与目标模型的行为差异，或同一模型在不同基准上的行为差异，识别潜在可疑行为供人工审查。
AI.result: 1) 在Commit0基准中发现先前未知的漏洞（未压缩的git历史允许恢复真实标签，至少5个模型得分虚高）；2) 独立重现了ImpossibleBench和SWE-bench的已知漏洞；3) 定量评估显示相比均匀采样，审查工作量减少6-23倍；4) Hodoscope发现的行为描述可提升LLM评判器的检测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 无监督监控方法能有效发现AI代理的未知问题行为，减少人工审查负担，并为从无监督监控过渡到监督监控提供了路径。Hodoscope工具展示了通过行为分布差异发现异常的有效性。

title: CLSGen: A Dual-Head Fine-Tuning Framework for Joint Probabilistic Classification and Verbalized Explanation
summary: With the recent progress of Large Language Models (LLMs), there is a growing interest in applying these models to solve complex and challenging problems. Modern LLMs, capable of processing long contexts and generating verbalized explanations, offer significant potential in addressing real-world applications. However, a critical hurdle in deploying LLMs for practical decision-making is their inability to provide reliable, quantitative probabilities. While task-specific fine-tuning of LLMs using traditional discriminative objectives (similar to encoder-only models) can yield probability estimates, this often leads to catastrophic forgetting and linguistic collapse. Consequently, the model loses its ability to generate explanations, severely undermining its interpretability and usability. To address this challenge, we propose CLSGen, a novel LLM fine-tuning framework designed for binary classification tasks. The CLSGen framework encompasses a new model architecture, training methodology, and data construction strategy to enable robust probability estimation without sacrificing the model's inherent explanation-generation capabilities. Experimental results across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that models fine-tuned with CLSGen outperform existing baselines in classification metrics (AUROC and F1-score). Regarding explanation, the results showed strong alignment between predicted labels and generated justifications, as well as high readability.

AI.tldr: CLSGen是一个用于二元分类任务的LLM微调框架，能够在保持模型解释生成能力的同时提供可靠的概率估计，解决了传统微调方法导致的灾难性遗忘和语言能力退化问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在处理复杂问题和生成解释方面有巨大潜力，但在实际决策应用中缺乏可靠的概率估计能力。传统的判别式微调方法虽然能获得概率估计，但会导致灾难性遗忘和语言能力退化，损害模型的解释性和可用性。
AI.method: CLSGen框架包含新的模型架构、训练方法和数据构建策略，专门为二元分类任务设计。该框架旨在使LLM能够进行稳健的概率估计，同时不牺牲其固有的解释生成能力。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，使用CLSGen微调的模型在分类指标（AUROC和F1分数）上优于现有基线。在解释方面，结果显示预测标签与生成理由之间有很强的对齐性，并且可读性高。
AI.conclusion: CLSGen框架成功解决了LLM在二元分类任务中概率估计与解释生成能力之间的权衡问题，为实际决策应用提供了既可靠又可解释的解决方案。

title: UDAPose: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Low-Light Human Pose Estimation
summary: Low-visibility scenarios, such as low-light conditions, pose significant challenges to human pose estimation due to the scarcity of annotated low-light datasets and the loss of visual information under poor illumination. Recent domain adaptation techniques attempt to utilize well-lit labels by augmenting well-lit images to mimic low-light conditions. But handcrafted augmentations oversimplify noise patterns, while learning-based methods often fail to preserve high-frequency low-light characteristics, producing unrealistic images that lead pose models to generalize poorly to real low-light scenes. Moreover, recent pose estimators rely on image cues through image-to-keypoint cross-attention, but these cues become unreliable under low-light conditions. To address these issues, we propose Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Pose Estimation (UDAPose), a novel framework that synthesizes low-light images and dynamically fuses visual cues with pose priors for improved pose estimation. Specifically, our synthesis method incorporates a Direct-Current-based High-Pass Filter (DHF) and a Low-light Characteristics Injection Module (LCIM) to inject high-frequency details from input low-light images, overcoming rigidity or the detail loss in existing approaches. Furthermore, we introduce a Dynamic Control of Attention (DCA) module that adaptively balances image cues with learned pose priors in the Transformer architecture. Experiments show that UDAPose outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with notable AP gains of 10.1 (56.4%) on the ExLPose-test hard set (LL-H) and 7.4 (31.4%) in cross-dataset validation on EHPT-XC. Code: https://github.com/Vision-and-Multimodal-Intelligence-Lab/UDAPose

AI.tldr: UDAPose提出了一种用于低光照条件下姿态估计的无监督域适应框架，通过合成逼真的低光照图像并动态融合视觉线索与姿态先验，显著提升了在低可见度场景下的性能。
AI.motivation: 低光照条件下的人体姿态估计面临两大挑战：缺乏标注的低光照数据集，以及现有域适应方法生成的图像不真实导致泛化能力差；同时，姿态估计器依赖的图像线索在低光照下变得不可靠。
AI.method: 提出了UDAPose框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 使用基于直流的高通滤波器(DHF)和低光照特征注入模块(LCIM)合成逼真低光照图像；2) 动态注意力控制(DCA)模块，在Transformer架构中自适应平衡图像线索与学习到的姿态先验。
AI.result: 在ExLPose-test hard set (LL-H)上获得了10.1 AP的显著提升(相对提升56.4%)，在EHPT-XC跨数据集验证上获得了7.4 AP提升(相对提升31.4%)，优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: UDAPose通过合成逼真的低光照图像并动态融合视觉线索与姿态先验，有效解决了低光照条件下姿态估计的域适应问题，显著提升了在真实低光照场景下的性能。

title: Do Agent Rules Shape or Distort? Guardrails Beat Guidance in Coding Agents
summary: Developers increasingly guide AI coding agents through natural language instruction files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules), yet no controlled study has measured whether these rules actually improve agent performance or which properties make a rule beneficial. We scrape 679 such files (25,532 rules) from GitHub and conduct the first large-scale empirical evaluation, running over 5,000 agent runs with a state-of-the-art coding agent on SWE-bench Verified. Rules improve performance by 7--14 percentage points, but random rules help as much as expert-curated ones -- suggesting rules work through context priming rather than specific instruction. Negative constraints ("do not refactor unrelated code") are the only individually beneficial rule type, while positive directives ("follow code style") actively hurt -- a pattern we analyze through the lens of potential-based reward shaping (PBRS). Moreover, individual rules are mostly harmful in isolation yet collectively helpful, with no degradation up to 50 rules. These findings expose a hidden reliability risk -- well-intentioned rules routinely degrade agent performance -- and provide a clear principle for safe agent configuration: constrain what agents must not do, rather than prescribing what they should.

AI.tldr: 研究首次大规模实证评估AI编码代理的自然语言指令文件效果，发现规则能提升7-14%性能，但随机规则与专家规则效果相当，负面约束比正面指令更有益
AI.motivation: 开发者越来越多地使用自然语言指令文件（如CLAUDE.md、.cursorrules）来指导AI编码代理，但缺乏对这些规则是否真正有效以及哪些属性使规则有益的受控研究
AI.method: 从GitHub抓取679个指令文件（25,532条规则），在SWE-bench Verified上进行了5,000多次代理运行的大规模实证评估，使用最先进的编码代理
AI.result: 规则能提升性能7-14个百分点，但随机规则与专家规则效果相当；负面约束是唯一有益的单条规则类型，而正面指令反而有害；单条规则大多有害但集体有益，最多50条规则不会导致性能下降
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了隐藏的可靠性风险——善意的规则经常降低代理性能，并提供了安全代理配置的明确原则：约束代理不能做什么，而不是规定应该做什么

title: Visual Enhanced Depth Scaling for Multimodal Latent Reasoning
summary: Multimodal latent reasoning has emerged as a promising paradigm that replaces explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) decoding with implicit feature propagation, simultaneously enhancing representation informativeness and reducing inference latency. By analyzing token-level gradient dynamics during latent training, we reveal two critical observations: (1) visual tokens exhibit significantly higher and more volatile gradient norms than their textual counterparts due to inherent language bias, resulting in systematic visual under-optimization; and (2) semantically simple tokens converge rapidly, whereas complex tokens exhibit persistent gradient instability constrained by fixed architectural depths. To address these limitations, we propose a visual replay module and routing depth scaling to collaboratively enhance visual perception and refine complicated latents for deeper contextual reasoning. The former module leverages causal self-attention to estimate token saliency, reinforcing fine-grained grounding through spatially-coherent constraints. Complementarily, the latter mechanism adaptively allocates additional reasoning steps to complex tokens, enabling deeper contextual refinement. Guided by a curriculum strategy that progressively internalizes explicit CoT into compact latent representations, our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks while delivering substantial inference speedups over explicit CoT baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态潜在推理框架，通过视觉重放模块和路由深度缩放来解决视觉token优化不足和复杂token收敛不稳定的问题，在保持高性能的同时显著提升推理速度。
AI.motivation: 多模态潜在推理虽然能增强表示信息量并减少推理延迟，但存在两个关键问题：1）视觉token由于语言偏见导致梯度规范显著高于文本token，造成系统性视觉优化不足；2）语义简单的token快速收敛，而复杂token在固定架构深度下表现出持续的梯度不稳定性。
AI.method: 提出视觉重放模块和路由深度缩放机制。视觉重放模块利用因果自注意力估计token显著性，通过空间一致约束增强细粒度接地；路由深度缩放自适应地为复杂token分配额外推理步骤，实现更深层次的上下文细化。采用课程策略逐步将显式CoT内化为紧凑的潜在表示。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能，同时相比显式CoT基线提供了显著的推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过分析梯度动态揭示了多模态潜在推理的关键瓶颈，提出的视觉重放和深度缩放机制有效解决了视觉优化不足和复杂token收敛问题，实现了高性能与高效率的平衡。

title: Frugal Knowledge Graph Construction with Local LLMs: A Zero-Shot Pipeline, Self-Consistency and Wisdom of Artificial Crowds
comment: Source code and raw results available: https://github.com/jourlin/synsynth (licence Hypocratic)
summary: This paper presents an empirical study of a multi-model zero-shot pipeline for knowledge graph construction and exploitation, executed entirely through local inference on consumer-grade hardware. We propose a reproducible evaluation framework integrating two external benchmarks (DocRED, HotpotQA), WebQuestionsSP-style synthetic data, and the RAGAS evaluation framework in an automated pipeline. On 500 document-level relations, our system achieves an F1 of 0.70 $\pm$ 0.041 in zero-shot, compared to 0.80 for supervised DREEAM. Text-to-query achieves an accuracy of 0.80 $\pm$ 0.06 on 200 samples. Multi-hop reasoning achieves an Exact Match (EM) of 0.46$\pm$0.04 on 500 HotpotQA questions, with a RAGAS faithfulness of 0.96 $\pm$ 0.04 on 50 samples. Beyond the pipeline, we study diversity mechanisms for difficult multi-hop reasoning. On 181 questions unsolvable at zero temperature, self-consistency (k=5, T =0.7) recovers up to 23% EM with a single Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, but the cross-model oracle (3 architectures x 5 samples) reaches 46.4%. We highlight an agreement paradox: strong consensus among samples signals collective hallucination rather than a reliable answer, echoing the work of Moussa{ï}d et al. on the wisdom of crowds. Extending to the full pipeline (500 questions), self-consistency (k=3) raises EM from 0.46 to 0.48 $\pm$ 0.04. A confidence-routing cascade mechanism (Phi-4 $\rightarrow$ GPT-OSS, k=5) achieves an EM of 0.55 $\pm$ 0.04, the best result obtained, with 45.4% of questions rerouted. Finally, we show that V3 prompt engineering applied to other models does not reproduce the gains observed with Gemma-4, confirming the specific prompt/model interaction. The entire system runs in $\sim$5 h on a single RTX 3090, without any training, for an estimated carbon footprint of 0.09 kg CO2 eq.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在消费级硬件上本地运行的多模型零样本知识图谱构建与利用管道，通过集成多个外部基准和评估框架，实现了高效的零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探索在消费级硬件上完全通过本地推理实现知识图谱构建与利用的可能性，降低计算成本和碳足迹，同时保持与监督方法竞争的性能。
AI.method: 方法包括：1）构建可复现的评估框架，集成DocRED、HotpotQA等外部基准和RAGAS评估框架；2）采用多模型零样本管道；3）研究多样性机制（如自一致性采样）处理困难的多跳推理；4）提出置信度路由级联机制；5）分析提示工程与模型的特定交互。
AI.result: 主要结果：1）在500个文档级关系上实现F1=0.70±0.041（零样本），接近监督方法DREEAM的0.80；2）文本到查询准确率0.80±0.06；3）多跳推理EM=0.46±0.04；4）自一致性采样将EM从0.46提升到0.48±0.04；5）置信度路由级联机制达到最佳EM=0.55±0.04；6）系统在单RTX 3090上运行约5小时，碳足迹仅0.09kg CO2 eq。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明：1）在消费级硬件上本地运行的多模型零样本管道是可行的，且性能接近监督方法；2）多样性机制能有效提升困难推理任务的性能；3）存在"一致性悖论"——强共识可能反映集体幻觉而非可靠答案；4）提示工程效果具有模型特异性；5）该方法具有低计算成本和环境友好性。

title: FreeScale: Scaling 3D Scenes via Certainty-Aware Free-View Generation
summary: The development of generalizable Novel View Synthesis (NVS) models is critically limited by the scarcity of large-scale training data featuring diverse and precise camera trajectories. While real-world captures are photorealistic, they are typically sparse and discrete. Conversely, synthetic data scales but suffers from a domain gap and often lacks realistic semantics. We introduce FreeScale, a novel framework that leverages the power of scene reconstruction to transform limited real-world image sequences into a scalable source of high-quality training data. Our key insight is that an imperfect reconstructed scene serves as a rich geometric proxy, but naively sampling from it amplifies artifacts. To this end, we propose a certainty-aware free-view sampling strategy identifying novel viewpoints that are both semantically meaningful and minimally affected by reconstruction errors. We demonstrate FreeScale's effectiveness by scaling up the training of feedforward NVS models, achieving a notable gain of 2.7 dB in PSNR on challenging out-of-distribution benchmarks. Furthermore, we show that the generated data can actively enhance per-scene 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization, leading to consistent improvements across multiple datasets. Our work provides a practical and powerful data generation engine to overcome a fundamental bottleneck in 3D vision. Project page: https://mvp-ai-lab.github.io/FreeScale.

AI.tldr: FreeScale框架利用场景重建将有限的真实世界图像序列转化为可扩展的高质量训练数据，通过确定性感知自由视角采样策略解决重建误差问题，显著提升新视角合成模型的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 新视角合成模型的泛化能力受到大规模多样化训练数据稀缺的限制。真实世界捕获数据稀疏离散，合成数据存在领域差距且缺乏真实语义，需要一种能够生成高质量可扩展训练数据的方法。
AI.method: 提出FreeScale框架，利用不完美的重建场景作为几何代理，采用确定性感知自由视角采样策略，识别语义有意义且受重建误差影响最小的新视角，生成高质量训练数据。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的分布外基准测试中，PSNR提升了2.7 dB；生成的数据还能增强每场景3D高斯溅射优化，在多个数据集上实现一致改进。
AI.conclusion: FreeScale提供了一个实用且强大的数据生成引擎，克服了3D视觉中的基本瓶颈，能够显著提升新视角合成模型的训练效果和泛化能力。

title: Persona Non Grata: Single-Method Safety Evaluation Is Incomplete for Persona-Imbued LLMs
summary: Personality imbuing customizes LLM behavior, but safety evaluations almost always study prompt-based personas alone. We show this is incomplete: prompting and activation steering expose *different*, architecture-dependent vulnerability profiles, and testing with only one method can miss a model's dominant failure mode. Across 5,568 judged conditions on four standard models from three architecture families, persona danger rankings under system prompting are preserved across all architectures ($ρ= 0.71$--$0.96$), but activation-steering vulnerability diverges sharply and cannot be predicted from prompt-side rankings: Llama-3.1-8B is substantially more AS-vulnerable, whereas Gemma-3-27B and Qwen3.5 are more vulnerable to prompting. The most striking illustration of this divergence is the *prosocial persona paradox*: on Llama-3.1-8B, P12 (high conscientiousness + high agreeableness) is among the safest personas under prompting yet becomes the highest-ASR activation-steered persona (ASR ~0.818). This is an inversion robust to coefficient ablation and matched-strength calibration, and replicated on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B. A trait refusal alignment framework, in which conscientiousness is strongly anti-aligned with refusal on Llama-3.1-8B, offers a partial geometric account. Reasoning provides only partial protection: two 32B reasoning models reach 15--18% prompt-side ASR, and activation steering separates them sharply in both baseline susceptibility and persona-specific vulnerability. Heuristic trace diagnostics suggest that the safer model retains stronger policy recall and self-correction behavior, not merely longer reasoning.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM人格注入的安全评估仅依赖提示方法是不完整的，激活引导会暴露不同的架构依赖性漏洞，两种方法的危险人格排名存在显著差异
AI.motivation: 当前LLM人格注入的安全评估主要依赖提示方法，但这种方法可能不完整，需要研究不同人格注入方法（提示与激活引导）对模型安全性的影响差异
AI.method: 在4个标准模型（来自3种架构家族）上进行5,568个条件评估，比较系统提示和激活引导两种人格注入方法的安全性表现，分析人格特质与拒绝行为的关系
AI.result: 提示方法下的人格危险排名在所有架构中保持一致性（ρ=0.71-0.96），但激活引导的漏洞模式显著不同且无法从提示侧排名预测；Llama-3.1-8B对激活引导更敏感，而Gemma-3-27B和Qwen3.5对提示更敏感；发现"亲社会人格悖论"现象
AI.conclusion: LLM安全评估需要同时考虑提示和激活引导两种方法，因为它们暴露不同的架构依赖性漏洞；仅依赖一种方法可能错过模型的主要失效模式

title: MADQRL: Distributed Quantum Reinforcement Learning Framework for Multi-Agent Environments
comment: Accepted in QC4C3 Workshop at IEEE QCNC, 2026
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is one of the most practical ways to learn from real-life use-cases. Motivated from the cognitive methods used by humans makes it a widely acceptable strategy in the field of artificial intelligence. Most of the environments used for RL are often high-dimensional, and traditional RL algorithms becomes computationally expensive and challenging to effectively learn from such systems. Recent advancements in practical demonstration of quantum computing (QC) theories, such as compact encoding, enhanced representation and learning algorithms, random sampling, or the inherent stochastic nature of quantum systems, have opened up new directions to tackle these challenges. Quantum reinforcement learning (QRL) is seeking significant traction over the past few years. However, the current state of quantum hardware is not enough to cater for such high-dimensional environments with complex multi-agent setup. To tackle this issue, we propose a distributed framework for QRL where multiple agents learn independently, distributing the load of joint training from individual machines. Our method works well for environments with disjoint sets of action and observation spaces, but can also be extended to other systems with reasonable approximations. We analyze the proposed method on cooperative-pong environment and our results indicate ~10% improvement from other distribution strategies, and ~5% improvement from classical models of policy representation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种分布式量子强化学习框架，通过多个智能体独立学习来分担训练负载，在合作式乒乓球环境中相比其他分布式策略提升约10%，相比经典策略表示模型提升约5%。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习算法在处理高维环境时计算成本高昂且具有挑战性，而当前量子硬件尚不足以应对复杂多智能体设置的高维环境，因此需要一种分布式框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出分布式量子强化学习框架，让多个智能体独立学习，将联合训练的负载从单个机器分配到多个智能体上。该方法适用于动作和观察空间不相交的环境，也可通过合理近似扩展到其他系统。
AI.result: 在合作式乒乓球环境中测试，结果显示相比其他分布式策略有约10%的改进，相比经典策略表示模型有约5%的改进。
AI.conclusion: 分布式量子强化学习框架能够有效解决当前量子硬件在处理高维复杂环境时的局限性，通过负载分配实现了性能提升，为量子强化学习的实际应用提供了可行方案。

title: STORM: End-to-End Referring Multi-Object Tracking in Videos
summary: Referring multi-object tracking (RMOT) is a task of associating all the objects in a video that semantically match with given textual queries or referring expressions. Existing RMOT approaches decompose object grounding and tracking into separated modules and exhibit limited performance due to the scarcity of training videos, ambiguous annotations, and restricted domains. In this work, we introduce STORM, an end-to-end MLLM that jointly performs grounding and tracking within a unified framework, eliminating external detectors and enabling coherent reasoning over appearance, motion, and language. To improve data efficiency, we propose a task-composition learning (TCL) strategy that decomposes RMOT into image grounding and object tracking, allowing STORM to leverage data-rich sub-tasks and learn structured spatial--temporal reasoning. We further construct STORM-Bench, a new RMOT dataset with accurate trajectories and diverse, unambiguous referring expressions generated through a bottom-up annotation pipeline. Extensive experiments show that STORM achieves state-of-the-art performance on image grounding, single-object tracking, and RMOT benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization and robust spatial--temporal grounding in complex real-world scenarios. STORM-Bench is released at https://github.com/amazon-science/storm-referring-multi-object-grounding.

AI.tldr: STORM是一个端到端的多模态大语言模型，统一执行指代多目标跟踪中的目标定位和跟踪任务，通过任务组合学习策略和数据丰富的新基准数据集实现最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有指代多目标跟踪方法将目标定位和跟踪分解为独立模块，存在训练视频稀缺、标注模糊、领域受限等问题，导致性能受限。
AI.method: 提出STORM端到端MLLM，统一执行定位和跟踪；采用任务组合学习策略，将RMOT分解为图像定位和对象跟踪两个子任务；构建STORM-Bench数据集，包含准确轨迹和多样化的指代表达式。
AI.result: STORM在图像定位、单目标跟踪和RMOT基准测试中达到最先进性能，展示了在复杂真实场景中的强泛化能力和鲁棒时空定位能力。
AI.conclusion: STORM通过统一的端到端框架、任务组合学习策略和高质量数据集，显著提升了指代多目标跟踪的性能，为复杂真实场景下的时空推理提供了有效解决方案。

title: BareBones: Benchmarking Zero-Shot Geometric Comprehension in VLMs
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable zero-shot recognition capabilities across a diverse spectrum of multimodal tasks, it yet remains an open question whether these architectures genuinely comprehend geometric structure or merely exploit RGB textures and contextual priors as statistical shortcuts. Existing evaluations fail to isolate this mechanism, conflating semantic reasoning with texture mapping and relying on imprecise annotations that inadvertently leak environmental cues. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{BareBones}, a zero-shot benchmark designed to stress-test pure geometric shape comprehension. We curate pixel-level silhouettes of geometrically distinct classes across six datasets: five established segmentation sources (ImageNet-S, DIS5K, ThinObject5K, PASCAL VOC, CUB-200) and our novel flagship collection, WTP-Bench, establishing a noise-free geometric taxonomy. WTP-Bench is an extreme, fine-grained visual puzzle that forces models to identify inter-class geometric concepts from boundary contours alone. Our evaluation of 26 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight VLMs (\eg, GPT-4.1, Gemini, Claude Sonnet 4.5, LLaVA) reveals a consistent, severe performance collapse under RGB deprivation, a phenomenon we term the \textit{Texture Bias Cliff}. By documenting universal structural blindspots, BareBones establishes a rigorous yardstick for genuine geometric grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BareBones基准测试，用于评估视觉语言模型在纯几何形状理解上的能力，发现现有模型在RGB纹理被剥夺时性能严重下降，存在"纹理偏置悬崖"现象。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法无法分离视觉语言模型对几何结构的真正理解能力，混淆了语义推理与纹理映射，且依赖可能泄露环境线索的不精确标注。需要设计一个能测试纯几何形状理解的基准。
AI.method: 创建BareBones零样本基准，包含像素级几何轮廓的六个数据集（ImageNet-S、DIS5K、ThinObject5K、PASCAL VOC、CUB-200和新的WTP-Bench），建立无噪声几何分类学。WTP-Bench是一个极细粒度的视觉谜题，迫使模型仅从边界轮廓识别类间几何概念。
AI.result: 评估26个最先进的专有和开源视觉语言模型（如GPT-4.1、Gemini、Claude Sonnet 4.5、LLaVA），发现在RGB纹理被剥夺时出现一致且严重的性能崩溃，称为"纹理偏置悬崖"现象。
AI.conclusion: BareBones通过记录普遍存在的结构盲点，为真正的几何基础理解建立了严格的衡量标准，揭示了当前视觉语言模型在几何理解上的局限性。

title: The Second Challenge on Real-World Face Restoration at NTIRE 2026: Methods and Results
comment: NTIRE 26: https://cvlai.net/ntire/2026 . NTIRE Real-World Face Restoration: https://ntire-face.github.io/2026/ . CVPR 2026 Workshop
summary: This paper provides a review of the NTIRE 2026 challenge on real-world face restoration, highlighting the proposed solutions and the resulting outcomes. The challenge focuses on generating natural and realistic outputs while maintaining identity consistency. Its goal is to advance state-of-the-art solutions for perceptual quality and realism, without imposing constraints on computational resources or training data. Performance is evaluated using a weighted image quality assessment (IQA) score and employs the AdaFace model as an identity checker. The competition attracted 96 registrants, with 10 teams submitting valid models; ultimately, 9 teams achieved valid scores in the final ranking. This collaborative effort advances the performance of real-world face restoration while offering an in-depth overview of the latest trends in the field.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026人脸修复挑战赛综述：聚焦真实世界人脸修复，评估自然度与身份一致性，共有96个注册者，10个团队提交有效模型
AI.motivation: 推动真实世界人脸修复技术的发展，提升感知质量和真实感，同时保持身份一致性，为领域提供最新趋势概述
AI.method: 采用加权图像质量评估(IQA)分数作为性能评价标准，使用AdaFace模型作为身份一致性检查器，不限制计算资源或训练数据
AI.result: 挑战赛吸引了96个注册者，10个团队提交了有效模型，最终9个团队在最终排名中获得有效分数
AI.conclusion: 该协作努力推动了真实世界人脸修复的性能，同时提供了该领域最新趋势的深入概述

title: Measuring the Authority Stack of AI Systems: Empirical Analysis of 366,120 Forced-Choice Responses Across 8 AI Models
comment: 18 pages, 15 tables, no figures. AIO Working Paper. Companion to: S. Lee (2026a)
summary: What values, evidence preferences, and source trust hierarchies do AI systems actually exhibit when facing structured dilemmas? We present the first large-scale empirical mapping of AI decision-making across all three layers of the Authority Stack framework (S. Lee, 2026a): value priorities (L4), evidence-type preferences (L3), and source trust hierarchies (L2). Using the PRISM benchmark -- a forced-choice instrument of 14,175 unique scenarios per layer, spanning 7 professional domains, 3 severity levels, 3 decision timeframes, and 5 scenario variants -- we evaluated 8 major AI models at temperature 0, yielding 366,120 total responses. Key findings include: (1) a symmetric 4:4 split between Universalism-first and Security-first models at L4; (2) dramatic defense-domain value restructuring where Security surges to near-ceiling win-rates (95.1%-99.8%) in 6 of 8 models; (3) divergent evidence hierarchies at L3, with some models favoring empirical-scientific evidence while others prefer pattern-based or experiential evidence; (4) broad convergence on institutional source trust at L2; and (5) Paired Consistency Scores (PCS) ranging from 57.4% to 69.2%, revealing substantial framing sensitivity across scenario variants. Test-Retest Reliability (TRR) ranges from 91.7% to 98.6%, indicating that value instability stems primarily from variant sensitivity rather than stochastic noise. These findings demonstrate that AI models possess measurable -- if sometimes unstable -- Authority Stacks with consequential implications for deployment across professional domains.

AI.tldr: 首次大规模实证研究AI系统在结构化困境中的决策模式，使用PRISM基准测试8个主流AI模型，揭示了AI在价值优先级、证据偏好和来源信任层次上的可测量但不稳定的权威栈结构。
AI.motivation: 探究AI系统在面对结构化困境时实际表现出的价值观、证据偏好和来源信任层次，填补AI决策行为实证研究的空白，为AI在不同专业领域的部署提供依据。
AI.method: 采用PRISM基准测试工具，包含每层14,175个独特场景，涵盖7个专业领域、3个严重程度、3个决策时间框架和5个场景变体。在温度0设置下评估8个主要AI模型，共收集366,120个响应。
AI.result: 1) L4层价值优先级：模型在普遍主义优先和安全优先之间对称分裂(4:4)；2) 国防领域价值重构：6个模型中安全价值胜率飙升至95.1%-99.8%；3) L3层证据偏好分歧：部分偏好经验科学证据，部分偏好模式或经验证据；4) L2层来源信任：广泛收敛于制度性来源；5) 配对一致性分数57.4%-69.2%，显示场景变体敏感性；重测信度91.7%-98.6%，表明价值不稳定性主要源于变体敏感性而非随机噪声。
AI.conclusion: AI模型拥有可测量的权威栈结构，但存在不稳定性，这对AI在不同专业领域的部署具有重要影响。研究为理解AI决策行为提供了实证基础，并揭示了AI价值系统的复杂性和领域依赖性。

title: Bidirectional Learning of Facial Action Units and Expressions via Structured Semantic Mapping across Heterogeneous Datasets
summary: Facial action unit (AU) detection and facial expression (FE) recognition can be jointly viewed as affective facial behavior tasks, representing fine-grained muscular activations and coarse-grained holistic affective states, respectively. Despite their inherent semantic correlation, existing studies predominantly focus on knowledge transfer from AUs to FEs, while bidirectional learning remains insufficiently explored. In practice, this challenge is further compounded by heterogeneous data conditions, where AU and FE datasets differ in annotation paradigms (frame-level vs.\ clip-level), label granularity, and data availability and diversity, hindering effective joint learning. To address these issues, we propose a Structured Semantic Mapping (SSM) framework for bidirectional AU--FE learning under different data domains and heterogeneous supervision. SSM consists of three key components: (1) a shared visual backbone that learns unified facial representations from dynamic AU and FE videos; (2) semantic mediation via a Textual Semantic Prototype (TSP) module, which constructs structured semantic prototypes from fixed textual descriptions augmented with learnable context prompts, serving as supervision signals and cross-task alignment anchors in a shared semantic space; and (3) a Dynamic Prior Mapping (DPM) module that incorporates prior knowledge derived from the Facial Action Coding System and learns a data-driven association matrix in a high-level feature space, enabling explicit and bidirectional knowledge transfer. Extensive experiments on popular AU detection and FE recognition benchmarks show that SSM achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks simultaneously, and demonstrate that holistic expression semantics can in turn enhance fine-grained AU learning even across heterogeneous datasets.

AI.tldr: SSM框架通过结构化语义映射实现AU检测和FE识别的双向学习，解决了异构数据条件下的联合学习问题，在两个任务上同时达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注从AU到FE的单向知识迁移，而双向学习探索不足。实际应用中，AU和FE数据集在标注范式、标签粒度、数据可用性和多样性方面存在异构性，阻碍了有效的联合学习。
AI.method: 提出结构化语义映射(SSM)框架，包含三个关键组件：1)共享视觉主干网络学习统一的面部表示；2)文本语义原型(TSP)模块通过可学习上下文提示构建结构化语义原型；3)动态先验映射(DPM)模块结合FACS先验知识并学习数据驱动的关联矩阵。
AI.result: 在流行的AU检测和FE识别基准测试中，SSM在两个任务上同时实现了最先进的性能，并证明整体表情语义可以反过来增强细粒度的AU学习，即使在异构数据集之间也是如此。
AI.conclusion: SSM框架通过结构化语义映射成功解决了异构数据条件下的AU-FE双向学习问题，实现了两个任务间的相互增强，为情感面部行为分析提供了有效的联合学习方案。

title: Mobile GUI Agent Privacy Personalization with Trajectory Induced Preference Optimization
summary: Mobile GUI agents powered by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can execute complex tasks on mobile devices. Despite this progress, most existing systems still optimize task success or efficiency, neglecting users' privacy personalization. In this paper, we study the often-overlooked problem of agent personalization. We observe that personalization can induce systematic structural heterogeneity in execution trajectories. For example, privacy-first users often prefer protective actions, e.g., refusing permissions, logging out, and minimizing exposure, leading to logically different execution trajectories from utility-first users. Such variable-length and structurally different trajectories make standard preference optimization unstable and less informative. To address this issue, we propose Trajectory Induced Preference Optimization (TIPO), which uses preference-intensity weighting to emphasize key privacy-related steps and padding gating to suppress alignment noise. Results on our Privacy Preference Dataset show that TIPO improves persona alignment and distinction while preserving strong task executability, achieving 65.60% SR, 46.22 Compliance, and 66.67% PD, outperforming existing optimization methods across various GUI tasks. The code and dataset will be publicly released at https://github.com/Zhixin-L/TIPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TIPO方法，通过轨迹诱导偏好优化解决移动GUI代理中的隐私个性化问题，在保持任务执行能力的同时提升个性化对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有移动GUI代理系统主要优化任务成功率和效率，忽视了用户的隐私个性化需求。隐私优先用户倾向于采取保护性操作（如拒绝权限、退出登录等），导致执行轨迹与效用优先用户存在系统性结构差异，而标准偏好优化方法难以处理这种变长且结构不同的轨迹。
AI.method: 提出轨迹诱导偏好优化（TIPO）方法，包含两个关键技术：1）偏好强度加权，强调隐私相关关键步骤；2）填充门控，抑制对齐噪声。该方法专门处理个性化导致的轨迹结构异质性。
AI.result: 在隐私偏好数据集上的实验表明，TIPO在保持强任务执行能力的同时，显著提升了个性化对齐和区分度，达到65.60%成功率、46.22合规率和66.67%个性化区分度，优于现有优化方法。
AI.conclusion: TIPO方法有效解决了移动GUI代理中的隐私个性化问题，通过处理轨迹结构异质性实现了更好的个性化对齐，同时保持了任务执行能力，为隐私敏感的智能代理系统提供了新的优化思路。

title: Differentiable Vector Quantization for Rate-Distortion Optimization of Generative Image Compression
comment: Accepted for publication at CVPR 2026 as an Oral presentation
summary: The rapid growth of visual data under stringent storage and bandwidth constraints makes extremely low-bitrate image compression increasingly important. While Vector Quantization (VQ) offers strong structural fidelity, existing methods lack a principled mechanism for joint rate-distortion (RD) optimization due to the disconnect between representation learning and entropy modeling. We propose RDVQ, a unified framework that enables end-to-end RD optimization for VQ-based compression via a differentiable relaxation of the codebook distribution, allowing the entropy loss to directly shape the latent prior. We further develop an autoregressive entropy model that supports accurate entropy modeling and test-time rate control. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RDVQ achieves strong performance at extremely low bitrates with a lightweight architecture, attaining competitive or superior perceptual quality with significantly fewer parameters. Compared with RDEIC, RDVQ reduces bitrate by up to 75.71% on DISTS and 37.63% on LPIPS on DIV2K-val. Beyond empirical gains, RDVQ introduces an entropy-constrained formulation of VQ, highlighting the potential for a more unified view of image tokenization and compression. The code will be available at https://github.com/CVL-UESTC/RDVQ.

AI.tldr: RDVQ是一个统一的VQ压缩框架，通过可微的码书分布松弛实现端到端率失真优化，在极低比特率下实现高性能图像压缩。
AI.motivation: 在存储和带宽受限条件下，极低比特率图像压缩需求日益增长。现有VQ方法缺乏联合率失真优化的原则性机制，因为表示学习和熵建模之间存在脱节。
AI.method: 提出RDVQ统一框架：1）通过码书分布的可微松弛实现端到端率失真优化，让熵损失直接塑造潜在先验；2）开发自回归熵模型，支持精确熵建模和测试时码率控制。
AI.result: RDVQ在极低比特率下实现强大性能，轻量级架构获得竞争性或更优的感知质量，参数显著减少。相比RDEIC，在DIV2K-val上DISTS比特率降低75.71%，LPIPS降低37.63%。
AI.conclusion: RDVQ不仅带来实证增益，还引入了VQ的熵约束公式，为图像标记化和压缩提供了更统一的视角。

title: Inspectable AI for Science: A Research Object Approach to Generative AI Governance
summary: This paper introduces AI as a Research Object (AI-RO), a paradigm for governing the use of generative AI in scientific research. Instead of debating whether AI is an author or merely a tool, we propose treating AI interactions as structured, inspectable components of the research process. Under this view, the legitimacy of an AI-assisted scientific paper depends on how model use is integrated into the workflow, documented, and made accountable. Drawing on Research Object theory and FAIR principles, we propose a framework for recording model configuration, prompts, and outputs through interaction logs and metadata packaging. These properties are particularly consequential in security and privacy (S&P) research, where provenance artifacts must satisfy confidentiality constraints, integrity guarantees, and auditability requirements that generic disclosure practices do not address. We implement a lightweight writing pipeline in which a language model synthesizes human-authored structured literature review notes under explicit constraints and produces a verifiable provenance record. We present this work as a position supported by an initial demonstrative workflow, arguing that governance of generative AI in science can be implemented as structured documentation, controlled disclosure, and integrity-preserving provenance capture. Based on this example, we outline and motivate a set of necessary future developments required to make such practices practical and widely adoptable.

AI.tldr: 提出AI作为研究对象的范式，将生成式AI在科研中的使用视为结构化、可审查的研究过程组件，强调通过记录模型配置、提示和输出来实现可追溯性和问责制。
AI.motivation: 解决生成式AI在科学研究中使用的治理问题，超越"AI是作者还是工具"的争论，建立可追溯、可审计的AI辅助研究框架，特别是在安全与隐私研究领域需要满足机密性、完整性和可审计性要求。
AI.method: 基于研究对象理论和FAIR原则，提出记录模型配置、提示和输出的框架，通过交互日志和元数据打包实现结构化文档；实现轻量级写作流程，让语言模型在明确约束下合成结构化文献综述笔记并生成可验证的溯源记录。
AI.result: 提出了AI-RO范式框架，实现了演示性工作流程，展示了如何通过结构化文档、受控披露和完整性保护的溯源捕获来治理科学中的生成式AI使用。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI在科学中的治理可以通过结构化文档、受控披露和完整性保护的溯源捕获来实现，需要进一步发展相关实践使其实用且广泛可采纳。

title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Short-form UGC Video Restoration in the Wild with Generative Models: Datasets, Methods and Results
summary: This paper presents an overview of the NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Short-form UGC Video Restoration in the Wild with Generative Models. This challenge utilizes a new short-form UGC (S-UGC) video restoration benchmark, termed KwaiVIR, which is contributed by USTC and Kuaishou Technology. It contains both synthetically distorted videos and real-world short-form UGC videos in the wild. For this edition, the released data include 200 synthetic training videos, 48 wild training videos, 11 validation videos, and 20 testing videos. The primary goal of this challenge is to establish a strong and practical benchmark for restoring short-form UGC videos under complex real-world degradations, especially in the emerging paradigm of generative-model-based S-UGC video restoration.
