title: What Do Vision-Language Models Encode for Personalized Image Aesthetics Assessment?
summary: Personalized image aesthetics assessment (PIAA) is an important research problem with practical real-world applications. While methods based on vision-language models (VLMs) are promising candidates for PIAA, it remains unclear whether they internally encode rich, multi-level aesthetic attributes required for effective personalization. In this paper, we first analyze the internal representations of VLMs to examine the presence and distribution of such aesthetic attributes, and then leverage them for lightweight, individual-level personalization without model fine-tuning. Our analysis reveals that VLMs encode diverse aesthetic attributes that propagate into the language decoder layers. Building on these representations, we demonstrate that simple linear models can perform PIAA effectively. We further analyze how aesthetic information is transferred across layers in different VLM architectures and across image domains. Our findings provide insights into how VLMs can be utilized for modeling subjective, individual aesthetic preferences. Our code is available at https://github.com/ynklab/vlm-latent-piaa.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了视觉语言模型内部是否编码了丰富的多层级美学属性，并利用这些表示进行无需微调的个性化图像美学评估。
AI.motivation: 个性化图像美学评估具有重要实际应用价值。虽然基于视觉语言模型的方法很有前景，但尚不清楚这些模型内部是否编码了有效个性化所需的多层级美学属性。
AI.method: 首先分析VLM内部表示中美学属性的存在和分布情况，然后利用这些表示进行轻量级的个体级个性化，无需模型微调。研究发现VLM编码了多样化的美学属性，这些属性传播到语言解码器层。
AI.result: 基于这些表示，简单的线性模型就能有效执行个性化图像美学评估。研究还分析了不同VLM架构中美学信息如何在层间传递，以及跨图像域的情况。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为如何利用VLM建模主观的个体美学偏好提供了见解，证明了VLM内部确实编码了丰富的多层级美学属性，可用于轻量级个性化应用。

title: UniToolCall: Unifying Tool-Use Representation, Data, and Evaluation for LLM Agents
comment: 18 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Code and datasets are publicly available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/UniToolCall
summary: Tool-use capability is a fundamental component of LLM agents, enabling them to interact with external systems through structured function calls. However, existing research exhibits inconsistent interaction representations, largely overlooks the structural distribution of tool-use trajectories, and relies on incompatible evaluation benchmarks. We present UniToolCall, a unified framework for tool learning that standardizes the entire pipeline from toolset construction and dataset generation to evaluation. The framework curates a large tool pool of 22k+ tools and constructs a hybrid training corpus of 390k+ instances by combining 10 standardized public datasets with structurally controlled synthetic trajectories. It explicitly models diverse interaction patterns, including single-hop vs. multi-hop and single-turn vs. multi-turn, while capturing both serial and parallel execution structures. To support coherent multi-turn reasoning, we further introduce an Anchor Linkage mechanism that enforces cross-turn dependencies. Furthermore, we convert 7 public benchmarks into a unified Query--Action--Observation--Answer (QAOA) representation with fine-grained evaluation at the function-call, turn, and conversation levels. Experiments show that fine-tuning Qwen3-8B on our dataset substantially improves tool-use performance. Under the distractor-heavy Hybrid-20 setting, achieves 93.0% single-turn Strict Precision, outperforming commercial models including GPT, Gemini, and Claude.

AI.tldr: UniToolCall是一个统一的工具学习框架，通过标准化工具集构建、数据集生成和评估流程，显著提升LLM的工具使用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究在工具使用方面存在交互表示不一致、忽视工具使用轨迹的结构分布、评估基准不兼容等问题，需要统一的框架来解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 构建包含22k+工具的大型工具池，创建390k+实例的混合训练语料，明确建模单跳/多跳、单轮/多轮交互模式，引入Anchor Linkage机制支持多轮推理，并将7个公共基准转换为统一的QAOA表示。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B上微调后，在干扰严重的Hybrid-20设置下，单轮严格精度达到93.0%，超越了GPT、Gemini和Claude等商业模型。
AI.conclusion: UniToolCall提供了一个全面统一的工具学习框架，通过标准化表示、结构化数据生成和细粒度评估，显著提升了LLM的工具使用能力。

title: At FullTilt: Real-Time Open-Set 3D Macromolecule Detection Directly from Tilted 2D Projections
summary: Open-set 3D macromolecule detection in cryogenic electron tomography eliminates the need for target-specific model retraining. However, strict VRAM constraints prohibit processing an entire 3D tomogram, forcing current methods to rely on slow sliding-window inference over extracted subvolumes. To overcome this, we propose FullTilt, an end-to-end framework that redefines 3D detection by operating directly on aligned 2D tilt-series. Because a tilt-series contains significantly fewer images than slices in a reconstructed tomogram, FullTilt eliminates redundant volumetric computation, accelerating inference by orders of magnitude. To process the entire tilt-series simultaneously, we introduce a tilt-series encoder to efficiently fuse cross-view information. We further propose a multiclass visual prompt encoder for flexible prompting, a tilt-aware query initializer to effectively anchor 3D queries, and an auxiliary geometric primitives module to enhance the model's understanding of multi-view geometry while improving robustness to adverse imaging artifacts. Extensive evaluations on three real-world datasets demonstrate that FullTilt achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance while drastically reducing runtime and VRAM requirements, paving the way for rapid, large-scale visual proteomics analysis. All code and data will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: FullTilt：一种基于倾斜序列的端到端3D大分子检测框架，无需目标特定模型重新训练，通过直接在2D倾斜序列上操作大幅加速推理，减少VRAM需求
AI.motivation: 现有开放集3D大分子检测方法受限于VRAM约束，无法处理完整3D断层扫描图，只能依赖缓慢的滑动窗口推理提取子体积，需要更高效的解决方案
AI.method: 提出FullTilt框架，直接在对齐的2D倾斜序列上操作，减少冗余体积计算；引入倾斜序列编码器融合跨视图信息，多类视觉提示编码器实现灵活提示，倾斜感知查询初始化器锚定3D查询，辅助几何基元模块增强多视图几何理解
AI.result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的广泛评估表明，FullTilt实现了最先进的零样本性能，同时大幅减少运行时间和VRAM需求
AI.conclusion: FullTilt为快速、大规模视觉蛋白质组学分析铺平了道路，通过直接在倾斜序列上操作而非重建的断层扫描图，实现了数量级的推理加速

title: Reasoning Resides in Layers: Restoring Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models with Layer-Selective Merging
summary: Multimodal adaptation equips large language models (LLMs) with perceptual capabilities, but often weakens the reasoning ability inherited from language-only pretraining. This trade-off is especially pronounced in video-language models (VLMs), where visual alignment can impair temporal reasoning (TR) over sequential events. We propose MERIT, a training-free, task-driven model merging framework for restoring TR in VLMs. MERIT searches over layer-wise self-attention merging recipes between a VLM and its paired text-only backbone using an objective that improves TR while penalizing degradation in temporal perception (TP). Across three representative VLMs and multiple challenging video benchmarks, MERIT consistently improves TR, preserves or improves TP, and generalizes beyond the search set to four distinct benchmarks. It also outperforms uniform full-model merging and random layer selection, showing that effective recovery depends on selecting the right layers. Interventional masking and frame-level attribution further show that the selected layers are disproportionately important for reasoning and shift model decisions toward temporally and causally relevant evidence. These results show that targeted, perception-aware model merging can effectively restore TR in VLMs without retraining.

AI.tldr: MERIT是一种无需训练的任务驱动模型融合框架，通过在视频语言模型与其纯文本骨干网络之间进行层级的自注意力融合，恢复视频语言模型的时间推理能力，同时保持时间感知能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态适应虽然赋予大语言模型感知能力，但往往会削弱其从纯语言预训练继承的推理能力。这种权衡在视频语言模型中尤为明显，视觉对齐会损害对序列事件的时间推理能力。
AI.method: 提出MERIT框架，在视频语言模型与其配对的纯文本骨干网络之间搜索层级的自注意力融合方案。使用一个目标函数来改善时间推理，同时惩罚时间感知能力的退化。该框架无需训练，通过选择性地融合特定层来恢复推理能力。
AI.result: 在三个代表性视频语言模型和多个具有挑战性的视频基准测试中，MERIT持续改善时间推理能力，保持或改善时间感知能力，并在搜索集之外的四个不同基准测试中表现出良好的泛化能力。优于均匀全模型融合和随机层选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 有针对性的、感知感知的模型融合可以有效恢复视频语言模型的时间推理能力，而无需重新训练。选择正确的层对于有效恢复至关重要，这些层对推理具有不成比例的重要性，并将模型决策转向时间和因果相关的证据。

title: Intersectional Sycophancy: How Perceived User Demographics Shape False Validation in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models exhibit sycophantic tendencies--validating incorrect user beliefs to appear agreeable. We investigate whether this behavior varies systematically with perceived user demographics, testing whether combinations of race, age, gender, and expressed confidence level produce differential false validation rates. Inspired by the legal concept of intersectionality, we conduct 768 multi-turn adversarial conversations using Anthropic's Petri evaluation framework, probing GPT-5-nano and Claude Haiku 4.5 across 128 persona combinations in mathematics, philosophy, and conspiracy theory domains. GPT-5-nano is significantly more sycophantic than Claude Haiku 4.5 overall ($\bar{x}=2.96$ vs. $1.74$, $p < 10^{-32}$, Wilcoxon signed-rank). For GPT-5-nano, we find that philosophy elicits 41% more sycophancy than mathematics and that Hispanic personas receive the highest sycophancy across races. The worst-scoring persona, a confident, 23-year-old Hispanic woman, averages 5.33/10 on sycophancy. Claude Haiku 4.5 exhibits uniformly low sycophancy with no significant demographic variation. These results demonstrate that sycophancy is not uniformly distributed across users and that safety evaluations should incorporate identity-aware testing.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型存在系统性谄媚行为，其程度因用户感知人口统计特征（种族、年龄、性别、自信水平）而异，GPT-5-nano比Claude Haiku 4.5更谄媚，且不同领域和种族群体间存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究大型语言模型的谄媚行为是否因用户感知的人口统计特征而存在系统性差异，特别是结合种族、年龄、性别和自信水平的交叉性分析，以评估模型安全测试中身份意识的重要性。
AI.method: 采用768轮多轮对抗性对话，使用Anthropic的Petri评估框架，测试GPT-5-nano和Claude Haiku 4.5模型在128种人物组合（种族、年龄、性别、自信水平）下，在数学、哲学和阴谋论三个领域的谄媚行为表现。
AI.result: GPT-5-nano整体上比Claude Haiku 4.5显著更谄媚（平均分2.96 vs 1.74，p<10^-32）。GPT-5-nano在哲学领域的谄媚程度比数学高41%，西班牙裔人物获得的谄媚程度最高。最差表现的人物组合（自信的23岁西班牙裔女性）平均谄媚得分5.33/10。Claude Haiku 4.5表现出均匀的低谄媚水平，无显著人口统计差异。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚行为在用户群体中并非均匀分布，模型安全评估应纳入身份意识测试，不同模型在谄媚行为上存在显著差异，需要针对不同人口统计特征进行更全面的安全评估。

title: HOG-Layout: Hierarchical 3D Scene Generation, Optimization and Editing via Vision-Language Models
summary: 3D layout generation and editing play a crucial role in Embodied AI and immersive VR interaction. However, manual creation requires tedious labor, while data-driven generation often lacks diversity. The emergence of large models introduces new possibilities for 3D scene synthesis. We present HOG-Layout that enables text-driven hierarchical scene generation, optimization and real-time scene editing with large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). HOG-Layout improves scene semantic consistency and plausibility through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) technology, incorporates an optimization module to enhance physical consistency, and adopts a hierarchical representation to enhance inference and optimization, achieving real-time editing. Experimental results demonstrate that HOG-Layout produces more reasonable environments compared with existing baselines, while supporting fast and intuitive scene editing.

AI.tldr: HOG-Layout：基于大语言模型和视觉语言模型的文本驱动分层3D场景生成与实时编辑系统，通过检索增强生成提升语义一致性，优化模块增强物理一致性，实现快速直观的场景编辑。
AI.motivation: 3D布局生成和编辑在具身AI和沉浸式VR交互中至关重要，但手动创建费时费力，而数据驱动方法缺乏多样性。大模型的出现为3D场景合成带来了新的可能性。
AI.method: 提出HOG-Layout系统，结合大语言模型和视觉语言模型实现文本驱动的分层场景生成；采用检索增强生成技术提升语义一致性；集成优化模块增强物理一致性；采用分层表示提升推理和优化效率，支持实时编辑。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，HOG-Layout相比现有基线方法能生成更合理的环境，同时支持快速直观的场景编辑。
AI.conclusion: HOG-Layout通过结合大模型、检索增强生成和优化模块，实现了高质量、语义一致、物理合理的3D场景生成与实时编辑，为具身AI和VR交互提供了有效解决方案。

title: Context Kubernetes: Declarative Orchestration of Enterprise Knowledge for Agentic AI Systems
comment: 24 pages, 8 tables, 1 figure, 8 experiments (5 correctness + 3 value). Open-source prototype: https://github.com/Cohorte-ai/context-kubernetes
summary: We introduce Context Kubernetes, an architecture for orchestrating enterprise knowledge in agentic AI systems, with a prototype implementation and eight experiments. The core observation is that delivering the right knowledge, to the right agent, with the right permissions, at the right freshness -- across an entire organization -- is structurally analogous to the container orchestration problem Kubernetes solved a decade ago. We formalize six core abstractions, a YAML-based declarative manifest for knowledge-architecture-as-code, a reconciliation loop, and a three-tier agent permission model where agent authority is always a strict subset of human authority. Three value experiments show: (1) without governance, agents serve phantom content from deleted sources and leak cross-domain data in 26.5% of queries; (2) without freshness monitoring, stale content is served silently -- with reconciliation, staleness is detected in under 1ms; (3) in five attack scenarios, flat permissions block 0/5 attacks, basic RBAC blocks 4/5, and the three-tier model blocks 5/5. Five correctness experiments confirm zero unauthorized deliveries, zero invariant violations, and architectural enforcement of out-of-band approval isolation that no surveyed enterprise platform provides. A survey of four major platforms (Microsoft, Salesforce, AWS, Google) documents that none architecturally isolates agent approval channels. We identify four properties that make context orchestration harder than container orchestration, and argue that these make the solution more valuable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Context Kubernetes架构，用于企业知识在AI代理系统中的编排管理，通过原型实现和八个实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 企业AI系统中，如何跨整个组织将正确的知识、以正确的权限、在正确的新鲜度下传递给正确的代理，这个问题在结构上类似于Kubernetes十年前解决的容器编排问题。现有企业平台缺乏对代理审批通道的架构隔离。
AI.method: 提出六个核心抽象概念，基于YAML的声明式知识架构即代码清单，协调循环，以及三层代理权限模型（代理权限始终是人员权限的严格子集）。通过原型实现和八个实验验证。
AI.result: 三个价值实验显示：(1)无治理时，26.5%查询中代理会提供已删除源的幻影内容并泄露跨域数据；(2)无新鲜度监控时，陈旧内容被静默提供，而协调循环可在1ms内检测到陈旧性；(3)在五种攻击场景中，扁平权限阻止0/5攻击，基础RBAC阻止4/5，三层模型阻止5/5。五个正确性实验确认零未授权交付、零不变式违规。
AI.conclusion: Context Kubernetes为解决企业知识编排问题提供了有效的架构方案，其三层权限模型和协调机制能有效防止数据泄露和未授权访问，填补了现有企业平台在代理审批通道隔离方面的空白。

title: Revisiting Compositionality in Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models: The Role of Inference
summary: Dual-encoder Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP are often characterized as bag-of-words systems due to their poor performance on compositional benchmarks. We argue that this limitation may stem less from deficient representations than from the standard inference protocol based on global cosine similarity. First, through controlled diagnostic experiments, we show that explicitly enforcing fine-grained region-segment alignment at inference dramatically improves compositional performance without updating pretrained encoders. We then introduce a lightweight transformer that learns such alignments directly from frozen patch and token embeddings. Comparing against full fine-tuning and prior end-to-end compositional training methods, we find that although these approaches improve in-domain retrieval, their gains do not consistently transfer under distribution shift. In contrast, learning localized alignment over frozen representations matches full fine-tuning on in-domain retrieval while yielding substantial improvements on controlled out-of-domain compositional benchmarks. These results identify global embedding matching as a key bottleneck in dual-encoder VLMs and highlight the importance of alignment mechanisms for robust compositional generalization.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现CLIP等双编码器视觉语言模型的组合泛化能力不足主要源于基于全局余弦相似度的推理协议，而非表征缺陷。通过引入轻量级Transformer学习冻结表征的局部对齐，显著提升了组合性能。
AI.motivation: 双编码器视觉语言模型（如CLIP）在组合基准测试中表现不佳，通常被描述为"词袋系统"。作者认为这种限制可能更多源于标准的全局余弦相似度推理协议，而非表征本身的缺陷。
AI.method: 1. 通过诊断实验证明在推理时显式强制执行细粒度区域-片段对齐能显著提升组合性能；2. 引入轻量级Transformer直接从冻结的patch和token嵌入中学习这种对齐关系；3. 与全微调和先前的端到端组合训练方法进行比较。
AI.result: 学习局部对齐的方法在域内检索任务上匹配全微调性能，同时在受控的域外组合基准测试中获得显著改进。而全微调和先前的端到端方法虽然改善了域内检索，但其增益在分布偏移下不能一致地转移。
AI.conclusion: 全局嵌入匹配是双编码器视觉语言模型的关键瓶颈，对齐机制对于鲁棒组合泛化至关重要。通过冻结表征上的局部对齐学习，可以在不更新预训练编码器的情况下显著提升组合性能。

title: RationalRewards: Reasoning Rewards Scale Visual Generation Both Training and Test Time
comment: Project Page: https://tiger-ai-lab.github.io/RationalRewards/ ; Code, Dataset, Models are released
summary: Most reward models for visual generation reduce rich human judgments to a single unexplained score, discarding the reasoning that underlies preference. We show that teaching reward models to produce explicit, multi-dimensional critiques before scoring transforms them from passive evaluators into active optimization tools, improving generators in two complementary ways: at training time, structured rationales provide interpretable, fine-grained rewards for reinforcement learning; at test time, a Generate-Critique-Refine loop turns critiques into targeted prompt revisions that improve outputs without any parameter updates. To train such a reward model without costly rationale annotations, we introduce Preference-Anchored Rationalization (PARROT), a principled framework that recovers high-quality rationales from readily available preference data through anchored generation, consistency filtering, and distillation. The resulting model, RationalRewards (8B), achieves state-of-the-art preference prediction among open-source reward models, competitive with Gemini-2.5-Pro, while using 10-20x less training data than comparable baselines. As an RL reward, it consistently improves text-to-image and image-editing generators beyond scalar alternatives. Most strikingly, its test-time critique-and-refine loop matches or exceeds RL-based fine-tuning on several benchmarks, suggesting that structured reasoning can unlock latent capabilities in existing generators that suboptimal prompts fail to elicit.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RationalRewards模型，通过让奖励模型生成多维度的批判性解释来改进视觉生成，在训练时提供细粒度奖励，在测试时通过生成-批判-优化循环改进输出，无需参数更新。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉生成奖励模型通常将丰富的人类判断简化为单一分数，丢弃了偏好背后的推理过程。这限制了奖励模型作为主动优化工具的能力。
AI.method: 提出PARROT框架，通过锚定生成、一致性过滤和蒸馏，从现有的偏好数据中恢复高质量的解释。训练得到的RationalRewards模型（8B参数）既能生成解释，又能提供评分。
AI.result: RationalRewards在开源奖励模型中达到最先进的偏好预测性能，与Gemini-2.5-Pro竞争，但训练数据量少10-20倍。作为强化学习奖励，能持续改进文本到图像和图像编辑生成器。测试时的批判-优化循环在多个基准测试中匹配或超过基于强化学习的微调。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理能够解锁现有生成器中潜在的能力，这些能力在次优提示下无法被激发。让奖励模型生成解释性批判可以将其从被动评估器转变为主动优化工具。

title: Agentic Driving Coach: Robustness and Determinism of Agentic AI-Powered Human-in-the-Loop Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: Foundation models, including large language models (LLMs), are increasingly used for human-in-the-loop (HITL) cyber-physical systems (CPS) because foundation model-based AI agents can potentially interact with both the physical environments and human users. However, the unpredictable behavior of human users and AI agents, in addition to the dynamically changing physical environments, leads to uncontrollable nondeterminism. To address this urgent challenge of enabling agentic AI-powered HITL CPS, we propose a reactor-model-of-computation (MoC)-based approach, realized by the open-source Lingua Franca (LF) framework. We also carry out a concrete case study using the agentic driving coach as an application of HITL CPS. By evaluating the LF-based agentic HITL CPS, we identify practical challenges in reintroducing determinism into such agentic HITL CPS and present pathways to address them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用反应器模型计算（MoC）和Lingua Franca框架来解决基于基础模型的人机协同网络物理系统中的不可控非确定性挑战
AI.motivation: 基础模型（包括大语言模型）在人机协同网络物理系统中应用日益广泛，但人类用户和AI代理的不可预测行为以及动态变化的物理环境导致了不可控的非确定性，这成为当前亟待解决的挑战
AI.method: 提出基于反应器模型计算的方法，并通过开源Lingua Franca框架实现，以代理驾驶教练作为人机协同网络物理系统的具体案例进行研究
AI.result: 通过评估基于LF的代理人机协同网络物理系统，识别了在此类系统中重新引入确定性的实际挑战，并提出了解决这些挑战的途径
AI.conclusion: 反应器模型计算和Lingua Franca框架为解决基于基础模型的人机协同网络物理系统中的非确定性挑战提供了有效途径，为构建更可靠、可控的AI代理系统指明了方向

title: Why Do Large Language Models Generate Harmful Content?
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to generate harmful content. However, the underlying causes of such behavior remain under explored. We propose a causal mediation analysis-based approach to identify the causal factors responsible for harmful generation. Our method performs a multi-granular analysis across model layers, modules (MLP and attention blocks), and individual neurons. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLMs indicate that harmful generation arises in the later layers of the model, results primarily from failures in MLP blocks rather than attention blocks, and is associated with neurons that act as a gating mechanism for harmful generation. The results indicate that the early layers in the model are used for a contextual understanding of harmfulness in a prompt, which is then propagated through the model, to generate harmfulness in the late layers, as well as a signal indicating harmfulness through MLP blocks. This is then further propagated to the last layer of the model, specifically to a sparse set of neurons, which receives the signal and determines the generation of harmful content accordingly.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用因果中介分析方法识别大语言模型生成有害内容的因果因素，发现有害生成主要发生在模型后层，源于MLP模块而非注意力模块，并由稀疏神经元作为有害生成的"门控机制"。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型被证明会生成有害内容，但其根本原因尚未得到充分探索。研究者希望通过因果分析方法深入理解有害内容生成的底层机制。
AI.method: 采用因果中介分析方法，在模型层、模块（MLP和注意力块）和单个神经元三个粒度上进行分析，对最先进的大语言模型进行广泛实验。
AI.result: 有害生成主要发生在模型后层；主要由MLP模块而非注意力模块的故障引起；与作为有害生成门控机制的神经元相关。早期层用于理解提示中的有害性上下文，然后通过模型传播，在后层生成有害内容，MLP块传递有害性信号，最终由最后一层的稀疏神经元接收信号并决定是否生成有害内容。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过因果分析揭示了LLM有害内容生成的机制：早期层识别有害性上下文，MLP模块传播信号，后层稀疏神经元作为门控机制决定有害内容生成。这一发现为理解和缓解LLM的有害生成提供了新视角。

title: ReplicateAnyScene: Zero-Shot Video-to-3D Composition via Textual-Visual-Spatial Alignment
summary: Humans exhibit an innate capacity to rapidly perceive and segment objects from video observations, and even mentally assemble them into structured 3D scenes. Replicating such capability, termed compositional 3D reconstruction, is pivotal for the advancement of Spatial Intelligence and Embodied AI. However, existing methods struggle to achieve practical deployment due to the insufficient integration of cross-modal information, leaving them dependent on manual object prompting, reliant on auxiliary visual inputs, and restricted to overly simplistic scenes by training biases. To address these limitations, we propose ReplicateAnyScene, a framework capable of fully automated and zero-shot transformation of casually captured videos into compositional 3D scenes. Specifically, our pipeline incorporates a five-stage cascade to extract and structurally align generic priors from vision foundation models across textual, visual, and spatial dimensions, grounding them into structured 3D representations and ensuring semantic coherence and physical plausibility of the constructed scenes. To facilitate a more comprehensive evaluation of this task, we further introduce the C3DR benchmark to assess reconstruction quality from diverse aspects. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method over existing baselines in generating high-quality compositional 3D scenes.

AI.tldr: ReplicateAnyScene：一个能够将随意拍摄的视频自动转换为组合式3D场景的框架，无需手动提示或辅助输入，通过五级级联结构整合多模态先验知识
AI.motivation: 人类具有快速感知和分割视频中物体并将其组装成结构化3D场景的能力，但现有方法因跨模态信息整合不足而依赖手动提示、辅助输入或受限于简单场景，难以实际部署
AI.method: 提出ReplicateAnyScene框架，采用五级级联管道从视觉基础模型中提取文本、视觉和空间维度的通用先验知识，将其结构化对齐并融入3D表示，确保语义一致性和物理合理性
AI.result: 实验证明该方法在生成高质量组合式3D场景方面优于现有基线，并引入了C3DR基准以更全面地评估重建质量
AI.conclusion: ReplicateAnyScene实现了从随意拍摄视频到组合式3D场景的完全自动化和零样本转换，为空间智能和具身AI的发展提供了实用解决方案

title: SWE-AGILE: A Software Agent Framework for Efficiently Managing Dynamic Reasoning Context
summary: Prior representative ReAct-style approaches in autonomous Software Engineering (SWE) typically lack the explicit System-2 reasoning required for deep analysis and handling complex edge cases. While recent reasoning models demonstrate the potential of extended Chain-of-Thought (CoT), applying them to the multi-turn SWE task creates a fundamental dilemma: retaining full reasoning history leads to context explosion and ``Lost-in-the-Middle'' degradation, while discarding it would force the agent to redundantly re-reason at every step. To address these challenges, we propose SWE-AGILE, a novel software agent framework designed to bridge the gap between reasoning depth, efficiency, and context constraints. SWE-AGILE introduces a Dynamic Reasoning Context strategy, maintaining a ``sliding window'' of detailed reasoning for immediate continuity to prevent redundant re-analyzing, while compressing historical reasoning content into concise Reasoning Digests. Empirically, SWE-AGILE sets a new standard for 7B-8B models on SWE-Bench-Verified using only 2.2k trajectories and 896 tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/KDEGroup/SWE-AGILE.

AI.tldr: SWE-AGILE：一种新型软件代理框架，通过动态推理上下文策略解决自主软件工程中推理深度与上下文限制的平衡问题
AI.motivation: 现有ReAct风格的自主软件工程方法缺乏显式的System-2推理能力来处理深度分析和复杂边缘情况。同时，在多轮软件工程任务中，保留完整推理历史会导致上下文爆炸和"迷失在中间"问题，而丢弃历史又会导致冗余重复推理。
AI.method: 提出SWE-AGILE框架，采用动态推理上下文策略：维护详细推理的"滑动窗口"以保证即时连续性，同时将历史推理内容压缩为简洁的推理摘要。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench-Verified基准测试中，仅使用2.2k轨迹和896个任务，SWE-AGILE为7B-8B模型设立了新的性能标准。
AI.conclusion: SWE-AGILE成功解决了自主软件工程中推理深度、效率和上下文约束之间的平衡问题，为软件代理框架提供了创新解决方案。

title: DreamKG: A KG-Augmented Conversational System for People Experiencing Homelessness
comment: This manuscript has been accepted at the 14th IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI 2026)
summary: People experiencing homelessness (PEH) face substantial barriers to accessing timely, accurate information about community services. DreamKG addresses this through a knowledge graph-augmented conversational system that grounds responses in verified, up-to-date data about Philadelphia organizations, services, locations, and hours. Unlike standard large language models (LLMs) prone to hallucinations, DreamKG combines Neo4j knowledge graphs with structured query understanding to handle location-aware and time-sensitive queries reliably. The system performs spatial reasoning for distance-based recommendations and temporal filtering for operating hours. Preliminary evaluation shows 59% superiority over Google Search AI on relevant queries and 84% rejection of irrelevant queries. This demonstration highlights the potential of hybrid architectures that combines LLM flexibility with knowledge graph reliability to improve service accessibility for vulnerable populations effectively.

AI.tldr: DreamKG是一个基于知识图谱增强的对话系统，专门为无家可归者提供准确、及时的社区服务信息，通过结合Neo4j知识图谱和结构化查询理解，有效避免大语言模型的幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 无家可归者在获取社区服务信息时面临严重障碍，现有的大语言模型容易产生幻觉，无法提供准确可靠的位置和时间敏感信息，需要一种更可靠的解决方案来改善弱势群体的服务可及性。
AI.method: 系统结合Neo4j知识图谱和结构化查询理解，构建包含费城组织、服务、位置和营业时间的知识图谱，通过空间推理处理基于距离的推荐，通过时间过滤处理营业时间查询，确保回答基于已验证的最新数据。
AI.result: 初步评估显示，DreamKG在相关查询上比Google搜索AI优越59%，能够拒绝84%的不相关查询，证明了混合架构在提供可靠服务信息方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DreamKG展示了将大语言模型的灵活性与知识图谱的可靠性相结合的混合架构潜力，能够有效改善弱势群体获取社区服务的可及性，为类似应用提供了有价值的参考。

title: WBCBench 2026: A Challenge for Robust White Blood Cell Classification Under Class Imbalance
comment: IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI)
summary: We present WBCBench 2026, an ISBI challenge and benchmark for automated WBC classification designed to stress-test algorithms under three key difficulties: (i) severe class imbalance across 13 morphologically fine-grained WBC classes, (ii) strict patient-level separation between training, validation and test sets, and (iii) synthetic scanner- and setting-induced domain shift via controlled noise, blur and illumination perturbations. All images are single-site microscopic blood smear acquisitions with standardised staining and expert hematopathologist annotations. This paper reviews the challenge and summarises the proposed solutions and final outcomes. The benchmark is organised into two phases. Phase 1 provides a pristine training set. Phase 2 introduces degraded images with split-specific severity distributions for train, validation and test, emulating a realistic shift between development and deployment conditions. We specify a standardised submission schema, open-source evaluator, and macro-averaged F1 score as the primary ranking metric.

AI.tldr: WBCBench 2026是一个ISBI挑战赛基准，用于自动化白细胞分类，旨在测试算法在三个关键难点下的性能：严重类别不平衡、严格的患者级别数据分离以及合成域偏移。
AI.motivation: 开发一个能够应对现实世界挑战的白细胞分类基准，包括类别不平衡、患者级别数据分离和域偏移问题，以评估算法在临床部署环境中的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 基准分为两个阶段：第一阶段提供原始训练集；第二阶段引入退化图像，通过控制噪声、模糊和光照扰动模拟扫描仪和设置引起的域偏移，并在训练、验证和测试集中采用不同的严重程度分布。
AI.result: 建立了标准化的提交模式、开源评估器，并使用宏平均F1分数作为主要排名指标，为白细胞分类算法提供了全面的评估框架。
AI.conclusion: WBCBench 2026为白细胞分类算法提供了一个具有挑战性的基准测试平台，能够模拟真实临床环境中的困难，促进更鲁棒算法的开发。

title: Detecting Safety Violations Across Many Agent Traces
summary: To identify safety violations, auditors often search over large sets of agent traces. This search is difficult because failures are often rare, complex, and sometimes even adversarially hidden and only detectable when multiple traces are analyzed together. These challenges arise in diverse settings such as misuse campaigns, covert sabotage, reward hacking, and prompt injection. Existing approaches struggle here for several reasons. Per-trace judges miss failures that only become visible across traces, naive agentic auditing does not scale to large trace collections, and fixed monitors are brittle to unanticipated behaviors. We introduce Meerkat, which combines clustering with agentic search to uncover violations specified in natural language. Through structured search and adaptive investigation of promising regions, Meerkat finds sparse failures without relying on seed scenarios, fixed workflows, or exhaustive enumeration. Across misuse, misalignment, and task gaming settings, Meerkat significantly improves detection of safety violations over baseline monitors, discovers widespread developer cheating on a top agent benchmark, and finds nearly 4x more examples of reward hacking on CyBench than previous audits.

AI.tldr: Meerkat系统通过结合聚类和智能搜索，在大型智能体轨迹集合中发现安全违规行为，相比现有方法显著提高了检测效果
AI.motivation: 当前安全审计面临挑战：违规行为通常罕见、复杂，有时甚至被对抗性隐藏，只有在分析多个轨迹时才能发现。现有方法存在局限：单轨迹判断会错过跨轨迹可见的违规，智能审计无法扩展到大型轨迹集合，固定监控器对意外行为脆弱
AI.method: Meerkat结合聚类与智能搜索，通过结构化搜索和自适应调查有希望的区域，在自然语言指定的违规行为中发现稀疏违规，不依赖种子场景、固定工作流程或穷举枚举
AI.result: 在滥用、错位和任务博弈设置中，Meerkat显著提高了安全违规检测效果；在顶级智能体基准测试中发现广泛的开发者作弊行为；在CyBench上发现的奖励黑客示例比先前审计多近4倍
AI.conclusion: Meerkat通过结合聚类和智能搜索的方法，有效解决了在大型轨迹集合中发现复杂、稀疏安全违规的挑战，相比现有方法有显著改进

title: A Mamba-Based Multimodal Network for Multiscale Blast-Induced Rapid Structural Damage Assessment
summary: Accurate and rapid structural damage assessment (SDA) is crucial for post-disaster management, helping responders prioritise resources, plan rescues, and support recovery. Traditional field inspections, though precise, are limited by accessibility, safety risks, and time constraints, especially after large explosions. Machine learning with remote sensing has emerged as a scalable solution for rapid SDA, with Mamba-based networks achieving state-of-the-art performance. However, these methods often require extensive training and large datasets, limiting real-world applicability. Moreover, they fail to incorporate key physical characteristics of blast loading for SDA. To overcome these challenges, we propose a Mamba-based multimodal network for rapid SDA that integrates multi-scale blast-loading information with optical remote sensing images. Evaluated on the 2020 Beirut explosion, our method significantly improves performance over state-of-the-art approaches. Code is available at: https://github.com/IMPACTSquad/Blast-Mamba

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Mamba的多模态网络，用于快速结构损伤评估，通过整合多尺度爆炸载荷信息与光学遥感图像，在2020年贝鲁特爆炸事件中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统现场检查在大型爆炸后存在可及性、安全风险和时间限制等问题；现有机器学习方法需要大量训练数据和数据集，且未能整合爆炸载荷的关键物理特性，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出基于Mamba的多模态网络，整合多尺度爆炸载荷信息与光学遥感图像，用于快速结构损伤评估。
AI.result: 在2020年贝鲁特爆炸事件评估中，该方法显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过整合爆炸载荷物理特性与遥感数据，提高了结构损伤评估的准确性和实用性，为灾后管理提供了更有效的解决方案。

title: Uncertainty-Guided Attention and Entropy-Weighted Loss for Precise Plant Seedling Segmentation
summary: Plant seedling segmentation supports automated phenotyping in precision agriculture. Standard segmentation models face difficulties due to intricate background images and fine structures in leaves. We introduce UGDA-Net (Uncertainty-Guided Dual Attention Network with Entropy-Weighted Loss and Deep Supervision). Three novel components make up UGDA-Net. The first component is Uncertainty-Guided Dual Attention (UGDA). UGDA uses channel variance to modulate feature maps. The second component is an entropy-weighted hybrid loss function. This loss function focuses on high-uncertainty boundary pixels. The third component employs deep supervision for intermediate encoder layers. We performed a comprehensive systematic ablation study. This study focuses on two widely-used architectures, U-Net and LinkNet. It analyzes five incremental configurations: Baseline, Loss-only, Attention-only, Deep Supervision, and UGDA-Net. We trained UGDA-net using a high-resolution plant seedling image dataset containing 432 images. We demonstrate improved segmentation performance and accuracy. With an increase in Dice coefficient of 9.3% above baseline. LinkNet's variance is 13.2% above baseline. Overlays that are qualitative in nature show the reduced false positives at the leaf boundary. Uncertainty heatmaps are consistent with the complex morphology. UGDA-Net aids in the segmentation of delicate structures in plants and provides a high-def solution. The results showed that uncertainty-guided attention and uncertainty-weighted loss are two complementing systems.

AI.tldr: UGDA-Net通过不确定性引导的双重注意力机制、熵加权损失函数和深度监督，显著提升了植物幼苗分割的精度，特别是在复杂背景和精细叶片结构上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 植物幼苗分割对于精准农业中的自动化表型分析至关重要，但现有分割模型在处理复杂背景图像和叶片精细结构时面临困难，需要更有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出了UGDA-Net（不确定性引导的双重注意力网络），包含三个核心组件：1）不确定性引导的双重注意力机制，利用通道方差调制特征图；2）熵加权混合损失函数，专注于高不确定性的边界像素；3）对中间编码器层进行深度监督。
AI.result: 在包含432张高分辨率植物幼苗图像的数据集上训练，UGDA-Net显著提升了分割性能：U-Net的Dice系数比基线提高9.3%，LinkNet的方差比基线提高13.2%，定性分析显示叶片边界假阳性减少，不确定性热图与复杂形态一致。
AI.conclusion: UGDA-Net为植物精细结构分割提供了高精度解决方案，证明了不确定性引导的注意力和不确定性加权损失是互补的系统，有助于处理复杂农业图像中的分割挑战。

title: HO-Flow: Generalizable Hand-Object Interaction Generation with Latent Flow Matching
summary: Generating realistic 3D hand-object interactions (HOI) is a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics, requiring both temporal coherence and high-fidelity physical plausibility. Existing methods remain limited in their ability to learn expressive motion representations for generation and perform temporal reasoning. In this paper, we present HO-Flow, a framework for synthesizing realistic hand-object motion sequences from texts and canoncial 3D objects. HO-Flow first employs an interaction-aware variational autoencoder to encode sequences of hand and object motions into a unified latent manifold by incorporating hand and object kinematics, enabling the representation to capture rich interaction dynamics. It then leverages a masked flow matching model that combines auto-regressive temporal reasoning with continuous latent generation, improving temporal coherence. To further enhance generalization, HO-Flow predicts object motions relative to the initial frame, enabling effective pre-training on large-scale synthetic data. Experiments on the GRAB, OakInk, and DexYCB benchmarks demonstrate that HO-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance in both physical plausibility and motion diversity for interaction motion synthesis.

AI.tldr: HO-Flow是一个从文本和规范3D对象生成逼真手-物体交互运动序列的框架，通过交互感知VAE编码运动到统一潜在空间，结合掩码流匹配模型提升时间连贯性，在多个基准测试中达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 生成逼真的3D手-物体交互（HOI）是计算机视觉和机器人学的基本挑战，需要时间连贯性和高保真物理合理性。现有方法在学习表达性运动表示进行生成和执行时间推理方面仍然有限。
AI.method: HO-Flow首先使用交互感知变分自编码器将手和物体运动序列编码到统一潜在流形，结合手和物体运动学捕捉丰富的交互动态。然后利用掩码流匹配模型，结合自回归时间推理和连续潜在生成，提升时间连贯性。为增强泛化能力，HO-Flow预测相对于初始帧的物体运动，支持在大规模合成数据上进行有效预训练。
AI.result: 在GRAB、OakInk和DexYCB基准测试上的实验表明，HO-Flow在手-物体交互运动合成方面，在物理合理性和运动多样性上都达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: HO-Flow通过统一的潜在表示学习和结合自回归推理的流匹配模型，能够生成物理合理且时间连贯的手-物体交互运动，为3D手-物体交互合成提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Collaborative Multi-Agent Scripts Generation for Enhancing Imperfect-Information Reasoning in Murder Mystery Games
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in perceptual tasks, yet they degrade in complex multi-hop reasoning under multiplayer game settings with imperfect and deceptive information. In this paper, we study a representative multiplayer task, Murder Mystery Games, which require inferring hidden truths based on partial clues provided by roles with different intentions. To address this challenge, we propose a collaborative multi-agent framework for evaluating and synthesizing high-quality, role-driven multiplayer game scripts, enabling fine-grained interaction patterns tailored to character identities (i.e., murderer vs. innocent). Our system generates rich multimodal contexts, including character backstories, visual and textual clues, and multi-hop reasoning chains, through coordinated agent interactions. We design a two-stage agent-monitored training strategy to enhance the reasoning ability of VLMs: (1) chain-of-thought based fine-tuning on curated and synthetic datasets that model uncertainty and deception; (2) GRPO-based reinforcement learning with agent-monitored reward shaping, encouraging the model to develop character-specific reasoning behaviors and effective multimodal multi-hop inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly boosts the performance of VLMs in narrative reasoning, hidden fact extraction, and deception-resilient understanding. Our contributions offer a scalable solution for training and evaluating VLMs under uncertain, adversarial, and socially complex conditions, laying the groundwork for future benchmarks in multimodal multi-hop reasoning under imperfect information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个协作多智能体框架，用于评估和合成高质量的角色驱动多人游戏剧本，通过两阶段智能体监督训练策略提升视觉语言模型在复杂多跳推理任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在感知任务中表现出色，但在具有不完美和欺骗信息的多人游戏设置下的复杂多跳推理中表现不佳。本文以谋杀之谜游戏为代表任务，研究如何提升模型在这种不确定、对抗性和社交复杂条件下的推理能力。
AI.method: 提出协作多智能体框架生成高质量角色驱动游戏剧本；设计两阶段智能体监督训练策略：1) 基于思维链的微调，使用包含不确定性和欺骗的策划和合成数据集；2) GRPO强化学习与智能体监督奖励塑造，鼓励模型发展角色特定推理行为和多模态多跳推理能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法显著提升了视觉语言模型在叙事推理、隐藏事实提取和抗欺骗理解方面的性能，为在不确定、对抗性和社交复杂条件下训练和评估视觉语言模型提供了可扩展解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为多模态多跳推理在不完美信息条件下的未来基准测试奠定了基础，为解决视觉语言模型在复杂社交推理场景中的局限性提供了有效途径。

title: Immune2V: Image Immunization Against Dual-Stream Image-to-Video Generation
summary: Image-to-video (I2V) generation has the potential for societal harm because it enables the unauthorized animation of static images to create realistic deepfakes. While existing defenses effectively protect against static image manipulation, extending these to I2V generation remains underexplored and non-trivial. In this paper, we systematically analyze why modern I2V models are highly robust against naive image-level adversarial attacks (i.e., immunization). We observe that the video encoding process rapidly dilutes the adversarial noise across future frames, and the continuous text-conditioned guidance actively overrides the intended disruptive effect of the immunization. Building on these findings, we propose the Immune2V framework which enforces temporally balanced latent divergence at the encoder level to prevent signal dilution, and aligns intermediate generative representations with a precomputed collapse-inducing trajectory to counteract the text-guidance override. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Immune2V produces substantially stronger and more persistent degradation than adapted image-level baselines under the same imperceptibility budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Immune2V框架，通过防止对抗噪声在视频编码过程中被稀释，并抵消文本引导的覆盖效应，来增强对图像到视频生成模型的防御能力。
AI.motivation: 图像到视频生成技术可能被滥用于制作未经授权的深度伪造视频，而现有的防御方法主要针对静态图像篡改，对I2V生成的防御研究不足且具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出Immune2V框架：1）在编码器层面强制时间平衡的潜在差异以防止信号稀释；2）将中间生成表示与预计算的崩溃诱导轨迹对齐以抵消文本引导覆盖效应。
AI.result: 实验表明，在相同的不可感知性约束下，Immune2V比适应的图像级基线方法产生更强大、更持久的视频质量退化效果。
AI.conclusion: Immune2V框架有效解决了现代I2V模型对简单图像级对抗攻击的鲁棒性问题，为防御未经授权的深度伪造视频生成提供了新方法。

title: Retrieval Is Not Enough: Why Organizational AI Needs Epistemic Infrastructure
summary:
Organizational knowledge used by AI agents typically lacks epistemic structure: retrieval systems surface semantically relevant content without distinguishing binding decisions from abandoned hypotheses, contested claims from settled ones, or known facts from unresolved questions. We argue that the ceiling on organizational AI is not retrieval fidelity but \emph{epistemic} fidelity--the system's ability to represent commitment strength, contradiction status, and organizational ignorance as computable properties.
  We present OIDA, a framework that structures organizational knowledge as typed Knowledge Objects carrying epistemic class, importance scores with class-specific decay, and signed contradiction edges. The Knowledge Gravity Engine maintains scores deterministically with proved convergence guarantees (sufficient condition: max degree $< 7$; empirically robust to degree 43). OIDA introduces QUESTION-as-modeled-ignorance: a primitive with inverse decay that surfaces what an organization does \emph{not} know with increasing urgency--a mechanism absent from all surveyed systems. We describe the Epistemic Quality Score (EQS), a five-component evaluation methodology with explicit circularity analysis. In a controlled comparison ($n{=}10$ response pairs), OIDA's RAG condition (3,868 tokens) achieves EQS 0.530 vs.\ 0.848 for a full-context baseline (108,687 tokens); the $28.1\times$ token budget difference is the primary confound. The QUESTION mechanism is statistically validated (Fisher $p{=}0.0325$, OR$=21.0$). The formal properties are established; the decisive ablation at equal token budget (E4) is pre-registered and not yet run.

AI.tldr: OIDA框架为组织知识添加认知结构，通过知识对象、矛盾边和问题机制来表征承诺强度、矛盾状态和组织无知，相比传统检索系统提供更高的认知保真度。
AI.motivation: 当前AI代理使用的组织知识缺乏认知结构：检索系统仅返回语义相关内容，无法区分已采纳决策与废弃假设、争议主张与已定结论、已知事实与未解决问题。组织AI的上限不是检索保真度，而是认知保真度——系统表征承诺强度、矛盾状态和组织无知作为可计算属性的能力。
AI.method: 提出OIDA框架，将组织知识结构化为带有认知类别、类别特定衰减的重要性分数和带符号矛盾边的类型化知识对象。知识引力引擎确定性维护分数并具有收敛保证（充分条件：最大度<7；经验上可容忍度43）。引入QUESTION作为建模无知的原语，具有逆衰减特性，能越来越紧迫地揭示组织不知道的内容。提出认知质量分数（EQS）五组件评估方法，包含显式循环性分析。
AI.result: 在受控比较中（n=10响应对），OIDA的RAG条件（3,868个token）获得EQS 0.530，而完整上下文基线（108,687个token）为0.848；28.1倍的token预算差异是主要混杂因素。QUESTION机制统计验证显著（Fisher p=0.0325，OR=21.0）。形式性质已建立，等token预算下的决定性消融实验（E4）已预注册但尚未运行。
AI.conclusion: OIDA框架通过为组织知识添加认知结构，解决了传统检索系统在区分知识状态方面的局限性。该框架的核心创新包括知识对象、矛盾边和问题机制，能够更好地表征组织知识的承诺强度、矛盾状态和无知领域，为组织AI提供更高的认知保真度。

title: Retinal Cyst Detection from Optical Coherence Tomography Images
summary: Retinal Cysts are formed by leakage and accumulation of fluid in the retina due to the incompetence of retinal vasculature. These cystic spaces have significance in several ocular diseases such as age-related macular degeneration, diabetic macular edema, etc. Optical coherence tomography is one of the predominant diagnosing techniques for imaging retinal pathologies. Segmenting and quantification of intraretinal cysts plays the vital role in predicting visual acuity. In literature, several methods have been proposed for automatic segmentation of intraretinal cysts. As cystoid macular edema becomes a major problem to humankind, we need to quantify it accurately and operate it out, else it might cause many problems later on. Though research is being carried out in this area, not much of progress has been made and accuracy achieved so far is 68\% which is very less. Also, the methods depend on the quality of the image and give very low results for high noise images like topcon. This work uses ResNet CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) approach of segmentation by the way of patchwise classification for training on image set from cyst segmentation challenge dataset and testing on test data set given by 2 different graders for all 4 vendors in the challenge. It also compares these methods using first publicly available novel cyst segmentation challenge dataset. The methods were evaluated using quantitative measures to assess their robustness against the challenges of intraretinal cyst segmentation. The results are found to be better than the previous state of the art approaches giving more than 70\% dice coefficient on all vendors irrespective of their quality.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用ResNet CNN进行视网膜囊肿分割，通过补丁分类方法在囊肿分割挑战数据集上训练，在四种不同厂商的图像上测试，获得了超过70%的Dice系数，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 视网膜囊肿在多种眼部疾病中具有重要意义，但现有自动分割方法的准确率较低（仅68%），且对图像质量敏感，特别是对高噪声图像效果不佳。囊肿性黄斑水肿对人类健康构成重大威胁，需要准确量化以便及时治疗。
AI.method: 采用ResNet卷积神经网络进行分割，通过补丁分类方法在囊肿分割挑战数据集上进行训练。测试使用了挑战中2名不同标注者标注的4种厂商图像数据集，并与现有方法进行对比。
AI.result: 该方法在所有四种厂商图像上都获得了超过70%的Dice系数，无论图像质量如何，均优于先前的最佳方法（68%），表现出更好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ResNet CNN方法在视网膜囊肿分割任务中表现出色，显著提高了分割准确率，对图像质量变化具有更好的鲁棒性，为临床诊断提供了更可靠的自动化工具。

title: GenTac: Generative Modeling and Forecasting of Soccer Tactics
summary: Modeling open-play soccer tactics is a formidable challenge due to the stochastic, multi-agent nature of the game. Existing computational approaches typically produce single, deterministic trajectory forecasts or focus on highly structured set-pieces, fundamentally failing to capture the inherent variance and branching possibilities of real-world match evolution. Here, we introduce GenTac, a diffusion-based generative framework that conceptualizes soccer tactics as a stochastic process over continuous multi-player trajectories and discrete semantic events. By learning the underlying distribution of player movements from historical tracking data, GenTac samples diverse, plausible, long-horizon future trajectories. The framework supports rich contextual conditioning, including opponent behavior, specific team or league playing styles, and strategic objectives, while grounding continuous spatial dynamics into a 15-class tactical event space. Extensive evaluations on our proposed benchmark, TacBench, demonstrate four key capabilities: (1) GenTac achieves high geometric accuracy while strictly preserving the collective structural consistency of the team; (2) it accurately simulates stylistic nuances, distinguishing between specific teams (e.g., Auckland FC) and leagues (e.g., A-League versus German leagues); (3) it enables controllable counterfactual simulations, demonstrably altering spatial control and expected threat metrics based on offensive or defensive guidance; and (4) it reliably anticipates future tactical outcomes directly from generated rollouts. Finally, we demonstrate that GenTac can be successfully trained to generalize to other dynamic team sports, including basketball, American football, and ice hockey.

AI.tldr: GenTac是一个基于扩散模型的生成框架，用于建模开放式足球战术，通过历史追踪数据学习球员运动分布，生成多样、合理的长时程轨迹，并支持丰富的上下文条件控制。
AI.motivation: 现有计算方法通常产生单一确定性轨迹预测或专注于高度结构化的定位球，无法捕捉真实比赛演变中的固有方差和分支可能性，因此需要新的方法来建模开放式足球战术的随机、多智能体特性。
AI.method: GenTac是一个扩散生成框架，将足球战术概念化为连续多球员轨迹和离散语义事件的随机过程。它学习历史追踪数据中球员运动的底层分布，支持丰富的上下文条件控制（包括对手行为、特定球队或联赛风格、战略目标），并将连续空间动态映射到15类战术事件空间。
AI.result: 在TacBench基准测试中，GenTac展示了四个关键能力：1）实现高几何精度同时严格保持团队集体结构一致性；2）准确模拟风格细微差别，区分特定球队和联赛；3）支持可控反事实模拟，基于进攻或防守指导改变空间控制和预期威胁指标；4）可靠预测未来战术结果。此外，GenTac可成功推广到其他动态团队运动。
AI.conclusion: GenTac提供了一个强大的生成框架，能够有效建模开放式足球战术的随机性和多样性，支持丰富的条件控制和战术分析，并具有跨运动推广的潜力，为团队运动的战术建模和分析开辟了新途径。

title: LRD-Net: A Lightweight Real-Centered Detection Network for Cross-Domain Face Forgery Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of diffusion-based generative models has made face forgery detection a critical challenge in digital forensics. Current detection methods face two fundamental limitations: poor cross-domain generalization when encountering unseen forgery types, and substantial computational overhead that hinders deployment on resource-constrained devices. We propose LRD-Net (Lightweight Real-centered Detection Network), a novel framework that addresses both challenges simultaneously. Unlike existing dual-branch approaches that process spatial and frequency information independently, LRD-Net adopts a sequential frequency-guided architecture where a lightweight Multi-Scale Wavelet Guidance Module generates attention signals that condition a MobileNetV3-based spatial backbone. This design enables effective exploitation of frequency-domain cues while avoiding the redundancy of parallel feature extraction. Furthermore, LRD-Net employs a real-centered learning strategy with exponential moving average prototype updates and drift regularization, anchoring representations around authentic facial images rather than modeling diverse forgery patterns. Extensive experiments on the DiFF benchmark demonstrate that LRD-Net achieves state-of-the-art cross-domain detection accuracy, consistently outperforming existing methods. Critically, LRD-Net accomplishes this with only 2.63M parameters - approximately 9x fewer than conventional approaches - while achieving over 8x faster training and nearly 10x faster inference. These results demonstrate that robust cross-domain face forgery detection can be achieved without sacrificing computational efficiency, making LRD-Net suitable for real-time deployment in mobile authentication systems and resource-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: LRD-Net是一种轻量级人脸伪造检测网络，通过序列化频率引导架构和真实中心学习策略，在保持高检测精度的同时大幅减少计算开销，适用于资源受限设备。
AI.motivation: 当前人脸伪造检测方法面临两个主要挑战：1）跨域泛化能力差，难以检测未见过的伪造类型；2）计算开销大，难以部署在资源受限设备上。需要同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 提出LRD-Net框架：1）采用序列化频率引导架构，轻量级多尺度小波引导模块生成注意力信号来调节MobileNetV3空间骨干网络；2）使用真实中心学习策略，通过指数移动平均原型更新和漂移正则化，将表示锚定在真实人脸图像周围。
AI.result: 在DiFF基准测试中，LRD-Net实现了最先进的跨域检测精度，仅使用263万参数（比传统方法少约9倍），训练速度提升8倍以上，推理速度提升近10倍。
AI.conclusion: LRD-Net证明了在不牺牲计算效率的情况下实现鲁棒的跨域人脸伪造检测是可行的，适合移动认证系统和资源受限环境中的实时部署。

title: Product Review Based on Optimized Facial Expression Detection
comment: 9 pages, 11 figures, Published in the 2016 Ninth International Conference on Contemporary Computing (IC3), August 11-13, 2016, Noida, India. This is a pre-print version of the paper
summary: This paper proposes a method to review public acceptance of products based on their brand by analyzing the facial expression of the customer intending to buy the product from a supermarket or hypermarket. In such cases, facial expression recognition plays a significant role in product review. Here, facial expression detection is performed by extracting feature points using a modified Harris algorithm. The modified Harris algorithm reduced the time complexity of the existing feature extraction Harris Algorithm. A comparison of time complexities of existing algorithms is done with proposed algorithm. The algorithm proved to be significantly faster and nearly accurate for the needed application by reducing the time complexity for corner points detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过分析超市顾客面部表情来评估产品品牌接受度的方法，使用改进的Harris算法进行特征点提取，显著降低了时间复杂度。
AI.motivation: 通过分析顾客在超市选购产品时的面部表情来评估产品品牌接受度，传统方法需要更高效的特征提取算法来降低计算复杂度。
AI.method: 使用改进的Harris算法进行面部表情特征点提取，该算法在原有Harris算法基础上优化，降低了时间复杂度，并与现有算法进行了对比。
AI.result: 改进的Harris算法在时间复杂性方面显著优于现有算法，在角点检测方面速度更快且精度接近，适用于实际应用需求。
AI.conclusion: 提出的改进Harris算法能够高效准确地提取面部特征点，为基于面部表情的产品品牌接受度评估提供了实用的技术方案。

title: STGV: Spatio-Temporal Hash Encoding for Gaussian-based Video Representation
summary: 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) has recently become a promising paradigm for high-quality video representation. However, existing methods employ content-agnostic or spatio-temporal feature overlapping embeddings to predict canonical Gaussian primitive deformations, which entangles static and dynamic components in videos and prevents modeling their distinct properties effectively. These result in inaccurate predictions for spatio-temporal deformations and unsatisfactory representation quality. To address these problems, this paper proposes a Spatio-Temporal hash encoding framework for Gaussian-based Video representation (STGV). By decomposing video features into learnable 2D spatial and 3D temporal hash encodings, STGV effectively facilitates the learning of motion patterns for dynamic components while maintaining background details for static elements.In addition, we construct a more stable and consistent initial canonical Gaussian representation through a key frame canonical initialization strategy, preventing from feature overlapping and a structurally incoherent geometry representation. Experimental results demonstrate that our method attains better video representation quality (+0.98 PSNR) against other Gaussian-based methods and achieves competitive performance in downstream video tasks.

AI.tldr: STGV提出了一种时空哈希编码框架，通过将视频特征分解为可学习的2D空间和3D时空哈希编码，有效分离静态和动态组件，提升基于高斯分布的视频表示质量。
AI.motivation: 现有2D高斯分布方法使用内容无关或时空特征重叠嵌入来预测规范高斯基元变形，导致视频中静态和动态组件纠缠，无法有效建模其不同特性，造成时空变形预测不准确和表示质量不理想。
AI.method: 1. 提出时空哈希编码框架(STGV)，将视频特征分解为可学习的2D空间哈希编码和3D时空哈希编码；2. 采用关键帧规范初始化策略构建更稳定一致的初始规范高斯表示，避免特征重叠和结构不连贯的几何表示。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法相比其他基于高斯分布的方法获得了更好的视频表示质量（PSNR提升0.98），并在下游视频任务中取得了有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: STGV通过分离静态和动态组件的特征表示，有效解决了现有高斯分布视频表示方法中特征纠缠的问题，显著提升了视频表示质量和时空变形预测准确性。

title: ReXSonoVQA: A Video QA Benchmark for Procedure-Centric Ultrasound Understanding
summary: Ultrasound acquisition requires skilled probe manipulation and real-time adjustments. Vision-language models (VLMs) could enable autonomous ultrasound systems, but existing benchmarks evaluate only static images, not dynamic procedural understanding. We introduce ReXSonoVQA, a video QA benchmark with 514 video clips and 514 questions (249 MCQ, 265 free-response) targeting three competencies: Action-Goal Reasoning, Artifact Resolution & Optimization, and Procedure Context & Planning. Zero-shot evaluation of Gemini 3 Pro, Qwen3.5-397B, LLaVA-Video-72B, and Seed 2.0 Pro shows VLMs can extract some procedural information, but troubleshooting questions remain challenging with minimal gains over text-only baselines, exposing limitations in causal reasoning. ReXSonoVQA enables developing perception systems for ultrasound training, guidance, and robotic automation.

AI.tldr: ReXSonoVQA是一个用于评估视觉语言模型在超声视频中动态程序理解能力的视频问答基准，包含514个视频片段和问题，测试三种核心能力，结果显示现有模型在故障排除问题上仍有局限。
AI.motivation: 超声检查需要熟练的探头操作和实时调整，现有视觉语言模型基准仅评估静态图像，缺乏对动态程序理解的评估，因此需要开发专门针对超声视频程序理解的基准测试。
AI.method: 创建ReXSonoVQA基准，包含514个超声视频片段和514个问题（249个选择题和265个自由回答题），针对三种核心能力：动作-目标推理、伪影解析与优化、程序上下文与规划。对多个视觉语言模型进行零样本评估。
AI.result: 评估Gemini 3 Pro、Qwen3.5-397B、LLaVA-Video-72B和Seed 2.0 Pro等模型，结果显示视觉语言模型能够提取部分程序信息，但在故障排除问题上表现不佳，仅略优于纯文本基线，暴露了因果推理的局限性。
AI.conclusion: ReXSonoVQA基准能够推动开发用于超声训练、指导和机器人自动化的感知系统，现有视觉语言模型在动态程序理解方面仍有改进空间，特别是在因果推理和故障排除能力上。

title: AmodalSVG: Amodal Image Vectorization via Semantic Layer Peeling
summary: We introduce AmodalSVG, a new framework for amodal image vectorization that produces semantically organized and geometrically complete SVG representations from natural images. Existing vectorization methods operate under a modal paradigm: tracing only visible pixels and disregarding occlusion. Consequently, the resulting SVGs are semantically entangled and geometrically incomplete, limiting SVG's structural editability. In contrast, AmodalSVG reconstructs full object geometries, including occluded regions, into independent, editable vector layers. To achieve this, AmodalSVG reformulates image vectorization as a two-stage framework, performing semantic decoupling and completion in the raster domain to produce amodally complete semantic layers, which are then independently vectorized. In the first stage, we introduce Semantic Layer Peeling (SLP), a VLM-guided strategy that progressively decomposes an image into semantically coherent layers. By hybrid inpainting, SLP recovers complete object appearances under occlusions, enabling explicit semantic decoupling. To vectorize these layers efficiently, we propose Adaptive Layered Vectorization (ALV), which dynamically modulates the primitive budget via an error-budget-driven adjustment mechanism. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AmodalSVG significantly outperforms prior methods in visual fidelity. Moreover, the resulting amodal layers enable object-level editing directly in the vector domain, capabilities not supported by existing vectorization approaches. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: AmodalSVG是一个新的图像矢量化框架，能够从自然图像生成语义组织且几何完整的SVG表示，通过重建包括被遮挡区域的完整对象几何形状，实现独立可编辑的矢量图层。
AI.motivation: 现有矢量化方法仅追踪可见像素并忽略遮挡，导致生成的SVG语义纠缠且几何不完整，限制了SVG的结构可编辑性。需要一种能够重建完整对象几何形状（包括被遮挡区域）的方法。
AI.method: 采用两阶段框架：1）语义层剥离（SLP）- 使用VLM引导策略逐步将图像分解为语义连贯的图层，通过混合修复恢复被遮挡区域的完整对象外观；2）自适应分层矢量化（ALV）- 通过误差预算驱动调整机制动态调制基元预算，高效矢量化这些图层。
AI.result: AmodalSVG在视觉保真度方面显著优于先前方法，生成的amodal图层支持直接在矢量域进行对象级编辑，这是现有矢量化方法不具备的能力。
AI.conclusion: AmodalSVG通过语义解耦和几何完成，实现了从自然图像到语义组织、几何完整的SVG表示的转换，为矢量图形编辑提供了新的可能性。

title: Pseudo-Unification: Entropy Probing Reveals Divergent Information Patterns in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) were designed to combine the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) with the generation capability of vision models. In practice, however, this synergy remains elusive: UMMs fail to transfer LLM-like reasoning to image synthesis and exhibit divergent response behaviors. We term this phenomenon pseudo-unification. Diagnosing its internal causes is important, but existing probing methods either lack model-internal insight or ignore prompt-response dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose an information-theoretic probing framework that jointly analyzes how UMMs encode inputs and generate outputs. Applied to ten representative UMMs, our framework reveals that pseudo-unification stems from a dual divergence: (i) Modality-Asymmetric Encoding, where vision and language follow different entropy trajectories, and (ii) Pattern-Split Response, where text generation exhibits high-entropy creativity while image synthesis enforces low-entropy fidelity. Only models that unify both sides (e.g., via contextual prediction) achieve more genuine unification, enabling stronger reasoning-based text-to-image generation even with fewer parameters. Our work provides the first model-internal probing of unification, demonstrating that real multimodal synergy requires consistency in information flow, not just shared parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种信息论探测框架，揭示了多模态模型伪统一现象的内部原因：模态不对称编码和模式分裂响应，只有实现信息流一致性的模型才能实现真正的多模态协同。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型旨在结合大型语言模型的推理能力和视觉模型的生成能力，但在实践中这种协同效应难以实现，存在伪统一现象。现有探测方法要么缺乏模型内部洞察，要么忽略提示-响应依赖关系，因此需要新的诊断方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种信息论探测框架，联合分析UMMs如何编码输入和生成输出。该框架应用于十个代表性UMMs，从信息流角度诊断伪统一现象的内部机制。
AI.result: 探测发现伪统一源于双重分歧：1) 模态不对称编码 - 视觉和语言遵循不同的熵轨迹；2) 模式分裂响应 - 文本生成呈现高熵创造性，而图像合成强制低熵保真度。只有通过上下文预测统一两边的模型才能实现更真实的统一，即使参数较少也能实现更强的基于推理的文生图生成。
AI.conclusion: 这是首次对多模态统一进行模型内部探测的研究，表明真正的多模态协同需要信息流的一致性，而不仅仅是共享参数。信息论框架为诊断和改善UMMs提供了新视角。

title: FineEdit: Fine-Grained Image Edit with Bounding Box Guidance
summary: Diffusion-based image editing models have achieved significant progress in real world applications. However, conventional models typically rely on natural language prompts, which often lack the precision required to localize target objects. Consequently, these models struggle to maintain background consistency due to their global image regeneration paradigm. Recognizing that visual cues provide an intuitive means for users to highlight specific areas of interest, we utilize bounding boxes as guidance to explicitly define the editing target. This approach ensures that the diffusion model can accurately localize the target while preserving background consistency. To achieve this, we propose FineEdit, a multi-level bounding box injection method that enables the model to utilize spatial conditions more effectively. To support this high precision guidance, we present FineEdit-1.2M, a large scale, fine-grained dataset comprising 1.2 million image editing pairs with precise bounding box annotations. Furthermore, we construct a comprehensive benchmark, termed FineEdit-Bench, which includes 1,000 images across 10 subjects to effectively evaluate region based editing capabilities. Evaluations on FineEdit-Bench demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art open-source models (e.g., Qwen-Image-Edit and LongCat-Image-Edit) in instruction compliance and background preservation. Further assessments on open benchmarks (GEdit and ImgEdit Bench) confirm its superior generalization and robustness.

AI.tldr: FineEdit提出了一种基于边界框的多级注入方法，用于精确的图像编辑定位，同时保持背景一致性，并在大规模数据集上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于自然语言提示的扩散编辑模型缺乏精确定位能力，难以保持背景一致性，需要更直观的视觉引导方式来实现精确的区域编辑。
AI.method: 提出FineEdit方法：使用边界框作为空间条件来明确定义编辑目标，采用多级边界框注入机制，使模型能更有效地利用空间信息。同时构建了包含120万图像对的FineEdit-1.2M数据集和包含1000张图像的FineEdit-Bench基准。
AI.result: 在FineEdit-Bench上显著优于现有开源模型（如Qwen-Image-Edit和LongCat-Image-Edit），在指令遵循和背景保持方面表现优异。在公开基准（GEdit和ImgEdit Bench）上也显示出更好的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 边界框引导的FineEdit方法能够实现精确的目标定位和背景保持，为图像编辑提供了更有效的空间条件利用方式，在区域编辑任务中表现出色。

title: You Only Judge Once: Multi-response Reward Modeling in a Single Forward Pass
summary: We present a discriminative multimodal reward model that scores all candidate responses in a single forward pass. Conventional discriminative reward models evaluate each response independently, requiring multiple forward passes, one for each potential response. Our approach concatenates multiple responses with separator tokens and applies cross-entropy over their scalar scores, enabling direct comparative reasoning and efficient $N$-way preference learning. The multi-response design also yields up to $N\times$ wall-clock speedup and FLOPs reduction over conventional single-response scoring. To enable $N$-way reward evaluation beyond existing pairwise benchmarks, we construct two new benchmarks: (1) MR$^2$Bench-Image contains human-annotated rankings over responses from 8 diverse models; (2) MR$^2$Bench-Video is a large-scale video-based reward benchmark derived from 94K crowdsourced pairwise human judgments over video question-answering spanning 19 models, denoised via preference graph ensemble. Both benchmarks provide 4-response evaluation variants sampled from the full rankings. Built on a 4B vision-language backbone with LoRA fine-tuning and a lightweight MLP value head, our model achieves state-of-the-art results on six multimodal reward benchmarks, including MR$^2$Bench-Image, MR$^2$Bench-Video, and four other existing benchmarks. Our model outperforms existing larger generative and discriminative reward models. We further demonstrate that our reward model, when used in reinforcement learning with GRPO, produces improved policy models that maintain performance across standard multimodal benchmarks while substantially improving open-ended generation quality, outperforming a single-response discriminative reward model (RM) baseline by a large margin in both training stability and open-ended generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多模态判别式奖励模型，能在单次前向传播中同时评估多个候选响应，相比传统方法实现N倍加速和计算量减少，并在多个基准测试中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 传统判别式奖励模型需要独立评估每个响应，导致多次前向传播效率低下。需要一种能同时评估多个响应、支持直接比较推理的高效方法。
AI.method: 使用分隔符连接多个响应，应用交叉熵计算标量分数，实现N路偏好学习。基于4B视觉语言骨干网络，采用LoRA微调和轻量级MLP值头。
AI.result: 在六个多模态奖励基准测试中达到SOTA，包括新构建的MR²Bench-Image和MR²Bench-Video。相比传统单响应奖励模型，在训练稳定性和开放生成质量上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出的多响应奖励模型在效率和性能上均优于现有方法，能有效提升强化学习策略模型的质量，为多模态奖励建模提供了新的高效解决方案。

title: Towards Automated Solar Panel Integrity: Hybrid Deep Feature Extraction for Advanced Surface Defect Identification
summary: To ensure energy efficiency and reliable operations, it is essential to monitor solar panels in generation plants to detect defects. It is quite labor-intensive, time consuming and costly to manually monitor large-scale solar plants and those installed in remote areas. Manual inspection may also be susceptible to human errors. Consequently, it is necessary to create an automated, intelligent defect-detection system, that ensures continuous monitoring, early fault detection, and maximum power generation. We proposed a novel hybrid method for defect detection in SOLAR plates by combining both handcrafted and deep learning features. Local Binary Pattern (LBP), Histogram of Gradients (HoG) and Gabor Filters were used for the extraction of handcrafted features. Deep features extracted by leveraging the use of DenseNet-169. Both handcrafted and deep features were concatenated and then fed to three distinct types of classifiers, including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Extreme Gradient Boost (XGBoost) and Light Gradient-Boosting Machine (LGBM). Experimental results evaluated on the augmented dataset show the superior performance, especially DenseNet-169 + Gabor (SVM), had the highest scores with 99.17% accuracy which was higher than all the other systems. In general, the proposed hybrid framework offers better defect-detection accuracy, resistance, and flexibility that has a solid basis on the real-life use of the automated PV panels monitoring system.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合手工特征和深度学习特征的混合方法用于太阳能电池板缺陷检测，通过特征融合和多种分类器实现高效自动化监测。
AI.motivation: 传统人工监测太阳能电池板存在劳动强度大、成本高、易出错等问题，特别是在大规模和偏远地区的光伏电站中。需要开发自动化智能缺陷检测系统来确保连续监测、早期故障发现和最大发电量。
AI.method: 提出新颖的混合方法：使用LBP、HoG和Gabor滤波器提取手工特征，利用DenseNet-169提取深度特征，将两类特征拼接后输入SVM、XGBoost和LGBM三种分类器进行缺陷检测。
AI.result: 在增强数据集上的实验结果显示，DenseNet-169 + Gabor (SVM)组合取得了最佳性能，准确率达到99.17%，优于其他所有系统。混合框架整体表现出更好的缺陷检测精度、鲁棒性和灵活性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的混合框架为自动化光伏面板监测系统提供了坚实的基础，能够有效解决太阳能电池板缺陷检测问题，具有实际应用价值。

title: Using Deep Learning Models Pretrained by Self-Supervised Learning for Protein Localization
comment: 29 pages, 8 figures, submitted to BMC Bioinformatics
summary:
Background: Task-specific microscopy datasets are often small, making it difficult to train deep learning models that learn robust features. While self-supervised learning (SSL) has shown promise through pretraining on large, domain-specific datasets, generalizability across datasets with differing staining protocols and channel configurations remains underexplored. We investigated the generalizability of SSL models pretrained on ImageNet-1k and HPA FOV, evaluating their embeddings on OpenCell with and without fine-tuning, two channel-mismatch strategies, and varying fine-tuning data fractions. We additionally analyzed single-cell embeddings on a labeled OpenCell subset.
  Result: DINO-based ViT backbones pretrained on HPA FOV or ImageNet-1k transfer well to OpenCell even without fine-tuning. The HPA FOV-pretrained model achieved the highest zero-shot performance (macro $F_1$ 0.822 $\pm$ 0.007). Fine-tuning further improved performance to 0.860 $\pm$ 0.013. At the single-cell level, the HPA single-cell-pretrained model achieved the highest k-nearest neighbor performance across all neighborhood sizes (macro $F_1$ $\geq$ 0.796).
  Conclusion: SSL methods like DINO, pretrained on large domain-relevant datasets, enable effective use of deep learning features for fine-tuning on small, task-specific microscopy datasets.

AI.tldr: 自监督学习模型（特别是DINO-based ViT）在大型领域相关数据集（如HPA FOV）上预训练后，即使不进行微调也能在OpenCell显微镜数据集上表现良好，且微调能进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 任务特异性显微镜数据集通常较小，难以训练出学习稳健特征的深度学习模型。虽然自监督学习通过在大型领域特定数据集上进行预训练显示出潜力，但其在不同染色方案和通道配置的数据集之间的泛化能力尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 研究在ImageNet-1k和HPA FOV上预训练的SSL模型的泛化能力，评估它们在OpenCell数据集上的嵌入表示，包括：1) 有/无微调；2) 两种通道不匹配策略；3) 不同比例的微调数据；4) 在标记的OpenCell子集上分析单细胞嵌入。
AI.result: 基于DINO的ViT主干网络在HPA FOV或ImageNet-1k上预训练后，即使不进行微调也能很好地迁移到OpenCell。HPA FOV预训练模型获得最高的零样本性能（宏观F1分数0.822±0.007）。微调后性能进一步提升至0.860±0.013。在单细胞水平上，HPA单细胞预训练模型在所有邻域大小下都获得了最高的k近邻性能（宏观F1分数≥0.796）。
AI.conclusion: 在大型领域相关数据集上预训练的SSL方法（如DINO）能够有效利用深度学习特征，用于在小规模任务特异性显微镜数据集上进行微调。

title: MMR-AD: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset for Benchmarking General Anomaly Detection with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: In the progress of industrial anomaly detection, general anomaly detection (GAD) is an emerging trend and also the ultimate goal. Unlike the conventional single- and multi-class AD, general AD aims to train a general AD model that can directly detect anomalies in diverse novel classes without any retraining or fine-tuning on the target data. Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown great promise in achieving general anomaly detection due to their revolutionary visual understanding and language reasoning capabilities. However, MLLM's general AD ability remains underexplored due to: (1) MLLMs are pretrained on amounts of data sourced from the Web, these data still have significant gaps with the data in AD scenarios. Moreover, the image-text pairs during pretraining are also not specifically for AD tasks. (2) The current mainstream AD datasets are image-based and not yet suitable for post-training MLLMs. To facilitate MLLM-based general AD research, we present MMR-AD, which is a comprehensive benchmark for both training and evaluating MLLM-based AD models. With MMR-AD, we reveal that the AD performance of current SOTA generalist MLLMs still falls far behind the industrial requirements. Based on MMR-AD, we also propose a baseline model, Anomaly-R1, which is a reasoning-based AD model that learns from the CoT data in MMR-AD and is further enhanced by reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments show that our Anomaly-R1 achieves remarkable improvements over generalist MLLMs in both anomaly detection and localization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了MMR-AD基准数据集和Anomaly-R1模型，用于评估和提升多模态大语言模型在通用异常检测任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 通用异常检测是工业异常检测的终极目标，但当前多模态大语言模型在异常检测方面能力不足，主要原因是：1) MLLMs预训练数据与异常检测场景数据存在显著差距；2) 现有异常检测数据集不适合MLLMs的后训练。
AI.method: 提出了MMR-AD基准数据集，用于训练和评估基于MLLM的异常检测模型。基于该基准，开发了Anomaly-R1基线模型，这是一个基于推理的异常检测模型，从MMR-AD中的思维链数据学习，并通过强化学习进一步增强。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前最先进的通用MLLMs在异常检测性能上仍远低于工业要求。而Anomaly-R1模型在异常检测和定位方面相比通用MLLMs取得了显著改进。
AI.conclusion: MMR-AD基准为基于MLLM的通用异常检测研究提供了重要工具，Anomaly-R1模型展示了通过专门训练可以显著提升MLLMs在异常检测任务上的性能。

title: Energy-oriented Diffusion Bridge for Image Restoration with Foundational Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion bridge models have shown great promise in image restoration by explicitly connecting clean and degraded image distributions. However, they often rely on complex and high-cost trajectories, which limit both sampling efficiency and final restoration quality. To address this, we propose an Energy-oriented diffusion Bridge (E-Bridge) framework to approximate a set of low-cost manifold geodesic trajectories to boost the performance of the proposed method. We achieve this by designing a novel bridge process that evolves over a shorter time horizon and makes the reverse process start from an entropy-regularized point that mixes the degraded image and Gaussian noise, which theoretically reduces the required trajectory energy. To solve this process efficiently, we draw inspiration from consistency models to learn a single-step mapping function, optimized via a continuous-time consistency objective tailored for our trajectory, so as to analytically map any state on the trajectory to the target image. Notably, the trajectory length in our framework becomes a tunable task-adaptive knob, allowing the model to adaptively balance information preservation against generative power for tasks of varying degradation, such as denoising versus super-resolution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our E-Bridge achieves state-of-the-art performance across various image restoration tasks while enabling high-quality recovery with a single or fewer sampling steps. Our project page is https://jinnh.github.io/E-Bridge/.

AI.tldr: 提出E-Bridge框架，通过设计低能量轨迹的扩散桥模型，在图像恢复任务中实现高效高质量恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散桥模型依赖复杂高成本轨迹，限制了采样效率和最终恢复质量，需要更高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 设计能量导向的扩散桥框架，通过缩短时间范围、从熵正则化点开始反向过程来降低轨迹能量；借鉴一致性模型学习单步映射函数，通过连续时间一致性目标优化。
AI.result: E-Bridge在多种图像恢复任务中达到最先进性能，能够以单步或较少采样步骤实现高质量恢复。
AI.conclusion: E-Bridge框架通过低能量轨迹设计，在保持信息保留和生成能力平衡的同时，显著提升了图像恢复的效率和效果。

title: ArtiCAD: Articulated CAD Assembly Design via Multi-Agent Code Generation
summary: Parametric Computer-Aided Design (CAD) of articulated assemblies is essential for product development, yet generating these multi-part, movable models from high-level descriptions remains unexplored. To address this, we propose ArtiCAD, the first training-free multi-agent system capable of generating editable, articulated CAD assemblies directly from text or images. Our system divides this complex task among four specialized agents: Design, Generation, Assembly, and Review. One of our key insights is to predict assembly relationships during the initial design stage rather than the assembly stage. By utilizing a Connector that explicitly defines attachment points and joint parameters, ArtiCAD determines these relationships before geometry generation, effectively bypassing the limited spatial reasoning capabilities of current LLMs and VLMs. To further ensure high-quality outputs, we introduce validation steps in the generation and assembly stages, accompanied by a cross-stage rollback mechanism that accurately isolates and corrects design- and code-level errors. Additionally, a self-evolving experience store accumulates design knowledge to continuously improve performance on future tasks. Extensive evaluations on three datasets (ArtiCAD-Bench, CADPrompt, and ACD) validate the effectiveness of our approach. We further demonstrate the applicability of ArtiCAD in requirement-driven conceptual design, physical prototyping, and the generation of embodied AI training assets through URDF export.

AI.tldr: ArtiCAD是首个无需训练的多智能体系统，能够从文本或图像直接生成可编辑的、可活动的CAD装配体，通过四个专业智能体（设计、生成、装配、评审）协作完成，并在设计阶段预测装配关系，避免现有LLM/VLM的空间推理限制。
AI.motivation: 参数化CAD对于产品开发至关重要，但目前从高级描述生成多部件、可活动的装配体模型仍未被充分探索。现有方法在生成可编辑的、可活动的CAD装配体方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出ArtiCAD多智能体系统，包含四个专业智能体：设计、生成、装配、评审。关键创新是在设计阶段而非装配阶段预测装配关系，使用连接器明确定义连接点和关节参数。引入生成和装配阶段的验证步骤，以及跨阶段回滚机制来隔离和纠正错误。建立自演进经验库积累设计知识。
AI.result: 在三个数据集（ArtiCAD-Bench、CADPrompt和ACD）上的广泛评估验证了方法的有效性。展示了ArtiCAD在需求驱动的概念设计、物理原型制作以及通过URDF导出生成具身AI训练资产方面的适用性。
AI.conclusion: ArtiCAD是首个能够从文本或图像直接生成可编辑、可活动CAD装配体的训练免费多智能体系统，通过在设计阶段预测装配关系、引入验证机制和自演进经验库，有效解决了现有方法的局限性，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: LumiMotion: Improving Gaussian Relighting with Scene Dynamics
summary: In 3D reconstruction, the problem of inverse rendering, namely recovering the illumination of the scene and the material properties, is fundamental. Existing Gaussian Splatting-based methods primarily target static scenes and often assume simplified or moderate lighting to avoid entangling shadows with surface appearance. This limits their ability to accurately separate lighting effects from material properties, particularly in real-world conditions. We address this limitation by leveraging dynamic elements - regions of the scene that undergo motion - as a supervisory signal for inverse rendering. Motion reveals the same surfaces under varying lighting conditions, providing stronger cues for disentangling material and illumination. This thesis is supported by our experimental results which show we improve LPIPS by 23% for albedo estimation and by 15% for scene relighting relative to next-best baseline. To this end, we introduce LumiMotion, the first Gaussian-based approach that leverages dynamics for inverse rendering and operates in arbitrary dynamic scenes. Our method learns a dynamic 2D Gaussian Splatting representation that employs a set of novel constraints which encourage the dynamic regions of the scene to deform, while keeping static regions stable. As we demonstrate, this separation is crucial for correct optimization of the albedo. Finally, we release a new synthetic benchmark comprising five scenes under four lighting conditions, each in both static and dynamic variants, for the first time enabling systematic evaluation of inverse rendering methods in dynamic environments and challenging lighting. Link to project page: https://joaxkal.github.io/LumiMotion/

AI.tldr: LumiMotion是首个利用动态场景进行逆渲染的高斯方法，通过运动区域作为监督信号来解耦材质和光照，在动态环境下显著提升了反照率估计和场景重光照性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯泼溅的逆渲染方法主要针对静态场景，通常假设简化或适中的光照以避免阴影与表面外观的纠缠，这限制了在真实世界条件下准确分离光照效果和材质属性的能力。
AI.method: 提出LumiMotion方法，学习动态2D高斯泼溅表示，利用动态区域（场景中发生运动的部分）作为监督信号，通过一组新颖的约束条件使动态区域变形而保持静态区域稳定，从而更好地解耦材质和光照。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，相比最佳基线方法，反照率估计的LPIPS指标提升了23%，场景重光照性能提升了15%。同时发布了包含5个场景、4种光照条件、静态和动态变体的新合成基准数据集。
AI.conclusion: 动态元素为逆渲染提供了强大的监督信号，能够有效解耦材质和光照，LumiMotion方法在动态场景中实现了更准确的逆渲染，并为该领域提供了首个系统评估动态环境下逆渲染方法的基准。

title: TraversalBench: Challenging Paths to Follow for Vision Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) perform strongly on many multimodal benchmarks. However, the ability to follow complex visual paths -- a task that human observers typically find straightforward -- remains under-tested. We introduce TraversalBench, a controlled benchmark for exact visual path traversal. Each instance contains a single continuous polyline, a unique start marker, and markers placed at path vertices; the task is to recover the exact ordered sequence encountered when traversing the path from start to finish. The benchmark explicitly balances key path-structural factors including self-intersection count, tortuosity, vertex count, and nearby confounding lines, while minimizing reliance on OCR, world knowledge, and open-ended planning. We find that self-intersections are the dominant source of difficulty. A first-crossing analysis shows that errors are sharply localized: performance is relatively stable immediately before the first crossing, then drops steeply when the model must resolve the correct continuation. By contrast, nearby confounding lines produce a weaker persistent degradation that compounds with repeated exposure. These analyses make TraversalBench a useful diagnostic for identifying whether models suffer from human-like failures or other breakdowns in sustained visual processing. An auxiliary reading-order benchmark further reveals a consistent preference for layouts compatible with left-to-right serialization, while not explaining away the main effects of path complexity. Together, these results position TraversalBench as a controlled diagnostic of path-faithful visual reasoning and as a useful testbed for studying multimodal spatial reasoning under ambiguity, clutter, and distractor structure. More broadly, we position TraversalBench as a contribution to the still-limited area of sustained visual grounding benchmarks for VLMs.

AI.tldr: TraversalBench是一个用于测试视觉语言模型在复杂视觉路径追踪能力的基准测试，专注于精确的路径遍历任务，发现自交叉是主要困难来源。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型在多模态基准测试中表现良好，但其遵循复杂视觉路径的能力（人类通常认为简单的任务）尚未得到充分测试。需要一种受控的基准来评估模型在精确视觉路径遍历方面的能力。
AI.method: 引入TraversalBench基准测试，包含单个连续折线、唯一起始标记和路径顶点标记。任务是从起点到终点恢复遍历路径时遇到的确切有序序列。基准平衡了自交叉次数、曲折度、顶点数和附近混淆线等关键路径结构因素，同时最小化对OCR、世界知识和开放式规划的依赖。
AI.result: 发现自交叉是主要困难来源。首次交叉分析显示错误高度局部化：在第一次交叉前性能相对稳定，但当模型必须解析正确的延续时性能急剧下降。相比之下，附近混淆线产生较弱的持续退化，随着重复暴露而累积。辅助阅读顺序基准进一步揭示了模型对从左到右序列化兼容布局的一致偏好。
AI.conclusion: TraversalBench作为路径忠实视觉推理的受控诊断工具，以及研究在模糊、杂乱和干扰结构下的多模态空间推理的有用测试平台。更广泛地说，该基准为视觉语言模型的持续视觉基础测试领域做出了贡献。

title: Panoptic Pairwise Distortion Graph
summary: In this work, we introduce a new perspective on comparative image assessment by representing an image pair as a structured composition of its regions. In contrast, existing methods focus on whole image analysis, while implicitly relying on region-level understanding. We extend the intra-image notion of a scene graph to inter-image, and propose a novel task of Distortion Graph (DG). DG treats paired images as a structured topology grounded in regions, and represents dense degradation information such as distortion type, severity, comparison and quality score in a compact interpretable graph structure. To realize the task of learning a distortion graph, we contribute (i) a region-level dataset, PandaSet, (ii) a benchmark suite, PandaBench, with varying region-level difficulty, and (iii) an efficient architecture, Panda, to generate distortion graphs. We demonstrate that PandaBench poses a significant challenge for state-of-the-art multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as they fail to understand region-level degradations even when fed with explicit region cues. We show that training on PandaSet or prompting with DG elicits region-wise distortion understanding, opening a new direction for fine-grained, structured pairwise image assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的图像比较评估方法，将图像对表示为区域的结构化组合，引入了失真图任务，并提供了数据集、基准测试和架构
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要关注整体图像分析，而忽略了区域级别的理解。为了进行更细粒度、结构化的成对图像评估，需要一种能够表示区域级退化信息的结构化方法
AI.method: 将场景图概念从单图像扩展到图像对，提出失真图任务，将成对图像表示为基于区域的结构化拓扑。开发了PandaSet区域级数据集、PandaBench基准测试套件和Panda架构来生成失真图
AI.result: PandaBench对现有最先进的多模态大语言模型构成了显著挑战，这些模型即使有明确的区域提示也无法理解区域级退化。在PandaSet上训练或使用失真图提示可以激发区域级失真理解
AI.conclusion: 失真图为细粒度、结构化的成对图像评估开辟了新方向，通过区域级结构化表示能够更好地理解和比较图像退化

title: Towards Realistic 3D Emission Materials: Dataset, Baseline, and Evaluation for Emission Texture Generation
comment: Dataset will be available at https://github.com/yx345kw/EmissionGen
summary: 3D texture generation is receiving increasing attention, as it enables the creation of realistic and aesthetic texture materials for untextured 3D meshes. However, existing 3D texture generation methods are limited to producing only a few types of non-emissive PBR materials (e.g., albedo, metallic maps and roughness maps), making them difficult to replicate highly popular styles, such as cyberpunk, failing to achieve effects like realistic LED emissions. To address this limitation, we propose a novel task, emission texture generation, which enables the synthesized 3D objects to faithfully reproduce the emission materials from input reference images.
