Our key contributions include: first, We construct the Objaverse-Emission dataset, the first dataset that contains 40k 3D assets with high-quality emission materials. Second, we propose EmissionGen, a novel baseline for the emission texture generation task. Third, we define detailed evaluation metrics for the emission texture generation task. Our results demonstrate significant potential for future industrial applications. Dataset will be available at https://github.com/yx345kw/EmissionGen.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一项新任务——发射纹理生成，旨在解决现有3D纹理生成方法无法处理发光材料（如LED效果）的局限性，并构建了首个包含4万个高质量发射材料3D资产的数据集Objaverse-Emission。
AI.motivation: 现有3D纹理生成方法只能生成有限的非发射性PBR材料（如反照率、金属度和粗糙度贴图），无法复制像赛博朋克这样需要发光效果（如LED发射）的流行风格，这限制了3D纹理生成的实用性和美观性。
AI.method: 论文提出了EmissionGen方法作为发射纹理生成任务的新基线，并构建了Objaverse-Emission数据集——首个包含4万个高质量发射材料3D资产的数据集，同时为发射纹理生成任务定义了详细的评估指标。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，该方法在发射纹理生成方面具有显著潜力，能够使合成的3D对象忠实地再现输入参考图像中的发射材料效果，为未来工业应用提供了重要基础。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功提出了发射纹理生成这一新任务，通过构建首个大规模发射材料数据集和开发EmissionGen基线方法，填补了现有3D纹理生成技术在发光材料处理方面的空白，展示了在工业应用中的巨大潜力。

title: Byte-level generative predictions for forensics multimedia carving
comment: Accepted for publication at the "SPIE Defense + Security" Conference
summary: Digital forensic investigations often face significant challenges when recovering fragmented multimedia files that lack file system metadata. While traditional file carving relies on signatures and discriminative deep learning models for fragment classification, these methods cannot reconstruct or predict missing data. We propose a generative approach to multimedia carving using bGPT, a byte-level transformer designed for next-byte prediction. By feeding partial BMP image data into the model, we simulate the generation of likely fragment continuations. We evaluate the fidelity of these predictions using different metrics, namely, cosine similarity, structural similarity index (SSIM), chi-square distance, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD). Our findings demonstrate that generative models can effectively predict byte-level patterns to support fragment matching in unallocated disk space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用bGPT（字节级Transformer）生成多媒体文件碎片的方法，通过预测部分BMP图像数据的后续字节来支持数字取证中的碎片匹配。
AI.motivation: 数字取证调查在恢复缺乏文件系统元数据的碎片化多媒体文件时面临重大挑战。传统文件雕刻方法依赖签名和判别式深度学习模型进行碎片分类，但这些方法无法重建或预测缺失数据。
AI.method: 提出生成式多媒体雕刻方法，使用bGPT（字节级Transformer）进行下一字节预测。将部分BMP图像数据输入模型，模拟生成可能的碎片延续。
AI.result: 使用余弦相似度、结构相似性指数（SSIM）、卡方距离和Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）等不同指标评估预测的保真度。结果表明生成模型能有效预测字节级模式以支持未分配磁盘空间中的碎片匹配。
AI.conclusion: 生成模型可以有效预测字节级模式，支持数字取证中未分配磁盘空间的碎片匹配，为多媒体文件恢复提供了新的生成式方法。

title: Test-time Scaling over Perception: Resolving the Grounding Paradox in Thinking with Images
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have begun to support Thinking with Images by invoking visual tools such as zooming and cropping during inference. Yet these systems remain brittle in fine-grained visual reasoning because they must decide where to look before they have access to the evidence needed to make that decision correctly. We identify this circular dependency as the Grounding Paradox. To address it, we propose Test-Time Scaling over Perception (TTSP), a framework that treats perception itself as a scalable inference process. TTSP generates multiple exploratory perception traces, filters unreliable traces using entropy-based confidence estimation, distills validated observations into structured knowledge, and iteratively refines subsequent exploration toward unresolved uncertainty. Extensive experiments on high-resolution and general multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that TTSP consistently outperforms strong baselines across backbone sizes, while also exhibiting favorable scalability and token efficiency. Our results suggest that scaling perception at test time is a promising direction for robust multimodal reasoning under perceptual uncertainty.

AI.tldr: TTSP框架通过将感知本身作为可扩展的推理过程，解决MLLMs中的"接地悖论"，在测试时生成多个探索性感知轨迹，过滤不可靠信息，蒸馏结构化知识，并迭代优化后续探索。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在细粒度视觉推理中存在脆弱性，因为它们必须在获得足够证据之前就决定观察位置，这种循环依赖被称为"接地悖论"，需要新的方法来解决。
AI.method: 提出测试时感知扩展(TTSP)框架：1)生成多个探索性感知轨迹；2)使用基于熵的置信度估计过滤不可靠轨迹；3)将验证后的观察结果蒸馏为结构化知识；4)迭代优化后续探索以解决未解决的uncertainty。
AI.result: 在高分辨率和通用多模态推理基准测试中，TTSP在不同骨干网络规模下均优于强基线方法，同时展现出良好的可扩展性和token效率。
AI.conclusion: 测试时感知扩展是解决感知不确定性下稳健多模态推理的有前景方向，通过将感知本身作为可扩展推理过程，有效解决了接地悖论问题。

title: EgoFun3D: Modeling Interactive Objects from Egocentric Videos using Function Templates
summary: We present EgoFun3D, a coordinated task formulation, dataset, and benchmark for modeling interactive 3D objects from egocentric videos. Interactive objects are of high interest for embodied AI but scarce, making modeling from readily available real-world videos valuable. Our task focuses on obtaining simulation-ready interactive 3D objects from egocentric video input. While prior work largely focuses on articulations, we capture general cross-part functional mappings (e.g., rotation of stove knob controls stove burner temperature) through function templates, a structured computational representation. Function templates enable precise evaluation and direct compilation into executable code across simulation platforms. To enable comprehensive benchmarking, we introduce a dataset of 271 egocentric videos featuring challenging real-world interactions with paired 3D geometry, segmentation over 2D and 3D, articulation and function template annotations. To tackle the task, we propose a 4-stage pipeline consisting of: 2D part segmentation, reconstruction, articulation estimation, and function template inference. Comprehensive benchmarking shows that the task is challenging for off-the-shelf methods, highlighting avenues for future work.

AI.tldr: EgoFun3D是一个用于从第一人称视角视频中建模交互式3D对象的任务框架、数据集和基准测试，通过函数模板捕捉跨部件功能映射关系。
AI.motivation: 交互式对象对具身AI很重要但稀缺，需要从现实世界视频中建模。现有工作主要关注关节运动，而本文关注更一般的跨部件功能映射关系。
AI.method: 提出函数模板作为结构化计算表示，用于捕捉跨部件功能映射。开发包含271个第一人称视角视频的数据集，带有3D几何、分割、关节和函数模板标注。提出4阶段流水线：2D部件分割、重建、关节估计和函数模板推断。
AI.result: 创建了EgoFun3D数据集和基准测试，包含271个具有挑战性的现实世界交互视频。实验表明该任务对现有方法具有挑战性，为未来工作指明了方向。
AI.conclusion: EgoFun3D为从第一人称视角视频中获取仿真就绪的交互式3D对象提供了系统框架，通过函数模板实现了跨仿真平台的可执行代码生成，为具身AI研究提供了重要资源。

title: Lightweight Low-Light Image Enhancement via Distribution-Normalizing Preprocessing and Depthwise U-Net
comment: Technical report for the NTIRE 2026 Efficient Low-Light Image Enhancement Challenge (CVPR 2026 Workshops), 4th place solution
summary: We present a lightweight two-stage framework for low-light image enhancement (LLIE) that achieves competitive perceptual quality with significantly fewer parameters than existing methods. Our approach combines frozen algorithm-based preprocessing with a compact U-Net built entirely from depthwise-separable convolutions. The preprocessing normalizes the input distribution by providing complementary brightness-corrected views, enabling the trainable network to focus on residual color correction. Our method achieved 4th place in the CVPR 2026 NTIRE Efficient Low-Light Image Enhancement Challenge. We further provide extended benchmarks and ablations to demonstrate the general effectiveness of our methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一个轻量级两阶段框架用于低光图像增强，通过冻结算法预处理和紧凑U-Net实现竞争性感知质量，参数量显著少于现有方法
AI.motivation: 现有低光图像增强方法通常参数量大、计算成本高，需要开发更高效的轻量级方法，在保持感知质量的同时减少模型复杂度
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1) 冻结算法预处理阶段，通过亮度校正提供互补视图，归一化输入分布；2) 紧凑U-Net阶段，完全由深度可分离卷积构建，专注于残差颜色校正
AI.result: 在CVPR 2026 NTIRE高效低光图像增强挑战赛中获得第4名，参数量显著减少的同时保持了竞争性的感知质量
AI.conclusion: 提出的轻量级两阶段框架通过结合冻结算法预处理和紧凑U-Net，在低光图像增强任务中实现了高效性和性能的良好平衡，为实际应用提供了可行方案

title: ReSpinQuant: Efficient Layer-Wise LLM Quantization via Subspace Residual Rotation Approximation
summary: Rotation-based Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising solution for mitigating activation outliers in the quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs). Global rotation methods achieve inference efficiency by fusing activation rotations into attention and FFN blocks, but suffer from limited expressivity as they are constrained to use a single learnable rotation matrix across all layers. To tackle this, layer-wise transformation methods emerged, achieving superior accuracy through localized adaptation. However, layer-wise methods cannot fuse activation rotation matrices into weights, requiring online computations and causing significant overhead. In this paper, we propose ReSpinQuant, a quantization framework that resolves such overhead by leveraging offline activation rotation fusion and matching basis using efficient residual subspace rotation. This design reconciles the high expressivity of layer-wise adaptation with only negligible inference overhead. Extensive experiments on W4A4 and W3A3 quantization demonstrate that ReSpinQuant achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming global rotation methods and matching the accuracy of computationally expensive layer-wise methods with minimal overhead.

AI.tldr: ReSpinQuant是一个量化框架，通过离线激活旋转融合和高效残差子空间旋转，解决了层级方法的高计算开销问题，在保持高表达能力的同时实现最小推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有旋转后训练量化方法存在权衡：全局旋转方法计算效率高但表达能力有限（单旋转矩阵跨所有层），而层级方法精度高但无法融合激活旋转矩阵到权重中，需要在线计算并造成显著开销。
AI.method: ReSpinQuant采用离线激活旋转融合和匹配基的残差子空间旋转，将层级适应的高表达能力与最小推理开销相结合。
AI.result: 在W4A4和W3A3量化上的广泛实验表明，ReSpinQuant实现了最先进的性能，优于全局旋转方法，并与计算昂贵的层级方法精度相当，同时开销最小。
AI.conclusion: ReSpinQuant成功解决了旋转后训练量化中的表达能力和计算开销之间的权衡，为大型语言模型量化提供了高效且高精度的解决方案。

title: FlowCoMotion: Text-to-Motion Generation via Token-Latent Flow Modeling
summary: Text-to-motion generation is driven by learning motion representations for semantic alignment with language. Existing methods rely on either continuous or discrete motion representations. However, continuous representations entangle semantics with dynamics, while discrete representations lose fine-grained motion details. In this context, we propose FlowCoMotion, a novel motion generation framework that unifies both treatments from a modeling perspective. Specifically, FlowCoMotion employs token-latent coupling to capture both semantic content and high-fidelity motion details. In the latent branch, we apply multi-view distillation to regularize the continuous latent space, while in the token branch we use discrete temporal resolution quantization to extract high-level semantic cues. The motion latent is then obtained by combining the representations from the two branches through a token-latent coupling network. Subsequently, a velocity field is predicted based on the textual conditions. An ODE solver integrates this velocity field from a simple prior, thereby guiding the sample to the potential state of the target motion. Extensive experiments show that FlowCoMotion achieves competitive performance on text-to-motion benchmarks, including HumanML3D and SnapMoGen.

AI.tldr: FlowCoMotion是一个新颖的文本到动作生成框架，通过令牌-潜在耦合统一了连续和离散运动表示，解决了现有方法中语义与动态纠缠或细节丢失的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到动作生成方法依赖连续或离散运动表示，但连续表示将语义与动态纠缠在一起，而离散表示会丢失细粒度运动细节。需要一种能同时捕捉语义内容和高质量运动细节的统一方法。
AI.method: FlowCoMotion采用令牌-潜在耦合框架：1) 潜在分支使用多视图蒸馏正则化连续潜在空间；2) 令牌分支使用离散时间分辨率量化提取高级语义线索；3) 通过令牌-潜在耦合网络结合两个分支的表示；4) 基于文本条件预测速度场；5) 使用ODE求解器从简单先验积分速度场生成目标动作。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D和SnapMoGen等文本到动作基准测试中，FlowCoMotion取得了具有竞争力的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: FlowCoMotion通过统一连续和离散表示的方法，有效解决了文本到动作生成中语义对齐与运动细节保持的平衡问题，为运动生成提供了新的建模视角。

title: Structured State-Space Regularization for Compact and Generation-Friendly Image Tokenization
comment: Related blog posts in https://jinsingsangsung.github.io/collections/blog/ : Towards 2-Dimensional State-Space Models series
summary: Image tokenizers are central to modern vision models as they often operate in latent spaces. An ideal latent space must be simultaneously compact and generation-friendly: it should capture image's essential content compactly while remaining easy to model with generative approaches. In this work, we introduce a novel regularizer to align latent spaces with these two objectives. The key idea is to guide tokenizers to mimic the hidden state dynamics of state-space models (SSMs), thereby transferring their critical property, frequency awareness, to latent features. Grounded in a theoretical analysis of SSMs, our regularizer enforces encoding of fine spatial structures and frequency-domain cues into compact latent features; leading to more effective use of representation capacity and improved generative modelability. Experiments demonstrate that our method improves generation quality in diffusion models while incurring only minimal loss in reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的正则化方法，通过让图像分词器模仿状态空间模型的隐藏状态动态，将频率感知特性转移到潜在特征中，从而创建既紧凑又易于生成的潜在空间。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉模型通常在潜在空间中操作，理想的潜在空间需要同时满足紧凑性和生成友好性：既要紧凑地捕捉图像本质内容，又要便于生成模型建模。当前方法在这两个目标之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的正则化方法，引导图像分词器模仿状态空间模型（SSMs）的隐藏状态动态，从而将SSMs的关键特性——频率感知——转移到潜在特征中。该方法基于对SSMs的理论分析，强制将精细空间结构和频域线索编码到紧凑的潜在特征中。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在扩散模型中提高了生成质量，同时仅带来最小的重建保真度损失，实现了更有效的表示容量利用和改善的生成模型能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将状态空间模型的频率感知特性转移到图像分词器的潜在空间中，可以创建同时满足紧凑性和生成友好性的理想潜在表示，为视觉生成模型提供了更好的基础。

title: LDEPrompt: Layer-importance guided Dual Expandable Prompt Pool for Pre-trained Model-based Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Prompt-based class-incremental learning methods typically construct a prompt pool consisting of multiple trainable key-prompts and perform instance-level matching to select the most suitable prompt embeddings, which has shown promising results. However, existing approaches face several limitations, including fixed prompt pools, manual selection of prompt embeddings, and strong reliance on the pretrained backbone for prompt selection. To address these issues, we propose a \textbf{L}ayer-importance guided \textbf{D}ual \textbf{E}xpandable \textbf{P}rompt Pool (\textbf{LDEPrompt}), which enables adaptive layer selection as well as dynamic freezing and expansion of the prompt pool. Extensive experiments on widely used class-incremental learning benchmarks demonstrate that LDEPrompt achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating its effectiveness and scalability.

AI.tldr: LDEPrompt提出了一种基于层重要性的双可扩展提示池方法，用于解决提示式类增量学习中的固定提示池、手动选择提示嵌入和过度依赖预训练骨干网络的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示的类增量学习方法存在以下问题：1）使用固定的提示池；2）需要手动选择提示嵌入；3）提示选择过程过度依赖预训练骨干网络。这些问题限制了方法的适应性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出LDEPrompt方法，采用基于层重要性的指导机制，实现自适应层选择以及提示池的动态冻结和扩展。该方法能够根据任务需求自动调整提示池结构。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的类增量学习基准测试中进行了大量实验，LDEPrompt取得了最先进的性能，验证了其有效性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: LDEPrompt通过自适应层选择和动态提示池管理，有效解决了现有提示式类增量学习方法的局限性，在多个基准测试中表现出优越性能。

title: Efficient Transceiver Design for Aerial Image Transmission and Large-scale Scene Reconstruction
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE ISIT-w
summary: Large-scale three-dimensional (3D) scene reconstruction in low-altitude intelligent networks (LAIN) demands highly efficient wireless image transmission. However, existing schemes struggle to balance severe pilot overhead with the transmission accuracy required to maintain reconstruction fidelity. To strike a balance between efficiency and reliability, this paper proposes a novel deep learning-based end-to-end (E2E) transceiver design that integrates 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) directly into the training process. By jointly optimizing the communication modules via the combined 3DGS rendering loss, our approach explicitly improves scene recovery quality. Furthermore, this task-driven framework enables the use of a sparse pilot scheme, significantly reducing transmission overhead while maintaining robust image recovery under low-altitude channel conditions. Extensive experiments on real-world aerial image datasets demonstrate that the proposed E2E design significantly outperforms existing baselines, delivering superior transmission performance and accurate 3D scene reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于深度学习的端到端收发器设计，将3D高斯泼溅直接集成到训练过程中，用于低空智能网络中的大规模3D场景重建，显著降低传输开销并提高场景恢复质量。
AI.motivation: 低空智能网络中大规模3D场景重建需要高效的无线图像传输，但现有方案难以在严重的导频开销和保持重建保真度所需的传输精度之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出基于深度学习的端到端收发器设计，将3D高斯泼溅直接集成到训练过程中，通过联合优化通信模块和3DGS渲染损失，并采用稀疏导频方案显著降低传输开销。
AI.result: 在真实世界航拍图像数据集上的广泛实验表明，所提出的端到端设计显著优于现有基线方法，提供卓越的传输性能和准确的3D场景重建。
AI.conclusion: 该任务驱动的框架在效率和可靠性之间取得了良好平衡，能够在低空信道条件下保持鲁棒的图像恢复，同时显著减少传输开销。

title: OmniScript: Towards Audio-Visual Script Generation for Long-Form Cinematic Video
summary: Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in short-form video understanding, yet translating long-form cinematic videos into detailed, temporally grounded scripts remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces the novel video-to-script (V2S) task, aiming to generate hierarchical, scene-by-scene scripts encompassing character actions, dialogues, expressions, and audio cues. To facilitate this, we construct a first-of-its-kind human-annotated benchmark and propose a temporally-aware hierarchical evaluation framework. Furthermore, we present OmniScript, an 8B-parameter omni-modal (audio-visual) language model tailored for long-form narrative comprehension. OmniScript is trained via a progressive pipeline that leverages chain-of-thought supervised fine-tuning for plot and character reasoning, followed by reinforcement learning using temporally segmented rewards. Extensive experiments demonstrate that despite its parameter efficiency, OmniScript significantly outperforms larger open-source models and achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art proprietary models, including Gemini 3-Pro, in both temporal localization and multi-field semantic accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了视频到脚本（V2S）新任务，构建了首个人类标注基准，并开发了OmniScript模型，这是一个8B参数的音频视觉语言模型，专门用于长视频叙事理解，在性能上超越大型开源模型并接近最先进的专有模型。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在短视频理解方面表现出色，但将长视频（特别是电影视频）转换为详细、时间定位的脚本仍然是一个重大挑战。需要解决长视频叙事理解中的时间定位和多模态信息整合问题。
AI.method: 1. 提出视频到脚本（V2S）新任务，构建首个人类标注基准；2. 提出时间感知的分层评估框架；3. 开发OmniScript模型（8B参数的全模态音频视觉语言模型），采用渐进式训练流程：先通过思维链监督微调进行情节和角色推理，然后使用时间分段奖励进行强化学习。
AI.result: 尽管参数效率高，OmniScript显著优于大型开源模型，在时间定位和多领域语义准确性方面达到与最先进专有模型（包括Gemini 3-Pro）相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功解决了长视频叙事理解的关键挑战，提出的V2S任务、评估框架和OmniScript模型为长视频内容分析和生成提供了有效解决方案，展示了参数效率模型在复杂多模态任务中的潜力。

title: Semantic-Geometric Dual Compression: Training-Free Visual Token Reduction for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Understanding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated immense potential in Earth observation. However, the massive visual tokens generated when processing Ultra-High-Resolution (UHR) imagery introduce prohibitive computational overhead, severely bottlenecking their inference efficiency. Existing visual token compression methods predominantly adopt static and uniform compression strategies, neglecting the inherent "Semantic-Geometric Duality" in remote sensing interpretation tasks. Specifically, object semantic tasks focus on the abstract semantics of objects and benefit from aggressive background pruning, whereas scene geometric tasks critically rely on the integrity of spatial topology. To address this challenge, we propose DualComp, a task-adaptive dual-stream token compression framework. Dynamically guided by a lightweight pre-trained router, DualComp decouples feature processing into two dedicated pathways. In the object semantic stream, the Spatially-Contiguous Semantic Aggregator (SCSA) utilizes size-adaptive clustering to aggregates redundant background while protecting small object. In the scene geometric stream, the Instruction-Guided Structure Recoverer (IGSR) introduces a greedy path-tracing topology completion mechanism to reconstruct spatial skeletons. Experiments on the UHR remote sensing benchmark XLRS-Bench demonstrate that DualComp accomplishes high-fidelity remote sensing interpretation at an exceptionally low computational cost, achieving simultaneous improvements in both efficiency and accuracy.

AI.tldr: DualComp是一个面向超高分辨率遥感图像的任务自适应双流token压缩框架，通过动态路由将特征处理分为对象语义流和场景几何流，分别采用不同的压缩策略，在降低计算成本的同时提升遥感解释的准确率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在处理超高分辨率遥感图像时会产生大量视觉token，带来巨大的计算开销。现有的视觉token压缩方法采用静态统一的压缩策略，忽视了遥感解释任务中固有的"语义-几何二重性"：对象语义任务关注对象的抽象语义，需要积极修剪背景；而场景几何任务则严重依赖空间拓扑的完整性。
AI.method: 提出DualComp框架，通过轻量级预训练路由器动态指导，将特征处理解耦为两个专用路径：1) 对象语义流中，使用空间连续语义聚合器通过尺寸自适应聚类聚合冗余背景，同时保护小对象；2) 场景几何流中，使用指令引导结构恢复器引入贪婪路径追踪拓扑补全机制来重建空间骨架。
AI.result: 在超高分辨率遥感基准测试XLRS-Bench上的实验表明，DualComp能够以极低的计算成本实现高保真度的遥感解释，在效率和准确性方面同时取得改进。
AI.conclusion: DualComp通过任务自适应的双流token压缩策略，有效解决了超高分辨率遥感图像处理中的计算效率瓶颈问题，同时考虑了遥感解释任务中语义和几何需求的不同特性，实现了效率和精度的双重提升。

title: BoxTuning: Directly Injecting the Object Box for Multimodal Model Fine-Tuning
summary: Object-level spatial-temporal understanding is essential for video question answering, yet existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode frames holistically and lack explicit mechanisms for fine-grained object grounding. Recent work addresses this by serializing bounding box coordinates as text tokens, but this text-coordinate paradigm suffers from a fundamental modality mismatch: object information is inherently visual, yet encoding it as text incurs a high token cost that forces aggressive temporal downsampling. We propose BoxTuning, which resolves this mismatch by injecting object spatial-temporal information directly into the visual modality. Colored bounding boxes and trajectory trails are rendered onto video frames as visual prompts, with only a concise color-to-object legend retained as text. This reduces the token cost significantly, achieving 87-93% text token reduction in practice. It also preserves full temporal resolution, where the trajectory trails further encode inter-frame motion direction and speed within each keyframe, recovering fine-grained dynamics that text-coordinate methods are forced to discard. Experimental results on five video QA benchmarks (CLEVRER, Perception Test, STAR, NExT-QA, IntentQA) show that BoxTuning surpasses text-coordinate baselines on spatially oriented tasks and nearly eliminates the accuracy degradation observed on reasoning-centric tasks, establishing visual prompting as a more natural and efficient paradigm for conveying object information to video MLLMs.

AI.tldr: BoxTuning是一种视觉提示方法，通过将彩色边界框和轨迹轨迹渲染到视频帧上，直接将对象时空信息注入视觉模态，显著减少文本标记成本并保持完整时间分辨率，在视频问答任务中优于文本坐标方法。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在视频问答中缺乏细粒度对象定位机制，而将边界框坐标序列化为文本标记的方法存在模态不匹配问题：对象信息本质上是视觉的，但编码为文本会导致高昂的标记成本，迫使进行激进的时间下采样。
AI.method: BoxTuning通过将彩色边界框和轨迹轨迹渲染到视频帧上作为视觉提示，仅保留简洁的颜色-对象图例作为文本。这种方法将对象时空信息直接注入视觉模态，显著减少文本标记成本（实践中减少87-93%），并保持完整时间分辨率。轨迹轨迹进一步编码关键帧内的帧间运动方向和速度。
AI.result: 在五个视频问答基准测试（CLEVRER、Perception Test、STAR、NExT-QA、IntentQA）上的实验结果显示，BoxTuning在空间导向任务上超越了文本坐标基线，并几乎消除了在推理中心任务上观察到的准确度下降。
AI.conclusion: BoxTuning建立了一种更自然、更高效的范式，用于向视频多模态大语言模型传达对象信息，通过视觉提示解决了文本坐标方法的模态不匹配问题，在保持完整时间分辨率的同时显著减少了标记成本。

title: Naka-GS: A Bionics-inspired Dual-Branch Naka Correction and Progressive Point Pruning for Low-Light 3DGS
summary: Low-light conditions severely hinder 3D restoration and reconstruction by degrading image visibility, introducing color distortions, and contaminating geometric priors for downstream optimization. We present NAKA-GS, a bionics-inspired framework for low-light 3D Gaussian Splatting that jointly improves photometric restoration and geometric initialization. Our method starts with a Naka-guided chroma-correction network, which combines physics-prior low-light enhancement, dual-branch input modeling, frequency-decoupled correction, and mask-guided optimization to suppress bright-region chromatic artifacts and edge-structure errors. The enhanced images are then fed into a feed-forward multi-view reconstruction model to produce dense scene priors. To further improve Gaussian initialization, we introduce a lightweight Point Preprocessing Module (PPM) that performs coordinate alignment, voxel pooling, and distance-adaptive progressive pruning to remove noisy and redundant points while preserving representative structures. Without introducing heavy inference overhead, NAKA-GS improves restoration quality, training stability, and optimization efficiency for low-light 3D reconstruction. The proposed method was presented in the NTIRE 3D Restoration and Reconstruction (3DRR) Challenge, and outperformed the baseline methods by a large margin. The code is available at https://github.com/RunyuZhu/Naka-GS

AI.tldr: NAKA-GS是一个仿生启发的低光照3D高斯泼溅框架，通过联合改进光度恢复和几何初始化，解决低光照条件下3D重建的可见性、色彩失真和几何先验污染问题。
AI.motivation: 低光照条件严重阻碍3D恢复和重建，会降低图像可见度、引入色彩失真，并污染下游优化所需的几何先验信息。
AI.method: 1. Naka引导的色度校正网络：结合物理先验的低光照增强、双分支输入建模、频率解耦校正和掩码引导优化；2. 前馈多视图重建模型生成密集场景先验；3. 轻量级点预处理模块（PPM）进行坐标对齐、体素池化和距离自适应渐进剪枝。
AI.result: 在NTIRE 3D恢复与重建挑战赛中表现优异，大幅超越基线方法，提高了恢复质量、训练稳定性和优化效率，且不引入沉重的推理开销。
AI.conclusion: NAKA-GS通过仿生启发的框架有效解决了低光照3D重建中的关键问题，在保持高效性的同时显著提升了恢复和重建性能。

title: rPPG-VQA: A Video Quality Assessment Framework for Unsupervised rPPG Training
summary: Unsupervised remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) promises to leverage unlabeled video data, but its potential is hindered by a critical challenge: training on low-quality "in-the-wild" videos severely degrades model performance. An essential step missing here is to assess the suitability of the videos for rPPG model learning before using them for the task. Existing video quality assessment (VQA) methods are mainly designed for human perception and not directly applicable to the above purpose. In this work, we propose rPPG-VQA, a novel framework for assessing video suitability for rPPG. We integrate signal-level and scene-level analyses and design a dual-branch assessment architecture. The signal-level branch evaluates the physiological signal quality of the videos via robust signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) estimation with a multi-method consensus mechanism, and the scene-level branch uses a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to identify interferences like motion and unstable lighting. Furthermore, we propose a two-stage adaptive sampling (TAS) strategy that utilizes the quality score to curate optimal training datasets. Experiments show that by training on large-scale, "in-the-wild" videos filtered by our framework, we can develop unsupervised rPPG models that achieve a substantial improvement in accuracy on standard benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tianyang-Dai/rPPG-VQA.

AI.tldr: 提出rPPG-VQA框架，通过信号级和场景级双分支评估视频对远程光电容积描记术的适用性，结合自适应采样策略筛选高质量训练数据，显著提升无监督rPPG模型性能。
AI.motivation: 无监督远程光电容积描记术(rPPG)需要利用未标记视频数据，但在"野外"低质量视频上训练会严重降低模型性能。现有视频质量评估方法主要针对人类感知设计，不适用于评估视频对rPPG学习的适用性。
AI.method: 提出rPPG-VQA框架：1) 信号级分支通过多方法共识机制进行稳健的信噪比估计，评估视频生理信号质量；2) 场景级分支使用多模态大语言模型识别运动和光照不稳定等干扰；3) 提出两阶段自适应采样策略，利用质量分数筛选最优训练数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明，通过使用该框架筛选的大规模"野外"视频进行训练，无监督rPPG模型在标准基准测试中实现了显著精度提升。
AI.conclusion: rPPG-VQA框架有效评估视频对rPPG学习的适用性，通过质量驱动的数据筛选显著提升无监督rPPG模型性能，为利用大规模未标记视频数据提供了有效解决方案。

title: Boxes2Pixels: Learning Defect Segmentation from Noisy SAM Masks
comment: Accepted for presentation at the AI4RWC Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary:
Accurate defect segmentation is critical for industrial inspection, yet dense pixel-level annotations are rarely available. A common workaround is to convert inexpensive bounding boxes into pseudo-masks using foundation segmentation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM). However, these pseudo-labels are systematically noisy on industrial surfaces, often hallucinating background structure while missing sparse defects.
  To address this limitation, a noise-robust box-to-pixel distillation framework, Boxes2Pixels, is proposed that treats SAM as a noisy teacher rather than a source of ground-truth supervision. Bounding boxes are converted into pseudo-masks offline by SAM, and a compact student is trained with (i) a hierarchical decoder over frozen DINOv2 features for semantic stability, (ii) an auxiliary binary localization head to decouple sparse foreground discovery from class prediction, and (iii) a one-sided online self-correction mechanism that relaxes background supervision when the student is confident, targeting teacher false negatives.
  On a manually annotated wind turbine inspection benchmark, the proposed Boxes2Pixels improves anomaly mIoU by +6.97 and binary IoU by +9.71 over the strongest baseline trained under identical weak supervision. Moreover, online self-correction increases the binary recall by +18.56, while the model employs 80\% fewer trainable parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/CLendering/Boxes2Pixels.

AI.tldr: Boxes2Pixels：一种噪声鲁棒的框到像素蒸馏框架，利用SAM作为噪声教师而非真值监督源，通过分层解码器、辅助定位头和单边在线自校正机制，在工业缺陷分割任务中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 工业缺陷分割需要密集像素级标注，但实际中难以获取。常用方法是用SAM等基础分割模型将廉价边界框转换为伪掩码，但这些伪标签在工业表面上存在系统性噪声，经常错误识别背景结构而遗漏稀疏缺陷。
AI.method: 提出Boxes2Pixels框架：1）离线使用SAM将边界框转换为伪掩码；2）使用冻结DINOv2特征的分层解码器保证语义稳定性；3）辅助二元定位头将稀疏前景发现与类别预测解耦；4）单边在线自校正机制在学生模型置信度高时放松背景监督，针对教师的假阴性错误。
AI.result: 在手动标注的风力涡轮机检测基准上，Boxes2Pixels相比相同弱监督下的最强基线，异常mIoU提升+6.97，二元IoU提升+9.71。在线自校正使二元召回率提升+18.56%，同时模型参数量减少80%。
AI.conclusion: Boxes2Pixels框架通过将SAM视为噪声教师而非真值源，结合分层解码、辅助定位和在线自校正，有效解决了工业缺陷分割中伪标签噪声问题，在减少参数的同时显著提升了分割性能。

title: Do Thought Streams Matter? Evaluating Reasoning in Gemini Vision-Language Models for Video Scene Understanding
summary: We benchmark how internal reasoning traces, which we call thought streams, affect video scene understanding in vision-language models. Using four configurations of Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash Lite across scenes extracted from 100 hours of video, we ask three questions: does more thinking lead to better outputs, where do the gains stop, and what do these models actually think about? We introduce three evaluation metrics. Contentfulness measures how much of the thought stream is useful scene content versus meta-commentary. Thought-Final Coverage measures how faithfully the thought stream translates into the final output. Dominant Entity Analysis identifies which subjects, actions, and settings the model focuses on. GPT-5 serves as an independent judge. We find that quality gains from additional thinking plateau quickly, with most improvement occurring in the first few hundred tokens. Flash Lite offers the best balance between quality and token usage. Tight reasoning budgets cause the model to add content in the final output that it never reasoned about, a form of compression-step hallucination. Despite being different model tiers, Flash and Flash Lite produce similar thought streams, though they differ in style: Flash discusses its reasoning process, while Lite focuses on describing the scene.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了视觉语言模型中内部推理轨迹（思维流）对视频场景理解的影响，发现质量提升在最初几百个token后趋于平稳，Flash Lite在质量和token使用之间达到最佳平衡，不同模型层级产生相似但风格不同的思维流。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是评估视觉语言模型中内部推理轨迹（思维流）如何影响视频场景理解，探究更多思考是否带来更好输出、增益何时停止以及模型实际思考内容这三个核心问题。
AI.method: 使用Google Gemini 2.5 Flash和Flash Lite的四种配置，从100小时视频中提取场景，引入三个评估指标：内容充实度（衡量思维流中有用场景内容与元评论的比例）、思维-最终覆盖度（衡量思维流转化为最终输出的忠实度）、主导实体分析（识别模型关注的主体、动作和场景），并使用GPT-5作为独立评判者。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）质量提升随额外思考快速趋于平稳，大部分改进发生在最初几百个token内；2）Flash Lite在质量和token使用之间达到最佳平衡；3）紧凑的推理预算导致模型在最终输出中添加从未推理过的内容，形成压缩步骤幻觉；4）尽管是不同的模型层级，Flash和Flash Lite产生相似的思维流，但风格不同：Flash讨论其推理过程，而Lite专注于描述场景。
AI.conclusion: 思维流对视频场景理解有显著影响但收益递减，模型层级差异主要影响推理风格而非内容质量，紧凑推理预算可能导致幻觉问题，Flash Lite在效率和质量平衡方面表现最佳。

title: LoViF 2026 Challenge on Human-oriented Semantic Image Quality Assessment: Methods and Results
comment: Accepted by CVPR2026 Workshop; LoViF Challenge
summary: This paper reviews the LoViF 2026 Challenge on Human-oriented Semantic Image Quality Assessment. This challenge aims to raise a new direction, i.e., how to evaluate the loss of semantic information from the human perspective, intending to promote the development of some new directions, like semantic coding, processing, and semantic-oriented optimization, etc. Unlike existing datasets of quality assessment, we form a dataset of human-oriented semantic quality assessment, termed the SeIQA dataset. This dataset is divided into three parts for this competition: (i) training data: 510 pairs of degraded images and their corresponding ground truth references; (ii) validation data: 80 pairs of degraded images and their corresponding ground-truth references; (iii) testing data: 160 pairs of degraded images and their corresponding ground-truth references. The primary objective of this challenge is to establish a new and powerful benchmark for human-oriented semantic image quality assessment. There are a total of 58 teams registered in this competition, and 6 teams submitted valid solutions and fact sheets for the final testing phase. These submissions achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the SeIQA dataset.

AI.tldr: LoViF 2026挑战赛提出面向人类的语义图像质量评估新方向，创建SeIQA数据集，58个团队参赛，6个团队提交方案，在语义质量评估上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图像质量评估方法缺乏从人类视角评估语义信息损失的能力，需要推动语义编码、处理和语义导向优化等新方向的发展。
AI.method: 创建SeIQA数据集（训练集510对、验证集80对、测试集160对），组织LoViF 2026挑战赛，邀请团队开发面向人类的语义图像质量评估方法。
AI.result: 58个团队注册参赛，6个团队提交有效解决方案，这些提交在SeIQA数据集上达到了最先进的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛成功建立了面向人类的语义图像质量评估新基准，推动了语义信息评估领域的发展，为相关研究方向提供了重要数据集和评估框架。

title: 3DTV: A Feedforward Interpolation Network for Real-Time View Synthesis
summary:
Real-time free-viewpoint rendering requires balancing multi-camera redundancy with the latency constraints of interactive applications. We address this challenge by combining lightweight geometry with learning and propose 3DTV, a feedforward network for real-time sparse-view interpolation. A Delaunay-based triplet selection ensures angular coverage for each target view. Building on this, we introduce a pose-aware depth module that estimates a coarse-to-fine depth pyramid, enabling efficient feature reprojection and occlusion-aware blending. Unlike methods that require scene-specific optimization, 3DTV runs feedforward without retraining, making it practical for AR/VR, telepresence, and interactive applications. Our experiments on challenging multi-view video datasets demonstrate that 3DTV consistently achieves a strong balance of quality and efficiency, outperforming recent real-time novel-view baselines. Crucially, 3DTV avoids explicit proxies, enabling robust rendering across diverse scenes. This makes it a practical solution for low-latency multi-view streaming and interactive rendering.
  Project Page: https://stefanmschulz.github.io/3DTV_webpage/

AI.tldr: 3DTV是一个用于实时稀疏视角插值的前馈网络，通过结合轻量级几何与学习技术，在AR/VR、远程呈现和交互应用中实现实时自由视点渲染，无需场景特定优化。
AI.motivation: 实时自由视点渲染需要在多相机冗余性与交互应用的延迟约束之间取得平衡。现有方法通常需要场景特定优化，不适用于实时应用。
AI.method: 提出3DTV网络，采用Delaunay-based triplet selection确保每个目标视角的角度覆盖；引入pose-aware depth模块估计从粗到细的深度金字塔，实现高效特征重投影和遮挡感知融合；无需重新训练即可前馈运行。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的多视角视频数据集上的实验表明，3DTV在质量和效率之间实现了良好平衡，优于最近的实时新视角基线方法；能够避免显式代理，在不同场景中实现鲁棒渲染。
AI.conclusion: 3DTV为低延迟多视角流媒体和交互渲染提供了一个实用的解决方案，特别适用于AR/VR、远程呈现和交互应用。

title: H-SPAM: Hierarchical Superpixel Anything Model
summary: Superpixels offer a compact image representation by grouping pixels into coherent regions. Recent methods have reached a plateau in terms of segmentation accuracy by generating noisy superpixel shapes. Moreover, most existing approaches produce a single fixed-scale partition that limits their use in vision pipelines that would benefit multi-scale representations. In this work, we introduce H-SPAM (Hierarchical Superpixel Anything Model), a unified framework for generating accurate, regular, and perfectly nested hierarchical superpixels. Starting from a fine partition, guided by deep features and external object priors, H-SPAM constructs the hierarchy through a two-phase region merging process that first preserves object consistency and then allows controlled inter-object grouping. The hierarchy can also be modulated using visual attention maps or user input to preserve important regions longer in the hierarchy. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that H-SPAM strongly outperforms existing hierarchical methods in both accuracy and regularity, while performing on par with most recent state-of-the-art non-hierarchical methods. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/waldo-j/hspam.

AI.tldr: H-SPAM是一个生成准确、规则且完美嵌套的层次化超像素的统一框架，通过两阶段区域合并过程构建层次结构，支持视觉注意力图或用户输入调制。
AI.motivation: 现有超像素方法在分割精度上已达到瓶颈，生成的超像素形状嘈杂，且大多只能产生单一固定尺度的分割，限制了在需要多尺度表示的视觉管道中的应用。
AI.method: H-SPAM从精细分割开始，在深度特征和外部对象先验的指导下，通过两阶段区域合并过程构建层次结构：第一阶段保持对象一致性，第二阶段允许受控的对象间分组。层次结构还可以使用视觉注意力图或用户输入进行调制，以在层次结构中更长时间地保留重要区域。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试中，H-SPAM在准确性和规则性方面显著优于现有的层次化方法，同时与最新的非层次化最先进方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: H-SPAM提供了一个统一的框架，能够生成准确、规则且完美嵌套的层次化超像素，解决了现有方法在形状噪声和单一尺度限制方面的问题，支持多尺度视觉应用。

title: NTIRE 2026 The 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) Challenge: AI Flash Portrait (Track 3)
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 Workshop. Includes supplementary material as ancillary file
summary: In this paper, we present a comprehensive overview of the NTIRE 2026 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) challenge, with a specific focus on Track 3: AI Flash Portrait. Despite significant advancements in deep learning for image restoration, existing models still encounter substantial challenges in real-world low-light portrait scenarios. Specifically, they struggle to achieve an optimal balance among noise suppression, detail preservation, and faithful illumination and color reproduction. To bridge this gap, this challenge aims to establish a novel benchmark for real-world low-light portrait restoration. We comprehensively evaluate the proposed algorithms utilizing a hybrid evaluation system that integrates objective quantitative metrics with rigorous subjective assessment protocols. For this competition, we provide a dataset containing 800 groups of real-captured low-light portrait data. Each group consists of a 1K-resolution low-light input image, a 1K ground truth (GT), and a 1K person mask. This challenge has garnered widespread attention from both academia and industry, attracting over 100 participating teams and receiving more than 3,000 valid submissions. This report details the motivation behind the challenge, the dataset construction process, the evaluation metrics, and the various phases of the competition. The released dataset and baseline code for this track are publicly available from the same \href{https://github.com/zsn1434/AI_Flash-BaseLine/tree/main}{GitHub repository}, and the official challenge webpage is hosted on \href{https://www.codabench.org/competitions/12885/}{CodaBench}.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026 RAIM挑战赛第三赛道AI Flash Portrait聚焦真实世界低光人像恢复，旨在解决现有模型在噪声抑制、细节保留和色彩还原之间的平衡问题，提供了800组真实拍摄的低光人像数据集。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度学习在图像恢复方面取得显著进展，现有模型在真实世界低光人像场景中仍面临重大挑战，特别是在噪声抑制、细节保留以及准确的照明和色彩还原之间的平衡问题上。为了弥补这一差距，该挑战赛旨在为真实世界低光人像恢复建立新的基准。
AI.method: 挑战赛提供了包含800组真实拍摄的低光人像数据集，每组包含1K分辨率的低光输入图像、1K地面真值(GT)和1K人物掩码。采用混合评估系统，结合客观定量指标和严格的主观评估协议来全面评估参赛算法。
AI.result: 该挑战赛获得了学术界和工业界的广泛关注，吸引了超过100个参赛团队，收到了超过3,000份有效提交。数据集和基线代码已在GitHub上公开，挑战赛官方网页托管在CodaBench平台。
AI.conclusion: NTIRE 2026 RAIM挑战赛第三赛道成功建立了真实世界低光人像恢复的新基准，通过大规模数据集和混合评估系统推动了该领域的研究进展，为后续研究提供了重要的参考框架和资源。

title: Decoupled Similarity for Task-Aware Token Pruning in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Token pruning has emerged as an effective approach to reduce the substantial computational overhead of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by discarding less informative visual tokens while preserving performance. However, existing methods typically rely on individual attention sources from different LVLM components, resulting in incomplete and suboptimal pruning decisions due to biased attention distributions. To address this problem, we propose DeSAP, a novel Decoupled Similarity-Aware Pruning method for precise, task-aware token pruning within the visual encoder. Specifically, DeSAP introduces a decoupled similarity to capture fine-grained cross-modal relevance between visual features and text tokens, providing explicit task-related guidance for pruning. By integrating decoupled similarity with visual saliency signals derived from visual attention, DeSAP performs token pruning under the guidance of both task-related and visual cues, enabling robust pruning even under aggressive pruning ratios. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and architectures show that DeSAP consistently outperforms SOTA methods in both accuracy and efficiency. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, DeSAP achieves a 10 times FLOPs reduction and a 2.3 times prefill speedup by retaining only 11.1% of visual tokens, while maintaining 98.1% of the original performance.

AI.tldr: DeSAP提出了一种解耦相似性感知的视觉令牌剪枝方法，通过结合跨模态相关性和视觉显著性信号，在保持性能的同时大幅降低大型视觉语言模型的计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有令牌剪枝方法通常依赖单个注意力源，导致注意力分布偏差和不完整的剪枝决策，需要更精确的任务感知剪枝方法。
AI.method: DeSAP引入解耦相似性来捕获视觉特征与文本令牌之间的细粒度跨模态相关性，结合视觉注意力产生的视觉显著性信号，在任务相关和视觉线索的双重指导下进行令牌剪枝。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，DeSAP仅保留11.1%的视觉令牌，实现了10倍的FLOPs减少和2.3倍的预填充加速，同时保持原始性能的98.1%。
AI.conclusion: DeSAP通过解耦相似性感知剪枝方法，在各种基准测试和架构中均优于现有方法，实现了精度和效率的双重提升。

title: Script-a-Video: Deep Structured Audio-visual Captions via Factorized Streams and Relational Grounding
summary: Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are transforming video captioning from a descriptive endpoint into a semantic interface for both video understanding and generation. However, the dominant paradigm still casts videos as monolithic narrative paragraphs that entangle visual, auditory, and identity information. This dense coupling not only compromises representational fidelity but also limits scalability, since even local edits can trigger global rewrites. To address this structural bottleneck, we propose Multi-Stream Scene Script (MTSS), a novel paradigm that replaces monolithic text with factorized and explicitly grounded scene descriptions. MTSS is built on two core principles: Stream Factorization, which decouples a video into complementary streams (Reference, Shot, Event, and Global), and Relational Grounding, which reconnects these isolated streams through explicit identity and temporal links to maintain holistic video consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MTSS consistently enhances video understanding across various models, achieving an average reduction of 25% in the total error rate on Video-SALMONN-2 and an average performance gain of 67% on the Daily-Omni reasoning benchmark. It also narrows the performance gap between smaller and larger MLLMs, indicating a substantially more learnable caption interface. Finally, even without architectural adaptation, replacing monolithic prompts with MTSS in multi-shot video generation yields substantial human-rated improvements: a 45% boost in cross-shot identity consistency, a 56% boost in audio-visual alignment, and a 71% boost in temporal controllability.

AI.tldr: MTSS提出了一种新的视频描述范式，通过流分解和关系接地将视频分解为多个互补流，替代传统的整体式段落描述，显著提升视频理解和生成性能。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在视频描述中仍采用整体式段落描述，将视觉、听觉和身份信息纠缠在一起，这不仅损害了表示保真度，还限制了可扩展性，因为局部编辑可能触发全局重写。
AI.method: MTSS基于两个核心原则：流分解（将视频解耦为参考流、镜头流、事件流和全局流）和关系接地（通过显式的身份和时间链接重新连接这些孤立流以保持视频整体一致性）。
AI.result: MTSS在视频理解方面显著提升性能，在Video-SALMONN-2上平均减少25%的总错误率，在Daily-Omni推理基准上平均提升67%性能。在视频生成方面，即使没有架构调整，也能带来45%的跨镜头身份一致性提升、56%的音视频对齐提升和71%的时间可控性提升。
AI.conclusion: MTSS通过结构化分解的视频描述范式，解决了传统整体式描述的结构瓶颈，不仅提升了视频理解性能，还缩小了不同规模MLLM之间的性能差距，为视频生成提供了更可控的接口。

title: Variational Latent Entropy Estimation Disentanglement: Controlled Attribute Leakage for Face Recognition
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security (TIFS). 13 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables
summary: Face recognition embeddings encode identity, but they also encode other factors such as gender and ethnicity. Depending on how these factors are used by a downstream system, separating them from the information needed for verification is important for both privacy and fairness. We propose Variational Latent Entropy Estimation Disentanglement (VLEED), a post-hoc method that transforms pretrained embeddings with a variational autoencoder and encourages a distilled representation where the categorical variable of interest is separated from identity-relevant information. VLEED uses a mutual information-based objective realised through the estimation of the entropy of the categorical attribute in the latent space, and provides stable training with fine-grained control over information removal. We evaluate our method on IJB-C, RFW, and VGGFace2 for gender and ethnicity disentanglement, and compare it to various state-of-the-art methods. We report verification utility, predictability of the disentangled variable under linear and nonlinear classifiers, and group disparity metrics based on false match rates. Our results show that VLEED offers a wide range of privacy-utility tradeoffs over existing methods and can also reduce recognition bias across demographic groups.

AI.tldr: VLEED是一种后处理方法，使用变分自编码器转换预训练的人脸识别嵌入，通过互信息目标分离身份信息与性别/种族等属性，实现隐私保护和公平性平衡。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别嵌入不仅编码身份信息，还包含性别、种族等敏感属性。这些属性在下游系统中可能被滥用，导致隐私泄露和公平性问题，因此需要将其从验证所需信息中分离出来。
AI.method: 提出VLEED（变分潜在熵估计解缠）方法：使用变分自编码器转换预训练嵌入，通过基于互信息的目标函数（通过估计潜在空间中分类属性的熵实现），鼓励提取出分离身份相关信息和分类变量的表示。
AI.result: 在IJB-C、RFW和VGGFace2数据集上评估性别和种族解缠效果，与多种先进方法比较。结果显示VLEED在隐私-效用权衡方面优于现有方法，并能减少跨人口统计组的识别偏见。
AI.conclusion: VLEED通过变分自编码器和互信息目标，有效分离人脸嵌入中的身份信息与敏感属性，提供稳定的训练和细粒度控制，在隐私保护和公平性方面优于现有方法。

title: A Deep Equilibrium Network for Hyperspectral Unmixing
summary: Hyperspectral unmixing (HU) is crucial for analyzing hyperspectral imagery, yet achieving accurate unmixing remains challenging. While traditional methods struggle to effectively model complex spectral-spatial features, deep learning approaches often lack physical interpretability. Unrolling-based methods, despite offering network interpretability, inadequately exploit spectral-spatial information and incur high memory costs and numerical precision issues during backpropagation. To address these limitations, we propose DEQ-Unmix, which reformulates abundance estimation as a deep equilibrium model, enabling efficient constant-memory training via implicit differentiation. It replaces the gradient operator of the data reconstruction term with a trainable convolutional network to capture spectral-spatial information. By leveraging implicit differentiation, DEQ-Unmix enables efficient and constant-memory backpropagation. Experiments on synthetic and two real-world datasets demonstrate that DEQ-Unmix achieves superior unmixing performance while maintaining constant memory cost.

AI.tldr: 提出DEQ-Unmix方法，将丰度估计重新表述为深度平衡模型，通过隐式微分实现高效恒定内存训练，在保持物理可解释性的同时提升高光谱解混性能。
AI.motivation: 传统高光谱解混方法难以有效建模复杂的光谱-空间特征，深度学习方法缺乏物理可解释性，而展开式方法存在内存成本高和数值精度问题。需要一种既能有效利用光谱-空间信息，又具有物理可解释性且内存高效的方法。
AI.method: 将丰度估计重新表述为深度平衡模型，用可训练的卷积网络替换数据重建项的梯度算子来捕获光谱-空间信息，通过隐式微分实现高效恒定内存的反向传播。
AI.result: 在合成和两个真实数据集上的实验表明，DEQ-Unmix实现了优越的解混性能，同时保持了恒定的内存成本。
AI.conclusion: DEQ-Unmix通过深度平衡模型框架，在保持物理可解释性的同时，有效解决了传统方法和深度学习方法在高光谱解混中的局限性，实现了性能与内存效率的平衡。

title: Any 3D Scene is Worth 1K Tokens: 3D-Grounded Representation for Scene Generation at Scale
summary: 3D scene generation has long been dominated by 2D multi-view or video diffusion models. This is due not only to the lack of scene-level 3D latent representation, but also to the fact that most scene-level 3D visual data exists in the form of multi-view images or videos, which are naturally compatible with 2D diffusion architectures. Typically, these 2D-based approaches degrade 3D spatial extrapolation to 2D temporal extension, which introduces two fundamental issues: (i) representing 3D scenes via 2D views leads to significant representation redundancy, and (ii) latent space rooted in 2D inherently limits the spatial consistency of the generated 3D scenes. In this paper, we propose, for the first time, to perform 3D scene generation directly within an implicit 3D latent space to address these limitations. First, we repurpose frozen 2D representation encoders to construct our 3D Representation Autoencoder (3DRAE), which grounds view-coupled 2D semantic representations into a view-decoupled 3D latent representation. This enables representing 3D scenes observed from arbitrary numbers of views--at any resolution and aspect ratio--with fixed complexity and rich semantics. Then we introduce 3D Diffusion Transformer (3DDiT), which performs diffusion modeling in this 3D latent space, achieving remarkably efficient and spatially consistent 3D scene generation while supporting diverse conditioning configurations. Moreover, since our approach directly generates a 3D scene representation, it can be decoded to images and optional point maps along arbitrary camera trajectories without requiring per-trajectory diffusion sampling pass, which is common in 2D-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个直接在隐式3D潜在空间中生成3D场景的方法，通过3D表示自编码器和3D扩散变换器解决传统2D多视图方法存在的表示冗余和空间一致性问题。
AI.motivation: 当前3D场景生成主要依赖2D多视图或视频扩散模型，存在两个根本问题：1) 通过2D视图表示3D场景导致显著的表示冗余；2) 基于2D的潜在空间固有地限制了生成3D场景的空间一致性。
AI.method: 提出3D表示自编码器(3DRAE)，重用冻结的2D表示编码器将视图耦合的2D语义表示转换为视图解耦的3D潜在表示；然后引入3D扩散变换器(3DDiT)在该3D潜在空间中进行扩散建模。
AI.result: 该方法实现了高效且空间一致的3D场景生成，支持多种条件配置，并能沿任意相机轨迹解码为图像和可选点云图，无需每个轨迹的扩散采样过程。
AI.conclusion: 直接在隐式3D潜在空间中生成3D场景的方法解决了传统2D方法的局限性，为3D场景生成提供了更高效、更一致的新范式。

title: A Compact and Efficient 1.251 Million Parameter Machine Learning CNN Model PD36-C for Plant Disease Detection: A Case Study
summary: Deep learning has markedly advanced image based plant disease diagnosis as improved hardware and dataset quality have enabled increasingly accurate neural network models. This paper presents PD36 C, a compact convolutional neural network (1,250,694 parameters and 4.77 MB) for plant disease classification. Trained with TensorFlow Keras on the New Plant Diseases Dataset (87k images, 38 classes), PD36 C is designed for robustness and edge deployability, complemented by a Qt for Python desktop application that offers an intuitive GUI and offline inference on commodity hardware. Across experiments, training accuracy reached 0.99697 by epoch 30, and average test accuracy was 0.9953 across 38 classes. Per class performance is uniformly high; on the lower end, Corn (maize) Cercospora leaf spot achieved precision around 0.9777 and recall around 0.9634, indicating occasional confusion with visually similar categories, while on the upper end numerous classes including Apple Black rot, Cedar apple rust, Blueberry healthy, Cherry Powdery mildew, Cherry healthy, and all four grape categories achieved perfect precision 1.00 and recall of 1.00, indicating no false positives and strong coverage. These results show that with a well curated dataset and careful architectural design, small CNNs can achieve competitive accuracy compared with recent baselines while remaining practical for edge scenarios. We also note typical constraints such as adverse weather, low quality imagery, and leaves exhibiting multiple concurrent diseases that can degrade performance and warrant future work on domain robustness. Overall, PD36 C and its application pipeline contribute a field ready, efficient solution for AI assisted plant disease detection in smart agriculture.

AI.tldr: PD36 C是一个紧凑的卷积神经网络（125万参数，4.77MB），用于植物病害分类，在38类87k图像数据集上达到99.53%的平均测试准确率，并配有Qt桌面应用，适合边缘部署。
AI.motivation: 深度学习推动了基于图像的植物病害诊断，但需要开发既准确又适合边缘部署的紧凑模型，以应对智能农业中的实际应用需求。
AI.method: 提出PD36 C紧凑卷积神经网络，使用TensorFlow Keras在新植物病害数据集（87k图像，38类）上训练，并开发了Qt for Python桌面应用提供直观GUI和离线推理功能。
AI.result: 训练准确率达到99.697%，38类平均测试准确率为99.53%。多个类别（苹果黑腐病、雪松苹果锈病、蓝莓健康、樱桃白粉病等）实现完美精度和召回率（1.00），玉米叶斑病等类别精度约0.9777，召回率约0.9634。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的数据集和架构，小型CNN能在保持边缘部署实用性的同时达到与最新基准相当的准确性。PD36 C及其应用管道为智能农业中的AI辅助植物病害检测提供了现场可用的高效解决方案。

title: LEADER: Learning Reliable Local-to-Global Correspondences for LiDAR Relocalization
summary: LiDAR relocalization has attracted increasing attention as it can deliver accurate 6-DoF pose estimation in complex 3D environments. Recent learning-based regression methods offer efficient solutions by directly predicting global poses without the need for explicit map storage. However, these methods often struggle in challenging scenes due to their equal treatment of all predicted points, which is vulnerable to noise and outliers. In this paper, we propose LEADER, a robust LiDAR-based relocalization framework enhanced by a simple, yet effective geometric encoder. Specifically, a Robust Projection-based Geometric Encoder architecture which captures multi-scale geometric features is first presented to enhance descriptiveness in geometric representation. A Truncated Relative Reliability loss is then formulated to model point-wise ambiguity and mitigate the influence of unreliable predictions. Extensive experiments on the Oxford RobotCar and NCLT datasets demonstrate that LEADER outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving 24.1% and 73.9% relative reductions in position error over existing techniques, respectively. The source code is released on https://github.com/JiansW/LEADER.

AI.tldr: LEADER是一个基于LiDAR的鲁棒重定位框架，通过几何编码器和截断相对可靠性损失来提升在复杂场景中的6-DoF姿态估计精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于学习的回归方法在复杂场景中表现不佳，因为它们对所有预测点一视同仁，容易受到噪声和异常值的影响，需要更鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出了LEADER框架，包含：1）鲁棒的基于投影的几何编码器架构，捕获多尺度几何特征；2）截断相对可靠性损失函数，建模点级模糊性并减轻不可靠预测的影响。
AI.result: 在Oxford RobotCar和NCLT数据集上的实验表明，LEADER优于现有最先进方法，位置误差分别相对减少了24.1%和73.9%。
AI.conclusion: LEADER通过几何编码器和可靠性损失函数有效提升了LiDAR重定位的鲁棒性和精度，在复杂3D环境中实现了更准确的6-DoF姿态估计。

title: Beyond Reconstruction: Reconstruction-to-Vector Diffusion for Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection
summary: While Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection (HAD) excels at identifying sparse targets in complex scenes, existing models remain trapped in a scalar "reconstruction-as-endpoint" paradigm. This reliance on ambiguous scalar residuals consistently triggers sub-pixel anomaly vanishing during spatial downsampling, alongside severe confirmation bias when unpurified anomalies corrupt training weights. In this paper, we propose Reconstruction-to-Vector Diffusion (R2VD), which fundamentally redefines reconstruction as a manifold purification origin to establish a novel residual-guided generative dynamics paradigm. Our framework introduces a four-stage pipeline: (1) a Physical Prior Extraction (PPE) stage that mitigates early confirmation bias via dual-stream statistical guidance; (2) a Guided Manifold Purification (GMP) stage utilizing an OmniContext Autoencoder (OCA) to extract purified residual maps while preserving fragile sub-pixel topologies; (3) a Residual Score Modeling (RSM) stage where a Diffusion Transformer (DiT), guarded by a Physical Spectral Firewall (PSF), effectively isolates cross-spectral leakage; and (4) a Vector Dynamics Inference (VDI) stage that robustly decouples targets from backgrounds by evaluating high-dimensional vector interference patterns instead of conventional scalar errors. Comprehensive evaluations on eight datasets confirm that R2VD establishes a new state-of-the-art, delivering exceptional target detectability and background suppression.

AI.tldr: R2VD提出了一种新的高光谱异常检测范式，将重构作为流形净化起点，通过残差引导生成动力学解决传统标量重构方法中的亚像素异常消失和确认偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有高光谱异常检测模型局限于"重构即终点"的标量范式，依赖模糊的标量残差导致空间下采样时亚像素异常消失，且未净化的异常会污染训练权重产生严重确认偏差。
AI.method: 提出四阶段框架：1)物理先验提取阶段通过双流统计指导缓解早期确认偏差；2)引导流形净化阶段使用全上下文自编码器提取净化残差图并保护脆弱亚像素拓扑；3)残差评分建模阶段通过受物理光谱防火墙保护的扩散变换器隔离跨光谱泄漏；4)向量动力学推理阶段通过评估高维向量干扰模式而非传统标量误差来稳健解耦目标与背景。
AI.result: 在八个数据集上的综合评估证实R2VD建立了新的最先进水平，提供了卓越的目标可检测性和背景抑制能力。
AI.conclusion: R2VD从根本上重新定义了重构作为流形净化起点，建立了新的残差引导生成动力学范式，有效解决了传统高光谱异常检测中的关键限制。

title: Video-based Heart Rate Estimation with Angle-guided ROI Optimization and Graph Signal Denoising
comment: This paper has been accepted by ICASSP 2026
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact heart rate measurement from facial videos, but its performance is significantly degraded by facial motions such as speaking and head shaking. To address this issue, we propose two plug-and-play modules. The Angle-guided ROI Adaptive Optimization module quantifies ROI-Camera angles to refine motion-affected signals and capture global motion, while the Multi-region Joint Graph Signal Denoising module jointly models intra- and inter-regional ROI signals using graph signal processing to suppress motion artifacts. The modules are compatible with reflection model-based rPPG methods and validated on three public datasets. Results show that jointly use markedly reduces MAE, with an average decrease of 20.38\% over the baseline, while ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each module. The work demonstrates the potential of angle-guided optimization and graph-based denoising to enhance rPPG performance in motion scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出两个即插即用模块来改善面部运动对远程光电容积描记术(rPPG)心率测量的影响：角度引导的ROI自适应优化模块和多区域联合图信号去噪模块。
AI.motivation: 远程光电容积描记术(rPPG)能够从面部视频进行非接触式心率测量，但其性能在面部运动（如说话和摇头）时会显著下降，需要解决运动伪影问题。
AI.method: 提出了两个即插即用模块：1) 角度引导的ROI自适应优化模块，通过量化ROI-相机角度来优化受运动影响的信号并捕捉全局运动；2) 多区域联合图信号去噪模块，使用图信号处理联合建模区域内和区域间的ROI信号来抑制运动伪影。
AI.result: 在三个公共数据集上验证，联合使用两个模块显著降低了平均绝对误差(MAE)，相比基线平均降低了20.38%。消融研究证实了每个模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了角度引导优化和图信号去噪在运动场景中增强rPPG性能的潜力，提出的模块与基于反射模型的rPPG方法兼容。

title: Scene Change Detection with Vision-Language Representation Learning
summary: Scene change detection (SCD) is crucial for urban monitoring and navigation but remains challenging in real-world environments due to lighting variations, seasonal shifts, viewpoint differences, and complex urban layouts. Existing methods rely primarily on low-level visual features, limiting their ability to accurately identify changed objects amid the visual complexity of urban scenes. In this paper, we propose LangSCD, a vision-language framework for scene change detection that overcomes this single-modal limitation by incorporating semantic reasoning through language. Our approach introduces a modular language component that leverages vision-language models (VLMs) to generate textual descriptions of scene changes, which are fused with visual features through a cross-modal feature enhancer. We further introduce a geometric-semantic matching module that refines the predicted masks by enforcing semantic consistency and spatial completeness. Existing real-world scene change detection benchmarks provide only binary change annotations, which are insufficient for downstream applications requiring fine-grained understanding of scene dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce NYC-CD, a large-scale dataset of 8,122 real-world image pairs collected in New York City with multiclass change annotations generated through a semi-automatic pipeline. Extensive experiments across multiple street-view benchmarks demonstrate that our language and matching modules consistently improve existing change-detection architectures, achieving state-of-the-art performance and highlighting the value of integrating linguistic reasoning with visual representations for robust scene change detection.

AI.tldr: LangSCD是一个用于场景变化检测的视觉语言框架，通过语言模块增强语义理解，并在纽约市数据集上实现最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有场景变化检测方法主要依赖低层视觉特征，难以在复杂的城市环境中准确识别变化物体，且现有基准数据集仅提供二元变化标注，无法满足需要细粒度场景动态理解的下游应用需求。
AI.method: 提出LangSCD框架，包含：1）语言模块利用视觉语言模型生成场景变化的文本描述；2）跨模态特征增强器融合视觉和语言特征；3）几何语义匹配模块通过强制语义一致性和空间完整性来优化预测掩码；4）引入NYC-CD数据集，包含8,122个纽约市图像对，通过半自动流程生成多类别变化标注。
AI.result: 在多个街景基准测试上的广泛实验表明，语言和匹配模块持续改进现有变化检测架构，实现了最先进的性能，突显了将语言推理与视觉表示相结合对于鲁棒场景变化检测的价值。
AI.conclusion: LangSCD通过整合语言语义推理，克服了传统单模态方法的局限性，在复杂城市环境中实现了更准确和细粒度的场景变化检测，为下游应用提供了更好的支持。

title: Online Reasoning Video Object Segmentation
summary: Reasoning video object segmentation predicts pixel-level masks in videos from natural-language queries that may involve implicit and temporally grounded references. However, existing methods are developed and evaluated in an offline regime, where the entire video is available at inference time and future frames can be exploited for retrospective disambiguation, deviating from real-world deployments that require strictly causal, frame-by-frame decisions. We study Online Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (ORVOS), where models must incrementally interpret queries using only past and current frames without revisiting previous predictions, while handling referent shifts as events unfold. To support evaluation, we introduce ORVOSB, a benchmark with frame-level causal annotations and referent-shift labels, comprising 210 videos, 12,907 annotated frames, and 512 queries across five reasoning categories. We further propose a baseline with continually-updated segmentation prompts and a structured temporal token reservoir for long-horizon reasoning under bounded computation. Experiments show that existing methods struggle under strict causality and referent shifts, while our baseline establishes a strong foundation for future research.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在线推理视频目标分割（ORVOS），提出了一种因果推理框架，要求模型仅使用过去和当前帧进行增量解释，不能利用未来信息，并处理随时间推移的指代转移问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频目标分割方法通常在离线环境下开发评估，可以访问整个视频并利用未来帧进行回溯消歧，这与实际部署中需要严格因果、逐帧决策的场景不符。现实世界应用要求模型在仅能访问过去和当前帧的情况下进行推理。
AI.method: 提出了ORVOSB基准数据集，包含210个视频、12,907个标注帧和512个查询，涵盖五个推理类别。同时提出了一个基线方法，使用持续更新的分割提示和结构化时间令牌存储库，在有限计算下实现长时程推理。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有方法在严格因果性和指代转移条件下表现不佳，而提出的基线方法为未来研究建立了坚实基础，能够更好地处理在线推理场景。
AI.conclusion: 在线推理视频目标分割是一个重要且具有挑战性的研究方向，需要模型在仅能访问过去和当前帧的情况下进行因果推理。提出的ORVOSB基准和基线方法为这一领域的研究提供了有价值的起点。

title: Observe Less, Understand More: Cost-aware Cross-scale Observation for Remote Sensing Understanding
summary: Remote sensing understanding inherently requires multi-resolution observation, since different targets and application tasks demand different levels of spatial detail. While low-resolution (LR) imagery enables efficient global observation, high-resolution (HR) imagery provides critical local details at much higher acquisition cost and limited coverage. This motivates a cross-scale sensing strategy that selectively acquires HR imagery from LR-based global perception to improve task performance under constrained cost. Existing methods for HR sampling methods typically make selection decisions from isolated LR patches, which ignore fine-grained intra-patch importance and cross-patch contextual interactions, leading to fragmented feature representation and suboptimal scene reasoning under sparse HR observations. To address this issue, we formulate cross-scale remote sensing understanding as a unified cost-aware problem that couples fine-grained HR sampling with cross-patch representation prediction, enabling more effective task reasoning with fewer HR observations. Furthermore, we present GL-10M, a large-scale benchmark of 10 million spatially aligned multi-resolution images, enabling systematic evaluation of budget-constrained cross-scale reasoning in remote sensing. Extensive experiments on recognition and retrieval tasks show that our method consistently achieves a superior performance-cost trade-off.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种跨尺度遥感理解方法，通过细粒度高分辨率采样与跨块表示预测相结合，在有限成本下实现更有效的任务推理，并构建了包含1000万张空间对齐多分辨率图像的大规模基准数据集GL-10M。
AI.motivation: 遥感理解需要多分辨率观测，低分辨率图像可实现高效全局观测，而高分辨率图像提供关键局部细节但成本高、覆盖有限。现有高分辨率采样方法通常从孤立的低分辨率块做出选择决策，忽略了细粒度块内重要性和跨块上下文交互，导致稀疏高分辨率观测下的特征表示碎片化和次优场景推理。
AI.method: 将跨尺度遥感理解制定为统一的成本感知问题，耦合细粒度高分辨率采样与跨块表示预测，实现更有效任务推理。同时构建了GL-10M大规模基准数据集，包含1000万张空间对齐的多分辨率图像，用于系统评估预算约束下的跨尺度推理。
AI.result: 在识别和检索任务上的大量实验表明，该方法在性能与成本权衡方面始终优于现有方法，在有限高分辨率观测下实现了更优的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的跨尺度遥感理解框架通过统一成本感知方法，结合细粒度采样和跨块表示预测，在约束成本下实现了更有效的任务推理，为遥感领域提供了新的解决方案和大规模评估基准。

title: HuiYanEarth-SAR: A Foundation Model for High-Fidelity and Low-Cost Global Remote Sensing Imagery Generation
summary: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery generation is essential for deepening the study of scattering mechanisms, establishing trustworthy electromagnetic scene models, and fundamentally alleviating the data scarcity bottleneck that constrains development in this field. However, existing methods find it difficult to simultaneously ensure high fidelity in both global geospatial semantics and microscopic scattering mechanisms, resulting in severe challenges for global generation. To address this, we propose \textbf{HuiYanEarth-SAR}, the first foundational SAR imagery generation model based on AlphaEarth and integrated scattering mechanisms. By injecting geospatial priors to control macroscopic structures and utilizing implicit scattering characteristic modeling to ensure the authenticity of microscopic textures, we achieve the capability of generating high-fidelity SAR images for global locations solely based on geographic coordinates. This study not only constructs an efficient SAR scene simulator but also establishes a bridge connecting geography, scatter mechanism, and artificial intelligence from a methodological standpoint. It advances SAR research by expanding the paradigm from perception and understanding to simulation and creation, providing key technical support for constructing a high-confidence digital twin of the Earth.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了HuiYanEarth-SAR，首个基于AlphaEarth和集成散射机制的合成孔径雷达图像生成基础模型，能够仅根据地理坐标生成高保真全球SAR图像。
AI.motivation: SAR图像生成对于研究散射机制、建立可信电磁场景模型、缓解数据稀缺瓶颈至关重要。现有方法难以同时保证全局地理空间语义和微观散射机制的高保真度，导致全局生成面临严重挑战。
AI.method: 提出HuiYanEarth-SAR基础模型，通过注入地理空间先验控制宏观结构，利用隐式散射特征建模确保微观纹理真实性，实现仅基于地理坐标生成高保真SAR图像。
AI.result: 构建了高效的SAR场景模拟器，建立了连接地理学、散射机制和人工智能的方法桥梁，实现了从感知理解到模拟创造的范式扩展。
AI.conclusion: 该研究不仅构建了SAR场景模拟器，还从方法论角度连接了地理学、散射机制和人工智能，为构建高置信度地球数字孪生提供了关键技术支撑，推动了SAR研究从感知理解向模拟创造的范式转变。

title: Beyond Model Design: Data-Centric Training and Self-Ensemble for Gaussian Color Image Denoising
summary: This paper presents our solution to the NTIRE 2026 Image Denoising Challenge (Gaussian color image denoising at fixed noise level $σ= 50$). Rather than proposing a new restoration backbone, we revisit the performance boundary of the mature Restormer architecture from two complementary directions: stronger data-centric training and more complete Test-Time capability release. Starting from the public Restormer $σ\!=\!50$ baseline, we expand the standard multi-dataset training recipe with larger and more diverse public image corpora and organize optimization into two stages. At inference, we apply $\times 8$ geometric self-ensemble to further release model capacity. A TLC-style local inference wrapper is retained for implementation consistency; however, systematic ablation reveals its quantitative contribution to be negligible in this setting. On the challenge validation set of 100 images, our final submission achieves 30.762 dB PSNR and 0.861 SSIM, improving over the public Restormer $σ\!=\!50$ pretrained baseline by up to 3.366 dB PSNR. Ablation studies show that the dominant gain originates from the expanded training corpus and the two-stage optimization schedule, and self-ensemble provides marginal but consistent improvement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了NTIRE 2026图像去噪挑战的解决方案，通过数据增强和测试时自集成技术，在成熟的Restormer架构上实现了显著性能提升
AI.motivation: 探索成熟Restormer架构的性能边界，而非提出新的网络结构。通过数据中心的训练方法和完整的测试时能力释放来提升去噪性能
AI.method: 1. 从公开的Restormer σ=50基线开始；2. 使用更大更多样的公开图像数据集扩展标准多数据集训练；3. 采用两阶段优化策略；4. 推理时应用×8几何自集成；5. 保留TLC风格的局部推理包装器
AI.result: 在挑战验证集上达到30.762 dB PSNR和0.861 SSIM，比公开的Restormer σ=50预训练基线提升高达3.366 dB PSNR。消融研究表明主要增益来自扩展的训练语料库和两阶段优化计划
AI.conclusion: 通过数据中心的训练方法和测试时自集成技术，可以在成熟的Restormer架构上实现显著的性能提升，证明了在现有架构基础上通过优化训练和推理策略的重要性

title: Degradation-Aware and Structure-Preserving Diffusion for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
summary: Real-world image super-resolution is particularly challenging for diffusion models because real degradations are complex, heterogeneous, and rarely modeled explicitly. We propose a degradation-aware and structure-preserving diffusion framework for real-world SR. Specifically, we introduce Degradation-aware Token Injection, which encodes lightweight degradation statistics from low-resolution inputs and fuses them with semantic conditioning features, enabling explicit degradation-aware restoration. We further propose Spatially Asymmetric Noise Injection, which modulates diffusion noise with local edge strength to better preserve structural regions during training. Both modules are lightweight add-ons to the adopted diffusion SR framework, requiring only minor modifications to the conditioning pipeline. Experiments on DIV2K and RealSR show that our method delivers competitive no-reference perceptual quality and visually more realistic restoration results than recent baselines, while maintaining a favorable perception--distortion trade-off. Ablations confirm the effectiveness of each module and their complementary gains when combined. The code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/jiyang0315/DASP-SR.git.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对真实世界图像超分辨率的退化感知和结构保持扩散框架，通过退化感知令牌注入和空间非对称噪声注入来提升恢复质量。
AI.motivation: 真实世界图像超分辨率对扩散模型具有挑战性，因为真实退化复杂、异质且很少被显式建模。现有方法难以同时处理复杂的退化模式并保持图像结构。
AI.method: 提出两个轻量级模块：1) 退化感知令牌注入：从低分辨率输入编码轻量级退化统计信息，与语义条件特征融合，实现显式的退化感知恢复；2) 空间非对称噪声注入：根据局部边缘强度调制扩散噪声，在训练过程中更好地保持结构区域。
AI.result: 在DIV2K和RealSR数据集上的实验表明，该方法在无参考感知质量方面具有竞争力，视觉上比现有基线更真实，同时保持了良好的感知-失真权衡。消融实验证实了每个模块的有效性及其组合时的互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 提出的退化感知和结构保持扩散框架通过两个轻量级模块有效解决了真实世界图像超分辨率中的复杂退化问题，在保持结构的同时实现了更真实的恢复效果。

title: PACO: Proxy-Task Alignment and Online Calibration for On-the-Fly Category Discovery
summary: On-the-Fly Category Discovery (OCD) requires a model, trained on an offline support set, to recognize known classes while discovering new ones from an online streaming sequence. Existing methods focus heavily on offline training. They aim to learn discriminative representations on the support set so that novel classes can be separated at test time. However, their discovery mechanism at inference is typically reduced to a single threshold. We argue that this paradigm is fundamentally flawed as OCD is not a static classification problem, but a dynamic process. The model must continuously decide 1) whether a sample belongs to a known class, 2) matches an existing novel category, or 3) should initiate a new one. Moreover, prior methods treat the support set as fixed knowledge. They do not update their decision boundaries as new evidence arrives during inference. This leads to unstable and inconsistent category formation. Our experiments confirm these issues. With properly calibrated and adaptive thresholds, substantial improvements can be achieved, even without changing the representation. Motivated by this, we propose PACO, a support-set-calibrated, tree-structured online decision framework. The framework models inference as a sequence of hierarchical decisions, including known-class routing, birth-aware novel assignment, and attach-versus-create operations over a dynamic prototype memory. Furthermore, we simulate the proxy discovery process to initialize the thresholds during offline training to align with inference. Thresholds are continuously updated during inference using mature novel prototypes. Importantly, PACO requires no heavy training and no dataset-specific tuning. It can be directly integrated into existing OCD pipelines as an inference-time module. Extensive experiments show significant improvements over SOTA baselines across seven benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PACO框架，通过支持集校准的树状在线决策机制解决动态类别发现问题，无需重新训练即可显著提升现有OCD方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有OCD方法过度依赖离线训练，将发现机制简化为单一阈值，忽略了OCD本质上是动态过程，需要持续判断样本属于已知类别、匹配现有新类别还是创建新类别。同时，它们将支持集视为固定知识，不在推理过程中更新决策边界，导致类别形成不稳定和不一致。
AI.method: 提出PACO框架：1）将推理建模为分层决策序列，包括已知类别路由、出生感知新类别分配、以及动态原型内存上的附加与创建操作；2）在离线训练期间通过模拟代理发现过程初始化阈值以与推理对齐；3）在推理过程中使用成熟的新类别原型持续更新阈值。该框架无需重新训练，可直接作为推理时模块集成到现有OCD流程中。
AI.result: 在七个基准测试上相比现有最先进方法取得显著改进，即使不改变表示学习，仅通过适当校准和自适应阈值也能实现大幅性能提升。
AI.conclusion: OCD应被视为动态过程而非静态分类问题，PACO框架通过支持集校准的树状在线决策机制有效解决了现有方法的局限性，提供了一种轻量级、无需重新训练即可提升OCD性能的解决方案。

title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Robust AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild
comment: CVPR 2026 NTIRE Workshop Paper, Robust AI-Generated Image Detection Technical Report
summary: This paper presents an overview of the NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Robust AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild, held in conjunction with the NTIRE workshop at CVPR 2026. The goal of this challenge was to develop detection models capable of distinguishing real images from generated ones in realistic scenarios: the images are often transformed (cropped, resized, compressed, blurred) for practical usage, and therefore, the detection models should be robust to such transformations. The challenge is based on a novel dataset consisting of 108,750 real and 185,750 AI-generated images from 42 generators comprising a large variety of open-source and closed-source models of various architectures, augmented with 36 image transformations. Methods were evaluated using ROC AUC on the full test set, including both transformed and untransformed images. A total of 511 participants registered, with 20 teams submitting valid final solutions. This report provides a comprehensive overview of the challenge, describes the proposed solutions, and can be used as a valuable reference for researchers and practitioners in increasing the robustness of the detection models to real-world transformations.

AI.tldr: NTIRE 2026挑战赛专注于开发能够区分真实图像与AI生成图像的鲁棒检测模型，特别关注图像在现实使用中可能经历的各种变换（裁剪、压缩、模糊等）。
AI.motivation: 随着AI生成图像技术的快速发展，区分真实图像与AI生成图像的需求日益迫切。然而，现实场景中的图像通常会经历各种变换处理，现有检测模型对这些变换的鲁棒性不足，因此需要开发能够在真实世界场景中有效工作的检测模型。
AI.method: 挑战赛基于包含108,750张真实图像和185,750张AI生成图像的新数据集，涵盖42种生成器模型，并使用36种图像变换进行增强。参与者开发检测模型，通过ROC AUC指标在包含变换和未变换图像的完整测试集上进行评估。
AI.result: 共有511名参与者注册，20个团队提交了有效的最终解决方案。挑战赛成功推动了鲁棒AI生成图像检测技术的发展，为研究人员和从业者提供了有价值的参考。
AI.conclusion: NTIRE 2026挑战赛强调了开发对现实世界变换具有鲁棒性的AI生成图像检测模型的重要性，为未来研究提供了基准和方向，有助于提升检测模型在实际应用中的可靠性。

title: TAG-Head: Time-Aligned Graph Head for Plug-and-Play Fine-grained Action Recognition
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, to appear in ICPR 2026
summary: Fine-grained human action recognition (FHAR) is challenging because visually similar actions differ by subtle spatio-temporal cues. Many recent systems enhance discriminability with extra modalities (e.g., pose, text, optical flow), but this increases annotation burden and computational cost. We introduce TAG-Head, a lightweight spatio-temporal graph head that upgrades standard 3D backbones (SlowFast, R(2+1)D-34, I3D, etc.) for FHAR using RGB only. Our pipeline first applies a Transformer encoder with learnable 3D positional encodings to the backbone tokens, capturing long-range dependencies across space and time. The resulting features are then refined by a graph in which (i) fully-connected intra-frame edges to resolve subtle appearance differences within frames, and (ii) time-aligned temporal edges that connect features at the same spatial location across frames to stabilise motion cues without over-smoothing. The head is compact (little parameter/FLOP overhead), plug-and-play across backbones, and trained end-to-end with the backbone. Extensive evaluations on FineGym (Gym99 and Gym288) and HAA500 show that TAG-Head sets a new state-of-the-art among RGB-only models and surpasses many recent multimodal approaches (video + pose + text) that rely on privileged information. Ablations disentangle the contributions of the Transformer and the graph topology, and complexity analyses confirm low latency. TAG-Head advances FHAR by explicitly coupling global context with high-resolution spatial interactions and low-variance temporal continuity inside a slim, composable graph head. The simplicity of the design enables straightforward adoption in practical systems that favour RGB-only sensors, while delivering performance gains typically associated with heavier or multimodal models. Code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: TAG-Head是一个轻量级时空图头部模块，仅使用RGB视频就能提升3D主干网络在细粒度人体动作识别中的性能，超越了许多需要额外模态（姿态、文本、光流）的多模态方法。
AI.motivation: 细粒度人体动作识别（FHAR）面临视觉相似动作难以区分的挑战。现有方法通常依赖额外模态（姿态、文本、光流）来提高区分度，但这增加了标注负担和计算成本。因此需要一种仅使用RGB视频就能达到高性能的轻量级解决方案。
AI.method: TAG-Head包含两个主要组件：1）带有可学习3D位置编码的Transformer编码器，用于捕捉跨时空的长距离依赖关系；2）图网络，包含全连接帧内边（解决帧内细微外观差异）和时间对齐的时序边（连接跨帧相同空间位置的特征，稳定运动线索）。该模块紧凑、即插即用，可与各种3D主干网络（SlowFast、R(2+1)D-34、I3D等）端到端训练。
AI.result: 在FineGym（Gym99和Gym288）和HAA500数据集上的广泛评估表明，TAG-Head在仅使用RGB的模型中达到了新的最先进水平，甚至超越了许多依赖特权信息（视频+姿态+文本）的多模态方法。消融实验验证了Transformer和图拓扑的贡献，复杂度分析确认了低延迟特性。
AI.conclusion: TAG-Head通过在一个轻量级可组合图头中显式耦合全局上下文与高分辨率空间交互以及低方差时序连续性，推进了细粒度人体动作识别。该设计的简洁性使其易于在实际系统中采用，同时提供了通常需要更重或多模态模型才能达到的性能增益。

title: SVD-Prune: Training-Free Token Pruning For Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLM) have revolutionized multimodal learning by jointly processing visual and textual information. Yet, they face significant challenges due to the high computational and memory demands of processing long sequences of vision tokens. Many existing methods rely on local heuristics, such as attention scores or token norms. However, these criteria suffer from positional bias and information dispersion, limiting their ability to preserve essential content at high pruning ratios and leading to performance degradation on visually detailed images. To address these issues, we propose SVD-Prune, a trainingfree, plug-and-play token pruning method based on Singular Value Decomposition. It decomposes the vision token feature matrix and selects the top-K tokens using statistical leverage scores, ensuring only tokens contributing most to the dominant global variance are preserved. Experiments show that SVD-Prune consistently outperforms prior pruning methods under extreme vision token budgets, maintaining strong performance even with 32 and 16 vision tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出SVD-Prune方法，基于奇异值分解实现无需训练、即插即用的视觉token剪枝，解决现有方法在高剪枝率下性能下降的问题
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型处理长序列视觉token时面临高计算和内存需求，现有基于注意力分数或token范数的局部启发式方法存在位置偏差和信息分散问题，在高剪枝率下难以保留关键内容，导致在视觉细节丰富的图像上性能下降
AI.method: 提出SVD-Prune方法，基于奇异值分解对视觉token特征矩阵进行分解，使用统计杠杆分数选择top-K个token，确保只保留对主导全局方差贡献最大的token
AI.result: 实验表明SVD-Prune在极端视觉token预算下（32和16个token）持续优于现有剪枝方法，保持强大性能
AI.conclusion: SVD-Prune是一种无需训练、即插即用的token剪枝方法，通过奇异值分解有效解决现有方法的局限性，在高剪枝率下仍能保持模型性能

title: CLAY: Conditional Visual Similarity Modulation in Vision-Language Embedding Space
summary: Human perception of visual similarity is inherently adaptive and subjective, depending on the users' interests and focus. However, most image retrieval systems fail to reflect this flexibility, relying on a fixed, monolithic metric that cannot incorporate multiple conditions simultaneously. To address this, we propose CLAY, an adaptive similarity computation method that reframes the embedding space of pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as a text-conditional similarity space without additional training. This design separates the textual conditioning process and visual feature extraction, allowing highly efficient and multi-conditioned retrieval with fixed visual embeddings. We also construct a synthetic evaluation dataset CLAY-EVAL, for comprehensive assessment under diverse conditioned retrieval settings. Experiments on standard datasets and our proposed dataset show that CLAY achieves high retrieval accuracy and notable computational efficiency compared to previous works.

AI.tldr: CLAY是一种自适应图像相似度计算方法，利用预训练视觉语言模型构建文本条件相似度空间，无需额外训练即可实现多条件检索
AI.motivation: 当前图像检索系统通常使用固定的相似度度量，无法反映人类视觉相似性感知的自适应性和主观性，也无法同时纳入多个条件
AI.method: 将预训练视觉语言模型的嵌入空间重构为文本条件相似度空间，分离文本条件处理和视觉特征提取，使用固定视觉嵌入实现高效多条件检索
AI.result: 在标准数据集和自建的CLAY-EVAL数据集上，CLAY实现了高检索精度和显著的计算效率提升
AI.conclusion: CLAY提供了一种无需训练的自适应相似度计算方法，能够灵活反映用户兴趣和关注点，在图像检索中实现高效的多条件查询

title: Progressively Texture-Aware Diffusion for Contrast-Enhanced Sparse-View CT
summary: Diffusion-based sparse-view CT (SVCT) imaging has achieved remarkable advancements in recent years, thanks to its more stable generative capability. However, recovering reliable image content and visually consistent textures is still a crucial challenge. In this paper, we present a Progressively Texture-aware Diffusion (PTD) model, a coarse-to-fine learning framework tailored for SVCT. Specifically, PTD comprises a basic reconstructive module PTD$_{\textit{rec}}$ and a conditional diffusion module PTD$_{\textit{diff}}$. PTD$_{\textit{rec}}$ first learns a deterministic mapping to recover the majority of the underlying low-frequency signals (i.e., coarse content with smoothed textures), which serves as the initial estimation to enable fidelity. Moreover, PTD$_{\textit{diff}}$ aims to reconstruct high-fidelity details for coarse prediction, which explores a dual-domain guided conditional diffusion to generate reliable and consistent textures. Extensive experiments on sparse-view CT reconstruction demonstrate that our PTD achieves superior performance in terms of structure similarity and visual appeal with only a few sampling steps, which mitigates the randomness inherent in general diffusion models and enables a better trade-off between visual quality and fidelity of high-frequency details.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种渐进式纹理感知扩散模型（PTD），通过粗到细的学习框架解决稀疏视图CT重建中的纹理一致性问题，结合确定性重建模块和条件扩散模块，在保证保真度的同时生成视觉一致的高频细节。
AI.motivation: 虽然基于扩散的稀疏视图CT成像近年来取得了显著进展，但恢复可靠的图像内容和视觉一致的纹理仍然是一个关键挑战。现有方法在生成稳定性和纹理一致性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出PTD模型，包含两个模块：1）PTD_rec重建模块，学习确定性映射恢复低频信号（粗糙内容和平滑纹理），提供初始估计保证保真度；2）PTD_diff条件扩散模块，采用双域引导的条件扩散为粗糙预测重建高保真细节，生成可靠且一致的纹理。
AI.result: 在稀疏视图CT重建的广泛实验中，PTD在结构相似性和视觉吸引力方面表现出优越性能，仅需少量采样步骤，缓解了一般扩散模型的随机性，实现了视觉质量和高频细节保真度之间的更好平衡。
AI.conclusion: PTD模型通过渐进式纹理感知的粗到细学习框架，有效解决了稀疏视图CT重建中的纹理一致性问题，在保证图像保真度的同时生成了视觉一致的高频细节，为医学影像重建提供了有效解决方案。

title: The Impact of Federated Learning on Distributed Remote Sensing Archives
comment: This work was completed in 2021. It is posted as a historical record and reference baseline
